name: Call of the Void
description: A supernatural compulsion to leap into the unknown exerts itself on anyone who approaches the ledge.
disable: @Check[occultism|dc:34|name:Expel Magical Compulsion] or @Check[arcana|dc:36|name:Expel Magical Compulsion] to expel the magical compulsion from the current island and from any of the red ropes directly attached to it, darkening the rope in color. The Echo also automatically disables the hazard from any island he's standing on, and any of the red ropes directly attached to it, when he Reconstitutes from Thought on that island.
reset: The call of the void persists as long as the Echo exists, though it doesn't activate until the Echo has rolled initiative. The hazard resets each day.
routine: (1 action) The call targets all creatures adjacent to a ledge or on one of the red ropes and tugs at their minds. A creature who has already fallen this round is immune.
stealth: (expert) to notice a slight tugging feeling

actions.name: Leap into the Unknown
actions.description:
Trigger A creature enters a square adjacent to the ledge of an island or steps onto one of the red ropes

Effect The call of the void tugs at the mind of intruders, compelling them to leap off the ledge. The creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:34] save or @Check[acrobatics|dc:32|traits:action:balance] check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} or else drop off the ledge. If the creature falls off, it drops 100 feet, loops through the closed space of the mindscape, and lands in the square it fell from, taking falling damage as normal (usually @Damage[50[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage] damage). The call of the void then rolls initiative.

fr.name: Sauter dans l'inconnu
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature pénètre dans une case adjacente du rebord d'une île ou s'engage sur l'une des cordes rouges

Effet L'appel du néant attire l'attention des intrus, les poussant à sauter de la corniche. La créature doit réussir un jet de @Check[will|dc:34] ou un test d'@Check[acrobatics|dc:32|traits:action:balance] pour @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Garder l'équilibre} ou sauter de la corniche. Si la créature tombe, elle chute de 30 mètres, traverse l'espace clos du paysage mental et atterrit sur la case d'où elle est tombée, subissant les dégâts de chute comme à l'ordinaire (habituellement @Damage[50[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage]{50 dégâts contondants}). Puis, l'appel du néant lance l'initiative.

zh.name: 跃入未知 Leap into the Unknown
zh.description:
触发 当一名生物进入到岛屿边缘的方格，或是登上一条红绳

效果 虚空的呼唤牵动着入侵者的思绪，迫使他们从边缘处一跃而下。该生物必须通过一次成功的@Check[will|dc:34]豁免或@Check[acrobatics|dc:32|traits:action:balance]检定来@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]，否则便会落入虚空。若生物跌落，其将坠落100尺，并由于思维空间的封闭循环，落回到其跌落时的位置，照常承受坠落伤害（通常是@Damage[50[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage]伤害）。随后，虚空的呼唤进行先攻检定。

fr.name: Appel du néant
fr.description: Une compulsion surnaturelle à sauter dans l'inconnu s'exerce sur tous ceux qui s'approchent de la corniche
fr.disable: @Check[occultism|dc:34|name:Repousser cette compulsion magique] ou d'@Check[arcana|dc:36|name:Repousser cette compulsion magique] pour repousser la compulsion magique de l'île en question et de toutes les cordes rouges qui y sont directement attachées, en assombrissant la couleur de la corde. L'Écho désactive aussi automatiquement le danger de toute île sur laquelle il se trouve, et de toute corde rouge qui y est directement attachée, lorsqu'il se reconstitue à partir de la Pensée sur cette île.
fr.reset: L'appel du néant persiste pour aussi longtemps que l'Écho existe, quoique l'appel ne s'active que lorsque l'Écho ait lancé l'initiative. Le piège se réinitialise chaque jour.
fr.routine: (1 action) L'appel cible toutes les créatures adjacentes à une corniche ou sur l'une des cordes rouges et exerce une pression sur leur esprit. Une créature qui est déjà tombée ce round est immunisée.

zh.name: 虚空的呼唤 Call of the Void
zh.description: 一股超自然的冲动，促使那些临近边缘之人跃入未知当中。
zh.disable: @Check[occultism|dc:34|name:Expel Magical Compulsion]或@Check[arcana|dc:36|name:Expel Magical Compulsion]驱逐当前岛屿以及任何与之直接相连的红绳上的魔法冲动，绳索的颜色会就此变得黯淡下去。当回声在岛上执行汲思重构行动时，其所在岛屿以及任何与之直接相连的红绳上的危害也会立刻解除。
zh.reset: 只要回声依旧存在，虚空的呼唤就不会消失。不过，只有在回声进行完他的先攻检定之后，虚空的呼唤才会启动。该危害每天都会重置。
zh.routine: （1动作）虚空的呼唤会以所有邻近边缘以及位于红绳上的生物作为目标，牵动他们的思绪。一名在本回合中已经跌落过的生物将会免疫本次效果。
zh.stealth: （专家）来注意到一种轻微的拉扯感

pl.name: Call of the Void
pl.description: A supernatural compulsion to leap into the unknown exerts itself on anyone who approaches the ledge.
pl.disable: @Check[occultism|dc:34|name:Expel Magical Compulsion] or @Check[arcana|dc:36|name:Expel Magical Compulsion] to expel the magical compulsion from the current island and from any of the red ropes directly attached to it, darkening the rope in color. The Echo also automatically disables the hazard from any island he's standing on, and any of the red ropes directly attached to it, when he Reconstitutes from Thought on that island.
pl.reset: The call of the void persists as long as the Echo exists, though it doesn't activate until the Echo has rolled initiative. The hazard resets each day.
pl.routine: (1 action) The call targets all creatures adjacent to a ledge or on one of the red ropes and tugs at their minds. A creature who has already fallen this round is immune.
pl.stealth: (expert) to notice a slight tugging feeling

name: Camazotz's Swarm
description: A massive swarm of bats flies throughout the room, hampering vision, attacking foes, and magically restoring Camazotz's followers.
disable: @Check[nature|dc:17] (trained) to disperse the swarm or @Check[religion|dc:15] (trained) to disrupt Camazotz's connection, which disperses the swarm
reset: The swarm disperses and returns to roost throughout the room 1 minute after all enemies leave the room. The swarm recovers 5 Hit Points per day thanks the power of Camazotz.
routine: (2 actions) The swarm uses its first action to move up to 30 feet to envelop as many enemies as possible within its @Template[type:burst|distance:30] space. All enemies in the swarm's space become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} while within the swarm. It then uses its second action to bite all enemies, dealing @Damage[(1d6+3)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save) to all enemies in the space.

actions.name: Swarming Descent
actions.description:
Trigger A creature that's not a worshipper of Camazotz enters the room

Effect The hundreds of bats descend down into the room in a terrifying, shrieking mass. The swarm occupies a @Template[type:burst|distance:30] on the floor of the room. All enemies within this area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:17] save. On a failure, a creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure). The swarm then rolls initiative.

zh.name: Swarming Descent
zh.description:
Trigger A creature that's not a worshipper of Camazotz enters the room

Effect The hundreds of bats descend down into the room in a terrifying, shrieking mass. The swarm occupies a @Template[type:burst|distance:30] on the floor of the room. All enemies within this area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:17] save. On a failure, a creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure). The swarm then rolls initiative.

actions.name: Restore Follower
actions.description:
Requirements An ally is in the swarm's space

Trigger The swarm dealt damage to an enemy

Effect The swarm takes some of the blood it drank from an enemy and feeds it to an ally in its space. The ally restores Hit Points equal to the highest damage the swarm dealt to an enemy this turn.

zh.name: Restore Follower
zh.description:
Requirements An ally is in the swarm's space

Trigger The swarm dealt damage to an enemy

Effect The swarm takes some of the blood it drank from an enemy and feeds it to an ally in its space. The ally restores Hit Points equal to the highest damage the swarm dealt to an enemy this turn.

pl.description: A massive swarm of bats flies throughout the room, hampering vision, attacking foes, and magically restoring Camazotz's followers.
pl.disable: @Check[nature|dc:17] (trained) to disperse the swarm or @Check[religion|dc:15] (trained) to disrupt Camazotz's connection, which disperses the swarm
pl.reset: The swarm disperses and returns to roost throughout the room 1 minute after all enemies leave the room. The swarm recovers 5 Hit Points per day thanks the power of Camazotz.
pl.routine: (2 actions) The swarm uses its first action to move up to 30 feet to envelop as many enemies as possible within its @Template[type:burst|distance:30] space. All enemies in the swarm's space become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} while within the swarm. It then uses its second action to bite all enemies, dealing @Damage[(1d6+3)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save) to all enemies in the space.

name: Camouflaged Spiked Pit
description: A 20-foot deep, funnel-shaped pit with dozens of wooden spikes lining its walls.
disable: Yanking the cloth away is a simple way to expose the danger to allow someone to merely avoid it by walking around its edges, but it cannot be quickly disabled.
reset: Creatures can still fall into the trap once it has been exposed, but the camouflaged cover must be reset manually for the trap to become hidden again.

actions.name: Spiked Pitfall
actions.description:
Trigger A creature walks onto one of the pits

Effect The triggering creature falls and rolls through several spikes as it slides to the bottom. This inflicts @Damage[5[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage] damage from the fall itself down the steep slope (the falling PC can't attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} due to the lack of defined edges to the pit's walls), but the falling PC must also attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:26|traits:damaging-effect] save.

Critical Success The character avoids all of the spikes and takes no additional damage.

Success The character takes @Damage[(2d10+11)[piercing]] damage from the spikes.

Failure The character takes @Damage[(4d10+22)[piercing]] damage from the spikes.

Critical Failure The character takes @Damage[(4d10+22)[piercing]] damage from the spikes plus @Damage[2d6[bleed]] damage. While the character is taking this bleed damage, they are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} from the pain.

fr.name: Fosse garnie d'épieux
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature tombe dans une des fosses.

Effet La créature déclencheuse tombe et se prend plusieurs pieux dans sa chute vers le fond. Elle subit @Damage[5[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage]{5 dégâts} de la chute (le PJ qui tombe ne peut pas tenter de Se raccrocher in extrémis, car les bords de la fosse ne sont pas clairement définis), et doit aussi tenter un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:26|traits:damaging-effect].

Succès critique Le personnage évite les pieux et ne subit aucun dégât supplémentaire.

Succès Le personnage subit @Damage[(2d10+11)[piercing]]{2d10+11 dégâts perforants} des pieux.

Échec Le personnage subit @Damage[(4d10+22)[piercing]]{4d10+22 dégâts perforants} des pieux.

Échec critique Le personnage subit @Damage[(4d10+22)[piercing]]{4d10+22 dégâts perforants} des pieux plus @Damage[2d6[bleed]]{2d6 dégâts de saignement}. Aussi longtemps que le personnage subit des dégâts de saignement, il est aussi @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Nauséeux 2} à cause de la douleur.

zh.name: 尖刺陷坑 Spiked Pitfall
zh.description:
触发 有生物走入其中1处陷坑

效果 触发生物在滑入陷坑底部其间会坠落并滚过数个尖刺。跌落本身会造成@Damage[5[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage]伤害（由于陷坑坑壁与地面之间没有明显边缘，因此坠落PC无法在此期间尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]），除此之外坠落 PC 还必须尝试@Check[reflex|dc:26|traits:damaging-effect]豁免

大成功 角色避开所有尖刺，因此没有受任何额外伤害

成功 角色由于尖刺而承受@Damage[(2d10+11)[piercing]]伤害

失败 角色由于尖刺而承受@Damage[(4d10+22)[piercing]]伤害

大失败 角色由于尖刺而承受@Damage[(4d10+22)[piercing]]伤害和@Damage[2d6[bleed]]伤害。由于角色承受了该流血伤害，他还会由于疼痛而陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 2}

fr.name: Fosse camouflée hérissée de pieux
fr.description: Une fosse d'une profondeur de 6 mètres en forme d'entonnoir a été creusée, tapissée de pieux qui garnissent les murs.
fr.disable: Enlever la pièce de camouflage est une façon très simple d'exposer le piège et empêcher quiconque de tomber dedans.
fr.reset: Des créatures pourraient encore tomber dedans même exposé, mais le camouflage doit être remis en place manuellement pour être à nouveau caché.

zh.name: 伪装尖刺陷坑 Camouflaged Spiked Pit
zh.description: 20尺深的漏斗形陷坑，坑壁上设置了几十个木制尖刺。
zh.disable: 把伪装用的布料拉开是暴露这些危险的最简单的手段，这让人能够沿着它的边缘绕开陷坑，但这种陷阱无法被快速解除。
zh.reset: 角色在陷阱被暴露之后仍旧可能跌入其中，但只有重新设置陷坑上方的伪装才能重置陷阱并使其重新隐藏起来。

pl.name: Zakamuflowany Dół z Kolcami
pl.description: Głęboki na 20 stóp dół w kształcie leja z dziesiątkami drewnianych kolców na ścianach.
pl.disable: Wyszarpnięcie tkaniny to prosty sposób na ujawnienie niebezpieczeństwa i umożliwienie komuś jego uniknięcia poprzez obejście krawędzi, ale nie można tego szybko wyłączyć.
pl.reset: Stworzenia nadal mogą wpaść do pułapki po jej odsłonięciu, ale zakamuflowana osłona musi zostać zresetowana ręcznie, aby pułapka ponownie się ukryła.

name: Cannibalistic Echoes
description: A pack of cannibalistic spirits swarm through the area, devouring living creatures.
disable: @Check[intimidation|dc:40|name:Drive off the spirits] (master) to drive the spirits off with a ferocious display or @Check[occultism|dc:42|name:Exorcise the spirits] (expert) to exorcise the spirits
reset: 1 day
stealth: (master) to sense something unusual lurking in the area's echoes

actions.name: Feast
actions.description:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 10 feet

Effect The spirits bite and chew, dealing @Damage[(6d12+35)[piercing]] damage to each creature within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 feet}. Affected creatures must each attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:41] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage, @Damage[2d8[bleed]], and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, @Damage[4d8[bleed]], and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}.

fr.name: Festoyer
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature vivante s'approche dans les 3 mètres.

Effet Les esprits mordent et mâchonnent, infligeant @Damage[(6d12+35)[piercing]]{6d12+35 dégâts perforants} à chaque créature dans une @Template[emanation|distance:30]{émanation 9 mètres}. Les créatures affectées doivent chacune tenter un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:41].

Succès critique La créature n'est pas affectée.

Succès La créature subit la moitié des dégâts.

Échec La créature subit la totalité des dégâts, @Damage[2d8[bleed]]{2d8 dégâts de saignement} et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drainée 1}.

Échec critique La créature subit le double des dégâts, @Damage[4d8[bleed]]{4d8 dégâts de saignement} et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drainée 2}.

zh.name: 盛宴 Feast
zh.description:
触发 一个活物接近作祟10尺内；

效果 鬼魂噬咬咀嚼，对@Template[emanation|distance:30]{30尺}内的所有生物造成@Damage[(6d12+35)[piercing]]伤害。受影响的生物必须尝试一次@Check[reflex|dc:41]豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全伤害，@Damage[2d8[bleed]]伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 Drained 1}。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，@Damage[4d8[bleed]]伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 Drained 2}。

fr.name: Échos cannibalistes
fr.description: Une meute d'esprits cannibales envahit la zone, dévorant toute créature vivante
fr.disable: @Check[intimidation|dc:40|name:Chasser les esprits] (maître) pour chasser les esprits avec une démonstration de férocité ou @Check[occultism|dc:42|name:Exorciserles esprits] (expert) pour exorciser les esprits.
fr.reset: 1 jour
fr.stealth: Maître pour percevoir quelque chose d'inhabituel qui se cache dans les échos de la zone.

zh.name: 相喰回音 Cannibalistic Echoes
zh.description: 一大群同类相食的鬼魂在这片区域内出没，吞噬活物。
zh.disable: @Check[intimidation|dc:40|name:Drive off the spirits]（大师）做出凶猛的姿态让鬼魂退却；@Check[occultism|dc:42|name:Exorcise the spirits]（专家）驱逐鬼魂
zh.stealth: （大师）来感知在这个区域的回声中隐藏着不祥之物

pl.name: Cannibalistic Echoes
pl.description: A pack of cannibalistic spirits swarm through the area, devouring living creatures.
pl.disable: @Check[intimidation|dc:40|name:Drive off the spirits] (master) to drive the spirits off with a ferocious display or @Check[occultism|dc:42|name:Exorcise the spirits] (expert) to exorcise the spirits
pl.reset: 1 dzień
pl.stealth: (master) to sense something unusual lurking in the area's echoes

name: Cannibalization of the Priestess
description: Spectral undead converge on any living creatures to rip into and devour them.
disable: @Check[athletics|dc:28] to push past or run away, or @Check[occultism|dc:28] or @Check[religion|dc:28] (expert) to exorcise the haunt
reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after there are no bleeding creatures left in M2. If disabled, it resets after 1 day. Destroying Illcayna is the only way to permanently destroy this haunt.
routine: (1 action) The haunt converges upon all creatures currently bleeding in area M2. The targeted creatures must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] save against @Damage[3d6[spirit],3d6[void]] damage from the spirits pulling and gnawing on their souls. On a critical failure, the creature also suffers @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] damage.

actions.name: Swarm
actions.description:
Trigger A living creature enters the square of the town center

Effect All creatures within area M2 take @Damage[3d10[slashing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic] save). The haunt then rolls initiative.

name: Canopy Drop
description: A trapdoor, connected to floor sensors, opens in the section of floor marked on the map, while the surrounding floor suddenly tilts to a 45-degree angle and the fountains in the wall begin spraying at high pressure, making the tile slippery and pushing creatures toward the open chute.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:23|name:Jam Trapdoor Mechanism|traits:action:disable-a-device] (expert) to jam the mechanisms and keep the trapdoor from opening, or to locate the bypass switch hidden under a stair riser just outside the room
publication: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace

actions.name: Flush
actions.description:
Trigger Two or more creatures stand on the trapped spaces

Effect One round after the trap is triggered, all creatures in the room fall 40 feet down the shaft to area E36, taking @Damage[20[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage] damage from the fall plus @Damage[2d6[piercing]] damage as they land in the spiked pit.

The creatures can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} to snag the hammock or one of the hanging storage containers to avoid falling.

The DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb} the walls or Grab an Edge is 20.

fr.name: Élimination
fr.description:
Déclencheur Deux créatures ou plus se tiennent sur les espaces piégés.

Effet Un round après que le piège a été déclenché, toutes les créatures de la pièce font une chute de 12 mètres le long du conduit jusqu'à la zone E36 et subissent @Damage[20[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage]{20 dégâts contondants} dus à la chute et @Damage[2d6[piercing]]{2d6 dégâts perforants} à leur atterrissage dans la fosse à pointes.

Les créatures peuvent @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Se raccrocher in extremis} pour s'accrocher au hamac ou à l'un des meubles de stockage suspendus pour ne pas tomber.

Le DD pour @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Escalader} les parois ou pour Se raccrocher in extremis est de 20.

zh.name: 冲下 Flush
zh.description:
触发 两个或两个以上的生物站陷阱空间上

效果 在陷阱被触发一轮后，房间里的所有生物都从竖井坠落40尺到达E36区，坠落造成@Damage[20[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage]伤害，加上降落到尖刺坑中的@Damage[2d6[piercing]]伤害。

这些生物可以尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]，以抓住吊床或一个悬挂的储藏箱来避免坠落。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]或抓住边缘的DC是20。

fr.name: Chute de la canopée
fr.description: Une trappe, connectée à des capteurs au sol, s'ouvre dans la section signalée sur la carte, tandis que tout le reste du sol s'incline soudain à 45 degrés et que les fontaines au mur se mettent à jaillir à haute pression, ce qui rend le carrelage glissant et pousse les créatures vers la coulisse ouverte.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:23|name:Coincer les mécanismes|traits:action:disable-a-device] (expert) pour coincer les mécanismes et empêcher la trappe de s'ouvrir ou trouver l'interrupteur caché sous la contremarche d'un escalier à l'extérieur de la chambre.

zh.name: 天顶坠落 Canopy Drop
zh.description: 一个与地板的传感器连接的活板门在地图上标记的地板处打开，周围的地板突然倾斜45度角，墙上的喷泉开始因高压洒水使得瓷砖很滑并将生物推向打开的斜槽。
zh.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:23|name:Jam Trapdoor Mechanism|traits:action:disable-a-device]（专家）以堵塞机械机构、防止活板门打开、或者找到隐藏在房间外楼梯立管下的开关

pl.name: Canopy Drop
pl.description: A trapdoor, connected to floor sensors, opens in the section of floor marked on the map, while the surrounding floor suddenly tilts to a 45-degree angle and the fountains in the wall begin spraying at high pressure, making the tile slippery and pushing creatures toward the open chute.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:23|name:Jam Trapdoor Mechanism|traits:action:disable-a-device] (expert) to jam the mechanisms and keep the trapdoor from opening, or to locate the bypass switch hidden under a stair riser just outside the room

name: Carnivorous Mold
description: Spores explode onto nearby creatures, leaving welts as the mold dissolves exposed flesh.
disable: @Check[religion|dc:42] (legendary) to neutralize the void energy that animates the mold, or @Check[survival|dc:36] (master) to remove the mold without triggering the spores

actions.name: Spore Explosion
actions.description:
Trigger A living creature moves adjacent to the mold or damages the mold

Effect All creatures within 15 feet of the mold are exposed to the flesh-eating spores.

actions.name: Flesh-Eating Spores
actions.description:
The flesh-eating spores leave red rings on the skin as they dissolve the target's flesh

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:44]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[4d10[void]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[6d10[void]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[8d10[void]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3} (1 round)

pl.description: Spores explode onto nearby creatures, leaving welts as the mold dissolves exposed flesh.
pl.disable: @Check[religion|dc:42] (legendary) to neutralize the void energy that animates the mold, or @Check[survival|dc:36] (master) to remove the mold without triggering the spores

name: Carrion Vortex
description: The countless bones and feathers on the floor churn into the air in a clattering swarm of partially reconstructed skeletal birds, whose mournful song fills the area as surely as do their slashing beaks and talons.
disable: @Check[nature|dc:23|name:Convince Carrion You Pose No Threat] to convince the carrion vortex that the PCs pose no ill intent or @Check[religion|dc:20|name:Exorcise the Haunt] to exorcise the haunt
reset: 24 hours; defeating the corrupted psychopomps in areas D5 and E4 destroys this haunt forever.
routine: (1 action; evocation, occult) The churning vortex of beaks and bones takes its action through area D2, clawing and pecking at any creature in the area. All creatures in area D2 take @Damage[(2d8+9)[slashing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic|traits:evocation,occult] save).

actions.name: Psychopomp Dirge
actions.description:
Trigger Three or more creatures enter area D2, or anyone attempts to gather or destroy the bird remains

Effect The carrion vortex fills area D2 with the overwhelming cries of what sounds like thousands of whippoorwills, but this cacophony can't be heard beyond this room. Creatures in area D2 must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save. (worshipers of Pharasma or those with ties to psychopomps gain a +4 circumstance bonus to this save).The haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature understands the dirge is also intended as a warning and a desperate request for absolution. The creature can sense the presence of the corrupted psychopomps in areas D5 and E4 as if under the effects of a locate spell, for 24 hours. As long as this effect persists, the character gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks made against the corrupted psychopomps in these areas.

Success As critical success, but the locate effect only lasts 10 minutes. The creature takes @Damage[2d8[mental]] damage from overwhelming feelings of sadness and despair.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[4d8[mental]] damage from overwhelming feelings of sadness and despair.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[6d8[mental]] damage from overwhelming feelings of sadness and despair, and as long as the haunt remains active and they remain in area D2, the character is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} as they're forced to do nothing but sob for one action every round.

fr.name: Chant funeste de psychopompes
fr.description:
Déclencheur Trois créatures ou plus pénètrent dans la zone D2 ou quelqu'un tente de rassembler ou de détruire les restes des oiseaux sur le sol

Effet Le vortex de charogne remplit la zone D2 avec des cris assourdissants tels des millier d'engoulevents, mais cette cacophonie ne peut pas être entendue au-delà de la zone D2. Les créatures dans la zone doivent tenter un jet de @Check[will|dc:21]. (Les fidèles de Pharasma ou ceux qui ont des liens étroits avec les psychopompes obtiennent un bonus de circonstances de +4 à ce jet de sauvegarde). Puis la hantise lance l'initiative.

Succès critique La créature comprend que le chant funeste est également un avertissement et une requête désespérée d'absolution. La créature peut ressentir la présence des psychopompes pervertis dans les zones D5 et E4 comme un effet du sort Localisation pendant 24 heures. Pendant la durée de cet effet, le personnage obtient un bonus de statut de +1 à ses jets d'attaques, ses jets de sauvegarde et ses tests de compétences contre les psychopompes pervertis dans ces zones.

Succès Comme en cas de succès, mais l'effet de localisation ne dure que 10 minutes. La créature subit @Damage[2d8[mental]]{2d8 dégâts mentaux} à cause de sentiments de tristesse et de désespoir.

Échec La créature subit @Damage[4d8[mental]]{4d8 dégâts mentaux} à cause de sentiments de tristesse et de désespoir.

Échec critique La créature subit @Damage[6d8[mental]]{6d8 dégâts mentaux} à cause de sentiments de tristesse et de désespoir et, tant que la hantise reste active et qu'elle reste dans la zone D2, le personnage est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Ralenti 1} alors qu'il passe une action à sangloter sans pouvoir se décider sur une action à chaque round.

zh.name: 招魂者挽歌 Psychopomp Dirge
zh.description:
触发 三个或更多生物进入D2区，或者任何人试图收集或摧毁鸟的残骸。

效果 腐尸漩涡使D2区域充满了听起来像成千上万只三声夜莺鸟的叫声，但这种嘈杂声在这间房间之外是听不到的。D2 区的生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:21]豁免（法莱斯玛的信徒或那些与招魂者有联系的人在这次豁免中获得+4 环境加值）。然后，作祟骰先攻。

大成功 该PC 理解了这首哀歌也是一种警告和对赦免的绝望请求。该PC可以感知到D5和E4区腐化招魂者的存在，如同受到定位术影响，持续24 小时。只要这个效果持续存在，角色在对这些区域的腐化招魂者进行的攻击检定、豁免和技能检定中获得+1状态加值。

成功 同大成功一样，但定位术只持续10 分钟。该生物因内心充满悲伤和绝望的感觉而受到@Damage[2d8[mental]]伤害。

失败 该生物因内心充满悲伤和绝望的感觉而受到@Damage[4d8[mental]]伤害。

大失败 该生物因内心充满悲伤和绝望情绪而受到@Damage[6d8[mental]]伤害，并且只要作祟仍处于激活状态，并且他们仍在D2区域，该角色获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1}，因为他们要被迫每轮用一个动作啜泣。

fr.name: Vortex de charogne
fr.description: Les innombrables os et plumes sur le sol se soulèvent pour former dans les airs une nuée de squelettes d'oiseaux partiellement reconstitués, dont le chant funeste remplit la zone aussi surement que le font leur bec et leurs serres.

Toutes les créatures dans la zone D2 subissent @Damage[(2d8+9)[slashing]]{2d8+9 dégâts tranchants} (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic|traits:evocation,occult])

name: Cataclysmic Planar Rift
description: This apocalypse represents the effects of numerous planar rifts forming and exploding in a region, with the risk of the planar fabric being compromised enough to tear a city-sized (if not larger) hole in reality. These rifts are likely to eject inhabitants of the other plane into the Universe, as well as serve as gateways for furious defenders to pour through to punish anyone they think might be responsible for the problem. Any additional encounters that result from these incursions should award XP as normal for encounters of their difficulty. While the rifts are likely to all lead to the same plane, particularly far-reaching disruptions might create gateways to multiple planes at once, with each rift spewing forth its own defenders. These groups would each have their own aims and agendas, clashing, collaborating, or causing chaos wherever they go.
disable: DC 42 Lore (expert) with the plane's Lore skill, @Check[arcana|dc:45] (master), @Check[nature|dc:45] (master), @Check[occultism|dc:45] (master), @Check[religion|dc:45] (master) or @Check[performance|dc:48] (legendary) to perform a planar stabilization rite to minimize the damage
routine:
(1+ hours, @Check[flat|dc:18]) Rifts detonate with raw planar essence. As the hazard progresses, the ruptures grow more frequent until they merge together into a gaping portal (this final stage might be prevented with good fortune or successful efforts to Prepare). Ruptures occur once per 10 minutes for the first hour and once per minute for the second hour. The frequency with which each unprepared creature in the area is hit by a rupture depends upon their proximity to the hazard's epicenter. If the hazard proceeds into a third hour, all creatures and objects in the area take the hazard's damage one final time before being swallowed up by the burgeoning portal and deposited on the other plane.

The planar explosions deal 2d12+18 damage, with a DC 42 basic saving throw, and inflict a condition on a failed saving throw. The damage type, saving throw type, condition, and condition duration depend upon the exploding plane, as detailed in the table below.

pl.name: Cataclysmic Planar Rift (Escalation)
pl.description: This apocalypse represents the effects of numerous planar rifts forming and exploding in a region, with the risk of the planar fabric being compromised enough to tear a city-sized (if not larger) hole in reality. These rifts are likely to eject inhabitants of the other plane into the Universe, as well as serve as gateways for furious defenders to pour through to punish anyone they think might be responsible for the problem. Any additional encounters that result from these incursions should award XP as normal for encounters of their difficulty. While the rifts are likely to all lead to the same plane, particularly far-reaching disruptions might create gateways to multiple planes at once, with each rift spewing forth its own defenders. These groups would each have their own aims and agendas, clashing, collaborating, or causing chaos wherever they go.

(1+ hours, @Check[flat|dc:18]) Rifts detonate with raw planar essence. As the hazard progresses, the ruptures grow more frequent until they merge together into a gaping portal (this final stage might be prevented with good fortune or successful efforts to Prepare). Ruptures occur once per 10 minutes for the first hour and once per minute for the second hour. The frequency with which each unprepared creature in the area is hit by a rupture depends upon their proximity to the hazard's epicenter. If the hazard proceeds into a third hour, all creatures and objects in the area take the hazard's damage one final time before being swallowed up by the burgeoning portal and deposited on the other plane.

The planar explosions deal 3d12+18 damage, with a DC 45 basic saving throw, and inflict a condition on a failed saving throw. The damage type, saving throw type, condition, and condition duration depend upon the exploding plane, as detailed in the table below.

name: Cave-in
description: The tunnel collapses, filling the passage with stone.

name: Centipede Carcasses Trap
description: Three giant centipede carcasses have wire springs that pull out and fling their sharpened legs around the room.
disable: @Check[nature|dc:23|name:Bend Carapace|traits:mechanical,trap] (trained) to bend the centipede carapace so the wire can't pull out any more legs, or @Check[thievery|dc:21|name:Cut Wires|traits:mechanical,trap] (expert) to cut the springy wires. After all three carcasses are disabled (regardless of the check used), the trap is deactivated. The trap automatically deactivates after 10 rounds.
routine: (1 action) Each creature within 30 feet of a centipede carcass that hasn't been disabled takes @Damage[6d4[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic|name:Avoid Carapace Strike|traits:mechanical,trap] save).

actions.name: Volley of Legs
actions.description:
Trigger A carcass is touched or jostled

Effect Each creature within 30 feet of any centipede carcass takes @Damage[4d4[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic|name:Avoid Carapace Strike|traits:mechanical,trap] save), and the area becomes difficult terrain due to the many sharpened legs on the ground. Each creature that Strides more than 10 feet through the area must succeed at a @Check[acrobatics|dc:20|name:Avoid Piercing Terrain|traits:mechanical,trap] check or take @Damage[1d4[piercing]] damage.

The trap then rolls initiative.

zh.name: 尖足齐射 Volley of Legs
zh.description:
触发 触碰或挤压一具尸体；

效果 距离蜈蚣尸体30尺内的每个生物，受到[[/r (4d4)[piercing]]]{4d4穿刺伤害}（@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic|name:Avoid Carapace Strike|traits:mechanical,trap]豁免）；由于地面上残留着许多尖足，区域内变为困难地形。每一个在该区域行走超过10尺的生物都必须成功通过 @Check[acrobatics|dc:20|name:Avoid Piercing Terrain|traits:mechanical,trap]检定，否则受到[[/r (1d4)[piercing]]]{1d4穿刺伤害}。

接着陷阱骰先攻。

zh.name: 蜈蚣尸体陷阱 Centipede Carcasses Trap
zh.description: 三具巨蜈蚣尸体上都固着了绷紧的铁丝弹簧，可以扯出它们尖锐的足，并向这片区域射出。
zh.disable: @Check[nature|dc:23|name:Bend Carapace|traits:mechanical,trap]（受训）以弯折蜈蚣的甲壳，防止铁丝扯出足；或@Check[thievery|dc:21|name:Cut Wires|traits:mechanical,trap]（专家）以剪断弹簧。当解除（不论使用哪种检定）所有的三具尸体后，陷阱无害化。陷阱在10轮后自动无害化。
zh.routine: （1动作） 距离某个未被解除的蜈蚣尸体30尺内的每个生物，受到[[/r (6d4)[piercing]]]{6d4穿刺伤害}（@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic|name:Avoid Carapace Strike|traits:mechanical,trap]豁免）。

name: Central Spears (BB)
disable: A hero must succeed at a @Check[thievery|dc:18|traits:hazard|name:Disable Mechanism] check on the triggering floor tiles or the wall sockets in the western wall.
reset: The central spears reset after 1 minute.

actions.name: Spear Barrage
actions.description: When a creature moves into any of the squares in the outlined area, the trap shoots three spears from the western wall. It makes one ranged Strike against the westernmost creature in each row.

fr.name: Barrage de lances
fr.description: Lorsqu'une créature se déplace sur l'une des cases de la zone contourée, le piège projette trois lances depuis le mur ouest. Il fait une Frappe à distance contre la créature le plus à l'ouest de chaque rangée.

zh.name: 长矛齐射 Spear Barrage
zh.description: 一旦有生物走进陷阱范围，从西侧的墙上会射出三支矛。它会对每行最西边的第一个生物进行一次远程打击。

fr.name: Lances centrales (BI)
fr.disable: Un héros doit réussir un test de @Check[thievery|dc:18|traits:hazard|name:Désamorcer le mécanisme] sur la case déclencheuse ou sur les trous dans le mur ouest.
fr.reset: Les lances centrales se réinitialisent au bout d'1 minute.

zh.name: 中间矛陷阱 Central Spears (BB)
zh.disable: 一个英雄必须通过@Check[thievery|dc:18|traits:hazard|name:Disable Mechanism]检定，解除触发的压力板，或堵住西侧墙上的发射口。
zh.reset: 矛陷阱会在1分钟之后重置。

pl.name: Centralne Włócznie (ZN)
pl.disable: Bohater musi odnieść sukces w @Check[thievery|dc:18|traits:hazard|name:Disable Mechanism] na wyzwalających kafelkach podłogowych lub gniazdach ściennych w zachodniej ścianie.
pl.reset: Centralne włócznie resetują się po 1 minucie.

name: Chaotic Door (1-2)
description: The frame splinters as the door flings open, the force hitting those nearby.
disable: @Check[athletics|dc:17|name:Hold the Door Shut|traits:chaotic,hazard,magical,trap] (trained) to hold the door shut against the force, or @Check[thievery|dc:18|name:Relieve Door Pressure|traits:chaotic,hazard,magical,trap] (trained) to deftly relieve pressure from the door.
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-09: The Seven Secrets of Dacilane Academy

actions.name: Slam
actions.description:
Trigger A creature touches any part of the door.

Effect The door flies open with incredible force. The triggering creature must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:17|traits:damaging-effect,chaotic,hazard,trap,magical] save as the door explodes outward into them, which deals @Damage[3d8[bludgeoning]] damage.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is knocked 10 feet toward the window behind them.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is knocked 20 feet toward the window. The window shatters and the PC falls 5 feet before colliding with the ground, taking an additional @Damage[1d6[piercing]] damage from passing through the broken glass.

fr.name: Claquer
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature touche n'importe quelle partie de la porte.

Effet La porte s'ouvre brusquelent avec une force incroyable. La créature déclencheuse doit tenter une jet de @Check[reflex|dc:17|traits:damaging-effect,chaotic,hazard,trap,magical] alors que la porte explose vers elle, infligeant @Damage[3d8[bludgeoning]]{3d8 dégâts contondants}.

Succès critique La créature ne subit aucun dégât.

Succès La créature subit la moitié des dégâts.

Échec La créature subit la totalité des dégâts et est repoussée de 3 mètres vers la fenêtre derrière elle.

Échec critique La créature subit le double des dégâts et est repoussée de 6 mètres vers la fenêtre derrière elle. La fenêtre se brise et le PJ tombe de 1,50 mètre au sol, subissant @Damage[1d6[piercing]]{1d6 dégâts perforants} causés par le verre brisé de la fenêtre.

大成功 生物不受伤害。

成功 The creature takes half damage。

大失败 The creature takes full damage and is knocked 20 feet toward the window. The window shatters and the PC falls 5 feet before colliding with the ground, taking an additional @Damage[1d6[piercing]] damage from passing through the broken glass。

fr.description: Le cadre se brise tandis que la porte s'ouvre avec violence, sa force s'abattant sur les personnes à proximité
fr.disable: @Check[athletics|dc:17|name:Rentenir la porte|traits:chaotic,hazard,magical,trap] (qualifiée) pour retenir la force de la porte, ou @Check[thievery|dc:18|name:Atténuer la pression de la porte|traits:chaotic,hazard,magical,trap] (qualifié) pour atténuer adroitement la pression de la porte.

name: Charge of the Spear Legion
description: When triggered, the room lurches suddenly on its side, causing those in the room to slide down toward the double line of spears on the west wall while the statues on the east slide down on a pulley-and-roller system to smash into the victims.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:20] to deactivate the triggering pressure plate near the northern door
publication: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
reset: After 1 minute, the chamber rights itself and resets the trap.

actions.name: Shift Sideways
actions.description:
Trigger A Small or larger creature approaches within 15 feet of the double door to area D9.

Effect The entire room rotates, its west half descending as its right half rises, forming a 45º slope down to the west. All creatures in the room fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and slide toward the west wall (a creature adjacent to the north or south wall can attempt to arrest this fall with a DC 20 check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge}) and take @Damage[(2d6 + 5)[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic]) as they land among the spears. At the same time, the warhammer-wielding statues to the east slide downward on chains to smash into the lower wall; each person in the trap is subjected to a sliding statue Strike.

pl.name: Charge of the Spear Legion
pl.description: When triggered, the room lurches suddenly on its side, causing those in the room to slide down toward the double line of spears on the west wall while the statues on the east slide down on a pulley-and-roller system to smash into the victims.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:20] to deactivate the triggering pressure plate near the northern door
pl.reset: After 1 minute, the chamber rights itself and resets the trap.

name: Cheerful Tune
description: A cheerful, wordless tune fills the room, compelling everyone to get to work.
disable: @Check[religion|dc:20|name:Exorcise Spirits|traits:complex,haunt] (trained) to exorcise the spirits, or @Check[intimidation|dc:21|name:Take a Break|traits:complex,haunt] to convince the spirits it is time to take a break; three total successes are required to disable the haunt.
publication: Pathfinder Society Intro #2: United in Purpose
reset: The ghostly workers cease their routine 2 rounds after all living creatures leave the room and reset after 6 hours.
routine: (3 actions) Ghostly workers appear in the room and begin abrading, scrubbing, and splashing cleaning chemicals on anyone in the area. Each creature in the room takes @Damage[(1d4+2)[slashing]] and @Damage[(1d4+2)[acid]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic|name:Avoid Workers|traits:haunt,complex] save; roll once for both).

actions.name: Nose to the Grindstone
actions.description:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 10 feet of the smiling face in the center of the north wall

Effect The whistling rises in volume to a painful pitch and deals @Damage[(1d8+4)[sonic]] damage. The affected creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:20|traits:damaging-effect] save, and the haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The target takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}, and is deafened for 2 minutes.

zh.name: 埋头苦干 Nose to the Grindstone
zh.description:
触发 活物接近北墙中央的笑脸10尺内

效果 哨音拔高为令人难忍的尖啸，造成@Damage[(1d8+4)[sonic]]伤害。受影响生物必须尝试@Check[will|dc:20|traits:damaging-effect]豁免检定，然后作祟骰先攻。

大成功 生物不受伤害。

成功 生物受到一半伤害。

失败 失败受到完整伤害，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]1分钟。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}，并耳聋2分钟。

zh.name: 欢快的曲调 Cheerful Tune
zh.description: 欢快的无人声曲调充满了房间，迫使每个人开始工作。
zh.disable: @Check[religion|dc:20|name:Exorcise Spirits|traits:complex,haunt]（受训）以驱赶鬼魂，或@Check[intimidation|dc:21|name:Take a Break|traits:complex,haunt]以让鬼魂意识到是时候休息了。解除作祟总共需要三次检定成功。
zh.reset: 幽灵工人在所有活物离开房间2轮后停止活动，6小时后重置。
zh.routine: （3动作）幽灵般的工人出现在房间里，开始擦洗、扫除，并向周围的人泼洒清洁剂。房间内的每个生物受到@Damage[(1d4+2)[slashing]]伤害和@Damage[(1d4+2)[acid]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic|name:Avoid Workers|traits:haunt,complex]豁免；两个伤害只需掷骰一次）。

pl.name: Cheerful Tune
pl.description: A cheerful, wordless tune fills the room, compelling everyone to get to work.
pl.disable: @Check[religion|dc:20|name:Exorcise Spirits|traits:complex,haunt] (trained) to exorcise the spirits, or @Check[intimidation|dc:21|name:Take a Break|traits:complex,haunt] to convince the spirits it is time to take a break; three total successes are required to disable the haunt.
pl.reset: The ghostly workers cease their routine 2 rounds after all living creatures leave the room and reset after 6 hours.
pl.routine: (3 actions) Ghostly workers appear in the room and begin abrading, scrubbing, and splashing cleaning chemicals on anyone in the area. Each creature in the room takes @Damage[(1d4+2)[slashing]] and @Damage[(1d4+2)[acid]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic|name:Avoid Workers|traits:haunt,complex] save; roll once for both).

name: Chernasardo Chomper
description: These animal snares have been repurposed to discourage unwanted intruders. When a creature steps onto the snare, jaws with sharpened teeth close around the creature's leg.
disable: @Check[acrobatics|dc:26] (trained) to step clear the snare before it springs, or @Check[thievery|dc:22] (trained) to trigger the trap harmlessly

actions.name: Bite
actions.description:
Trigger A creature moves into the space containing the trap

Effect The trap's jaws snap shut on the creature's leg, dealing @Damage[(4d8+14)[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] save). On a failure, the creature becomes caught in the trap and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} ([[/act escape dc=22]]).

pl.name: Chernasardo Chomper
pl.description: These animal snares have been repurposed to discourage unwanted intruders. When a creature steps onto the snare, jaws with sharpened teeth close around the creature's leg.

name: Choking Tethers
description: Three shadow tethers form when a creature reaches the hall's midpoint; each lashes, grabs, and crushes creatures in the hall.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:48] (legendary) to disable each tether or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (10th rank, counteract DC 48) to counteract each tether
routine: (six actions) This trap loses 2 actions each turn for each disabled shadow tether. Each shadow tether has 2 actions it can use to either Strike a creature or Constrict a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} creature, in any combination.

actions.name: Seize
actions.description:
Trigger A creature reaches the hall's midpoint

Effect The trap attempts a shadow tether Strike against the triggering creature. On a hit, the triggering creature is automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}. The trap then rolls initiative.

fr.name: Attraper
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature atteint le milieu du couloir

Effet Le piège tente une Frappe de pilier d'ombre contre la créature déclencheuse. En cas de succès, la créature déclencheuse est automatiquement @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agrippée}. Puis le piège détermine l'initiative.

zh.name: Seize
zh.description:
Trigger A creature reaches the hall's midpoint

Effect The trap attempts a shadow tether Strike against the triggering creature. On a hit, the triggering creature is automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}. The trap then rolls initiative.

fr.name: Pilier étrangleur
fr.description: Trois piliers d'ombres se forment lorsqu'une créature atteint le milieu u couloir. Chaque pilier frappe, saisit et broie les créatures dans le couloir.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:48] (légendaire) pour désamorcer chaque pilier ou @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dissipation de la magie} (contrer : Rang 10, DD 48) pour contrer chaque pilier
fr.routine: (six actions) À chaque tour le piège perd 2 actions par pilier d'ombre désamorcé. Chaque pilier d'ombre obtient 2 actions qu'il peut utiliser pour Frapper ou utiliser sa Constriction sur une créature qu'il a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agrippée} dans n'importe quel ordre.

pl.description: Three shadow tethers form when a creature reaches the hall's midpoint; each lashes, grabs, and crushes creatures in the hall.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:48] (legendary) to disable each tether or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (10th rank, counteract DC 48) to counteract each tether
pl.routine: (six actions) This trap loses 2 actions each turn for each disabled shadow tether. Each shadow tether has 2 actions it can use to either Strike a creature or Constrict a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} creature, in any combination.

name: Churning Lava (1-2)
description: The equilibrium of the brown mold and lava river is disturbed, creating bubbles of molten stone that burst and spew burning debris.
disable: @Check[nature|dc:14|name:Clear mold] or @Check[survival|dc:14|name:Clear mold] or @Check[thievery|dc:17|name:Clear mold] to clear your square and all adjacent squares of the mold; the churning lava does not target creatures in cleared squares with its spatter attack, but the hazard is not destroyed until every square has been cleared of mold.
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-19: Enter the Pallid Peak
reset: If not completely destroyed, the mold spreads to one additional square within 10 feet of lava each day until it fully regenerates and regains its state of equilibrium. If every square is cleaned of mold, the hazard is destroyed.
routine: (1 action) On the its initiative, the churning lava targets a random creature in the area with a ranged spatter attack as a magma bubble bursts.

actions.name: Boil
actions.description:
Trigger A creature disturbs the mold, typically by walking through it

Effect The hazard makes a spatter attack against the triggering creature, and then rolls initiative as the lava begins to bubble.

fr.name: Bouillir
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature dérange la moisissure, habituellement en marchant dedans

Effet Le danger effectue une attaque d'éclaboussure contre la créature qui a déclenché l'effet, et puis lance l'initiative alors que le magma commence à former des bulles.

zh.name: 沸腾 Boil
zh.description:
Trigger A creature disturbs the mold, typically by walking through it

Effect The hazard makes a spatter attack against the triggering creature, and then rolls initiative as the lava begins to bubble.

actions.name: Solidifying Lava
actions.description:
The target must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:17] save as the lava rapidly cools and solidifies. On a critical hit, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of the save.

Success The lava slides off the target with no additional effect.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}. The target or an adjacent creature can take an Interact action to remove the stone, removing the condition.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}. Each Interact action to remove the stone reduces the value of the clumsy condition by 1.

fr.name: Lave solidifiante
fr.description:
La cible doit tenter un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:17] alors que la lave refroidit rapidement et se solidifie. En cas de succès critique, utilisez le résultat du jet de sauvegarde comme un degré de succès inférieur au degré obtenu.

Succès La lave s'écoule de la cible sans effet supplémentaire.

Échec La cible devient @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Maladroite 1}. La cible ou une créature adjacente à elle peut prendre une action d'interagir pour enlever la pierre, enlevant l'état Maladroit.

Échec critique Comme en cas d'échec, sauf que la cible devient @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Maladroite 2}. Chaque Interaction pour enlever la pierre réduit la valeur de l'état Maladroit de 1.

zh.name: 凝固岩浆 Solidifying Lava
zh.description:
The target must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:17] save as the lava rapidly cools and solidifies. On a critical hit, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of the save.

Success The lava slides off the target with no additional effect.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}. The target or an adjacent creature can take an Interact action to remove the stone, removing the condition.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}. Each Interact action to remove the stone reduces the value of the clumsy condition by 1.

fr.name: Lave bouillonnante (1-2)
fr.description: L'équilibre entre la moississure brune et la rivière de lave est rompu, créant des bulles de pierre en fusion qui éclatent et projette des débris brûlants.
fr.disable: @Check[nature|dc:14|name:Enlever la moisissure] ou @Check[survival|dc:14|name:Enlever la moisissure] ou @Check[thievery|dc:17|name:Enlever la moisissure] pour nettoyer votre case et toutes les cases adjacentes à la moisissure. La lave bouillonnante ne cible pas les créatures dans les cases nettoyées avec son attaque d'éclaboussure, mais le danger n'est pas détruit tant qu'il reste une case de moisissure non nettoyée.
fr.reset: Si pas complètement détruit, la moisissure s'étend d'une case supplémentaire dans les 3 mètres de la lave chaque jour, jusqu'à ce qu'elle soit totalement régénérée et regagne son état d'équilibre. Si chaque case est nettoyée de la moisissure, le danger est détruit.
fr.routine: (1 action) À son initiative, la lave bouillonnante cible une créature aléatoire dans la zone avec une attaque à distance d'éclaboussure alors qu'une bulle de magma éclate.

zh.name: 翻腾岩浆 Churning Lava (1-2)
zh.description: 褐色霉菌和熔岩之间的平衡被扰乱，熔岩中冒出气泡，不断爆裂并飞溅出火花。
zh.disable: @Check[nature|dc:14|name:Clear mold|traits:uncommon,complex,environmental,fire]或@Check[survival|dc:14|name:Clear mold|traits:uncommon,complex,environmental,fire]或@Check[thievery|dc:17|name:Clear mold|traits:uncommon,complex,environmental,fire]清除你所在位置和所有触及范围内的霉菌。飞溅的岩浆不会伤害到处于没有霉菌的区域内的生物，但只有清除所有霉菌才能解除危害。
zh.reset: 如果没有完全破坏，霉菌每天会扩散到离熔岩10尺范围内的一个方格，直到它完全再生并恢复平衡状态。如果所有的霉菌都被清除，危害就被破坏了。
zh.routine: （1动作） 对区域内随机一个生物使用熔岩飞溅攻击。

name: Cleaning Agents
description: Solvents and detergents spray from the ceiling and run down the walls where they combine in dangerous ways.
disable: @Check[engineering-lore|dc:20|name:Disable Control Panel|traits:mechanical,complex]{Engineering Lore} (trained) or @Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Disable Control Panel|traits:mechanical,complex] (trained) to deactivate the control panel, or @Check[athletics|dc:21|name:Plug the Spouts|traits:mechanical,complex] or @Check[acrobatics|dc:21|name:Plug the Spouts|traits:mechanical,complex] to plug the spouts that release the chemicals; three successes are required to disable the trap.
publication: Pathfinder Society Intro #2: United in Purpose
reset: The trap deactivates after 1 minute and resets in 1 hour.
routine: (3 actions) The trap fills the room with a cloud of caustic vapor and deals @Damage[(2d6+2)[acid]] damage to all creatures in the area (@Check[fortitude|dc:20|basic|name:Cleaning Agent|traits:acid]).

actions.name: Decontamination Spray
actions.description:
Trigger A creature enters the room.

Effect The trap sprays cleaning chemicals at the triggering creature dealing @Damage[(1d8+4)[acid]] damage. The creature must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:20|traits:acid,damaging-effect] save, and the trap then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blind} for 1 round.

zh.name: 除污喷射 Decontamination Spray
zh.description:
触发 生物进入房间

效果 陷阱对触发生物喷出清洁剂，造成@Damage[(1d8+4)[acid]]伤害。该生物必须尝试@Check[reflex|dc:20|traits:acid,damaging-effect]豁免检定，然后陷阱骰先攻。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害。

失败 失败受到完整伤害，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]1轮。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]1轮。

zh.name: 清洁剂 Cleaning Agents
zh.description: 天花板喷出溶液和洗涤剂，顺着墙壁流下，混合成危险的合剂。
zh.disable: @Check[engineering-lore|dc:20|name:Disable Control Panel|traits:mechanical,complex]{DC20工程学识}（受训）或@Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Disable Control Panel|traits:mechanical,complex]（受训）以停用操作面板，或@Check[athletics|dc:21|name:Plug the Spouts|traits:mechanical,complex]或@Check[acrobatics|dc:21|name:Plug the Spouts|traits:mechanical,complex]以堵住释放化学品的喷嘴。解除陷阱需要三次检定成功。
zh.reset: 陷阱在1分钟后休眠，1小时后重置。
zh.routine: （3动作）陷阱将房间灌满腐蚀性蒸汽，对该区域内的所有生物造成@Damage[(2d6+2)[acid]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:20|basic|name:Cleaning Agent|traits:acid]豁免）。

name: Cleansing Cascade
description: The ritual power in this room, corrupted by necromantic energy, slams purifying water into all "unclean" creatures that try to leave.
disable: @Check[religion|dc:25|name:Ceremonially purify everyone] (expert) to ceremonially purify everyone in the room, by pouring water from a tub over their hands, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (4th rank; counteract DC 25) to counteract the corrupted ritual magic.
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-14: The Tomb Between Worlds
reset: 1 minute

actions.name: Purifying Blast
actions.description:
Trigger A living creature steps out of the room.

Effect Water sprays out of the tubs. name: Clockwork Looms
description: The looms spring to life, sending skeins of spidersilk yarn between them that attempt to ensnare nearby creatures and pull them into the machinery.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:46] (master) to shut down all eight looms at once by activating either of the bypass locks once either lock is located (this check is automatically successful if Fenton's keys are used), @Check[thievery|dc:37] (master) twice to shut down a single loom by deftly removing critical components, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (7th rank, counteract DC 33) to counteract a single loom
reset: A loom deactivates if no Small or larger creatures are in area C6, resetting in 1 minute unless disabled or all looms are broken.
routine:
(1 action) Each loom takes one of two possible actions on its turn, depending on if it's currently restraining a creature or not.

Not Restraining a Creature: If a loom isn't restraining a creature, it launches a tangle of yarn at a random creature in the room that isn't currently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}. That creature must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:37] save. If there are no non-restrained targets for the loom to attempt to grapple, it takes no actions this round.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is entangled, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the end of the looms' next turn.

Failure The creature is tangled in the yarn and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} until the end of the loom's next turn—or if it already has the clumsy condition, it becomes restrained (see critical failure).

Critical Failure The creature becomes restrained. A restrained creature can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} the tangle of yarn or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} with a DC 37 check.

Restraining a Creature: If a loom has restrained a creature, it instead fires more lines of yarn at the restrained creature and then drags that creature (if the creature is Medium or smaller) 20 feet toward itself. (If it's restraining a Large or larger creature, it can only drag the creature 5 feet toward itself). If this dragging causes a creature to become adjacent to the loom, the loom pulls the creature into its grinding gears and inflicts @Damage[5d12[bludgeoning],5d12[slashing]] damage to the creature (@Check[reflex|dc:37|basic] save). The creature is then placed in an adjacent square and is still restrained by that loom.

name: Clockwork Poison Bomb
description: A clockwork bomb releases gouts of poisonous smoke. The smoke issues forth from a single nozzle attached to two tanks of pressurized poison
disable: Three [[/act disable-device dc=31]]{DC 31 Thievery} (expert) checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device} to disable the latches that lock the nozzle in place, then one [[/act disable-device dc=35]]{DC 35 Thievery} (master) check to Disable a Device to turn off the nozzle; DCs decrease by 2 if Oggvurm is immobilized, paralyzed, unconscious, or dead
reset: The trap issues smoke for 3 minutes before its tanks run dry. The tanks must be replaced before the bomb can be reactivated.
routine: (1 action) On its turn, the bomb spews forth a smoky gout of airborne @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.WvDbdESFJY6Be2u1]{Blackfinger Blight} poison. The cloud fills a 20-foot radius, or a 10-foot radius if only one tank remains intact. If the bomb is already in the center of a blackfinger blight cloud, the radius of that cloud increases by 20 feet (or 10 feet, if only one tank remains intact) instead.
stealth: The bomb uses Oggvurm's initiative roll as its Stealth roll

actions.name: Poisonous Cloud
actions.description:
Trigger The bomb is Activated, which requires 3 actions

Any creature that starts its turn in the smoke must roll a @Check[fortitude|dc:32|name:Blackfinger Blight|traits:contact,virulent] saving throw to avoid being afflicted by blackfinger blight poison.

The cloud remains for 1 minute or until dispersed by strong winds.

Effet La bombe relâche le @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.WvDbdESFJY6Be2u1]{Fléau de Noirs doigts} en un nuage de fumée dans un rayon de 6 mètres. Les créatures au sein de la fumée sont @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Masquées} aux autres créatures.

Toute créature qui débute son tour dans la fumée doit faire un jet de @Check[fortitude|dc:32|name:Fléau de Noirs Doigts|traits:contact,virulent] pour éviter d'être contaminée par le poison du fléau de noirs doigts.

Le nuage persiste 1 minute ou jusqu'à être dispersé par un vent fort.

触发 有人启动了炸弹，这需要3个动作

效果 爆弹在20尺半径内释放出一阵@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.WvDbdESFJY6Be2u1]的烟云。处在烟云中的生物对其他生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]。

任何在烟云内开始它的回合的生物必须骰@Check[fortitude|dc:32|name:Blackfinger Blight|traits:contact,virulent]，以对抗黑指枯毒素。

烟云持续存在1分钟，或直到被强风吹散。

fr.name: Bombe mécanique empoisonnée
fr.description: Une bombe mécanique relâche une fumée empoisonnée. Cette dernière sort d'un bec attaché à deux réservoirs de poison pressurisé.
fr.disable: Trois tests de Vol pour [[/act disable-device dc=31]]{Désamorcer un dispositif} (expert) afin d'ouvrir le loquet qui tient le bec, puis un test de Vol pour [[/act disable-device dc=35]]{Désamorcer un dispositif} (maître) afin de désactiver le bec ; les DD diminuent de 2 si Oggvurm est immobilisé, Paralysé, inconscient ou mort.

Le nuage remplit un rayon de 6 mètres ou de 3 mètres si un seul réservoir est intact. Si la bombe est déjà au centre d'un nuage de fléau de noirs doigts, le rayon du nuage augmente de 6 mètres (ou 3 mètres si un seul réservoir est intact).
fr.stealth: La bombe utilise le jet d'initiative d'Oggvurm en Discrétion.

actions.description:

Effect All creatures within 10 feet of the chest inhale the dust and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} (@Check[fortitude|dc:20|basic] save to negate both effects). As usual, the fatigued condition lasts until the affected creature receives a full night's rest.

description: A wave of magic passes through the area, causing crystal shards to grow and stab intruders.
disable: @Check[nature|dc:45] (master) to chip away at the crystal and disrupt its resonance, or @Check[thievery|dc:42] (master) to carefully detach the crystals and then safely smash them
reset: Once the cluster heart uses its reaction, it automatically resets after 1 minute. As long as the cluster heart has 150 or more Hit Points, it recovers 50 per day.

actions.description: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate} deals double damage, ignoring Hardness, rather than destroying the cluster heart outright

actions.name: Crystal Surge
actions.description:
Trigger A non-elemental creature ends its turn adjacent to the cluster heart

Effect The heart extends shards of crystal imbued with force, like a jabbing blade, and deals @Damage[(3d10+20)[force]] damage and @Damage[(3d10+20)[piercing]] damage to all creatures in a 20-foot radius (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic] save). A creature who takes piercing damage from the surge is exposed to crystal corruption. On a critical failure, a creature also takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] damage.

actions.name: Crystalline Corruption
actions.description:
Creatures afflicted by this curse slowly turn to solid crystal. This affliction's sickened, slowed, and paralyzed conditions can't be removed until the affliction itself is removed. Creatures with both the earth and elemental traits instead become carriers and suffer no ill effects aside from gaining the weakness to sonic.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:40]

Stage 1 sickened 1 (1 hour)

Stage 2 weakness 5 to sonic and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (1 day)

Stage 3 weakness 5 to sonic and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (1 day)

Stage 4 weakness 10 to sonic and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} (1 day)

Stage 5 weakness 10 to sonic, and the creature is permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified}.

description: Combustible material can ignite and burn ferociously.

actions.name: Ignite
actions.description:
Trigger An effect in the area deals at least @Damage[8[electricity]] or @Damage[4[fire]]

Effect The coal residue rapidly ignites, dealing @Damage[4d6[fire]] damage to all creatures in the area (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic] save). The area burns for 1 minute, during which creatures in the area are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, other creatures are concealed to them, and creatures who end their turn in the area take @Damage[1d6[fire]] damage.

fr.name: S'enflammer
fr.description:
Déclencheur Un effet dans la zone inflige au moins @Damage[8[electricity]]{8 dégâts d'électricité} ou @Damage[4[fire]]{4 dégâts de feu}

Effet Le résidu de charbon s'enflamme rapidement, infligeant @Damage[4d6[fire]]{4d6 dégâts de feu} à toutes les créatures dans la zone (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic]). La zone brûle pendant 1 minute, durant cette période toutes les créatures au sein de cette zone sont @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Masquées} et toutes les autres créatures leur sont Masquées. De plus, les créatures qui terminent leur tour dans la zone subissent @Damage[1d6[fire]]{1d6 dégâts de feu}.

zh.name: 燃烧 Ignite
zh.description:
触发 区域内的效果造成至少@Damage[8[electricity]]伤害或@Damage[4[fire]]伤害

效果 碎煤迅速燃烧，对区域内的所有生物造成@Damage[4d6[fire]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic]豁免）。该区域会燃烧1分钟，在此期间，该区域的生物获得隐蔽，其他生物对它们来说获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]，在该区域结束回合的生物会承受@Damage[1d6[fire]]伤害。

fr.description: Les matériaux combustibles peuvent s'enflammer et brûler intensément.
fr.disable: @Check[mining-lore|dc:15] (qualifié) pour répandre un constituant inerte sur la zone ou @Check[survival|dc:18] pour enlever suffisamment de matériau afin d'éviter une réaction en chaîne.

description: The temperature suddenly drops as spectral forces gather in the area.
disable: @Check[religion|dc:19|name:Banish the Cold Spot] (trained) to banish the cold spot with ritual prayers or @Check[occultism|dc:20|name:Foil the Arrival of Outside Forces] (trained) to foil the arrival of outside forces
reset: 1 hour

actions.name: Sudden Chill
actions.description:
Trigger A living creature enters the area

Effect The temperature drops as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} spirits gather around the living. Living creatures within 15 feet take @Damage[(2d4+5)[cold]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic]). Creatures that critically fail their save are additionally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}.

fr.name: Froid soudain
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature vivante pénètre la zone

Effet La température tombe soudainement alors que des esprits @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisibles} se rassemblent autour des vivants. Les créature vivantes dans les 4,50 mètres subissent @Damage[(2d4+5)[cold]]{2d4+5 dégâts de froid} (@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic]). Les créatures qui obtiennent un échec critique sur leur jet de sauvegarde sont également @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Maladroites 1}.

zh.name: 冷飕飕 Sudden Chill
zh.description:
触发 一个活物进入作祟区域；

效果 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形 Invisible}的鬼魂不断在生者周围聚集，温度显著下降。15尺内的活物受到@Damage[(2d4+5)[cold]]{2d4+5寒冷伤害}（@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic]豁免）。豁免大失败的生物还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 Clumsy 1}。

name: Collapsing Barricade (1-2)
description: A tunnel through this steep barricade is rigged to collapse. If a kobold spends one action to throw a lever, the tunnel collapses on the next creature to pass through.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:18] (trained) to carefully trigger the collapse without entering the tunnel or @Check[thievery|dc:22] (trained) to brace the tunnel so it is safe to pass through.
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-11: Flames of Rebellion

actions.name: Collapse
actions.description:
Trigger A creature crawls into the tunnel in the collapsing barricade after the trap is activated with the lever

Effect The barricade collapses on the creature, who must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:22|traits:damaging-effect] save.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage and escapes the barricade, emerging into a safe space on either side of it.

Success The creature takes @Damage[(1d6+2)[bludgeoning]] damage from collapsing debris and @Damage[(1d6+2)[slashing]] damage from broken glass before emerging on the opposite side of the barricade from the one they entered.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(2d6+4)[bludgeoning]] damage from collapsing debris and @Damage[(2d6+4)[slashing]] damage from broken glass before emerging on the opposite side of the barricade from the one they entered.

Critical Failure As a failure, and the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} beneath the barricade until they or another creature succeed at a @Check[athletics|dc:22|name:Escape Barricade] check to pull them free. They can still be targeted, touched, and otherwise interacted with by creatures on either side of the barrier.

fr.name: Effondrement
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature rampe dans le tunnel dans le piège après qu'il ait été activé avec le levier

Effet La barricade s'effondre sur la créature qui doit tenter un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:22|traits:damaging-effect].

Succès critique La créature ne subit aucun dégât et s'échappe d'un côté ou de l'autre du tunnel dans un espace hors de danger.

Succès La créature subit @Damage[(1d6+2)[bludgeoning]]{1d6+2 dégâts contondants} des débris qui s'effondrent sur elle et @Damage[(1d6+2)[slashing]]{1d6+2 dégâts tranchants} des morceaux de verre, avant d'émerger du côté opposé d'où elle est entrée dans le tunnel barricadé.

Échec La créature subit @Damage[(2d6+4)[bludgeoning]]{2d6+4 dégâts contondants} des débris qui s'effondrent sur elle et @Damage[(2d6+4)[slashing]]{2d6+4 dégâts tranchants} des morceaux de verre, avant d'émerger du côté opposé d'où elle est entrée dans le tunnel barricadé.

Échec critique Comme en cas d'échec, mais la créature est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilisée} en-dessous de la barricade jusqu'à ce qu'elle réussisse (ou qu'une autre créature réussisse) un test d@Check[athletics|dc:22|name:S'échapper de la barricade] pour s'en sortir. Elles peuvent toujours être cibles et touchée, et interagir autrement avec les créatures qui sont des deux côtés de la barrière.

name: Collapsing Bridge
description: An iron bridge's connectors give way to drop into the lake below.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:40|name:Disable Quick Release Mechanism|traits:action:disable-a-device] (master) to disable one side of the bridge's quick release mechanisms

actions.name: Collapse
actions.description:
Trigger A Small or larger creature moves more than 20 feet onto the bridge

Effect The bridge chains detach from their connectors, dropping itself and anything on it into the lake 150 feet below. A creature that's adjacent to the ledges to the north or south can attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:33] save to Grab the Edge, but creatures who can't reach the edge fall with the bridge into the toxic water below (unless one side of the bridge remains attached, in which case a creature can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} by clinging to the dangling bridge-requiring a successful @Check[athletics|dc:20|traits:action:climb] check to climb the hanging bridge to safety).

fr.name: Effondrement
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature de taille Petite ou supérieure se déplace de plus de 6 mètres sur le pont

Effet Les chaînes du pont se détachent de ses embouts, se laissant tomber et tout ce qui sur le pont tombent également dans un lac situé à 45 mètres en-dessous. Une créature qui est adjacente au bord et qui se situe au nord ou au sud peut tenter un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:33] pour Se raccrocher in extrémis, mais les créatures qui ne peuvent pas atteindre le bord tombent avec le pont dans les eaux toxiques du lac (à moins qu'un des bord du pont ne reste attaché, dans quel cas, la créature peut tenter de @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Se raccrocher in extremis} en s'accrochant à la partie du pont encore attaché. Ensuite elle peut tenter un test d'@Check[athletics|dc:20|traits:action:climb] pour remonter le pont jusqu'au bord).

Once the bridge begins to collapse, the river's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim} DC increases to 36 as the water churns with the falling debris. A creature that starts its turn swimming within 15 feet of the bridge takes @Damage[10d6[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:41|basic] save).

stealth: (or 0 if a PC has analyzed the supports and discovered they are on the verge of collapse)

Effect The bridge collapses. Any creature on the bridge between the red dotted lines falls 30 feet into water or onto land, taking damage as appropriate plus an additional @Damage[5d6[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic]) from falling debris; a creature within five feet of the red dotted line can try to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} (@Check[reflex|dc:24]) to avoid falling. A creature under the bridge-either directly below it or within ten feet of it-must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:24] save; a creature that's not directly under the bridge improves the result of their saving throw one degree.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes @Damage[(2d8 + 9)[bludgeoning]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(4d8 + 18)[bludgeoning]] damage and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[(8d8 + 18)[bludgeoning]] damage, is knocked prone, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} by fallen rubble from the collapsed bridge.

fr.name: Effondrement
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une fondation est détruite

Effet Le pont s'écroule. Toute créature sur le pont dans la zone délimitée par la ligne en pointillé rouge tombe de 9 mètres dans l'eau ou sur la terre, subissant les dégâts appropriés plus @Damage[5d6[bludgeoning]]{5d6 dégâts contondants} supplémentaires (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic]) de débris qui lui tombent dessus. Une créature dans les 1,50 mètre de la ligne en pointillée rouge peut tenter de @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Se raccrocher in extremis} (@Check[reflex|dc:24]) pour ne pas tomber. Une créature qui est sous le pont, soit directement dessous ou à 3 mètres, doit tenter un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:24]. Une créature qui n'est pas directement sous le pont obtient un résultat supérieur de un degré sur son jet de sauvegarde.

Succès critique La créature ne subit aucun dégât.

Succès La créature subit @Damage[(2d8+9)[bludgeoning]]{2d8+9 dégâts contondants}.

Échec La créature subit @Damage[(4d8+18)[bludgeoning]]{4d8+18 dégâts contondants} et est renversé @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{À terre}.

Échec critique La créature subit @Damage[(8d8+18)[bludgeoning]]{8d8+18 dégâts contondants}, est renversé À terre, et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilisée} sous les débris du pont détruit.

zh.name: 坍塌 Collapse
zh.description:
触发 破坏一个桥墩

效果 桥梁坍塌。桥梁上在红色虚线之间的任何生物都会掉进30尺深的水中或陆地上，受到对应伤害的同时额外还会受到碎片坠落导致的@Damage[5d6[bludgeoning]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic]豁免）。红色虚线五尺以内的生物可以尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]（@Check[reflex|dc:24]）来避免坠落。无论桥的正下方还是桥下10尺范围内的生物都必须进行@Check[reflex|dc:24]豁免，不在桥正下方的生物豁免检定的成功度提升一级。

大成功 该生物不受伤害。

成功 该生物受到@Damage[(2d8 + 9)[bludgeoning]]伤害。

失败 该生物受到@Damage[(4d8 + 18)[bludgeoning]]伤害，并且被击中@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。

大失败 该生物受到@Damage[(8d8 + 18)[bludgeoning]]伤害，被击中倒地，并且被坍塌桥梁上落下的碎石@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]。

fr.name: Effondrement de pont
fr.description: Alors qu'un pilier s'effondre, le pont gémit et tremble, puis s'écroule dans la rivière en dessous.

zh.disable: 花几周时间就可以重新修复桥墩来消除危险。根据GM的判断，可以使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kOa055FIrO9Smnya]或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Iela4GgVeO3LfAo]等法术来迅速支撑起桥墩，尽管在此时PC可能还无法掌握这些法术。

zh.description: 楼梯的支撑物被设置成一旦绊线被触发就会坍塌，导致一段10 尺长的一段楼梯会从悬崖上滚落下去。
zh.disable: @Check[crafting|dc:25] 或工程学识来加固支撑， @Check[perception|dc:27] 来发现楼梯扶手上的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]的绕行栏杆，或@Check[thievery|dc:29] 来破坏连接装置

pl.description: The stairs' supports are rigged to collapse if the trip wires are triggered, sending a 10-foot section of stairs tumbling down the cliff.

name: Collapsing Debris
description: The room initially appears merely dilapidated, but on closer inspection it is positively liable to collapse at any moment.
disable: @Check[crafting|dc:20] (untrained) to safely shore up the weaknesses in the masonry by replacing rotten wood with other assorted bric-a-brac, @Check[thievery|dc:17] (trained) to carefully place boards and the like to create bridges over structurally weak areas.
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-16: A Lie Told to Strangers
stealth: (trained) to notice the instability in the surrounding woodwork and precariously balanced masonry.
