Trigger A creature moves into the hazardous area

Effect Bricks and broken wood fall on the triggering creature, dealing @Damage[(2d6+5)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic] save).

fr.name: Effondrement
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature pénètre dans la zone dangereuse

Effect Des briques et du bois cassé tombent sur la créature déclencheuse, infligeant @Damage[(2d6+5)[bludgeoning]]{2d6+5 dégâts contondants}(@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic]).

fr.name: Effondrement de débris
fr.description: La pièce semble de prime abord simplement délabrée, mais en y regardant de plus près, on constate qu'elle risque de s'effondrer à tout moment
fr.disable: Test d'@Check[crafting|dc:20] (inexpérimenté) pour consolider en toute sécurité les faiblesses de la maçonnerie en remplaçant le bois pourri par d'autres éléments de récupération, de @Check[thievery|dc:17] (qualifié) to placer soigneusement des planches et autres éléments similaires pour créer des ponts au-dessus des zones structurellement faibles.
fr.stealth: Qualifié pour remarquer l'instabilité des boiseries environnantes et l'équilibre précaire de la maçonnerie

name: Collapsing Floor
description: The westernmost 5 feet of the building gives way, dropping rubble and anyone in the area into the depths of the Lantern Kingdom below.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:51|traits:action:disable-a-device|name:Jury Rig the Supports] to quickly jury-rig key supports against weak wall sections to prevent the collapse

actions.name: Collapse
actions.description:
Trigger A Small or larger creature walks into either 5-foot-square at the westernmost end of the building

Effect The triggering creature falls and takes @Damage[50[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage] damage, then an additional @Damage[10d6[bludgeoning]] damage as they and the building's falling timbers "land" in a devastating crash at area A1. The creature can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} reaction to avoid falling.

fr.name: Effondrement du plancher
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature de taille Petite ou supérieure entre sur une des cases de 1,50 mètre carrés placés à l'extrémité ouest du bâtiment.

Effet La créature déclencheuse tombe et subit @Damage[50[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage]{50 dégâts contondants}, puis @Damage[10d6[bludgeoning]]{10d6 dégâts contondants} supplémentaires alors que les éboulis du bâtiment s'écrasent dans la zone A1 avec la créature déclencheuse. La créature peut tenter de @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Se raccrocher in extremis} pour ne pas tomber.

zh.name: 倒塌 Collapse
zh.description:
触发 一个小体型或更大的生物走进建筑最西端5尺的方格

效果 该生物触发坠落并受到@Damage[50[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage]伤害，然后在区域A1和建筑中的梁木一同“着陆”时受到额外@Damage[10d6[bludgeoning]]伤害。该生物可以通过@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]反应动作来避免坠落。

fr.name: Effondrement du plancher
fr.description: Le plancher le plus à l'ouest d'une surface de 1,50 mètre du bâtiment est branlant, et s'effondre dans les profondeurs du Royaume de la lanterne en dessous.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:51|traits:action:disable-a-device|name:Bricoler rapidement] pour bricoler rapidement des supports pour réparer le plancher affaibli et empêcher l'effondrement

zh.name: 坍塌地板 Collapsing Floor
zh.description: 建筑最西端5尺的位置坍塌了，位于该区域的所有人都伴随着瓦砾掉进了下方的灯域深处。
zh.disable: 通过@Check[thievery|dc:51|traits:action:disable-a-device|name:Jury Rig the Supports]快速给薄弱墙体安装支撑部位来防止倒塌。

pl.name: Zapadająca się podłoga
pl.description: Najbardziej wysunięte 5 stóp budynku na zachód ustępuje, zrzucając gruz i wszystkich znajdujących się na obszarze w głębiny Królestwa Latarni.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:51|traits:action:disable-a-device|name:Jury Rig the Supports], aby szybko podeprzeć kluczowe podpory pod słabe sekcje ściany, aby zapobiec zawaleniu.

name: Collapsing Floor
description: Around the edges of the pit, more rotting boards are ready to give way.
disable: @Check[crafting|dc:16|name:Reinforce Beams] to reinforce the beams
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-01: The Absalom Initiation
reset: As the damage to the floor spreads, the areas adjacent to the new pit become new areas of this hazard.

actions.name: Pitfall
actions.description:
Trigger A creature walks next to the pit.

Effect The triggering creature falls in and takes falling damage (typically @Damage[3[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage] damage) plus @Damage[4d6[piercing]] damage from landing on broken boards.

That creature can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} to avoid falling; the DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb} the walls or Grab an Edge is 18.

fr.name: Chute dans la fosse
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature se déplace près de la trouée.

Effet La créature déclencheuse tombe et subit des dégâts de chute (habituellement @Damage[3[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage]{3 dégâts contondants}) et @Damage[4d6[piercing]]{4d6 dégâts perforants} supplémentaires des planches cassées. La créature peut tenter de @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Se raccrocher in extremis} pour ne pas tomber. Le DD pour Se raccrocher in extremis ou pour @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Escalader} est de 18.

zh.name: 坠坑 Pitfall
zh.description:
触发 一个生物走到坑旁边。

效果 该触发生物坠落，承受坠落伤害（通常为[[/r 3[bludgeoning]]]伤害）以及坠落到破碎的板材上的@Damage[4d6[piercing]]伤害。

该生物可以尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{抓住边缘 Grab an Edge}来避免坠落；@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]墙壁和抓住边缘的的DC为18。

pl.name: Zapadający się Ganek

name: Collapsing Structure
description: Mogaru brushes against a structure, severely compromising the building's stability and possibly causing it to collapse.
disable: @Check[athletics|dc:43|name:Brace the Structure] (master), @Check[crafting|dc:43|name:Brace the Structure] (master), or @Check[engineering-lore|dc:43|name:Brace the Structure]{Engineering Lore} (master) to brace the structure to reduce the risk of collapse until the end of the creature's next turn. The DC of the flat check for this round (see Routine) is increased by 4 on a success, or by 8 on a critical success. Increasing the flat check DC to 21 or higher stabilizes the structure, ending this hazard.
reset: The building becomes susceptible to Shake Apart again [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} after it is stabilized.
routine: (1 action) The GM rolls a @Check[flat|dc:9] to determine if the building collapses, increasing the DC as listed above. On a successful check, dust and debris fall within the building and 30 feet around it, providing @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealment} and dealing @Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]] damage to [[/gmr 1d4 #targets]] randomly chosen targets (@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic] save; on a critically failed save, the creature is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}). On a critical success, the effect is the same, but the debris deals @Damage[12d6[bludgeoning]] damage to [[/gmr 2d4 #targets]] randomly chosen targets instead (DC 35 basic Reflex save; on a critically failed Reflex save, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by rubble until freed [[[/act force-open dc=38]], [[/act escape dc=35]]]).
stealth: +20 (master) to notice cracks forming in the walls of the structure as Mogaru approaches

actions.name: Shake Apart
actions.description:
Trigger Mogaru applies any amount of force to the structure

Effect The building trembles. The floors of the building and the streets within 30 feet of the building become difficult terrain; creatures on this difficult terrain take a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls, AC, and skill checks. The hazard rolls initiative.

fr.name: Ébranler
fr.description:
Déclencheur Mogaru applique une pression sur la structure

Effet Le bâtiment tremble. Le sol de la structure et les rues dans un rayon de 9 mètres du bâtiment deviennent terrain difficile. Les créature sur ce terrain difficile subissent une pénalité de circonstances de -2 aux jets d'attaque, à la CA et aux test de compétences. Puis le danger lance l'initiative.

zh.name: 分崩离析 Shake Apart
zh.description:
触发 魔加鲁对建筑施加力道

效果 建筑开始颤抖。建筑的地板和建筑30尺内的街道变为困难地形；此困难地形中的生物在攻击骰、AC和技能检定上有-2环境减值。危害投掷先攻。

fr.name: Effondrement de structure
fr.description: Mogaru se frotte contre une structure, compromettant gravement la stabilité du bâtiment et risquant de le faire s'effondrer.
fr.disable: @Check[athletics|dc:43|name:Renforcer la structure] (maître), @Check[crafting|dc:43|name:Renforcer la structure] (maître) ou @Check[engineering-lore|dc:43|name:Renforcer la structure]{Connaissance en ingénierie} (maître) pour renforcer la structure et réduire le risque d'effondrement jusqu'à la fin du prochain tour de la créature. Le DD du jet basique pour ce round (voir Routine) est augmenté de 4 en cas de succès ou de 8 en cas de succès critique. Augmenter le DD du jet basique à 21 ou plus stabilise la structure, mettant fin à ce danger.
fr.reset: Le bâtiment redevient susceptible de se désagréger [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} après avoir été stabilisé.
fr.routine: (1 action) Le MJ effectue un test @Check[flat|dc:9] pour déterminer si le bâtiment s'effondre, augmentant le DD comme indiqué ci-dessus. En cas de succès, de la poussière et des débris tombent dans le bâtiment et dans un rayon de 9 mètres autour de celui-ci, provoquant un état @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Masqué} et infligeant @Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]]{6d6 dégâts contondants} à [[/gmr 1d4 #targets]] cibles choisies au hasard (@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic]. En cas d'échec critique, la créature est mise @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{À terre}). name: Colossus Rampage
description: Monsters of titanic proportions awaken and stampede across the land, crushing everything in their wake. These might be a group of battling kaiju, an army of titanic constructs, or another onslaught of oversized creatures. This hazard works best when combined with combat against one or more massive monsters. These creatures might notice the PCs' strength and decide to get rid of them before the PCs have a chance to interfere with their onslaught.
disable: @Check[crafting|dc:48] (master) or Thievery (master) to lay traps to hamper the approaching rampage; DC 50 (master) skill check with a skill typically used to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about the creature's type to make targeted preparations (DC 46 if it's a Lore skill); or @Check[warfare-lore|dc:46] (master), @Check[intimidation|dc:48] (master), or @Check[diplomacy|dc:50] (master) to rally nearby troops to prepare for battle
routine:
(10+ minutes, @Check[flat|dc:15]) The colossus rampage affects the entire area, but whether or not the affected area remains static, moves, expands, or otherwise changes is left to you to determine as the story needs. At the start of each minute, unprepared creatures in the area take @Damage[(3d10+10)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:47|basic] save). A creature that fails the save is jostled enough that they're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for that minute, while a creature that critically fails is pinned under fallen debris and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} until they [[/act escape dc=47]].

Two additional effects, based on the nature of the creatures and the battlefield, take place during that minute. Roll [[/gmr 1d10]] for each to determine on which round during that minute each effect takes place (rerolling duplicate rounds). You can create alternative abilities to better fit the nature of the creatures in the stampede, but in general, consider selecting one ability that imposes a condition or battlefield effect and one that deals damage. Note that these effects can affect prepared and unprepared creatures in the area, but when a prepared creature attempts a save against any of these effects, they increase their result by one degree of success.
stealth: DC 32 (master) skill check with a skill typically used to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about the rampaging creatures to notice subtle signs of their proximity in the surrounding landscape (DC 30 if it's a Lore skill) or @Check[survival|dc:38] (master) to notice the ground trembling from immense footfalls

actions.name: Deathly Terror
actions.description:
The stampede's approach inflicts overwhelming fear upon those who can't escape its path. This ability might represent exposure to frightful presence auras, terrifying howls, or simply the sheer presence of the advancing army. All creatures that start their turn in the area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:42] save, with the following effects. An affected creature can't reduce the value of its frightened condition while it remains in the aura.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to deathly terror for 10 minutes.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}.

zh.name: 死之恐怖 Deathly Terror
zh.description:
踩踏的逼近会对那些无法逃离其路径的人施加压倒性的恐惧。该能力可能代表暴露于恐怖威压灵光、令人战栗的嚎叫，或仅仅是推进大军本身的存在。所有在该区域内开始自身回合的生物都必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:42] 豁免，并具有以下效果。受影响的生物只要仍位于该灵光内，就无法降低其惊惧状态的数值。

大成功 该生物不受影响，并在10分钟内暂时免疫死之恐怖。

成功 该生物为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}。

失败 该生物为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 2}。

大失败 该生物为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 4}。

actions.name: Dust Shroud
actions.description: The stampede fills the air with an impenetrable cloud, blocking all vision. This cloud might arise from a dust storm churned up by massive stomping feet, debris from countless ruined buildings, or a magical ability to summon cloying mist. The cloud blocks all vision, making unprepared creatures @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until they leave the area, and imparting a –4 circumstance penalty to vision-based Perception checks for prepared creatures. Creatures outside the area can't see into the cloud.

zh.name: 沙尘蔽日 Dust Shroud
zh.description: 踩踏让空气中充满了无法看透的云雾，遮蔽了所有视线。这些云雾可能是巨物踩踏翻卷起的沙尘暴、无数建筑崩塌后的废墟尘埃，或召唤浓稠雾气的魔法能力。云雾遮蔽了所有视线，使未做好准备的生物 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2] 直至它们离开该区域，而做好准备的生物在基于视觉的察觉检定中承受–4环境减值。区域外的生物无法看到云雾之内。

actions.name: Energy Burst
actions.description:
Overlapping blasts of energy or other effects carpet the area. This ability might represent the energy breaths of creatures like dragons, or the overlapping auras of creatures wreathed in fire or other elements. It might also represent the combined effects of numerous spellcasters to cover the region, whether they are part of the stampede itself or defenders attempting to slow the stampede with indiscriminate magic. All creatures in the area take 4d10+12 acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, or void damage (@Check[reflex|dc:42|basic|options:area-effect] save). The damage type depends upon the nature of the magic (or can be randomly determined).

@Damage[(4d10+12)[acid]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[(4d10+12)[cold]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[(4d10+12)[electricity]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[(4d10+12)[fire]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[(4d10+12)[sonic]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[(4d10+12)[void]|options:area-damage]

zh.name: 能量爆发 Energy Burst
zh.description:
重叠的能量爆发或其他效果覆盖了该区域。该能力可能代表生物的能量吐息（如龙），或笼罩在火焰或其他元素中的生物灵光层层叠加。它也可以代表众多施法者联合对该地区的覆盖效果，这可能来自踩踏本身，也可能来自试图以不加区分的魔法减缓其前进的防御者。区域内的所有生物承受 @Check[reflex|dc:42|basic|options:area-effect] 豁免的伤害。伤害类型取决于魔法的性质（或可随机决定）。

@Damage[(4d10+12)[acid]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[(4d10+12)[cold]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[(4d10+12)[electricity]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[(4d10+12)[fire]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[(4d10+12)[sonic]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[(4d10+12)[void]|options:area-damage]

actions.name: Flying Shards
actions.description:
The stampede crushes through buildings and rends the ground in its wake. As it does, rocks, trees, metal fragments, and all manner of other dangerous objects soar through the air at perilous speeds. All creatures in the area take 4d10+12 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:42|basic|options:area-effect] save). The damage type depends upon the nature of what the stampede is currently destroying (or can be randomly determined).

@Damage[(4d10+12)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[(4d10+12)[piercing]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[(4d10+12)[slashing]|options:area-damage]

zh.name: 残骸飞溅 Flying Shards
zh.description:
在踩踏者行进的路径上，建筑被毁，大地崩裂。随着它们的行动，岩石、树木、金属破片和其他各种危险物品以恐怖的速度在空中划过。区域内的所有生物承受 @Check[fortitude|dc:42|basic|options:area-effect] 豁免的伤害。伤害类型取决于踩踏者当前正在破坏之物的性质（或可随机决定）。

@Damage[(4d10+12)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[(4d10+12)[piercing]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[(4d10+12)[slashing]|options:area-damage]

actions.name: Toxic Miasma
actions.description:
Poison fills the air, infiltrating the bodies of all who are unfortunate enough to enter its reach. This ability most often represents the effect of a congregation of poisonous monsters, but it could also come about from more unusual circumstances like the destruction of a site used to mass-produce toxic compounds. By default, the miasma exposes all creatures in the area to cerulean scourge, with Fortitude DC of 42. If the creatures in the stampede have their own specific poison with no onset, you can replace cerulean scourge with their poison effect. Use a Fortitude DC of 42 or the poison's normal DC, whichever is higher.

Cerulean Scourge This poison is infamous for making the victim's blood vessels glow with a bright blue light before painfully bursting.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:42|traits:alchemical,injury,poison]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[10d6[poison]] damage (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[12d6[poison]] damage (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[14d6[poison]] damage (1 round)

zh.name: 有毒瘴气 Toxic Miasma
zh.description:
毒素弥漫在空气中，渗透到所有不幸进入其范围的生物体内。该能力通常代表一大群带毒怪物的效果，但也可能源于更不寻常的情景，例如被摧毁的是一处大量生产有毒化合物的设施。在默认情况下，瘴气会使区域内的所有生物暴露于蔚蓝灾厄之中，其强韧DC为42。若踩踏中的生物具有自身的特定毒素且没有潜伏期，你可以用它们的毒素效果替代蔚蓝灾厄。使用强韧DC 42或该毒素的正常DC，以较高者为准。

蔚蓝灾厄 这种毒素以让受害者的血管在痛苦爆裂前发出明亮的蓝光而闻名。

豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:42|traits:alchemical,injury,poison]

最大持续时间 6轮

阶段1 @Damage[10d6[poison]] 伤害（1轮）

阶段2 @Damage[12d6[poison]] 伤害（1轮）

阶段3 @Damage[14d6[poison]] 伤害（1轮）

pl.name: Colossus Rampage
pl.description: Monsters of titanic proportions awaken and stampede across the land, crushing everything in their wake. These might be a group of battling kaiju, an army of titanic constructs, or another onslaught of oversized creatures. This hazard works best when combined with combat against one or more massive monsters. These creatures might notice the PCs' strength and decide to get rid of them before the PCs have a chance to interfere with their onslaught.
pl.disable: @Check[crafting|dc:48] (master) or Thievery (master) to lay traps to hamper the approaching rampage; DC 50 (master) skill check with a skill typically used to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about the creature's type to make targeted preparations (DC 46 if it's a Lore skill); or @Check[warfare-lore|dc:46] (master), @Check[intimidation|dc:48] (master), or @Check[diplomacy|dc:50] (master) to rally nearby troops to prepare for battle
pl.routine:
(10+ minutes, @Check[flat|dc:15]) The colossus rampage affects the entire area, but whether or not the affected area remains static, moves, expands, or otherwise changes is left to you to determine as the story needs. At the start of each minute, unprepared creatures in the area take @Damage[(3d10+10)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:47|basic] save). A creature that fails the save is jostled enough that they're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for that minute, while a creature that critically fails is pinned under fallen debris and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} until they [[/act escape dc=47]].

Two additional effects, based on the nature of the creatures and the battlefield, take place during that minute. Roll [[/gmr 1d10]] for each to determine on which round during that minute each effect takes place (rerolling duplicate rounds). You can create alternative abilities to better fit the nature of the creatures in the stampede, but in general, consider selecting one ability that imposes a condition or battlefield effect and one that deals damage. Note that these effects can affect prepared and unprepared creatures in the area, but when a prepared creature attempts a save against any of these effects, they increase their result by one degree of success.
pl.stealth: DC 32 (master) skill check with a skill typically used to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about the rampaging creatures to notice subtle signs of their proximity in the surrounding landscape (DC 30 if it's a Lore skill) or @Check[survival|dc:38] (master) to notice the ground trembling from immense footfalls

name: Compression Tunnel
description: This shadow tunnel compresses when creatures pass through.
disable: @Check[athletics|dc:46] (legendary) twice to push back the shadows or @Check[thievery|dc:48] (legendary) three times to pierce through the shadows
routine: (1 action) The tunnel compresses, crushing all creatures in it and dealing @Damage[(4d10+22)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:42|basic]). On a failed save, a creature additionally becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} ([[/act escape dc=42]]).

actions.name: Shudder
actions.description:
Trigger A creature reaches the tunnel's midpoint

Effect The tunnel shudders, knocking creatures @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} unless they succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:42] save. The trap then rolls initiative.

fr.name: Vibration
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature atteint le milieu du tunnel

Effet Le tunnel vibre, renversant les créatures @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{À terre} à moins qu'elles ne réussissent un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:42]. Puis le piège détermine l'initiative.

zh.name: Shudder
zh.description:
Trigger A creature reaches the tunnel's midpoint

Effect The tunnel shudders, knocking creatures @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} unless they succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:42] save. The trap then rolls initiative.

fr.name: Tunnel compresseur
fr.description: Ce tunnel d'ombres compressent les créatures quand elles passent dedans
fr.disable: @Check[athletics|dc:46] (légendaire) deux fois pour repousser les ombres ou test de @Check[thievery|dc:48] (légendaire) pour pénétrer les ombres.
fr.routine: (1 action) Le tunnel compresse et écrase toutes les créatures dedans, infligeant @Damage[(4d10+22)[bludgeoning]]{4d10+22 dégâts contondants} (@Check[fortitude|dc:42|basic]). En cas d'échec, la créature devient également @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilisée} ([[/act escape dc=42]]{S'Échapper}).

name: Conference Z's Victims
description: The pain of over 300 souls crying out for recognition and revenge pierces through the room, as a spiritual whirlwind fills the space.
disable: @Check[medicine|dc:30] or @Check[society|dc:30] to determine 287's first or surname through the journal text or @Check[occultism|dc:32] or @Check[religion|dc:32] to connect with the spiritual energy bound to the journal to find her name. Two successes are needed, one for each part of 287's name.
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-11: The Hidden Current
reset: The haunt vanishes permanently if 287's name is revealed.
routine: (1 action) The haunt makes a howling wail Strike against all living creatures in area A13 as 1 action.

actions.name: Please, See Me, Too
actions.description:
Trigger The PCs start investigating the journal for 287's name

Effect The victims all beg for attention and recognition, lashing out at the PCs when they remain focused. The haunt makes a howling wail Strike against all living creatures and then rolls initiative.

fr.name: S'il vous plait, regardez-moi aussi
fr.description:
Déclencheur Les PJ commencent à cherher le nom de 287 dans le journal.

Effet Les victimes implorent l'attention et la reconnaissance, s'acharnant sur les PJ lorsqu'ils sont concentrés. La hantise effectue une Frappe de Plainte stridente contre toutes les créatures vivantes, puis lance un jet d'initiative.

fr.name: Victimes de la conférence Z
fr.description: La douleur de plus de trois cent âmes qui hurlent pour être reconnues et obtenir leur vengeance emplit la pièce, alors qu'un vent spirituel tourbillonne dans la zone.
fr.disable: Test de @Check[medicine|dc:30] ou de @Check[society|dc:30] pour retrouver le prénom et le nom de 287 dans le texte du journal ou test d'@Check[occultism|dc:32] ou de @Check[religion|dc:32] pour se connecter à l'énergie spirituelle liée au journal et retrouver son noms ou son prénom.
fr.reset: La hantise s'éteint de façon permanente si l'identité complète de 287 est révélée.
fr.routine: (1 action) La hantise effectue une frappe de Plainte stridente contre chaque créature vivante dans la zone A13 en une action.

name: Confounding Betrayal
description: Allies appear to shed their disguises and reveal themselves to be malevolent monsters.
disable: @Check[deception|dc:28|name:Confound the Haunt] (expert) twice to confound the haunt with your own deceptions, or @Check[occultism|dc:28|name:Create a Ward Against Influence] (trained) twice to create a ward against the haunt's mental influence
reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.
routine:
(1 action; illusion, incapacitation, occult) The haunt continues to confound victims' senses and inspire them to commit violence against each other. Each creature in the haunt's area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:26] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is confused for 1 minute.

actions.name: Unmask
actions.description:
Trigger Two or more creatures enter the haunt's area

Effect Each creature sees the forms of nearby creatures shift and change, appearing to transform into fiendish or aberrant beings with a thirst for blood. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:30] save. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature sees through the illusions entirely and is temporarily immune to the haunt's routine for 1 minute.

Success The creature is unaffected by the strange images.

Failure The creature believes the illusions to be true; if they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} by the haunt's routine, they can't attempt flat checks to end the confused condition when they take damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is left with a lingering suspicion of others and can't benefit from Aid reactions for 24 hours.

fr.name: Démasquer
fr.description:
Déclencheur Au moins deux créatures pénètrent dans la zone de la hantise.

Effet Chaque créature voit la silhouette des créatures proches se déformer et se transformer avant de prendre l'apparence de fiélons ou d'aberrations assoiffés de sang. Chaque créature dans la zone d'effet doit tenter un jet de @Check[will|dc:30].

Succès critique La créature perce l'illusion et est temporairement immunisée contre la routine de la hantise pendant 1 minute.

Succès La créature n'est pas affectée par les étranges images.

Échec La créature croit que les illusions sont réelles ; si elle devient confuse du fait de la routine de la hantise, elle ne peut tenter de tests nus pour mettre un terme à l'état confus quand elle subit des dégâts.

Échec critique Comme en cas d'échec mais la créature conserve une méfiance envers les autres et ne peut bénéficier d'une réaction Aider pendant 24 heures.

zh.name: 揭开面具 Unmask
zh.description:
触发 两个或更多的生物进入作祟区域；

效果 每个生物都会看到身边生物的形态发生改变，似乎变成了嗜血的魔族或异怪。该区域内的每个生物都必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:30]豁免。

大成功 生物看穿了幻象，并在1分钟之内对作祟的例行程序临时免疫。

成功 目标不受幻象的影响。

失败 生物相信了幻象是真实的；如果它们受到作祟的例行程序影响而陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]，则它们不能在受到伤害时通过纯骰检定来结束困惑状态。

大失败 类似失败，但该生物也会对他人产生挥之不去的怀疑，并且在24小时之内无法从协助反应动作中获益。

fr.name: Trahison confondante
fr.description: Les alliés apparaissent retirer leurs déguisements et se révèlent être des monstres malveillants.
fr.disable: @Check[deception|dc:28|name:Tromper la hantise|traits:haunt](expert) deux fois pour tromper la hantise avec votre propres mensonges ou @Check[occultism|dc:28|name:créer une protection|traits:haunt,mental] (qualifié) deux fois pour créer une protection contre l'influence mentale de la hantise
fr.reset: La hantise se désactive 1 minute après que toutes les créatures aient quitté la zone mais se réactive immédiatement après
fr.routine:
(1 action ; illusion, mise hors de combat, occulte) La hantise continue à créer la confusion des sens de la victime et la pousser à commettre des violences contre les autres. Chaque créature dans la zone de la hantise doit tenter un jet de @Check[will|dc:26].

Succès critique La créature n'est pas affectée et est temporairement immunisée pendant 1 minute.

Succès La créature n'est pas affectée.

Échec La créature est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confuse} pendant 1 round.

Échec critique La créature est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confuse} pendant 1 minute.

zh.name: 迷之背叛 Confounding Betrayal
zh.description: 盟友似乎脱下了伪装，展现出了作为恶毒怪物的本来面目。
zh.disable: @Check[deception|dc:28|name:Confound the Haunt] （专家）2次，用你自己的诈术反过来骗过作祟；或@Check[occultism|dc:28|name:Create a Ward Against Influence] （受训）2次，创建一个能对抗作祟精神影响的结界。
zh.reset: 所有生物离开该区域1分钟之后，作祟会停止活动，但之后会立即重置。
zh.routine:
（1 动作；幻术系, 失能, 异能）作祟持续混淆受害者的感官，并刺激它们对彼此施加暴力。作祟区域内的每个生物都必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:26]豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响并且在1分钟内临时免疫。

成功 生物不受影响。

失败 生物陷入困惑1轮。

大失败 生物陷入困惑1分钟。

pl.name: Kłopotliwa Zdrada
pl.description: Sojusznicy zdają się zrzucać swoje przebrania i ujawniać, że są złowrogimi potworami.
pl.disable: @Check[deception|dc:28|name:Zmylenie Zjawy] (ekspert) dwukrotnie, aby zmylić zjawę własnymi podstępami, lub @Check[occultism|dc:28|name:Stworzenie Ochrony Przed Wpływem] (wyszkolony) dwukrotnie, aby stworzyć ochronę przed mentalnym wpływem zjawy
pl.reset: Nawiedzenie dezaktywuje się 1 minutę po tym, jak wszystkie stworzenia opuszczą obszar, ale natychmiast się resetuje.
pl.routine:
(1 akcja; iluzja, obezwładnienie, okultyzm) Zjawa nadal mąci zmysły ofiar i inspiruje je do popełniania aktów przemocy wobec siebie nawzajem. Każde stworzenie w obszarze działania zjawy musi wykonać test @Check[will|dc:26] obronny na Wolę.

Krytyczny sukces Stworzenie pozostaje niewzruszone i jest tymczasowo odporne przez 1 minutę.

Sukces Stworzenie pozostaje niewzruszone.

Porażka Stworzenie jest @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Zdezorientowane} przez 1 rundę.

Krytyczna porażka Stworzenie jest zdezorientowane przez 1 minutę.

name: Confounding Portal
description: Tiny runes carved around a doorframe or on a hall's walls surreptitiously confound creatures into circling the room or hallway they attempted to exit or pass through.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:17|name:Scratch Out Runes|traits:action:disable-a-device] to scratch out the runes, or @Check[arcana|dc:16|name:Destroy the Runes] to destroy the runes
reset: The trap resets after 1 round.

actions.name: Confounding Misdirection
actions.description:
Trigger A creature passes through the rune-carved doorway or hallway

Effect The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} by the illusions and directed back into the room they attempted to exit through another doorway or back to the hallway's beginning. This feels no different to the triggering creature than walking through the doorway or hallway, and onlookers are similarly befuddled. A creature who succeeds at a @Check[will|dc:19] save resists this illusion and exits the room or proceeds down the hall without being misdirected.

fr.name: Détournement déconcertant
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature traverse la porte ou le couloir sculpté de runes.

Effet La créature est The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confuse} par les illusions et est redirigée une nouvelle fois vers la pièce qu'elle tentait de quitter en passant par la porte ou le couloir où elle était. Pour la créature déclencheuse, cela ne semble pas différent d'un passage dans une porte ou un couloir, et les spectateurs sont tout aussi déroutés. Une créature qui réussit un jet de @Check[will|dc:19] résiste à l'illusion et quitte la pièce ou continue le couloir sans être détournée.

zh.name: 困惑误导 Confounding Misdirection
zh.description:
触发 一个生物通过带有符文雕刻的门框或走廊

效果 该生物因幻象@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]，径直地走回他们想要离开的房间或是回到走廊的入口。对于触发者这个过程与正常行进无异，旁观者也会同样被迷惑。成功通过@Check[will|dc:19]豁免的生物可以抵抗这种幻觉的影响，并正常地在不受困惑的情况下离开房间或穿过走廊继续前进。

fr.name: Portail déconcertant
fr.description: De minuscules runes gravées autour d'un cadre de porte ou sur les murs d'un hall d'entrée déconcertent subrepticement les créatures à tourner autour de la pièce ou du couloir qu'elles tentent de quitter ou de traverser.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:17|name:Gratter les runes|traits:action:disable-a-device] pour faire disparaître les runes en les grattant, ou d'@Check[arcana|dc:16|name:Détruire les runes] pour détruire les runes
fr.reset: Le piège se réinitialise après 1 round.

zh.name: 困惑入口 Confounding Portal
zh.description: 那些雕刻在门框或廊壁上的微小符文将生物困在离开房间或穿越走廊的循环中。
zh.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:17|name:Scratch Out Runes|traits:action:disable-a-device]来划去符文；@Check[arcana|dc:16|name:Destroy the Runes]以摧毁符文
zh.reset: 陷阱在1轮后重置。

pl.name: Confounding Portal
pl.description: Tiny runes carved around a doorframe or on a hall's walls surreptitiously confound creatures into circling the room or hallway they attempted to exit or pass through.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:17|name:Scratch Out Runes|traits:action:disable-a-device] to scratch out the runes, or @Check[arcana|dc:16|name:Destroy the Runes] to destroy the runes
pl.reset: The trap resets after 1 round.

name: Consonite Clusters
description: Consonite forms needle-like stalactites that can easily break free if touched, setting off a chain reaction that threatens to pierce anyone who stands in the area.
disable: @Check[acrobatics|dc:23] (trained) to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze} through the caps between the needles.
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-13: Thick as Thieves

actions.name: Needle Fall
actions.description:
Trigger A creature touches any consonite cluster

Effect The needles snap, and the vibrations resonate with some of the surrounding clusters. The falling minerals deal @Damage[(2d10+9)[untyped]] damage to creatures within a @Template[burst|distance:5] surrounding the triggering individual (@Check[reflex|dc:22] save). The needle fall does not involve every consonite growth within these squares, so can be triggered again from the same location.

fr.name: Chute d'aiguilles
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature touche une cascade de consonite

Effet Les aiguilles se brisent et des vibrations résonnent et s'étendent aux cascades d'aiguilles à proximité. Les minéraux qui tombent infligent @Damage[(2d10+9)[untyped]]{2d10+9 dégâts} aux créatures dans une @Template[burst|distance:5]{explosion de 1,50 mètre} centrée sur la créature déclencheuse (@Check[reflex|dc:22]). name: Convergence Lattice
description: A complex clockwork of bright metal and delicately carved gemstones, the lattice's interlocking gears begin to whir as golden runes glow across its surface.
disable:
@Check[thievery|dc:40|name:Obliterate a Key Rune|traits:magical,trap] (master) or @Check[religion|dc:35|name:Obliterate a Key Rune|traits:magical,trap] (master) four times to obliterate each of the four key runes.

A @Check[thievery|dc:45|name:Stop the Clockwork's Movement|traits:magical,trap] (legendary) check (or breaking the lattice) stops the clockwork's movement and prevents it from resetting, but doesn't stop its current activation.
reset: The convergence lattice deactivates and resets after there are no uncontrolled targets within line of sight for 1 minute.
routine:
(3 actions) The convergence lattice uses its first action to call for aid. Each convergent creature within 100 feet of the lattice Strides toward the lattice as a reaction. Creatures thus called continue to move toward the lattice on their turn each round until they are adjacent to it, at which point they defend it with their lives.

The lattice uses its second action to deal @Damage[16d6[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:42|basic] save) to a non-convergent creature within 100 feet. This damage is nonlethal; a creature knocked out by this damage doesn't gain the dying condition and is automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} by the convergence lattice when they awaken.

The lattice uses its third action to make the same attack against a second non-convergent creature within 100 feet; if there isn't such a second creature, it doesn't take its third action.
stealth: (master) to realize the lattice is a complex clockwork before it begins to move; noticing the lattice itself is DC 0.

fr.name: Réseau convergent

fr.disable:
@Check[thievery|dc:40|name:Détruire une Rune Clé|traits:magical,trap] (maître) ou @Check[religion|dc:35|name:Détruire une Rune Clé|traits:magical,trap] (maître) quatre fois pour détruire chacune des quatre runes clés.

Un test de @Check[thievery|dc:45|name:Arrêter les mouvements du mécanisme|traits:magical,trap] (légendaire) (ou briser le réseau) arrête les mouvements du mécanisme et empêche sa réinitialisation, mais pas son activation actuelle.
fr.reset: Le réseau convergent se désactive et se réinitialise lorsqu'il n'a plus aucune cible non contrôlée en ligne de mire durant 1 minute.
fr.routine:
(3 actions) Le réseau convergent utilise sa première action pour appeler à l'aide. Toute créature convergente à moins de 30 mètres du réseau Marche rapidement dans sa direction en réaction. Durant leur tour, les créatures appelées ainsi continuent à avancer vers le réseau à chaque round jusqu'à ce qu'elles soient dans un espace adjacent au mécanisme. Là, elles le défendent au péril de leur vie.

Le réseau utilise sa deuxième action pour infliger @Damage[16d6[mental]]{16d6 dégâts mentaux} (@Check[will|dc:42|basic]) à une créature non convergente à moins de 30 m. Ces dégâts sont non-létaux : une créature assommée par ceux-ci ne gagne pas l'état mourant et est automatiquement @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Contrôlée} par le réseau convergent lorsqu'elle se réveille.

Ce dernier utilise sa troisième action pour effectuer la même attaque contre une autre créature non convergente à moins de 30 m. Si aucune créature n'est disponible, il n'effectue pas sa troisième action.
fr.stealth: Maître pour réaliser que le réseau est un mécanisme complexe avant qu'il ne commence à bouger ; remarquer le réseau lui-même est un DD 0.

name: Corazal Aflame
description: Fire burns Corazal and threatens to spread to the surrounding forest.
disable: @Check[nature|dc:30] or @Check[survival|dc:30] (expert) to douse flames or @Check[athletics|dc:32] (expert) to smother flames; on the sixth successful check, the flames go out. Casting a non-cantrip water spell on the flames counts as one success.
routine: (1 action; fire) On its turn, the fire deals @Damage[(2d8+13)[fire]] damage to creatures in the grove, plus an additional @Damage[6[fire]] damage to Corazal and any creature within 15 feet of them (@Check[reflex|dc:29|basic] save).

actions.name: Blaze
actions.description:
Trigger A living creature approaches Corazal

Effect The flames blaze higher, dealing @Damage[(2d12+13)[fire]] damage to the triggering creature (@Check[reflex|dc:29|basic] save). The hazard then rolls initiative.

name: Cordon Alarm
description: A hempen rope tied between trees emanates an invisible, cylindrical barrier that sounds an alarm when crossed.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:18] (trained) to move the rope without setting of the alarm, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (1st rank; counteract DC 16) to disable the rope's magic
reset: The alarm resets immediately. Multiple breaches can cause the alarm to sound in multiple places at the same time, though the alarm can still be triggered only once per round.

actions.name: Alarm
actions.description:
Trigger An object or creature of at least 1 Bulk crosses an invisible vertical barrier extending 30 feet above and below the rope

Effect The rope squawks like an angry squirrel from the point where the barrier was breached. This alarm is as loud as a human scream and lasts for 1 minute. If an item or creature is still breaching the barrier at the end of this duration, the alarm immediately triggers again.

fr.name: Alarme
fr.description:
Déclencheur Un objet ou une créature d'au moins 1 Charge traverse une barrière verticale invisible s'étendant sur 9 mètres au-dessus et en dessous de la corde.

Effet La corde pousse un cri strident semblable à un écureuil en colère à l'endroit où la barrière a été franchie. Cette alarme est aussi forte qu'un cri humain et dure 1 minute. Si un objet ou une créature continue de franchir la barrière à la fin de cette durée, l'alarme se déclenche immédiatement une nouvelle fois.

zh.name: 警报 Alarm
zh.description:
触发 一个至少负载1的物体或生物穿过了绳子垂直方向上下分别延伸30尺的隐形屏障

效果 绳子从遭到闯入的位置发出如同愤怒松鼠的叫声。警报的音量与成年人类喊叫相同并且持续1分钟。如果警报结束时闯入者仍然存在，警报立即再次触发。

fr.name: Cordon d'alarme
fr.description: Une corde de chanvre attachée entre des arbres émet une barrière cylindrique invisible qui déclenche une alarme lorsqu'elle est franchie.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:18] (qualifié) pour déplacer la corde sans déclencher l'alarme, ou @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dissipation de la magie} (contrer : Rang 1 ; DD 16) pour désactiver la magie de la corde
fr.reset: L'alarme se réinitialise immédiatement. Plusieurs infractions peuvent provoquer l'activation de l'alarme à plusieurs endroits en même temps, bien que l'alarme ne puisse être déclenchée qu'une seule fois par round.

pl.reset: The alarm resets immediately. Multiple breaches can cause the alarm to sound in multiple places at the same time, though the alarm can still be triggered only once per round.

name: Corpse Disposal
description: A wooden trapdoor conceals a spike-filled pit 10 feet square and 20 feet deep. The DC to Climb out of the pit is @Check[athletics|dc:10|traits:action:climb].
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:18] (trained) to jam the trapdoor open
stealth: (or 0 if the trapdoor is disabled or broken)

actions.name: Dispose
actions.description:
Trigger A creature steps onto the trapdoor (marked "T" on the map)

Effect The triggering creature falls into the pit. The creature can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} reaction to avoid falling. Failing that, the creature falls 20 feet (taking @Damage[10[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage] from the fall) and takes @Damage[3d6[piercing]] from the metal spikes jutting up from the pit's floor. A creature who takes damage from the spikes is exposed to tetanus.

fr.name: Se débarrasser
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature marche sur la trappe (marquée "T" sur la carte).

Effet La créature qui a déclenché l'effet, tombe dans la fosse. Elle peut utiliser la réaction @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Se raccrocher in extremis} pour éviter la chute. Si elle échoue, elle tombe de 6 mètres (subissant @Damage[10[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage]{10 dégâts contondants} à cause de la chute) et subit @Damage[3d6[piercing]]{3d6 dégâts perforants} à cause des pics métalliques qui tapissent le fond de la fosse. Une créature blessée par ces pics est exposée au tétanos.

zh.name: 处理程序 Dispose
zh.description:
触发 一名生物踏入活板门区域（即地图上所有标志“T”的方格）

效果 触发生物掉入落穴。该生物可以尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]反应以避免坠落。若落入其中，该生物坠落20尺（这意味着受到来自坠落的@Damage[10[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage]伤害）并受到从落穴底部伸出的金属尖刺造成的@Damage[3d6[piercing]]伤害。受到尖刺造成伤害的生物会暴露于破伤风之下。

actions.name: Tetanus
actions.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:14]

Onset 10 days

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (1 week)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} and can't speak (1 day)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} with spasms (1 day)

Stage 4 death

fr.name: Tétanos
fr.description:
Jet de sauvegarde @Check[fortitude|dc:14]

Délai 10 jours

Stade 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Maladroit 1} (1 semaine)

Stade 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Maladroit 2} et incapable de parler (1 jour)

Stade 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralysé} par des spasmes (1 jour)

Stade 4 Mort

zh.name: 破伤风 Tetanus
zh.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:14]

潜伏期 10天

阶段1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 Clumsy 1} （1周）

阶段2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 Clumsy 2}并且无法说话（1天）

阶段3 因肌肉痉挛而陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]（1天）

阶段4 死亡

fr.stealth: (ou 0 si la trappe est désactivée ou brisée)

description: Churning vapors of glowing green mist fill a 30-foot-deep chasm.
disable: @Check[religion|dc:28] to counteract Kabriri's influence here by offering prayers to any non-evil deity and causing the mist to disperse, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (3rd rank; counteract DC 23) to counteract the mist for 24 hours

actions.description:

fr.name: Décomposition de la chair
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature termine son tour dans la brume

Effet La brume décompose rapidement la chair de toutes les créatures vivantes dans le gouffre, infligeant @Damage[10d6[void]]{10d6 dégâts du vide} (@Check[fortitude|dc:27|basic]).

zh.name: 腐蚀肉体 Decay Flesh
zh.description:
触发 一个生物在迷雾中结束回合

效果 迷雾会迅速腐蚀坑洞中所有生物的肉体，造成@Damage[10d6[void]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:27|basic]强韧豁免检定）。

fr.name: Brume de lueur de cadavre
fr.description: Des vapeurs tourbillonnantes d'une brume verte luminescente remplissent un gouffre de 9 mètres de profondeur.
fr.disable: @Check[religion|dc:28] pour contrer l'influence de Kabriri en adressant des prières à une divinité non mauvaise, ce qui provoque la dispersion de la brume, ou @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dissipation de la magie} (niveau 3 ; contre DD 23) pour contrer la brume pendant 24 heures
fr.reset: Le danger se réinitialise automatiquement à la fin d'un tour et peut de nouveau se déclencher au round suivant.

zh.name: 尸光迷雾 Corpselight Mist
zh.description: 翻涌的绿光迷雾充斥着一条30尺深的裂隙。
zh.disable: @Check[religion|dc:28]来向任意非邪恶神祗祈祷以反制卡布里里的影响使迷雾消散；或者@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]（3环级环，反制DC23）来反制迷雾24小时。
zh.reset: 该危害在回合结束时自动重置，并可在下一轮再次触发。

name: Corrupt Grove
description: A noisome mass of fungus at the center of the grove raises fungal guardians from the ground to defend itself.
disable: @Check[survival|dc:42] (master) six times to carefully remove all the tangled fungal clots that absorb Tanglebriar's ambient energies for nourishment or @Check[religion|dc:45] (legendary) on the grove three times by a character who has holy sanctification and who uses prayer to exorcise the unholy energies that sustain the corrupt grove
publication: Pathfinder #211: The Secret of Deathstalk Tower
reset: The corrupt grove resets 1 minute after no enemies are within the grove itself or attempting to damage the grove from beyond the crater's perimeter.
routine: (1 action; poison, primal) The corrupt grove pulses and exudes a blast of toxic spores in a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] that targets the area with the densest concentration of intruders. Creatures in this area take @Damage[8d6[poison]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:37|basic|traits:poison,primal] save).

actions.name: Awaken Guardians
actions.description:
Trigger A creature damages the corrupt grove, attempts but fails to disable it, or ends their turn within 10 feet of the central mass

Effect The corrupt grove suddenly contracts and then exudes an unsettling, trumpeting howl and rolls initiative.

zh.name: 唤醒守卫 Awaken Guardians
zh.description:
触发 一个生物对腐化树丛造成伤害，尝试但未能解除它，或在中心团块10尺内结束回合。

效果 腐化树丛突然收缩，随即发出一阵刺耳的、如号角般的啸叫，并骰先攻。

zh.name: 腐化树丛 Corrupt Grove
zh.description: 一团散发恶臭的真菌团块位于树丛的中央，能从地面召唤真菌守卫以保护自身。
zh.disable: 通过 6 次 @Check[survival|dc:42]（大师）来小心地移除所有吸收扭曲棘林环境能量以获取养分的缠结在一起的真菌团块。或者在树丛中进行三次 @Check[religion|dc:45]（传奇）来让一位圣洁受祝的角色祈祷以驱散维持腐化树丛的邪秽能量。
zh.reset: 腐化树丛将在树丛内没有敌人且无生物从凹坑外围试图对树丛造成伤害的1分钟后重置。
zh.routine: （1动作，毒素，原能）腐化树丛脉动震颤，随即喷涌出一股 @Template[type:cone|distance:60] 锥形范围剧毒孢子，瞄准区域内入侵生物最密集之处。身处该区域的生物将受到 @Damage[8d6[poison]] 点毒素伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:37|basic|traits:poison,primal] 强韧豁免）。

Creatures in this area take @Damage[8d6[poison]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:37|basic|traits:poison,primal] save).

name: Corrupted Draft
description: Discordant music, dance, and poetry combine to build a deep suspicion and distrust of strangers.
disable: @Check[performance|dc:28] to counteract the performance or @Check[religion|dc:28] or @Check[occultism|dc:28] to disrupt the spiritual energy. Two total successes are needed to disable the trap. The mechanical head can automatically disable the trap with two uses of Inspired Recitation.
reset: The hazard stops when there are no conscious creatures in area E3 and resets after 1 minute.
routine:
(1 action; emotion, fear, mental, occult) The echoes continue to reverberate, tearing at those in the area and filling them with distrust of others. All creatures in the area take @Damage[(2d10+11)[mental]] damage and must attempt a @Check[will|dc:28|traits:emotion,fear,mental,occult,damaging-effect] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is immune to the effects for 1 minute.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} by feelings of distrust and anxiety.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

actions.name: Sickening Performance
actions.description:
Trigger Two or more characters enter area E3 and make any sound at all

Effect Sounds or speech are amplified and garbled into a terrible, shrieking cry. All creatures in the area take @Damage[(2d10+11)[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:28|basic] save). The trap then rolls initiative.

zh.name: 可憎表演 Sickening Performance
zh.description:
触发 两名生物进入了区域E3并且发出任意声响

效果 他们发出的声响或言语被迅速放大并扭曲为一股尖锐可怖的号哭。区域内所有生物受到@Damage[(2d10+11)[mental]]伤害（@Check[will|dc:28|basic]豁免）。随后投先攻。

zh.name: 腐化蓝图 Corrupted Draft
zh.description: 不谐的音乐，舞蹈与诗篇组合在一起，营造出一种对他人深深的猜疑与不信的氛围。
zh.disable: @Check[performance|dc:28]以反制该表演，以及@Check[religion|dc:28]或@Check[occultism|dc:28]以瓦解其灵能。无效化该陷阱需要两次成功。机械脑袋可以使用激励复诵能力自动地完成上述条件。
zh.reset: 该危害在E3区域内不再存在有意识的生物后停止，并在1分钟后重置。
zh.routine:
（1动作；情绪，恐惧，心灵，异能） 哀嚎的回响仍持续地反射增强，撕扯着区域内所有人并向他们的心中注入对周围人的猜疑。区域内的所有生物受到@Damage[(2d10+11)[mental]]伤害，并且必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:28|traits:emotion,fear,mental,occult,damaging-effect]豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响，并且在1分钟内临时对此效果免疫。

成功 该生物受到的伤害减半。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并且由于心中的焦躁与猜疑陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 1}。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，并且陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 2}。

pl.name: Corrupted Draft
pl.description: Discordant music, dance, and poetry combine to build a deep suspicion and distrust of strangers.
pl.disable: @Check[performance|dc:28] to counteract the performance or @Check[religion|dc:28] or @Check[occultism|dc:28] to disrupt the spiritual energy. Two total successes are needed to disable the trap. The mechanical head can automatically disable the trap with two uses of Inspired Recitation.
pl.reset: The hazard stops when there are no conscious creatures in area E3 and resets after 1 minute.
pl.routine:
(1 action; emotion, fear, mental, occult) The echoes continue to reverberate, tearing at those in the area and filling them with distrust of others. All creatures in the area take @Damage[(2d10+11)[mental]] damage and must attempt a @Check[will|dc:28|traits:emotion,fear,mental,occult,damaging-effect] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is immune to the effects for 1 minute.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} by feelings of distrust and anxiety.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

name: Covetous Corridor
description: Statues depicting the runelords of envy steal magic from intruders.
disable: @Check[arcana|dc:45] (master) to unweave the magic surrounding a statue, @Check[athletics|dc:48] (expert) to wrest a statue's implement from its hands, @Check[thievery|dc:48] (expert) to slip an implement free, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (9th rank; counteract DC 36) to counteract the magic that empowers the statue. Increase the DCs to disable the Belimarius statue by 2. Each statue must be disabled or counteracted separately, and disabling the Belimarius statue or all nine other statues permanently disables the hazard.
reset: The hazard resets automatically if not disabled.
routine: (4 actions) The hazard uses Steal Magic twice. Once the implements of at least three runelord statues are charged, the hazard uses its next available action to Transfer Magic. If the hazard starts its turn with the Belimarius statue charged, the hazard uses its reaction to Empower Barrier. A disabled runelord statue can't use Steal Magic. If the Belimarius statue is disabled, the hazard can't use Transfer Magic or Empower Barrier.

actions.name: Covet Magic
actions.description:
Trigger A magic item or active spell effect enters the corridor

Effect A randomly determined statue uses the hazard's Steal Magic action. The hazard then rolls initiative.

zh.name: 垂涎魔法 Covet Magic
zh.description:
触发 魔法物品或活跃的法术效果进入长廊

效果 随机选取一座雕像，使用危害的窃取魔法动作。随后危害骰先攻。

actions.name: Steal Magic
actions.description:
Roll a [[/gmr d10]] to determine which statue activates, rerolling a result of 10 or any result that would indicate a disabled statue or a statue that is already charged. The indicated statue casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kUSShxXzY1sPtJA0]{Detonate Magic} with a [[/gmr 1d20+32 #Counteract]]{+32} bonus to its counteract check. The spell targets the closest magic item within 120 feet, prioritizing the highest-ranking magic item and targeting spell effects only if no magic item is within range. On a success or critical success, the statue gathers the dispersed energy into its implement, charging it.

While the statue's implement remains charged, any creature who is at least an expert in @Check[arcana|dc:44], @Check[nature|dc:44], @Check[occultism|dc:44], or @Check[religion|dc:44] can use a 2-action activity with the concentrate trait to attempt a DC 44 check using that skill. On a success or critical success, they return the magic to its original source, causing it to reactivate. Removing an implement from its statue prevents the statue from using Transfer Magic but doesn't prevent a creature from restoring the charge to its source.

zh.name: 窃取魔法 Steal Magic
zh.description:
掷 [[/gmr d10]] 确定哪座雕像被启动，若掷出 10 或结果指向已被解除或已充能的雕像，则重新掷骰。被指定的雕像施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kUSShxXzY1sPtJA0]，其反制检定加值为 [[/gmr 1d20+32 #Counteract]]{+32} 。该法术以120尺内最近的魔法物品为目标，优先选择环级最高的魔法物品，若范围内没有魔法物品，则仅以法术效果为目标。若检定成功或大成功，雕像将分散的能量聚集到其魔法器具中，为其充能。

只要雕像的魔法器具保持充能状态，任何在 @Check[arcana|dc:44]、@Check[nature|dc:44]、@Check[occultism|dc:44] 或 @Check[religion|dc:44] 技能上至少具有专家熟练度的生物都可以进行一个具有专注特征的双动作行动，尝试使用该技能进行 DC 44 的检定。若检定成功或未成功，他们将魔法恢复到其原始来源，使其重新激活。从雕像上取下魔法器具可防止雕像使用转移魔法，但不会阻止生物将充能恢复到其来源。

actions.name: Transfer Magic
actions.description:
Requirements The implements of at least three runelord statues are charged

Effect Three statues with charged implements transfer their charges to the Belimarius statue. While the Belimarius statue holds at least one charge, a creature can transfer charges from its implement as described in Steal Magic, except the DC of the skill check increases to DC 46; success returns the stolen magic to the appropriate items.

@Check[arcana|dc:46], @Check[nature|dc:46], @Check[occultism|dc:46], or @Check[religion|dc:46]

zh.name: 转移魔法 Transfer Magic
zh.description:
需求 至少有三座符文领主雕像的魔法器具被充能

效果 三座魔法器具已被充能的雕像将它们的充能转移到贝利玛留斯雕像上。只要贝利玛留斯雕像至少拥有一个充能，生物就可以按照窃取魔法中描述的方式从其魔法器具中转移充能，但技能检定 DC 增加到 46；成功就会将窃取的魔法恢复到相应的物品中。

@Check[arcana|dc:46]、@Check[nature|dc:46]、@Check[occultism|dc:46] 或 @Check[religion|dc:46]

actions.name: Empower Barrier
actions.description:
Requirements The hazard starts its turn, and the Belimarius statue holds at least one charge

Effect The Belimarius statue transfers all charges from its implement into the force barrier separating the corridor from area B3. For every charge the statue transfers, the force barrier gains 10 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 hour. (If the force barrier has been destroyed, the statue instead expends the first charge to cast a 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Iela4GgVeO3LfAo]{Wall of Force}, with any remaining charges granting the barrier temporary Hit Points.) Charges transferred to the force barrier are lost forever and can't be returned to items they were stolen from.

zh.name: 强化屏障 Empower Barrier
zh.description:
需求 危害开始其回合，且贝利玛留斯雕像至少拥有一个充能

效果 贝利玛留斯雕像将其魔法器具中的所有充能转移到分隔长廊与区域 B3 的力场屏障上。每转移一个充能，力场屏障获得 10 点临时生命值，持续 1 小时。（如果力场屏障已被摧毁，雕像则消耗第一个充能施放 6 环 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Iela4GgVeO3LfAo]，剩余充能为屏障提供临时生命值。）转移到力场屏障上的充能将永久消失，无法恢复到其被窃取的物品中。

name: Cracked Earth
description: This 20-foot-by-20-foot patch of ground is cobwebbed with cracks and fissures that crumble when a creature steps on it.
disable: @Check[survival|dc:16] (untrained) to collapse safely; @Check[crafting|dc:20] (trained) to shore it up enough to pass over without collapsing it

actions.name: Long Fall
actions.description:
Trigger A creature steps onto the cracked earth

Effect The creature fractures the thin crust of earth and falls through. That creature can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} reaction to avoid falling, as long as it is adjacent to an edge. Otherwise it takes falling damage (typically @Damage[25[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage] damage for a 50-foot drop). Some of these rifts eventually lead to the Darklands.

fr.name: Longue chute
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature marche sur la terre craquelée

Effet La créature fracture la fin croûte de terre et passe au travers. Cette créature peut utiliser la réaction @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Se raccrocher in extremis} pour éviter la chute, tant qu'elle est adjacente à un bord. Autrement elle subit des dégâts de chute (typiquement@Damage[25[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage]{25 dégâts contondants} pour une chute de 15 mètres). Certaines de ses failles peuvent aussi les conduire en Ombreterre.

zh.name: Long Fall
zh.description:
Trigger A creature steps onto the cracked earth

Effect The creature fractures the thin crust of earth and falls through. That creature can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} reaction to avoid falling, as long as it is adjacent to an edge. Otherwise it takes falling damage (typically @Damage[25[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage] damage for a 50-foot drop). Some of these rifts eventually lead to the Darklands.

fr.name: Terre craquelée
fr.description: Cette parcelle de 6 mètres sur 6 mètres est parsemée de fissures et de craquelures qui s'effritent lorsqu'une créature marche dessus.
fr.disable: @Check[survival|dc:16] (inexpérimenté) pour la faire s'effondrer en toute sécurité, @Check[crafting|dc:20] (qualifié) pour la consolider suffisamment pour passer sans l'effondrer.

pl.name: Cracked Earth
pl.description: This 20-foot-by-20-foot patch of ground is cobwebbed with cracks and fissures that crumble when a creature steps on it.
pl.disable: @Check[survival|dc:16] (untrained) to collapse safely; @Check[crafting|dc:20] (trained) to shore it up enough to pass over without collapsing it

name: Creatures of the Night
description: Bats and rats swarm around Ezio's enemies.
disable: @Check[nature|dc:24] or @Check[religion|dc:24] (trained) to scatter the vermin; two successes are required to disable it
routine: (1 action) The bats and rats bite all creatures in the room, doing @Damage[(2d8+3)[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic] save). On a failure, the creature also takes @Damage[3[persistent,bleed]] damage.

actions.name: Infest
actions.description:
Trigger Ezio summons the swarms

Effect The swarms coalesce in nauseating fashion. Each creature in the room must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). The hazard then rolls initiative.

name: Creeping Slime
description: The thick green slime has been imbued with foul hag magic, making it cling to and grow over living creatures that touch it.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:17] (trained) to carefully push the slime away without causing it to grow, @Check[crafting|dc:17] (one action) to neutralize it with alchemical reagents, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (2nd rank; counteract DC 15 [DC 18 in Subtier 3-4]) to counteract the magic animating it. Casting a 1st-rank or higher spell with the water trait washes away the slime.
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-22: Doom of Cassomir

actions.name: Coat with Slime
actions.description:
Trigger A creature steps into the slime covering the steps and upper landing.

Effect The slime rapidly climbs across the creature's body, grows cold, and congeals. Creatures assaulted by the slime take @Damage[(1d8+5)[cold]] damage(@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic] save); creatures that fail their save are also coated in slime, imposing a -5 foot circumstance penalty to their Speeds. The slime can't be easily cleaned away, and it requires ten minutes of bathing with clean water and soap to remove the slime.

fr.name: Enduit de vase
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature marche dans la vase qui recouvre les marches et le palier du dessus.

Effet La vase escalade rapidement le corps de la créature déclencheuse, devient froide puis congèle. Les créatures qui sont agressées par la vase, subissent @Damage[(1d8+5)[cold]]{1d8+5 dégâts de froid} (@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic] save). Une créature qui obtient un échec est également enduit de vase et subit une pénalité de circonstances de -1,50 mètre à ses Vitesses. La vase ne peut pas être enlevée facilement, et demande dix minutes dans de l'eau claire avec du savon pour l'enlever.

fr.name: Vase insidieuse
fr.description: La vase verte épaisse a été imprégnée de l'infâme magie de guenaude. Elle s'accroche aux créatures vivantes qui la touche et puis se développe sur elles.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:17] (qualifié) pour éloigner la vase doucement sans provoquer son développement, @Check[crafting|dc:17] (une action) pour neutraliser les réactifs alchimiques ou @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dissipation de la magie} (contrer : Rang 2 ; DD 15 [DD 18 en tiers 3-4]) pour contrer la magie qui l'anime. Lancer un sort de rang supérieur ou égal à 1 avec le trait eau fait partir la vase collante.

name: Crowd with Chamberpots
description: The crowd is riled up enough to start throwing chamberpots at the interlopers, but not riled up enough to risk their lives. The crowd fills nine contiguous squares but can be shaped to fit the streets. Characters can move through the crowd, but spaces occupied by the crowd are difficult terrain.
disable: After more people in the crowd have become shaken or taken damage than there are crowd leaders left standing, the crowd disperses. For abilities affecting an area, count each affected square as one member of the crowd.
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-01: The Absalom Initiation
reset: After more people in the crowd have become shaken or taken damage than there are crowd leaders left standing, the crowd disperses. For abilities affecting an area, count each affected square as one member of the crowd.
routine: (3 actions) The crowd uses its first action to Stride away from any opponent adjacent to them (or to get within 30 feet), then uses each remaining action to make a chamber pot Strike at a different target.

fr.name: Foule avec des pots de chambre
fr.description: La foule est suffisamment excitée pour commencer à jeter des ordures sur les intrus, mais pas assez pour risquer sa vie. La foule remplit neuf cases contiguës mais peut être modelée pour s'adapter aux rues. Les personnages peuvent se déplacer à travers la foule, mais les espaces occupés par la foule sont des terrains difficiles.
fr.disable: Lorsque le nombre de personnes secouées ou endommagées dans la foule est supérieur au nombre de meneurs encore debout, la foule se disperse. Pour les capacités affectant une zone, chaque case affectée est comptée comme un membre de la foule.
fr.routine: (3 actions) La foule utilise sa première action pour s'éloigner en Marchant rapidement de tout adversaire qui lui est adjacent (ou pour se placer à moins de 9 mètres), puis utilise chaque action restante pour effectuer un coup de Jet de déchets sur une cible différente.

zh.name: 扔夜壶的人群 Crowd with Chamberpots
zh.description: 愤怒的人群向冒犯者投掷夜壶，但还没到以身犯险的程度。该人群充满九个连续的方格，并且能够改变形状填充街区。角色能够移动穿过人群，但是被人群占据的位置是困难地形。
zh.disable: 在人群中已经动摇或者承受伤害的的人数超过了剩余站着的人群领头人数量，人群会散开。对于影响一个区域的效果，将每一格记为一个人群的成员。

pl.name: Crowd with Trash
pl.description: The crowd is riled up enough to start throwing garbage at the interlopers, but not riled up enough to risk their lives. The crowd fills nine contiguous squares but can be shaped to fit the streets. Characters can move through the crowd, but spaces occupied by the crowd are difficult terrain.
pl.disable: After more people in the crowd have become shaken or taken damage than there are crowd leaders left standing, the crowd disperses. For abilities affecting an area, count each affected square as one member of the crowd.
pl.reset: After more people in the crowd have become shaken or taken damage than there are crowd leaders left standing, the crowd disperses. For abilities affecting an area, count each affected square as one member of the crowd.
pl.routine: (3 actions) The crowd uses its first action to Stride away from any opponent adjacent to them (or to get within 30 feet), then uses each remaining action to make a trash Strike at a different target.

name: Cruel Welcome
description: A loved one, tied to a post with thick ropes, suddenly lurches to life and begins to shriek in anguish as soon as one of the PCs comes within 20 feet.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:31] (expert) to remove the small runes carved on the pole that focus the magic, or @Check[occultism|dc:28] (trained) to recognize the occult illusions woven into the trap and disable the underlying magic
reset: A cruel welcome trap resets at midnight.
routine:
(1 action; illusion, mental, occult, visual) The cruel welcome's head lifts, and it gazes at the closest PC within 20 feet; if there are no PCs in range, the trap does nothing, its turn ends, and it deactivates until midnight. The target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:26|traits:illusion,mental,occult,visual] save.

Critical Success The PC is unaffected. For the next 24 hours, the PC gains a +4 circumstance bonus to all saving throws against cruel welcome traps.

Success The PC recognizes the face of the tormented figure on the pole as that of a loved one, and the anguish of the sight results in @Damage[4d10[mental]] damage. For the next 24 hours, the PC gains a +4 circumstance bonus to all saving throws against cruel welcome traps.

Failure As success, but @Damage[(4d10+22)[mental]] damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but @Damage[(8d10+44)[mental]] damage, and the PC becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 24 hours.

actions.name: Become Cruel
actions.description:
Trigger A PC approaches within 20 feet of the trap

Effect The rag-wrapped figure cries out in pain. The triggering PC must attempt a @Check[will|dc:26] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure). The trap then rolls initiative.

name: Crumbling Floor
description: Around the edges of the pit, more rotting boards are ready to give way.
disable: @Check[crafting|dc:14|name:Reinforce Beams] to reinforce the beams
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-01: The Absalom Initiation
reset: As the damage to the floor spreads, the areas adjacent to the new pit become new areas of this hazard.

actions.name: Pitfall
actions.description:
Trigger A creature walks next to the pit.

Effect The triggering creature falls in and takes falling damage (typically @Damage[3[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage] damage) plus @Damage[2d6[piercing]] damage from landing on broken boards.

That creature can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} to avoid falling; the DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb} the walls or Grab an Edge is 14.

fr.name: Chute dans la fosse
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature marche à côté du trou.

Effet La créature qui déclenche ce piège tombe dans le trou et subit des dégâts de chute (généralement @Damage[3[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage]{3 dégâts contondants}) plus @Damage[2d6[piercing]]{2d6 dégâts perforants} en tombant sur les planches cassées. Elle peut effectuer la réaction @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Se raccrocher in extremis} pour éviter de chuter. Le DD pour @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Escalader} les murs ou Se raccrocher in extremis est de 14.

zh.name: 坠坑 Pitfall
zh.description:
触发 一个生物走到坑旁边。

效果 该触发生物坠落，承受坠落伤害（通常为[[/r 3[bludgeoning]]]伤害）以及坠落到破碎的板材上的@Damage[2d6[piercing]]伤害。

该生物可以尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{抓住边缘 Grab an Edge}来避免坠落；@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]墙壁和抓住边缘的DC为14。

fr.name: Effondrement du sol
fr.description: Autour des bords du trou, des planches pourries supplémentaires sont prêtes à s'effondrer.
fr.disable: @Check[crafting|dc:14|name:Renforcement de la poutre] pour renforcer la poutre
fr.reset: Alors que les dégâts du sol s'étendent, les zones adjacentes au nouveau trou deviennent des nouvelles zones de ce piège.

zh.name: 地板坍塌 Crumbling Floor
zh.description: 在坑的周围，一些腐烂的板子也将塌陷。
zh.disable: @Check[crafting|dc:14|name:Reinforce Beams]来强化支撑的梁
zh.reset: 随着对地板造成的伤害扩散，和新的坑相邻的区域成为该区域新的区域。

name: Crumbling Floor
description: At a cursory glance the tunnel appears to be little more than a waterlogged chamber.
disable: @Check[acrobatics|dc:17] (trained) to safely navigate the wet floor without stepping on any loose masonry or @Check[thievery|dc:19] (expert) to cause a controlled collapse without any danger to the PCs.
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-16: A Lie Told to Strangers
stealth: (trained) to notice the worn flagstones which are crumbling away at the slightest pressure.

actions.name: Collapse
actions.description:
Trigger A creature moves into the hazardous area

Effect The flooring crumbles, breaking apart under the creature and sending them into the stagnant water below, dealing @Damage[(2d12+12)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic] save). That creature can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} reaction to avoid falling.

fr.name: Effondrement
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature se déplace dans la zone dangereuse.

Effet Le sol s'effondre, se délitant sous la créature et envoyant celle-ci dans l'eau stagnante dessous, infligeant @Damage[(2d12+12)[bludgeoning]]{2d12+12 dégâts contondants} (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic]). La créature déclencheuse peut utiliser la réaction @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Se raccrocher in extremis} pour ne pas tomber.

fr.name: Effondrement du sol
fr.description: À première vue, le tunnel n'est guère plus qu'une chambre gorgée d'eau
fr.disable: Test d'@Check[acrobatics|dc:17] (qualifié) pour se déplacement en toute sûreté sur le sol mouillé sans marcher sur la maçonnerie dégradée ou test de @Check[thievery|dc:19] (expert) pour provoquer l'effondrement du sol sans danger aux autres PJ.
fr.stealth: Qualifié pour remarquer les dalles usées qui pourraient s'effondrer à la moindre pression sur elles.

name: Crush the Uninvited
description: A warning carved into the door frame magically crushes any who pass through the doorway without Kemnebi's permission.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:48] (legendary) to scratch out the warning or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (10th rank; counteract DC 48) to counteract the magic in the warning
stealth: (legendary); @Check[perception|dc:20] to notice the warning carved in the door frame

actions.name: Implosion
actions.description:
Trigger A creature passes through the doorway without Kemnebi's permission

Effect The trap casts implosion on the triggering creature. This is a 10th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4WS7HrFjwNvTn8T2]{Implosion} spell that deals @Damage[85[untyped]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:47|basic]).

fr.name: Implosion
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature passe l'encadrement de la porte sans la permission de Kemnebi

Effet Le piège lance le sort @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4WS7HrFjwNvTn8T2]{Implosion} au rang 10 sur la créature déclencheuse. Ceci inflige @Damage[85[untyped]]{85 dégâts} d'implosion à la créature (@Check[fortitude|dc:47|basic]).

name: Crushing Crowd (1-2)
description: The crowd rushes forward, risking a stampede as everyone tries to fnd a safe exit.
disable: @Check[diplomacy|dc:15] to calm the crowd, or @Check[intimidation|dc:18] or @Check[society|dc:18] to control the crowd's behavior
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-01: Intro to the Year of Immortal Influence
routine:
(1 action) On its initiative, the crowd moves 5 feet toward the exit in area A1, then crushes any creature in a @Template[emanation|distance:10], dealing @Damage[(2d6+2)[bludgeoning]] damage. All targets must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:18|basic] save.

Failure The target takes full damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, becomes prone, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

actions.name: Crush
actions.description:
Trigger Lady Embersplitter announces that the victim has died

Effect The crowd begins moving around the bailey and deals @Damage[(2d6+2)[bludgeoning]] damage in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic] save), and then rolls initiative.

fr.name: Écrasement
fr.description:
Déclencheur Lady Embersplitter annonce que la victime est morte

Effet La foule commence à se déplacer autour de la basse-cour et inflige @Damage[(2d6+2)[bludgeoning]]{2d6+2 dégâts contondants} dans une @Template[emanation|distance:10]{émanation de 3 mètres} (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic]), puis la foule détermine l'initiative.

fr.name: Foule écrasante (1-2)
fr.description: La foule se précipite en avant, risquant un mouvement de foule alors que tout le monde tente de trouver une sortie sûre.
fr.disable: @Check[diplomacy|dc:15] pour calmer la foule, ou @Check[intimidation|dc:18] ou @Check[society|dc:18] pour contrôler le comportement de la foule
fr.routine:
(1 action) À son initiative, la foule se déplace de 1,50 mètre vers la sortie de la zone A1, puis écrase toute créature dans une @Template[emanation|distance:10]{émanation de 3 mètres}, infligeant @Damage[(2d6+2)[bludgeoning]]{2d6+2 dégâts contondants}. Toutes les cibles doivent tenter un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:18|basic].

Échec La cible subit tous les dégâts et tombe @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{À terre}.

Échec critique La cible subit le double des dégâts, tombe À terre et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Maladroite 1} pendant 1 round.
