name: Frozen Moment
description: Warding magic attempts to trap intruders or would-be thieves in a disrupted time flow.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:38|name:Disassemble Spell Components|traits:action:disable-a-device] (legendary) to rapidly disassemble the spell's myriad components in a single blink of an eye; or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (9th rank; counteract DC 36) to counteract the trap before it triggers or to counteract the effect on one creature after the trap is triggered

actions.name: Adrift in Time
actions.description:
Trigger A creature touches the warded object or area.

Effect The triggering creature and all creatures within 30 feet are trapped in a disrupted time flow (@Check[fortitude|dc:38] negates). The creatures' minds move so quickly that each round seems to last a century, but their bodies and magical energies move so slowly that they can't use any actions except Recall Knowledge. An affected creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:36] saving throw against a warp mind spell immediately and again for every minute of real time that passes while the creature is trapped in the frozen moment. This effect has an unlimited duration but can be counteracted.

fr.name: Dérive temporelle
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature touche la zone ou l'objet protégé.

Effet La créature qui déclenche le piège et toutes les créatures à 9 mètres ou moins sont emportées dans une trame temporelle pervertie (@Check[fortitude|dc:38] pour annuler). L'esprit des créatures va une vitesse telle que chaque round semble durer un siècle, mais leur corps et les énergies magiques vont si lentement qu'ils ne peuvent effectuer aucune action à part Se souvenir. Une créature affectée doit immédiatement faire un jet de @Check[will|dc:36] contre le sort Déformer l'esprit et en faire un nouveau lors de chaque minute de temps réel qui s'écoule alors que la créature est piégée dans l'instant figé. Cet effet a une durée illimitée mais peut être contré.

zh.name: 时间漂流 Adrift in Time
zh.description:
触发 一个生触碰带有警戒功能的物品或区域；

效果 触发的生物和30尺范围内所有生物被静滞在固定的时间流中（通过@Check[fortitude|dc:38]检定则不受影响）。这些生物的思维运转速度很快，以至于每一轮似乎都过了一个世纪那么久，但是他们的身体和魔法能量移动的非常慢，以至于它们除了回忆知识以为不能进行任何动作。受影响的生物必须立即对心灵扭曲法术进行@Check[will|dc:36]豁免，并且在该生物被冻结后的每一分钟再次进行豁免。此效果持续时间无限，但是可以被反制。

fr.name: Instant figé
fr.description: Une magie protectrice tente de piéger les intrus et les voleurs dans une trame temporelle pervertie.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:38|name:Désassembler les éléments du sort|traits:action:disable-a-device] (légendaire) pour désassembler les multiples éléments du sort en un clin d'œil ou @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dissipation de la magie} (contrer : Rang 9, DD 36) le piège avant qu'il ne se déclenche ou pour contrer l'effet sur une créature après le déclenchement du piège

zh.name: 瞬间静滞 Frozen Moment
zh.description: 守卫魔法试图将入侵者或窃贼冻结在时间流中。
zh.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:38|name:Disassemble Spell Components|traits:action:disable-a-device] （传奇）在一眨眼的功夫内迅速瓦解咒语的各个组成部分；或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法 Dispel Magic}（9环级；反制 DC36）在触陷阱出发前反制，或在陷阱触发后反制它对一个生物施加的效果。

pl.name: Zamrożona Chwila
pl.description: Magia strażnicza próbuje uwięzić intruzów lub niedoszłych złodziei w zakłóconym przepływie czasu.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:38|name:Demontaż składników zaklęcia|traits:action:disable-a-device] (legendarny), aby błyskawicznie rozłożyć niezliczone komponenty zaklęcia w jednym mgnieniu oka; lub @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9 HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Rozproszenie Magii} (9. ranga; przeciwdziałanie ST 36), aby przeciwdziałać pułapce przed jej uruchomieniem lub przeciwdziałać efektowi na jednej istocie po uruchomieniu pułapki.

name: Full Head of Steam
description: Hidden vents emit scalding hot steam made from a particularly acrid solution, irritating the eyes and throat of anyone who inhales it.
disable: @Check[thievery|name:disable|dc:33] (expert) to block a vent, or @Check[crafting|name:disable|dc:31] (expert) to disable the heating element within the vent that turns the liquid into steam
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-20: The Rakshasa's Court
reset: The steam vents cease to operate 1 minute after all creatures have left the area and go into a maintenance cycle for 1 hour. After this time, they can be triggered again.
routine: (4 actions) Each of the four steam vents uses a single action each to emit superheated steam, which spreads for 60 feet along the wall from its location and extends out from the wall by 30 feet, dealing @Damage[(2d12+13)[untyped]] damage to each creature in their range (@Check[fortitude|dc:29] save). For each disabled vent, the trap loses 1 action each turn.
stealth: (trained); @Check[perception|dc:32] (expert) to find the precise location of the steam vents

actions.name: Billowing Steam
actions.description:
Trigger A creature enters the area of the trap

Effect All four vents rapidly heat and let out steam for 5 seconds, filling room with a painfully acrid smell. Each creature in the room must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:29] save, and the trap then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3}, and, struck by a coughing fit, falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

fr.name: Cracher la vapeur
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature pénètre dans la zone du piège

Effet Les quatre ventilateurs se réchauffent rapidement et laissent échapper de la vapeur pendant 5 secondes, remplissant la pièce avec une fumée âcre douloureuse. Chaque créature dans la pièce doit tenter un jet de @Check[fortitude|dc:29], puis le piège détermine l'initiative.

Succès critique La créature n'est pas affectée.

Succès La créature devient @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Nauséeuse 1}.

Échec La créature devient @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Nauséeuse 2} et @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Aveuglée}.

Échec critique La créature devient @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Nauséeuse 3} et suite à une quinte de toux, tombe @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{À terre}.

fr.name: Vapeur en poupe
fr.description: Des ventilateurs cachées émettent de la vapeur brûlante à partir d'une solution particulièrement âcre, irritant les yeux et la gorge de quiconque l'inhale.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|name:Désactivation|dc:33] (qualifié) pour bloquer un ventilateur, ou @Check[crafting|name:Désactivation|dc:31] (expert) pour désactiver l'élement chauffant dans le ventilateur qui transforme le liquide en vapeur.
fr.reset: Le ventilateur à vapeur arrête de tourner 1 minute après que toutes les créatures aient quittés la zone et se met en mode maintenance pendant 1 heure, après quoi qu'il peut à nouveau être déclenché.
fr.routine: (4 actions) Chacun des quatre ventilateurs utilise une action unique pour émettre de la vapeur surchauffée, qui se propage sur 18 mètres le long du mur à partir de son emplacement et s'étend à l'extérieur du mur sur 9 mètres, infligeant @Damage[(2d12+13)[untyped]]{2d12+13 dégâts} à chaque créature à portée (@Check[fortitude|dc:29]). Pour chaque ventilateur désactivé, le piège perd une action à son tour.
fr.stealth: Qualifié ; @Check[perception|dc:32] (expert) pour trouver l'emplacement précis des ventilateurs à vapeur

For each disabled vent, the trap loses 1 action each turn.

name: Fungal Colony
description: A ring of dead trees covered in dry fungus suddenly shakes and rattles as if something inside some of the trees were about to explode.
disable: @Check[nature|dc:45] twice to appeal to spirits of the natural world still lingering in the area and ask them to neutralize the infestation, @Check[survival|dc:39] four times to gently break open four key tree trunks in the colony to allow the spores to vent harmlessly, or @Check[thievery|dc:48] to trigger a chain reaction among the logs that forces the hazard to implode dramatically but harmlessly. Once the hazard is triggered, only the Nature check can disable it.
publication: Pathfinder #212: A Voice in the Blight
reset: 24 hours after the fungal colonies erupt, the hazard reactivates and can trigger again. If the warsworns are activated and destroyed, they do not appear again on a subsequent triggering.
routine:
(1 action; poison, primal) The 120-foot-tall plume of spores turn toxic. Each round, the spore cloud's highest point drops by 40 feet, and it expands outward from the initial perimeter at A2 by 20 feet on the ground and at a height of 10 feet. At the end of the third round, the spore cloud stabilizes as a ten-foot-high ring with a width of 45 feet, which completely fills the clearing with ease. This spore cloud doesn't obscure vision, but creatures that end their turn in it take @Damage[5d6[poison]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:41|basic|traits:poison,primal] save).

On round 4, the spore cloud settles to the ground on the hazard's action. If the hazard hasn't yet been disabled, the ground between areas A1 and A2 erupts, and a trio of fungus-encrusted warsworns, their bodies composed of ancient elven skeletons bound together by glistening filaments of mold, rises up to attack all intruders in the area. At this point, the hazard deactivates, but the warsworns fight until they're destroyed.

actions.name: Fungal Eruption
actions.description:
Trigger A Small or larger creature enters the hazardous ring or attempts to fly over it at a height of less than 120 feet

Effect The ring of fallen trees explodes upward to a height of 120 feet. All creatures in the ring or within the area 120 feet above it take @Damage[8d6[piercing]] damage and must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:41] save. The fungal colony then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Failure The target takes full damage, is sickened 1, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute as spores settle on their bodies and quickly grow into rigid, interlocking plates. A creature can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} the shells (DC 41) to end the slowed 1 effect early.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} as they become almost completely encased in a hard fungal shell until they roll to Escape (DC 41), at which point they are slowed 1 for an additional minute until they Escape a second time.

zh.name: 真菌喷发 Fungal Eruption
zh.description:
触发 小型或更大的生物进入危害的环形区域，或试图在低于120尺的高度飞越该区域。

效果 倒伏的树木环向上爆炸至120尺高度。菌落范围内或其上方120 尺区域内的所有生物将受到@Damage[8d6[piercing]]点穿刺伤害，并必须进行@Check[reflex|dc:41]反射豁免检定。随后，真菌菌落将骰先攻。

大成功：目标不受影响。

成功：目标受到一半伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 1}。

失败：目标受到全额伤害，陷入恶心1，且因孢子附着在身体上并迅速生长成坚硬、相互锁定的板状物，导致陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1} 一分钟。生物可尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱 Escape}（DC 41）以提前结束缓慢1的效果。

大失败：目标受到双倍伤害，并被@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚 Restrained}，身体几乎完全被坚硬的真菌外壳包裹，直到其尝试逃脱（DC 41）。逃脱后，目标仍会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 slowed 1}一分钟，直到其再次成功逃脱。

zh.name: 真菌菌落 Fungal Colony
zh.description: 一圈覆盖着干枯真菌的枯树突然剧烈摇晃并发出嘎吱声，仿佛其中一些树内的某些东西即将爆发.
zh.disable: 两次@Check[nature|dc:45] 检定，向仍徘徊在该区域的自然世界精魂祈求，请求它们中和菌落的侵染。四次@Check[survival|dc:39]检定以小心地破开菌落中的四棵关键树的树干，使孢子无害地排出。或者@Check[thievery|dc:48]触发原木间的连锁反应，迫使危害以剧烈但无害的方式内爆。一旦危害被触发，仅可通过自然检定解除.
zh.reset: 真菌菌落爆发 24 小时后，该危害将重新激活并可能再次触发。若战殁巨虫已被激活并被摧毁，则在后续的触发中它们不会再出现.
zh.routine:
（1动作；毒素，原能）高达120尺的孢子柱变得具有毒性。每一轮，孢子云的最顶端会下降40尺，同时从A2处的初始边界开始，地面部分向外扩展20尺，高度向增加10尺。到第三轮结束时，孢子云会稳定成一个高度为10尺、宽度为45尺的环状结构，轻松填满整个空地。此孢子云不会遮蔽视线，但任何在其内结束回合的生物将受到@Damage[5d6[poison]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:41|basic]豁免）。

到第四轮时，孢子云会随着陷阱的动作沉降到地面。如果陷阱尚未被解除，A1和A2区域之间的地面会爆发，三只长满真菌的战誓者从地面升起，战誓者的身体由古老的精灵骨架与闪光的霉丝编织而成，开始攻击所有进入该区域的入侵者。此时陷阱失效，但战誓者会继续战斗，直到被摧毁为止。

name: Fungal Curtain
description: A glowing wall of moss, lichens, mold, and stringy mushrooms weaves into a towering violet wall of shuddersome matter.
disable: @Check[nature|dc:42] (master) six times to identify and prune away the fungal curtain's six sensory bulbs (this doesn't remove the curtain; it must still be hacked through to allow access to the area beyond), or @Check[religion|dc:48] (legendary) twice to exorcise the fiendish energies that empower the fungal curtain and cause it to wilt into sludge
publication: Pathfinder #212: A Voice in the Blight
reset: The fungal curtain deactivates at the end of any round where there were no foes in area E5, then resets at the start of the next round. It restores 10 Hit Points to each damaged section every hour.
routine: (3 actions) The fungal curtain takes the following actions each round in this order; the fungal curtain can perceive targets via darkvision and has a Perception modifier of +38. On its first action, it extends a thorny tentacle to attempt a melee Strike on the closest target in reach—if there's no target in reach, the fungal curtain loses this action. On its second action, it fires a volley of thorny spores into area E5, attempting a ranged thorny spore Strike against all potential targets in the chamber. On its third action, it emits another whistling decay effect.
stealth: (legendary) to realize the fungus is hazardous; noticing the fungus itself has a DC of 0

actions.name: Whistling Decay
actions.description:
Trigger The fungal curtain takes damage or an attempt to disable it critically fails

Effect Pod like protrusions along the fungal curtain clench and then expel a shrill whistling sound along with clouds of flesh-eating spores. The whistling sound alerts the occupants of area E6. Any non-fungus, non-demon creature within 30 feet of the fungal curtain is exposed to the flesh-eating spores and takes @Damage[8d6[poison],4d6[persistent,void]]{8d6 poison damage and 4d6 persistent void} damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:42|basic] save). The fungal curtain then rolls initiative.

zh.name: 尖啸腐化 Whistling Decay
zh.description:
触发 真菌帷幕遭受伤害，或解除尝试大失败

效果 真菌帷幕上的荚状突起物骤然收缩，随后发出刺耳的尖啸并喷出食肉孢子云。尖啸会惊动区域E6的居民。真菌帷幕@Template[emanation|distance:30]范围内所有非真菌、非恶魔生物将暴露于食肉孢子中，承受@Damage[8d6[poison],4d6[persistent,void]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:42|basic|options:area-effect]豁免）。随后真菌帷幕骰先攻。

zh.name: 真菌帷幕 Fungal Curtain
zh.description: 一堵由苔藓、地衣、霉菌与纤维状蘑菇交织而成的发光菌墙，凝聚成一座由不断颤动的物质组成紫色高墙。
zh.disable: 六次@Check[nature|dc:42]检定（大师）以需识别并剪除真菌帷幕的六个感知球茎（此操作不会移除真菌帷幕，仍需劈砍方可进入后方区域） 两次@Check[religion|dc:48]检定（传奇）以驱散赋予真菌帷幕力量的魔化能量，使其凋零为腐泥
zh.reset: 若某轮结束时区域 E5 内无敌人，真菌帷幕将停止活动，并于下一轮开始时重置。其每小时为每处受损区域恢复 10 点生命值。
zh.routine: （3 动作）真菌帷幕每轮按以下顺序进行动作；其可通过黑暗视觉感知目标，察觉调整值为+38。它的第一个动作是伸出一根棘刺触须，对最近的可触及目标发动近战打击——若无可触及目标，真菌帷幕跳过此动作。第二动作是向区域E5进行棘刺孢子齐射，对区域内所有潜在目标发动远程棘刺孢子打击。第三个动作则再次释放尖啸腐化效果。
zh.stealth: （传奇）以意识到真菌存在危险；注意到真菌本体的DC为0。

name: Fungal Engine
description: A thick mass of pulsing fungi and mold infested with ghostly shapes cakes the walls of the room.
disable: @Check[nature|dc:41] seven times to seek out and remove seven specific nodes of fungi that govern the intake and dispersal of energy, or @Check[religion|dc:47] three times to exorcise the souls out of the engine and force it to shut down
publication: Pathfinder #212: A Voice in the Blight
reset: The fungal engine deactivates and resets after 1 minute, but any demons called in remain in the area for an hour to ensure the intruders don't return.
routine:
(1 action) The fungal engine expels clouds of toxic spores on its turn, causing all non-fungi and non-demon creatures in the room to take @Damage[10d6[poison]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:41|basic] save); any creature that takes damage is exposed to grayshroud.

Grayshroud

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:40]

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and fatigued (1 day)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and fatigued (1 day)

Stage 4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3}, fatigued, and can't speak (1 day)

Stage 5 death
stealth: (legendary) to notice the fungi is potentially hazardous and that the two mushrooms in the middle are load bearing and that destroying those with damage can disable the hazard; noticing the engine itself has a DC of 0

actions.name: Psychic Shriek
actions.description:
Trigger any damage is inflicted on the engine, or any attempt to disable it critically fails

Effect The entire mass of fungi shudders, then emits a piercing psychic scream as the trapped souls within cry out. All non-fungi creatures in area E3 take @Damage[10d6[spirit]] damage (@Check[will|dc:41|basic] save), and four vansidieth demons waiting for this precise alarm use translocate to teleport into the room to attack the intruders. The hazard then rolls initiative.

zh.name: 灵能尖啸 Psychic Shriek
zh.description:
触发引擎遭受任何伤害，或解除尝试大失败

效果 整个菌毯结构剧烈震颤，随即发出刺穿耳膜的灵能尖啸，这是被困灵魂发出的哀嚎。区域E3 内所有非真菌生物承受@Damage[10d6[spirit]] 伤害（@Check[will|dc:41|basic]豁免），同时四只等待此警报的统祸魔将通过次元移位传送进入房间攻击入侵者。随后该危害骰先攻。

zh.name: 真菌引擎 Fungal Engine
zh.description: 腔室墙壁被一层厚厚的充斥着幽灵般的形体的脉动真菌与霉菌覆盖。
zh.disable: 七次@Check[nature|dc:41] 检定以搜寻并移除七个控制能量输入与分散的特定真菌节点；三次@Check[religion|dc:47] 检定以驱散困于引擎内的灵魂并强制关闭引擎。
zh.reset: 引擎在1分钟后停止运作并重置，但被召唤的恶魔将留守区域 1 小时，以防止入侵者返回。
zh.routine:
（1动作）引擎在自身回合释放毒性孢子云，使房间内所有非真菌、非恶魔生物承受@Damage[10d6[poison]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:41|basic]豁免）

灰裹病

豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:40]

阶段1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]（1日）

name: Fungal Forge
publication: Pathfinder #212: A Voice in the Blight
reset: A fungal forge resets immediately at the start of every round, and immediately triggers again if there are still sapient creatures within it.
stealth: A fifteen-foot diameter spherical fungus with a five-foot-diameter circular aperture facing into the room; inside the fungus lie partially decayed humanoid remains.

actions.name: Defile and Pollute
actions.description:
Trigger A sapient living creature enters or is placed inside the fungal forge, a fungal forge takes damage, or an attempt to disable a forge critically fails

Effect The fungal forge floods its interior with sickly green demonic energy that looks like a mix of fluid and fog. A creature within the fungal forge takes 5d8 variable damage and 5d8 void damage as their soul withers and their flesh decays, while a creature within 20 feet of the forge is exposed to vented unholy energy and only takes the void damage as their flesh rots—in either case, an affected creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:41] save. The type of non-void damage a fungal forge inflicts on those within varies. The green forge (D6a) deals cold damage, the yellow one (D6b) poison damage, the orange one (D6c) acid damage, the black one (D6d) electricity damage, and the purple one (D6e) mental damage. Demons and fungi are immune to this effect entirely.

Green: @Damage[5d8[cold],5d8[void]]

Yellow: @Damage[5d8[poison],5d8[void]]

Orange: @Damage[5d8[acid],5d8[void]]

Black: @Damage[5d8[electricity],5d8[void]]

Purple: @Damage[5d8[mental],5d8[void]]

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage. If the creature is inside the fungal forge, they also become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} with an unlimited duration.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage. If the creature is inside the fungal forge, they also become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} with an unlimited duration.

zh.name: 玷污与污染 Defile and Pollute
zh.description:
触发 有智慧活物进入或被置入真菌熔炉、真菌熔炉受到伤害、或解除熔炉的尝试大失败；

效果 真菌熔炉用病态的绿色恶魔能量灌满内部空间，这些能量形如液体与雾气的混合体。位于熔炉内的生物承受 @Damage[5d8[variable],5d8[void]] 点伤害，因为他们的灵魂凋零，血肉腐化，而位于熔炉20尺内的生物则暴露于喷发的邪秽能量，仅承受虚能伤害，他们的血肉腐烂——无论哪种情况，受影响生物都必须尝试 @Check[fortitude|dc:41] 豁免。真菌熔炉对内部生物造成的非虚能伤害类型各异：绿色熔炉（D6a）造成寒冷伤害，黄色熔炉（D6b）造成毒素伤害，橙色熔炉（D6c）造成酸蚀伤害，黑色熔炉（D6d）造成电击伤害，紫色熔炉（D6e）造成心灵伤害。恶魔与真菌完全免疫此效果。

绿色： @Damage[5d8[cold],5d8[void]]

黄色： @Damage[5d8[poison],5d8[void]]

橙色： @Damage[5d8[acid],5d8[void]]

黑色： @Damage[5d8[electricity],5d8[void]]

紫色： @Damage[5d8[mental],5d8[void]]

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物承受半数伤害。

失败 生物承受全额伤害。若生物位于真菌熔炉内，还将永久获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 Enfeebled 1} 与 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 1}。

大失败 生物承受双倍伤害。若生物位于真菌熔炉内，还将永久获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 Enfeebled 2} 与 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 2}。

name: Fungal Heart
description: A pulsing green cluster of fungus suspended in the middle of the spherical room by thick lengths of fibrous stalks.
disable: @Check[nature|dc:33] (master) three times to carefully prune away specific tethers that keep the fungal heart active, or @Check[religion|dc:33] (master) three times to exorcise the demonic energies from the fungal heart.
reset: The fungal heart deactivates and resets if 3 rounds pass during which no attempts to disable or damage it take place. On subsequent activations of "Treerazer Notices," no telepathic message is sent—it's simply an overwhelming sensation of imminent doom.
routine: (1 action; divine, poison) The fungal heart clenches as if beating like a real heart, then exudes a churning cloud of toxic spores that fills areas D1 and D2. All creatures in these areas take @Damage[10d6[poison]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:34|basic] save; creatures in area D1 gain a +4 circumstance bonus to this save due to the diffusion of the spores as they wash into the larger area).
stealth: (master) to detect that the fungal heart is hazardous; noticing the fungal heart has a DC of 0

actions.name: Treerazer Notices
actions.description:
Trigger The fungal heart takes damage, or an attempt to disable it fails

Effect A sinister voice fills the minds of all creatures in area D1 or D2, speaking in Chthonian: "And so my whelp has failed, yet you have not found salvation—you have doomed Kyonin to fall. Will you be the first to die, or shall you linger long enough to see all you hold dear become mine?" The PCs immediately recognize this voice as belonging to Treerazer and must attempt a @Check[will|dc:39] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (or doomed 1, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for as long as they remain frightened on a critical failure). The Fungal Heart then rolls initiative.

zh.name: 毁木者的注视 Treerazer Notices
zh.description:
触发 真菌核心受伤害或解除尝试失败

效果 一道充满恶意的声音直接在区域 D1 与 D2 所有生物脑海中响起，用恶魔语低吟："看来我的仆从失败了...但你们找到的并非救赎——奇奥尼的陷落已成定局。你们谁愿第一个赴死？抑或苟延残喘，眼睁睁看着珍视的一切归于吾之手？" PC们立即辨认出这是毁木者的声音，必须立即进行 @Check[will|dc:39] 豁免，失败将陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭 Doomed 1} 与 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 2} （大失败则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭 Doomed 1} 与 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 4}，并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑 Fleeing}，直到惊惧状态结束）。真菌核心之后骰先攻。

zh.name: 真菌核心 Fungal Heart
zh.description: 由粗壮的纤维茎干悬吊在球形洞穴中央的脉动绿色真菌团簇。

name: Gala Crowd
description: The panicked crowd of gala attendees reacts to the unexpected attack.
disable: @Check[intimidation|dc:19], @Check[diplomacy|dc:21], or @Check[athletics|dc:24] to get guests to move out of harm's way; four total successes across all skills are required to disable the hazard
routine:
(1 action) The crowd reacts in one of the following ways, determined by a d12 die roll:

  • 1–2 Hunker Down: The crowd freezes in fear. It provides lesser cover to all creatures in the great room for 1 round.
  • 3–4 Run!: Determine a random direction. Each creature in the area must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:21] save or be moved 10 feet in that direction. On a critical failure, they're also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. This is forced movement.
  • 5–6 Hysteria: The crowd's dread is contagious. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure). This is an emotion, fear, and mental effect.
  • 7–8 Wailing: The cries make it hard to concentrate. For 1 round, any creature in the area that attempts an action with the concentrate trait must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:4] or the action is disrupted. This is an auditory effect.
  • 9–10 Crushing Press: Members of the crowd shove and push, trying to find a way to safety. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(2d8+5)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:21|basic] save).

  • 11–12 Wild Dismay: The chaos is overwhelming. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round. This is an emotion and mental effect.

actions.description:

name: Gas Trap
description: A spring slams and locks the room's door before four hidden gas vents begin pumping poison gas into the chamber.
disable: Four @Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Block Gas Vents|traits:action:disable-a-device] checks to block the gas vents, or a @Check[thievery|dc:26|name:Unlock Door|traits:action:pick-a-lock] check to unlock the door and escape
publication: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace
reset: The trap must be manually rearmed by unblocking the vents or replacing the poison gas tank in area E30.
routine:
(1 action) Each round on its initiative count, the trap pumps more toxic gas into the room.

Any breathing creature in the room takes @Damage[4d6[poison]] damage (a successful @Check[fortitude|dc:22|traits:poison,damaging-effect] save halves the damage taken). If a creature acts before the trap on the first round, it has the option of holding its breath to postpone taking damage from the trap-holding one's breath after the trap's first action has no effect, since the air in the creature's lungs is already tainted. Locating and blocking one of the hidden gas vents reduces the poison damage by 1d6-if all four are blocked, the trap is disabled, though the door remains locked. Otherwise, the trap functions for 1 minute before all the gas is expended and characters in the room cease taking damage, after which the trap ventilates the room for 1 additional minute.
stealth: (trained) to smell the poison gas or hear it hissing

Effet La porte de la chambre se ferme en claquant, se verrouille et le piège fait un jet d'initiative. (Le piège peut aussi être déclenché manuellement ou désarmé depuis la zone E30.)

zh.name: 毒气 Toxic Gas

fr.name: Piège à gaz
fr.description: Un ressort claque et verrouille la porte de la chambre, puis quatre ventilateurs commencent à y souffler du gaz empoisonné.
fr.disable: Quatre tests de @Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Obstruer les ventilateurs|traits:action:disable-a-device] pour obstruer les ventilateurs ou un test de @Check[thievery|dc:26|name:Déverrouiller la porte|traits:action:pick-a-lock] pour déverrouiller la porte et s'enfuir.
fr.reset: Le piège doit être manuellement réarmé en débouchant les ventilateurs ou en remplissant le réservoir de gaz empoisonné de la zone E30.
fr.routine:
(1 aciton) À chaque round, lors du tour déterminé par son initiative, le piège envoie davantage de gaz dans la chambre.

Toute créature qui respire dans la pièce subit @Damage[4d6[poison]]{4d6 dégâts de poison} (un jet de @Check[fortitude|dc:22|traits:poison,damaging-effect] réussi diminue les dégâts de moitié). Si une créature agit avant le piège lors du premier round, elle peut retenir son souffle pour retarder les dégâts subis. Retenir son souffle après la première action du piège n'a aucun effet, car l'air dans les poumons de la créature est déjà contaminé. Localiser et obstruer l'un des ventilateurs cachés réduit les dégâts de poison de 1d6 : si les quatre sont obstrués, le piège est désamorcé mais la porte reste verrouillée. Sinon, le piège fonctionne pendant une minute jusqu'à être à court de gaz et les personnages dans la pièce cessent de subir des dégâts. Le piège ventile les lieux durant une minute supplémentaire.
fr.stealth: Qualifié pour sentir le gaz empoisonné ou entendre son sifflement

zh.name: 毒气陷阱 Gas Trap
zh.description: 在四个隐藏的气体通风口开始向房间注入毒气之前，房间的门突然关上并上锁。
zh.disable: Four @Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Block Gas Vents|traits:action:disable-a-device] checks to block the gas vents, or a @Check[thievery|dc:26|name:Unlock Door|traits:action:pick-a-lock] check to unlock the door and escape
zh.reset: 必须通过疏浚通风口或更换E30区域的毒气箱以手动重新启用陷阱。
zh.routine:
（1动作）每一轮到它的回合，陷阱都会向房间注入更多的毒气。

房间里的任何在呼吸的生物都会受到@Damage[4d6[poison]]伤害（成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:22|traits:poison,damaging-effect]豁免以减半伤害）。如果在第一轮，一个生物在陷阱的回合之前行动，它可以选择屏住呼吸来推迟受到陷阱的伤害——在陷阱第一次行动后屏住呼吸将没有效果，因为该生物肺部的空气已经受到了污染。找到并阻塞其中一个隐藏的气体出口可以减少1d6的毒素伤害——如果所有的四个出口都被阻塞了，陷阱将被解除，尽管门仍然是锁着的。否则，陷阱将运行1分钟，然后所有气体耗尽，房间中的生物停止受到伤害，之后陷阱再打开房间1分钟。
zh.stealth: （受训）以闻到毒气或听到嘶嘶声

pl.name: Gas Trap
pl.description: A spring slams and locks the room's door before four hidden gas vents begin pumping poison gas into the chamber.
pl.disable: Four @Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Block Gas Vents|traits:action:disable-a-device] checks to block the gas vents, or a @Check[thievery|dc:26|name:Unlock Door|traits:action:pick-a-lock] check to unlock the door and escape
pl.reset: The trap must be manually rearmed by unblocking the vents or replacing the poison gas tank in area E30.
pl.routine:
(1 action) Each round on its initiative count, the trap pumps more toxic gas into the room.

Any breathing creature in the room takes @Damage[4d6[poison]] damage (a successful @Check[fortitude|dc:22|traits:poison,damaging-effect] save halves the damage taken). If a creature acts before the trap on the first round, it has the option of holding its breath to postpone taking damage from the trap-holding one's breath after the trap's first action has no effect, since the air in the creature's lungs is already tainted. Locating and blocking one of the hidden gas vents reduces the poison damage by 1d6-if all four are blocked, the trap is disabled, though the door remains locked. Otherwise, the trap functions for 1 minute before all the gas is expended and characters in the room cease taking damage, after which the trap ventilates the room for 1 additional minute.
pl.stealth: (trained) to smell the poison gas or hear it hissing

name: Ghost Crystal Cloud
description: The xulgath corpse splits open to release a cloud of tiny ectoplasmic crystals which, when they are inhaled, disorient and devitalize living creatures.
disable: @Check[arcana|dc:26|name:Render the cloud inert|traits:hazard,environmental] or @Check[occultism|dc:26|name:Render the cloud inert|traits:hazard,environmental] (expert) to render the crystal cloud inert
publication: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God
reset: The crystals regrow into a number sufficient to form another dangerous cloud after 1 week.

actions.name: Ectoplasmic Explosion
actions.description:
Trigger A creature touches or disturbs the corpse containing the growth of crystals

Effect All creatures within 10 feet of the corpse are exposed to the ghost crystal cloud.

fr.name: Déflagration ectoplasmique
fr.description:
Déclencheur A creature touches or disturbs the corpse containing the growth of crystals

Effet All creatures within 10 feet of the corpse are exposed to the ghost crystal cloud.

zh.name: 灵质爆炸 Ectoplasmic Explosion
zh.description:
触发 一个生物触碰或干扰了含有晶体的尸体；

效果 尸体10尺范围内的所有生物都暴露在鬼魂结晶云中。

actions.name: Ghost Crystal Cloud
actions.description:
Creatures with the ethereal trait are immune

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:26|traits:environmental,hazard]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d10[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[2d10[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[3d10[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} (1 round)

fr.name: Nuage de cristaux fantômes
fr.description:
Les créatures avec le trait éthéré sont immunisées

Jet de sauvegarde @Check[fortitude|dc:26|traits:environmental,hazard]

Durée maximale 6 rounds

Stade 1 @Damage[1d10[poison]]{1d10 dégâts de poison} et @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupéfié 1} (1 round)

Stade 2 @Damage[2d10[poison]]{2d10 dégâts de poison} et @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupéfié 2} (1 round)

Stade 3 @Damage[3d10[poison]]{3d10 dégâts de poison} et @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupéfié 3} (1 round)

zh.name: 鬼魂结晶云 Ghost Crystal Cloud
zh.description:
具有灵体特征的生物免疫；

豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:26|traits:environmental,hazard]

最大持续时间 6轮

阶段1 @Damage[1d10[poison]]伤害和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 1}（1轮）

阶段2 @Damage[2d10[poison]]伤害和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 2}（1轮）

阶段3 @Damage[3d10[poison]]伤害和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 3}（1轮）

fr.name: Nuage de cristaux fantômes
fr.description: Le corps du xulgath s'ouvre en deux et laisse échapper un nuage de minuscules cristaux ectoplasmiques qui, une fois inhalés, désorientent et affaiblissent les créatures vivantes.
fr.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:26|name:Rendre le nuage inerte|traits:hazard,environmental] ou d'@Check[occultism|dc:26|name:Rendre le nuage inerte|traits:hazard,environmental] (expert) pour rendre le nuage de cristaux inerte
fr.reset: Les cristaux réapparaissent en nombre suffisant pour former un autre nuage dangereux après une semaine.

zh.name: 鬼魂结晶云 Ghost Crystal Cloud
zh.description: 地蜥人的尸体裂开，释放出一团微小的外灵质晶体，当它们被吸入时，会使生物迷失方向和失去活力。
zh.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:26|name:Render the cloud inert|traits:hazard,environmental]或@Check[occultism|dc:26|name:Render the cloud inert|traits:hazard,environmental]（专家）使结晶云失去效用
zh.reset: 一周后，晶体重新长出足以形成另一个危险的云。

pl.name: Ghost Crystal Cloud
pl.description: The xulgath corpse splits open to release a cloud of tiny ectoplasmic crystals which, when they are inhaled, disorient and devitalize living creatures.
pl.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:26|name:Render the cloud inert|traits:hazard,environmental] or @Check[occultism|dc:26|name:Render the cloud inert|traits:hazard,environmental] (expert) to render the crystal cloud inert
pl.reset: The crystals regrow into a number sufficient to form another dangerous cloud after 1 week.

name: Ghost Stampede
description: Four massive skulls of aurochs, enormous wild cattle, rise into the air, each trailing its ghostly body behind it.
disable: @Check[nature|dc:36] (master) to calm one of the four aurochs or @Check[religion|dc:40] (trained) to exorcise them
reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures leave the area or after all four aurochs skulls are destroyed. After 1 hour, if at least one aurochs skull remains, the haunt reactivates.
routine: (4 actions) For each aurochs skull disabled or destroyed, the haunt has 1 fewer action. On each action, a different aurochs moves up to 60 feet and attempts a horn Strike against a different living creature. A creature critically hit by a horn Strike also takes @Damage[2d6[bleed]] and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

actions.name: Defend Territory
actions.description:
Trigger A creature approaches within 10 feet of an aurochs skull

Effect The skulls rise into the air, form ghostly bodies, and bellow in rage. Each creature within @Template[emanation|distance:60]{60 feet} of an aurochs skull must attempt a @Check[will|dc:36] saving throw. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(1d12+6)[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[(2d12+12)[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}.

fr.name: Défense du territoire
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature s'approche à 3 mètres d'un crâne d'auroch

Effet Les crânes s'élèvent dans les airs suivis de leur formes fantomatiques et meuglent de rage. Chaque créature dans une @Template[emanation|distance:60]{émanation de 18 mètres} d'un crâne d'un auroch doit effectuer un jet de @Check[will|dc:36|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:frightened]. La hantise lance ensuite l'initiative.

Succès critique La créature n'est pas affectée.

Succès La créature est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 1}.

FÉchec La créature subit @Damage[(1d12+6)[mental]|options:area-damage]{1d12+6 dégâts mentaux} et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 2}.

Échec critique La créature subit @Damage[(2d12+12)[mental]|options:area-damage]{2d12+12 dégâts mentaux} et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 4}.

zh.name: 护卫领土 Defend Territory
zh.description:
触发 一个生物接近至其中一只头骨10尺内；

效果 头骨升到空中，幽灵身体浮现，发出愤怒的牛叫。每个野牛头骨@Template[emanation|distance:60]{60尺}范围内的每个生物都必须尝试@Check[will|dc:36|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:frightened]豁免。然后作祟投掷先攻。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}。

失败 生物受到@Damage[(1d12+6)[mental]|options:area-damage]伤害，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 2}。

大失败 生物受到@Damage[(2d12+12)[mental]|options:area-damage]伤害，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 4}。

fr.name: Cavalcade de fantômes
fr.description: Quatre crânes squelettiques d'aurochs massifs s'élèvent dans les airs, chacun trainant un corps fantomatique derrière lui.
fr.disable: @Check[nature|dc:36] (maître) pour calmer un des quatre crânes d'aurochs ou @Check[religion|dc:40] (qualifié) pour les exorciser
fr.reset: La hantise se désactive après 1 minute après que toutes les créatures vivantes aient quittés la zone ou après la destruction des quatre crânes. Après 1 heure, si au moins un des crânes d'auroch est toujours là, la hantise se réactive.
fr.routine: (4 actions) Pour chaque crâne d'auroch désamorcé ou détruit, la hantise perd une action. À chaque action, un crâne différent s'avance de 18 mètres et tente une Frappe de corne contre une créature vivante différente. Une créature qui subit un coup critique de Frappe de corne subit également 2d6 dégâts de saignement et est mise @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{À terre}.

zh.name: 幽灵奔踏 Ghost Stampede
zh.description: 四个巨大的野牛头骨升到空中，每个头骨后面都显现出一具幽灵般的身体。
zh.disable: @Check[nature|dc:36]（大师）安抚四只野牛中的一只；@Check[religion|dc:40]（受训）超度它们
zh.reset: 当所有活着的生物都离开作祟区域1分钟后，或所有四个野牛头骨都被摧毁之后，作祟会停止活动。在1小时后，如果有至少1只野牛头骨没被摧毁，则作祟会重置。
zh.routine: （4个动作）每当有一个野牛头骨被摧毁，作祟就少1个动作。在每个动作中，一只不同的野牛行走最多60尺，然后尝试对不同的生物进行一次角抵打击。被角抵打击重击的生物还会受到2d6持续流血伤害，并被击至@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。

pl.name: Ghost Stampede
pl.description: Four massive skulls of aurochs, enormous wild cattle, rise into the air, each trailing its ghostly body behind it.
pl.disable: @Check[nature|dc:36] (master) to calm one of the four aurochs or @Check[religion|dc:40] (trained) to exorcise them
pl.reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures leave the area or after all four aurochs skulls are destroyed. After 1 hour, if at least one aurochs skull remains, the haunt reactivates.
pl.routine: (4 actions) For each aurochs skull disabled or destroyed, the haunt has 1 fewer action. On each action, a different aurochs moves up to 60 feet and attempts a horn Strike against a different living creature. A creature critically hit by a horn Strike also takes 2d6 persistent bleed damage and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

name: Ghostly Choir
description: A choir of lost souls rises out of the floor, singing an eerie chant that terrifies its listeners and buffets their bodies with walls of sound.
disable: @Check[performance|dc:28|name:Sing a Different Tune|traits:haunt] (trained) to disrupt the song's resonance with another tune or @Check[religion|dc:28|name:Ritually Silence the Haunt|traits:haunt] (trained) to ritually silence the spirits

actions.name: Profane Chant
actions.description:
Trigger A creature moves within 10 feet of the section of floor from which the choir can arise

Effect The choir rises, and its song deals @Damage[(4d8+18)[mental]] damage to living creatures within 30 feet of the souls' spectral forms. Affected creatures must each attempt a @Check[will|dc:24|traits:damaging-effect] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature takes full damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage. It also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

fr.name: Chant impie
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature approche à 3 mètres de la partie du sol d'où peut jaillir le choeur.

Effet Le choeur s'élève et son chant inflige @Damage[(4d8+18)[mental]]{4d8+18 dégâts mentaux} à toutes les créatures vivantes situées dans un rayon de 9 mètres des formes spectrales. Les créatures affectées doivent tenter un jet de @Check[will|dc:24|traits:damaging-effect].

Succès critique La créature n'est pas affectée.

Succès La cible subit la moitié des dégâts et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 1}.

Échec La cible subit la totalité des dégâts et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 2}.

Échec critique La créature subit le double des dégâts. Elle est également @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 3} et @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{En fuite} pendant 1 round.

zh.name: 亵渎颂歌 Profane Chant
zh.description:
触发 一个生物走进幽灵唱诗班升起的地板的10尺之内；

效果 幽灵唱诗班升起，它的歌声对幽灵形态30尺内的活物造成@Damage[(4d8+18)[mental]]伤害。受影响的生物每次都要尝试一次@Check[will|dc:24|traits:damaging-effect]检定。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}。

失败 生物受到全伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 2}。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害，同时陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 3}，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]1轮。

fr.name: Choeur spectral
fr.description: Un chœur d'âmes perdues sort du plancher, en chantant une chanson terrible qui terrifie ses auditeurs et ballotte leurs corps avec des murs de sons.
fr.disable: @Check[performance|dc:28|name:Chanter un autre air|traits:haunt] (qualifié) pour perturber l'harmonie du chant avec un autre air ou @Check[religion|dc:28|name:imposer le silence|traits:haunt] (qualifié) pour rituellement imposer le silence aux esprits

zh.name: 鬼灵唱诗班 Ghostly Choir
zh.description: 一群迷失的灵魂从地板中升起，唱着毛骨悚然的颂歌，惊吓听众，用音波墙来冲击他们的身体。
zh.disable: @Check[performance|dc:28|name:Sing a Different Tune|traits:haunt] （受训）打乱曲子的和声；@Check[religion|dc:28|name:Ritually Silence the Haunt|traits:haunt] （受训）让鬼魂安静下来

pl.name: Upiorny Chór
pl.description: Chór zagubionych dusz unosi się z podłogi, śpiewając niesamowity śpiew, który przeraża słuchaczy i wypełnia ich ciała kakofonią dźwięku.
pl.disable: @Check[performance|dc:28|name:Zaśpiewaj inną melodię|traits:haunt] (wytrenowanie), aby zakłócić rezonans pieśni inną melodią lub @Check[religion|dc:28|name:Rytualne uciszenie nawiedzenia|traits:haunt] (wytrenowanie), aby rytualnie uciszyć duchy.

name: Glimpse Grave
description: A tombstone bears the name of those who look upon it, causing their hearts to seize.
disable: @Check[religion|dc:45|name:Bless the tombstone] (legendary) to bless the tombstone or @Check[occultism|dc:50|name:Ward off the spirits] (trained) to ward off spirits
reset: 1 day
stealth: (expert) to notice the words on the tombstone waver

actions.name: Stop Heart
actions.description:
Trigger A creature reads or touches the tombstone

Effect The haunt deals @Damage[(8d10+44)[void]] damage (@Check[will|dc:47|basic]) to all creatures within @Template[emanation|distance:60]{60 feet} who can see the tombstone and can read any language. On a critical failure, a creature dies.

fr.name: Arrêt cardiaque
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature lit ou touche la pierre tombale

Effet La hantise inflige @Damage[(8d10+44)[void]]{8d10+44 dégâts de vide} (@Check[will|dc:47|basic]) à toutes les créatures dans une @Template[emanation|distance:60]{émanation de 18 mètres} qui peuvent apercevoir la pierre tombale et qui peuvent lire les mots (n'importe quel langage). En cas d'échec critique, la créature meurt.

zh.name: 心跳停止 Stop Heart
zh.description:
触发 一个生物阅读或触碰到墓碑；

效果 作祟对@Template[emanation|distance:60]{60尺}内所有能看见墓碑并且能阅读语言的生物造成@Damage[(8d10+44)[void]]伤害（@Check[will|dc:47|basic]豁免）。如果豁免大失败，生物死亡。

fr.name: Regard sur la tombe
fr.description: Une pierre tombale porte le nom de ceux qui la regarde, provoquant un arrêt cardiaque.
fr.disable: @Check[religion|dc:45|name:Bénir la tombe] (légendaire) pour bénir la pierre tombale ou @Check[occultism|dc:50|name:Chasser les esprit] (qualifié) pour chasser les esprits
fr.reset: 1 jour
fr.stealth: Expert pour remarquer que les mots sur la stèle oscillent.

zh.name: 直视死墓 Glimpse Grave
zh.description: 看见这座墓碑的人，会发现自己的名字被刻在上面，导致心脏抽搐。
zh.disable: @Check[religion|dc:45|name:Bless the tombstone]（传奇）祝圣墓碑；@Check[occultism|dc:50|name:Ward off the spirits]（受训）免受鬼魂伤害
zh.stealth: （专家）注意到墓碑上的字在颤动

pl.name: Glimpse Grave
pl.description: A tombstone bears the name of those who look upon it, causing their hearts to seize.
pl.disable: @Check[religion|dc:45|name:Bless the tombstone] (legendary) to bless the tombstone or @Check[occultism|dc:50|name:Ward off the spirits] (trained) to ward off spirits
pl.reset: 1 dzień
pl.stealth: (expert) to notice the words on the tombstone waver

name: Gloomglow Mushrooms
description: A field of grass-like fungal filaments amid clusters of softly glowing, long-stalked mushrooms.
disable: @Check[survival|dc:22|name:Clear Patch of Mushrooms|traits:environmental,fungus,hazard] (expert) to remove a 5-foot-patch without triggering the mushrooms.

actions.name: Glowing Spores
actions.description:
Trigger A creature moves into the mushrooms' space or damages the mushrooms. The mushrooms can't use this reaction if the damage was cold damage.

Effect The triggering creature and all creatures within 10 feet are sprayed with itchy, distracting, glowing spores and must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:22|traits:environmental,fungus,hazard] save. On a failed save, the creatures become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} on a critical failure) and take a -4 penalty to Stealth checks until the spores lose potency in 24 hours or are removed. name: Goh's Shame
description: A strange shadowy figure churns in the waters at Goh's feet.
disable: @Check[diplomacy|dc:21] to calm Goh enough that the haunt dissipates, @Check[religion|dc:23] to exorcise the haunt, or @Check[intimidation|dc:25] to "scare the shame" out of Goh
publication: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
reset: The haunt ends if Goh dies and doesn't reset. If Goh is dragged out of the water, the haunt ends at the end of its next turn but resets immediately the next time Goh enters the river.
routine:
(2 actions; emotion, fear, incapacitation, mental, occult) The haunt uses its first action to grapple with Goh and attempts to pull him underwater. Goh has a Fortitude DC of 19. In order to pull Goh underwater, the haunt must critically succeed at its grapple check against him with a result of 29 or higher to successfully restrain Goh. Goh is overwhelmed by terror and makes no attempt to escape, so it falls to the PCs to get him free from the haunt. If Goh is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} and pulled underwater, the haunt must continue to grapple him in following rounds. If the haunt manages to critically succeed at grappling Goh while he's restrained, the man dies from a combination of fright and drowning, at which point the haunt immediately ends. If Goh is pulled free and taken out of the water, the haunt loses one action and no longer attempts to grapple him. The haunt uses its second action to manifest the image of a drowned ghost, causing one creature it targets within 30 feet to attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save (the haunt always targets a creature who attempted to free Goh from its grip if possible).

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for as long as it remains frightened.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and fleeing as long as it remains frightened, or for 1 minute, whichever comes second.

actions.name: Grasping Hands
actions.description:

description: The passage closes around intruders. Cavities open in its soft wood and try to envelope anything within it.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:50] (legendary) three times to scrape away @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} sensors on the floor and walls, or @Check[nature|dc:55] (legendary) to call upon lingering elements of primal energy in the Witchbole to render the trap inert
publication: Pathfinder #212: A Voice in the Blight
reset: The trap deactivates as soon as a round begins with no living targets in area E4, and then resets at the start of the following round.
routine: (2 actions) The trap's first action on its turn is to heave and jolt, causing the entire length of area E4 to become difficult terrain until the start of the gorging passage's next turn. description: A section of ground thrusts up to form what looks like a mountain in which a sword has been impaled, and then the sword lashes out to stab at someone nearby. disable: @Check[thievery|dc:40] (master) to wipe away the faint runes scratched on the floor without activating a blade, or @Check[religion|dc:43] (master) to utter memorial prayers to Gorum to rob from the trap its violent energy
routine: (3 actions) If the Gorum's epitaph is adjacent to a creature, it uses its three actions to make greatsword Strikes on that creature (determining targets randomly if more than one creature is adjacent). Otherwise, it uses actions to Stride toward the closest visible target, then uses any remaining actions to Strike that target. Gray Master can flank with a Gorum's epitaph.

actions.name: Erupting Burst
actions.description:
Trigger A creature steps into the square in which the trap is hidden

Effect The ground erupts upward in the shape of a mountain impaled by a +2 greater striking greater astral wounding greatsword. The triggering creature must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:36] save to avoid becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of their next turn (plus being knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} on a critical failure). The trap then rolls initiative.

pl.name: Gorum's Epitaph
pl.description: A section of ground thrusts up to form what looks like a mountain in which a sword has been impaled, and then the sword lashes out to stab at someone nearby. A successful @Check[religion|dc:15] check to Recall Knowledge is enough to note that the hazard looks very similar to Gorum's religious symbol; any character who is at least expert in Religion notes this automatically.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:40] (master) to wipe away the faint runes scratched on the floor without activating a blade, or @Check[religion|dc:43] (master) to utter memorial prayers to Gorum to rob from the trap its violent energy
pl.routine: (3 actions) If the Gorum's epitaph is adjacent to a creature, it uses its three actions to make greatsword Strikes on that creature (determining targets randomly if more than one creature is adjacent). Otherwise, it uses actions to Stride toward the closest visible target, then uses any remaining actions to Strike that target. Gray Master can flank with a Gorum's epitaph.

name: Grasp Of The Damned
description: These desperate spirits are the echoes of people who committed great atrocities in the name of an evil god. Now, they are left with only the knowledge that their souls have been damned, and the unwavering belief that they can better their fate by providing powerful sacrifices for their fiendish masters.
disable: @Check[religion|dc:46|name:Call For Divine Intervention] (master) to inspire a deity to intervene and counteract the ritual
reset: 1 day

actions.name: Mark for Damnation
actions.description:
Trigger Three or more sentient living creatures of 13th level or higher enter the haunt's area.

Effect The haunt deals @Damage[(6d12+35)[void]] damage to each creature in the haunt's area, and each creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:40|traits:damaging-effect] save.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage and is doomed 1.

Success The creature takes half damage and is doomed 1.

Failure The creature takes full damage, becomes doomed 2, and is marked for damnation.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, becomes doomed 3, and is marked for damnation.

If a creature that is marked for damnation dies within the next 24 hours, including from the haunt's damage, its soul is immediately dragged away to the plane of the evil deity that the damned spirits served, where the creature's soul is held captive by one of that deity's powerful servitors. Only wish and similarly potent effects are able to recover the lost soul directly; however, it is also possible to recover the soul by journeying to the evil plane and defeating the soul's captor.

fr.name: Marque de damnation
fr.description:
Déclencheur Au moins trois créatures vivantes et conscientes de niveau 13 au moins pénètrent dans la zone de la hantise.

Effet La hantise inflige @Damage[(6d12+35)[void]]{6d12+35 dégâts de vide} à chaque créature située dans la zone affectée et chaque créature doit tenter un jet de @Check[will|dc:40|traits:damaging-effect].

Succès critique La créature ne subit aucun dégât et est Condamnée 1.

Succès La cible subit la moitié des dégâts et est Condamnée 1.

Échec La créature subit les pleins dégâts, est Condamnée 2 et reçoit la marque de damnation.

Échec critique La créature subit le double des dégâts, est Condamnée 3 et reçoit la marque de damnation.

Si une créature avec la marque de damnation meurt au cours des prochaines 24 heures, y compris à cause des dégâts infligés par la hantise, son âme est immédiatement entraînée sur le plan de la divinité maléfique que servaient les esprits damnés. L'âme y est alors retenue captive par un puissant serviteur de cette divinité. Seul un Souhait ou un effet similaire tout aussi puissant peut permettre de récupérer directement cette âme perdue. Cependant, il est aussi possible de se rendre sur le plan maléfique afin de vaincre le gardien de cette âme.

zh.name: 诅咒印记 Mark for Damnation
zh.description:
触发 3个或更多13级或更高级别的生物进入作祟区域；

效果 作祟对每个进入作祟区域的生物造成@Damage[(6d12+35)[void]]伤害，并且每个生物都必须尝试@Check[will|dc:40|traits:damaging-effects]检定。

大成功 生物不受伤害，但是陷入毁灭1。

成功 生物受到一半伤害，并且陷入毁灭1。

失败 生物受到满伤害，陷入毁灭2，并且被诅咒标记。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害，陷入毁灭3，并且被诅咒标记。

如果生物在被诅咒标记之后的24小时内死亡，包括作祟的伤害导致的死亡，它的灵魂立即被拖到被诅咒的灵魂所侍奉的邪恶神灵所在的位面，在那里该生物的灵魂被那位神祇其中一位的强大仆从所奴役。只有祈愿和类似的强大效果才能立即恢复失去的灵魂；但是，也可以通过前往邪恶位面并击败灵魂的俘获者来恢复灵魂。

fr.name: Emprise des damnés
fr.description: Ces esprits désespérés sont les échos d'individus ayant commis de grandes atrocités au nom d'une divinité maléfique. Désormais, ils ne savent qu'une seule chose, c'est que leur âme a été damnée et ils pensent pouvoir changer leur destin en offrant de puissants sacrifices à leurs maîtres fiélons.
fr.disable: @Check[religion|dc:46|name:inspirer l'intervention divine] (maître) pour inspirer l'intervention d'une divinité et contrer le rituel
fr.reset: 1 jour

zh.name: 诅咒之握 Grasp Of The Damned
zh.description: 这些绝望的灵魂是那些以邪恶之神的名义犯下滔天罪行的人的回响。现在，他们只知道自己的灵魂被诅咒了，并且坚定地相信他们可以通过为他们罪大恶极的主人提供巨大的牺牲来改善他们的命运。
zh.disable: @Check[religion|dc:46|name:Call For Divine Intervention] （大师）激发神祇以干预或反制仪式。

pl.name: Uścisk Potępionych
pl.description: Te zdesperowane duchy są echem ludzi, którzy popełnili wielkie okrucieństwa w imię złego boga. Teraz pozostała im tylko świadomość, że ich dusze zostały potępione i niezachwiana wiara, że mogą poprawić swój los, składając potężne ofiary swoim nikczemnym panom.
pl.disable: @Check[religion|dc:46|name:Wezwanie do boskiej interwencji] (master), aby zainspirować bóstwo do interwencji i przeciwdziałania rytuałowi.

routine: (1 action) On its initiative, the grasping currents attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} a swimming creature or capsize a rowboat by attempting an Athletics check with a [[/r 1d20+12 #Athletics]]{+12} modifier. A creature that's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by the grasping currents is pulled underwater and risks drowning. To capsize a rowboat, the haunt's Athletics check is rolled against the pilot's Athletics or Sailing Lore DC, whichever is higher.
stealth: (trained) to notice a weird, faintly glowing ripple of the current beneath the water.

pl.description: Kłębowisko utopionych duchów próbuje wciągnąć kogoś do wody, by do nich dołączył.

pl.stealth: (wytrenowany) by zauważyć dziwne, słabo świecące falowanie prądu pod wodą.

name: Grasping Dead
description: Hands of the buried dead rise from the ground, grabbing and tearing at creatures in the area to drag them underground.

Trigger At least two creatures enter the area

Creatures within the area are knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} unless they succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:26] save. The haunt then rolls initiative.

fr.name: Déplacement de terre
fr.description:
Déclencheur Au moins une créature pénètre dans la zone

Effet Le sol bouge et se déplace laissant passer des mains de cadavres qui transpercent la terre. La zone devient terrain difficile. Les créatures dans la zone sont poussées @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{À terre} sauf si elles réussissent un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:26]. La hantise lance ensuite l'initiative.

zh.name: 地裂 Shifting Earth

效果 当死者之手纷纷从地下伸出，地面剧烈地振动。区域变为困难地形。区域内的生物必须通过@Check[reflex|dc:26]豁免，否则@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。然后作祟投掷先攻。

fr.name: Cadavres agrippants
fr.description: Les mains des morts enterrés surgissent du sol, agrippant et déchirant les créatures dans la zone pour les entraîner sous terre.
fr.disable: @Check[religion|dc:22] (qualifié) pour prier rituellement pour les morts ou @Check[occultism|dc:24] (qualifié) pour exorciser la colère des esprits. Deux succès au total sont requis pour désactiver la hantise
fr.reset: La hantise se désactive 1 minute après que toutes les créatures vivantes aient quitté la zone. Après 1 heure, la hantise se réactive.
fr.routine: (1 action) Les mains agrippantes frappent toutes les créatures dans la zone, infligeant @Damage[(2d6+7)[bludgeoning]]{2d6+7 dégâts contondants} (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic]). En cas d'échec critique, une créature est partiellement entraînée dans la terre, devenant @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilisée} jusqu'à ce qu'elle [[/act escape dc=26]]{S'échappe}. Si elle est déjà Immobilisée, elle est complètement submergée et doit retenir sa respiration pour éviter de suffoquer.

fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:21|name:Immobiliser le membre] (qualifié) ou @Check[engineering-lore|dc:19|name:Immobiliser le membre]{Connaissance de l'ingénierie} ou @Check[azlant-lore|dc:19|name:Immobiliser le membre]{Connaissance de l'Azlant} deux fois pour immobiliser le membre, ou @Check[deception|dc:18|name:Duper le membre]{Duperie} deux fois pour que les membres s'accrochent entre-eux.
fr.routine: (2 actions) Les membres agrippants tentent de Saisir toutes les créatures pour les entraîner dans l'eau (Athletics [[/r 1d20 +12 #Athlétisme]]{+12}). Puis ils s'enroulent autour de toutes les créatures qu'ils ont Agrippé ou Entravés, infligeant @Damage[2d8[bludgeoning]]{2d8 dégâts contondants}(@Check[fortitude|dc:20|basic|name:Membres agrippants]).
fr.stealth: Qualifié ; @Check[perception|dc:23|traits:action:seek] (qualifié) pour remarquer les membres des constructions artificielles au fond de la fosse.

zh.name: Grasping Limbs (5-6)
zh.description: The limbs of smashed constructs line the bottom of the fissure, beneath the water. They desperately grab anything that gets too close。
zh.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:21|name:Immobilize Limbs] (trained) or @Check[engineering-lore|dc:19|name:Immobilize Limbs]{Engineering Lore} or @Check[azlant-lore|dc:19|name:Immobilize Limbs]{Azlant Lore} twice to immobilize the limbs, or @Check[deception|dc:18|name:Trick Limbs]{Deception} twice to trick the limbs into grasping each other.
zh.routine: （2动作） The grasping limbs try to Grapple all creatures in the water (Athletics [[/r 1d20 +12 #Athletics]]{+12}). They then tighten around all creatures they have grabbed or restrained, dealing @Damage[2d8[bludgeoning]]伤害 (@Check[fortitude|dc:20|basic|name:Grasping Limbs])。
zh.stealth: （受训）; @Check[perception|dc:23|traits:action:seek]（专家）to notice the construct limbs at the bottom of the pit。

pl.stealth: (trained); @Check[perception|dc:23|traits:action:seek] (expert) to notice the construct limbs at the bottom of the pit.

name: Gravehall Trap
description: When a living creature crosses the midpoint of the trapped tunnel, necromantic magic partially animates the corpses buried in the walls and ceiling.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:24|name:Disrupt Magical Trigger|traits:action:disable-a-device] (expert) to disrupt the magical trigger before the hazard rolls initiative, or @Check[religion|dc:18|name:Overwhelm the Area with Vitality Energy] (trained) to overwhelm the area with vitality energy and prevent the hazard from using its routine for 1 round; on the third successful Religion check, the necromantic energies are disrupted and the hazard is destroyed.
routine:
(1 action) Undead fists assail all creatures in the hall, dealing @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] damage. Creatures in the hall must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:21].

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage, and its Speeds are reduced by 10 feet (to a minimum of 5 feet) for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round.

actions.name: Lunging Dead
actions.description:
Trigger A living creature crosses the midpoint of the tunnel

Effect The dead reach out from the walls and ceiling, moaning and spewing writhing maggots. Creatures in the room must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save. The trap then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. It can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 while in the trap's area.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

fr.name: Fente des morts
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature vivante franchit la moitié du tunnel.

Effet Les morts s'agrippent à partir des murs et du plafond en gémissant et en crachant des asticots grouillants. Les créatures dans la piège doivent tenter un jet de @Check[will|dc:21]. Le piège roule alors son initiative.

Succès critique La cible n'est pas affectée

Succès La cible est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 1}

Échec La cible est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 2}. Elle ne peut pas réduire la valeur de l'état effrayé sous 1 tant qu'elle reste dans l'aire d'effet du piège.

Échec critique Comme en cas d'échec, et la cible est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralysée} pendant 1 round.

zh.name: Lunging Dead
zh.description:
Trigger A living creature crosses the midpoint of the tunnel

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. It can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 while in the trap's area.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

fr.name: Piège de la salle des tombes
fr.description: Lorsqu'une créature vivante traverse le milieu du tunnel piégé, la magie nécromantique anime partiellement les cadavres enfouis dans les murs et le plafond.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:24|name:perturber le déclencheur|traits:action:disable-a-device] (expert) pour perturber le déclencheur magique avant que le piège ne fasse son test d'initiative ou de @Check[religion|dc:18|name:surcharger de vitalité] (qualifié) pour surcharger la zone de vitalité et empêcher le piège d'utiliser sa routine pendant 1 round ; sur le troisième test de religion réussi, les énergies nécromantiques sont perturbées et le piège est détruit.
fr.routine:
(1 action) Les morts-vivants attaquent toute les créatures dans la salle infligeant @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]]{4d6 dégâts contondants}. Les créatures dans la salle doivent tenter un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:21].

Succès critique La cible n'est pas affectée.

Succès La cible subit la moitié des dégâts.

Échec La cible subit la totalité des dégâts et subit une pénalité de -3 mètres à toutes ses Vitesses (avec un minimum de 1,50 mètre) pendant 1 round.

Échec critique La cible subit le double des dégâts et se retrouve @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilisée} pendant 1 round.

zh.description: When a living creature crosses the midpoint of the trapped tunnel, necromantic magic partially animates the corpses buried in the walls and ceiling.
zh.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:24|name:Disrupt Magical Trigger|traits:action:disable-a-device] （专家） to disrupt the magical trigger before the hazard rolls initiative, or @Check[religion|dc:18|name:Overwhelm the Area with Positive Energy] （受训） to overwhelm the area with positive energy and prevent the hazard from using its routine for 1 round; on the third successful Religion check, the necromantic energies are disrupted and the hazard is destroyed.
zh.routine:
1 Undead fists assail all creatures in the hall, dealing [[/r (4d6)[bludgeoning]]]{4d6钝击伤害}. Creatures in the hall must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:21].

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 The target takes half damage.

失败 The target takes full damage, and its Speeds are reduced by 10 feet (to a minimum of 5 feet) for 1 round.

大失败 The target takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足 Immobilized} for 1 round.

pl.name: Pułapka Grobowej Hali
pl.description: Gdy żywa istota przekroczy punkt środkowy tunelu, magia nekromantyczna częściowo ożywia zwłoki zakopane w ścianach i suficie.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:24|name:Zakłócenie magicznego wyzwalacza|traits:action:disable-a-device] (ekspert), aby zakłócić magiczny wyzwalacz, zanim zagrożenie wyrzuci inicjatywę, lub @Check[religion|dc:18|name:Przytłocz obszar energią witalności] (wytrenowanie), aby przytłoczyć obszar energią witalną i uniemożliwić zagrożeniu korzystanie z rutyny przez 1 rundę; przy trzecim udanym teście Religii energia nekromantyczna zostaje zakłócona, a zagrożenie zniszczone.
pl.routine:
(1 akcja) Nieumarłe pięści atakują wszystkie stworzenia w sali, zadając @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] obrażeń. Istoty w sali muszą wykonać próbę @Check[reflex|dc:21].

Krytyczny Sukces Nie ma to wpływu na cel.

Sukces Cel otrzymuje połowę obrażeń.

Porażka Cel otrzymuje pełne obrażenia, a jego Szybkość zostaje zmniejszona o 10 stóp (do minimum 5 stóp) na 1 rundę.

Krytyczna Porażka Cel otrzymuje podwójne obrażenia i zostaje @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Unieruchomiony} na 1 rundę.

name: Grazing Deer
description: A herd of deer exits the woods to investigate the delicious-looking leshys.
disable: @Check[diplomacy|dc:17|name:Befriend the Deer]{Diplomacy (with Wild Empathy)} to befriend the deer and convince them that leshys aren't for nibbling, or @Check[intimidation|dc:20|name:Scare the Deer Away]{Intimidation} to scare away the deer.
publication: Pathfinder Adventure: A Fistful of Flowers
routine: (2 actions) The grazing deer takes one action to move about, and then one action to eagerly nibble at a randomly chosen PC. A character who spends three actions on their turn to Stride can avoid being nibbled by the grazing deer during the hazard's next turn. If all of the PCs do so, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:5|name:Escape the Deer]-on a success, the party escapes the deer and can proceed onward to Petalbrook, but they become delayed as a result of having to flee the pack of ravenous deer.

actions.name: Approach and Taste
actions.description:
Trigger The PCs emerge from the forest's edge

Effect A deer approaches the party and attempts a nibble Strike against a randomly determined PC. The grazing deer rolls initiative.

zh.name: 靠近尝一尝 Approach and Taste
zh.description:
触发 PC们从森林边缘出现

效果 一头鹿接近小队并对一名随机的PC进行一次啃咬打击，随后食草鹿投掷先攻。

zh.name: 吃草的鹿 Grazing Deer
zh.description: 一群鹿离开树林来研究这群看上去很美味的莱西。
zh.disable: @Check[diplomacy|dc:17|name:Befriend the Deer]{交涉（需要野性认同）}来与鹿友善相处并让它们相信莱西不是用来啃的东西，或者通过@Check[intimidation|dc:20|name:Scare the Deer Away]{威吓}来把鹿吓跑
zh.routine: （2动作）吃草的鹿用一个动作进行移动，再用一个动作迫不及待地啃向一名随机决定的PC。若一个角色在他们的回合中用三个动作进行行走便可在危害的下一个回合中避免被吃草的鹿啃咬。若所有PC 都选择如此，则进行一次@Check[flat|dc:5|name:Escape the Deer]检定——在检定成功的情况下，小队逃离了鹿并继续前往花溪村，但他们会因为不得不费力避开那贪吃的鹿而遭受延误。

name: Greased Floor
description: The floor is highly waxed and slippery.
disable: @Check[survival|dc:14] or @Check[thievery|dc:14] to remove the slippery coating or any ability that turns the area into difficult terrain.
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-05: Silver Bark, Golden Blades
reset: Manual, reapply the wax.

actions.name: Slip and Slide
actions.description:
Trigger A creature walks into the greased area

Effect The triggering creature must make a successful @Check[acrobatics|dc:12] check to avoid falling @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. The area is uneven ground.

fr.name: Déraper et glisser
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature marche sur la zone cirée à la graisse

Effet La créature déclencheuse doit réussir un test de @Check[acrobatics|dc:12] pour éviter de tomber @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{À terre}. La zone est un sol inégal.

fr.name: Sol ciré à la graisse
fr.description: Le sol est abondamment ciré à la graisse et glissant.
fr.disable: @Check[survival|dc:14] ou @Check[thievery|dc:14] pour retirer le revêtement glissant ou toute capacité qui transforme la zone en terrain difficile.
fr.reset: Manuel, remettre de la cire.

name: Greater Blood Shadow Mirror
description: A dark shape moves in the surface of an ornate mirror, its eyes wide as blood seeps down its tormented face.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:20] (trained) to fully cover the mirror or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (2nd rank; counteract DC 22) to dispel the mirror.
reset: 1 minute if no fresh blood has been spilled.
routine:
(2 actions; arcane, mental) The bloody figure in the mirror transforms to reflect a creature within 30 feet. The reflection bleeds profusely from the eyes, nose, and mouth, and the reflected creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21|traits:arcane,mental] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The creature bleeds from their mouth or nose.

Failure The creature bleeds from their eyes, mouth, and nose, and takes @Damage[2d8[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.
stealth: (trained); DC 0 to notice the mirror without noting it is a trap

actions.name: Bloody Glare
actions.description:
Trigger A creature spills blood in the room

Effect A ghastly figure of blood appears in the mirror's surface, forcing all creatures who can see it to attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save. The trap then rolls initiative.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature bleeds from their nose and mouth.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

fr.name: Regard sanguin
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature verse du sang dans la pièce

Effet Une silhouette en sang terrifiante apparaît sur la surface du miroir, forçant toutes les créatures qui peuvent l'apercevoir d'effectuer un jet de @Check[fortitude|dc:23]. Puis la hantise lance l'initiative The trap then rolls initiative.

Succès La créature n'est pas affectée.

Échec La créature saigne du nez et de la bouche.

Échec critique Comme en cas d'échec, mais la créature est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drainée 1}.

fr.name: Miroir de l'ombre en sang supérieur
fr.description: Une silhouette sombre se déplace à la surface d'un miroir orné, les yeux écarquillés, le sang coulant sur son visage tourmenté.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:20] (qualifié) pour recouvrir le miroir entièrement ou @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dissipation de la magie} (contrer : Rang 2 ; DD 22) pour dissiper le miroir.
fr.reset: 1 minute si il n'y a pas de sang frais versé
fr.routine:
(2 actions; arcanique, mental) La silhouette en sang se transforme pour réfléchir une créature dans les 9 mètres. La réflection saigne abondamment des yeux, nez et bouche, et la créature réfléchie doit effectuer un jet de @Check[will|dc:21|traits:arcane,mental] save.

Succès critique La créature n'est pas affectée et immunisée pendant 1 minute.

Succès La créature saigne du nez ou de sa bouche.

Échec La créature saigne des yeux, de la bouche et son nez et subit @Damage[1d10[bleed]]{1d10 dégâts de saignement}.

Échec critique Comme en cas de succès, et la créature est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 1}.
fr.stealth: Qualifié ; DD 0 pour remarquer le miroir sans savoir que c'est un piège

name: Greater Dragon's Ward
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:30] (master) to painstakingly remove the rune without triggering the magic, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (4th rank; counteract DC 28) to counteract the rune.

actions.name: Curse the Intruders
actions.description:
Trigger A creature passes the threshold

Effect Each living creature within 30 feet must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:26] save or be subjected to the dragon's curse A cursed creature takes a –2 status penalty to Fortitude saves, and any natural or magical healing it receives is halved The curse remains until removed by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} or similar magic

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.qPul8V5LMyHNpsOa]{Effect: Curse the Intruders}

fr.name: Maudire les intrus
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature franchit le seuil

Effet Chaque créature vivante dans un rayon de 9 mètres doit réussir un jet de @Check[will|dc:26]. En cas d'échec, elle est soumise à la malédiction du dragon. Une créature maudite subit une pénalité de statut de 2 aux jets de Vigueur, et toute guérison naturelle ou magique qu'elle reçoit est réduite de moitié. La malédiction persiste jusqu'à être supprimée par @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Affliction purifiée} ou une magie similaire.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.qPul8V5LMyHNpsOa]{Effect: Curse the Intruders}

fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:30] (maître) pour retirer méticuleusement la rune sans déclencher la magie, ou @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dissipation de la magie} (rang 4 ; contrer DD 28) pour contrer la rune.
