pl.description: A mass of brushes use magical paint to convert creatures into art.
pl.disable: @Check[crafting|dc:41|name:Crafting Disable] (master) to mix the paints into bland, useless colors, @Check[thievery|dc:41|name:Thievery Disable] (legendary) to dismantle the animated brushes, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (8th rank; counteract DC 41) to counteract the magic within the paint.

name: Locking Alarm
description: Any attempt to open the door without first tracing the symbol of Yhidothrus (an hourglass) on the door's face with a fingertip causes a glowing green ward to seal the door shut and raise an alarm.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:32] (expert) to bypass the magical triggers on the door, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (5th rank, counteract DC 29) to counteract the alarm.
reset: The locking alarm resets after 1 minute.

actions.name: Lock and Shriek
actions.description:
Trigger A creature attempts to open or affect the door

Effect The religious symbol of Yhidothrus glows green on the door, sealing it shut while simultaneously shrieking like a tormented soul. This howl is audible in areas D1-D4 and is loud enough in area D2 to rouse the bodaks.

While the door remains locked, a @Check[athletics|dc:32] check can Force it Open, or a @Check[thievery|dc:32] check can Pick the Lock. The lock can also be removed with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (5th rank, counteract DC 29).

Once triggered, the alarm continues to shriek and the door remains locked until the hazard is disabled or the door is destroyed or opened. Tracing Yhidothrus's hourglass-shaped religious symbol on either side of the door with a fingertip disables the alarm and the locking ward.

fr.name: Verrouiller et hurler
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature tente d'ouvrir ou affecter la porte.

Effet Le symbole religieux de Yhidothrus brille d'une lueur verte sur la porte, la verrouillant totalement alors que simultanément un hurlement pareil à une âme tourmentée retentit. Ce hurlement est entendu dans les zones D1-D4 et a un volume assez fort dans la zone D2 pour réveiller les bodaks.

Alors que la porte reste verrouillée, un test d'@Check[athletics|dc:32] peut l'Ouvrir de force, ou un test de @Check[thievery|dc:32] pour Crocheter la serrure. Cette serrure peut aussi être déverrouillée avec un sort de @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dissipation de la magie} (contrer : Rang 5, DD 29 pour contrer).

Une fois enclenchée, l'alarme continue à hurler et la porte reste verrouillée jusqu'à ce que le piège est désamorcée ou la porte est détruite ou ouverte. Tracer le symbole religieux du sablier d'Yhidothrus sur n'importe quelle face de la porte avec le bout du doigt désactive l'alarme et le glyphe de garde.

zh.name: 上锁与尖叫 Lock and Shriek
zh.description:
触发 一个生物试图打开或影响这扇门

效果 依多卓思的圣徽在门上发出绿色的光芒，将门封住，同时发出像受折磨的灵魂在尖叫的声音。D1-D4区都能听到哭号声，且声音足够唤醒D2区的波达尸。

门处于上锁状态时，可以尝试@Check[athletics|dc:32]检定进行破拆，或者@Check[thievery|dc:32]检定进行撬锁。锁也可以用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]（5环级，反制DC29）反制。

一旦被触发，警报器就会一直尖叫且门会一直锁着，直到危害被解除或者门被摧毁或打开。用指尖在门的两侧描画依多卓思的沙漏状圣徽，可以解除警报和封门的结界。

fr.name: Alarme de verrouillage
fr.description: Toute tentative d'ouvrir la porte sans tracer à priori le symbole de Yhidothrus (un sablier) sur la face de la porte avec le bout du doigt, cause l'activation d'un glyphe de garde de couleur verte qui verrouille la porte et fait sonner l'alarme.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:32] (expert) pour contourner les déclencheurs magiques sur la porte, ou @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dissipation de la magie} (contrer : Rang 5 ; DD 29) pour contrer l'alarme.
fr.reset: L'Alarme de verrouillage se réactive après 1 minute.

zh.name: 上锁警报器 Locking Alarm
zh.description: 任何人试图打开门，却没有先用指尖描画门上的依多卓思圣徽（沙漏），会导致发光的绿色防护罩出现将门封住并触发警报。
zh.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:32]（专家）绕过门上的魔法触发器，或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]（5环级，反制DC29）以反制警报。
zh.reset: 上锁警报器在1分钟后重置。

pl.name: Alarm Blokady
pl.description: Każda próba otwarcia drzwi bez uprzedniego narysowania palcem symbolu Yhidothrusa (klepsydry) na ich powierzchni powoduje, że świecąca na zielono bariera zamyka drzwi i uruchamia alarm.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:32] (ekspercki), aby ominąć magiczne wyzwalacze na drzwiach, lub @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Rozproszenie Magii} (5 ranga, przeciwdziałanie ST 29), aby przeciwdziałać alarmowi.
pl.reset: Alarm blokady zostanie zresetowany po 1 minucie.

name: Locking Door
description: A door (or other portal) slams shut and locks.
disable: @Check[athletics|dc:14|name:Push Back Against the Door] to push back against the door, @Check[crafting|dc:14|name:Wedge the Door Open] to wedge the door open, or @Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Jam the Lock] (trained) to jam the lock or open the lock afterward
stealth: to notice the door sway slightly, even though there's no breeze

actions.name: Shut In
actions.description:
Trigger A creature ends their move after passing through the doorway

Effect With an ethereal gust shimmering in the air, the door creaks as it swings shut and locks. The haunted door pushes anyone in its space into an adjacent space in the connecting chamber. A creature that would be pushed and succeeds at a @Check[reflex|dc:16] save selects which side of the door they end up on.

fr.name: Enfermer
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature termine son mouvement après être passé la porte.

Effet Avec un souffle léger dans l'air, la porte grince alors qu'elle se referme et se verrouille. La porte hantée pousse quiconque dans son espace dans un espace adjacent de la chambre communiquante. Une créature qui est poussée et réussit un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:16] peut choisir de quel côté de la porte elle veut se trouver.

zh.name: 关禁闭 Shut In
zh.description:
触发 一个生物在穿过门后结束移动；

效果 一阵闪烁着微光的灵质强风吹过门扉，门发出嘎吱作响的声音，关上并锁住了。这扇作祟的门会将它所在空间里的生物推到所连接的房间内的相邻空间里。成功尝试@Check[reflex|dc:16]豁免的生物可以选择他们最终停留在门的哪一侧。

zh.name: 上锁的门 Locking Door
zh.description: 一扇门（或其他入口）突然关闭并上锁。
zh.disable: @Check[athletics|dc:14|name:Push Back Against the Door]把门推开；@Check[crafting|dc:14|name:Wedge the Door Open]把门楔开；或@Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Jam the Lock]（受训）卡住门锁或事后开锁
zh.stealth: 注意到门在没有起风的情况下轻轻摇摆。

pl.name: Blokada Drzwi
pl.description: Drzwi (lub inny portal) zatrzaskują się i blokują.
pl.disable: @Check[athletics|dc:14|name:Odepchnij się od drzwi] aby odepchnąć się od drzwi, @Check[crafting|dc:14|name:Otwórz drzwi klinem] aby podważyć drzwi, lub @Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Wyłam zamek] (wytrenowany) aby wyłamać zamek lub otworzyć go później
pl.stealth: Zauważyć, że drzwi lekko się kołyszą, mimo że nie ma wiatru

name: Locus of Death
description: A magical orb inflicts terrible visions of gruesome ends on anyone who approaches.
disable: @Check[nature|dc:27] (master) to infuse the locus with life force, @Check[occultism|dc:30] or @Check[religion|dc:30] (expert) to counteract the locus's energies, @Check[thievery|dc:35] (master) to extricate the orb from the altar
reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures leave the area. After 1 hour, the haunt reactivates.
routine: (1 action; death, emotion, fear, mental) One living creature in the haunt's location (determined randomly) is targeted by a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Jmxru8zMdYMRuO5n]{Vision of Death} (@Check[will|dc:32|traits:death,emotion,fear,mental]). A creature that critically fails their save doesn't physically flee but instead can't attempt to disable the hazard until they're no longer frightened. Once all creatures have been affected, the haunt deactivates.

actions.name: Death Grip
actions.description:
Trigger A creature touches the orb or attempts to disable the haunt

Effect Necromantic energy lashes out from the orb and the triggering creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:32] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure). The haunt then rolls initiative.

zh.name: 死亡之握 Death Grip
zh.description:
触发 一个生物触碰法球或试图解除作祟

效果 法球中涌出的死灵能量猛击触发该效果的生物，该生物必须通过一次@Check[will|dc:32] 豁免否则 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1} （大失败时@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 2}）。然后作祟进行先攻检定。

actions.name: Death Manifest
actions.description: Casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Hnc7eGi7vyZenAIm]{Breath of Life}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YvXKGlHOt7mdW2jZ]{Death Ward}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IkGYwHRLhkuoGReG]{Raise Dead} in the orb's presence automatically destroys the locus; other spells or abilities that restore the dead to life might also do so, at GM discretion.

zh.name: 死亡显化 Death Manifest
zh.description: 在法球存在的情况下施展 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Hnc7eGi7vyZenAIm]，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YvXKGlHOt7mdW2jZ]，或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IkGYwHRLhkuoGReG]会自动摧毁法器；其他能将死者复活的法术或能力也可能在主持人的裁决下造成同样的效果。

actions.name: Unholy Repair
actions.description: The locus is sustained by the power of Tar-Baphon. The orb regains 10 Hit Points at the beginning of every round and is repaired by void damage.

zh.name: 邪秽修复 Unholy Repair
zh.description: 法器由塔-巴丰之力维持。每轮开始时，法球由虚能伤害修复，恢复10 点生命值。

zh.name: 死亡法器 Locus of Death
zh.description: 一个魔法球会让靠近它的人产生可怕的幻觉，看到自己可怕的结局。
zh.disable: @Check[nature|dc:27]（大师）将生命之力注入法器，@Check[occultism|dc:30]或@Check[religion|dc:30]（专家）反制法器的能量，@Check[thievery|dc:35]（大师）将球体从祭坛上取下
zh.reset: 当所有生物离开该区域 1分钟后，作祟会停止。1小时后，作祟会重新激活。
zh.routine: (1动作；死亡，情绪，恐惧，心灵) 在作祟地点随机选定的一个活着的生物成为4环 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Jmxru8zMdYMRuO5n]（@Check[will|dc:32|traits:death,emotion,fear,mental]）。豁免失败的生物不会产生逃离效果，但在不再惊惧之前无法尝试解除危害。所有生物都受到影响后，作祟停止。

name: Locus of Destruction
description: A magical orb drives intruders to commit acts of mindless destruction.
disable: @Check[crafting|dc:27] (master) to reconfigure the locus, @Check[occultism|dc:30] or @Check[religion|dc:30] (expert) to counteract the locus's energies, @Check[thievery|dc:35] (master) to extricate the orb from the altar
reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures leave the area. After 1 hour, the haunt reactivates.
routine:
(1 action; mental) The destructive impulses grow stronger. Affected creatures must attempt a @Check[will|dc:32|traits:mental] save; creatures who fail or critically fail can't attempt to disable the haunt that turn.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The creature is unaffected this round.

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round, targeting both creatures and objects.

Critical Failure As failure but the confusion lasts for 1 minute.

actions.name: Destruction's Fury
actions.description:
Trigger A creature touches the orb or attempts to disable the haunt

Effect A destructive fury fills the minds of all living creatures in the area, who must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:32] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} on a critical failure) for 1 minute. The haunt then rolls initiative.

zh.name: 毁灭之怒 Destruction's Fury
zh.description:
触发 一个生物触碰法球或试图解除作祟

效果 毁灭的狂怒充斥着区域内所有生物的心灵，它们必须成功通过一次@Check[will|dc:32|options:inflicts:stupefied]豁免，否则将@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 1}（大失败则@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 2}），持续1分钟。然后作祟投掷先攻。

actions.name: Destruction Manifest
actions.description: Casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TUj8eugNqAvB1vVR]{Creation} or a creation domain spell (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.xTpp8dHZsNMDm75B]{Creative Splash} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.eb4FXf62NYArTqek]{Artistic Flourish}) in the orb's presence automatically destroys the locus; other spells or abilities that create things might also do so at GM discretion.

zh.name: 毁灭显化 Destruction Manifest
zh.description: 在法球存在的情况下施展@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TUj8eugNqAvB1vVR]或一个创造领域法术（@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.xTpp8dHZsNMDm75B]或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.eb4FXf62NYArTqek]）会自动摧毁该法球；其他创造事物的法术或能力也可能在主持人的裁决下造成同样的效果。

actions.name: Destructive Backlash
actions.description:
Trigger The orb is damaged by an attack

Effect The locus makes a destructive lash Strike against the triggering creature.

zh.name: 毁灭反击 Destructive Backlash
zh.description:
触发 法球受到攻击

效果 法器对触发该效果的生物进行一次毁灭抽击打击。

zh.name: 毁灭法器 Locus of Destruction
zh.description: 一个魔法球驱使着入侵者做出无意识的破坏行为。
zh.disable: @Check[crafting|dc:27] (大师) 以重新配置法器，@Check[occultism|dc:30] 或 @Check[religion|dc:30] (专家) 反制法器的能量，@Check[thievery|dc:35] (大师) 以从祭坛上取出球体
zh.reset: 当所有生物离开该区域1分钟后，作祟会停止。1小时后，作祟会再次激活。
zh.routine:
（1动作；心灵）破坏性的冲动愈发强烈。受影响的生物必须进行一次@Check[will|dc:32|options:inflicts:confused|traits:mental]豁免；失败或大失败的生物在该回合无法尝试解除作祟。

大成功 该生物不受影响，并在1分钟内暂时免疫该效果。

成功 该生物本回合不受影响。

失败 该生物在1轮内陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]，会攻击周遭的生物和物体。

大失败 如同失败，但困惑状态持续1分钟。

name: Locus of Pain
description: An arcane orb sits upon a sinister altar, filling creatures in the area with unimaginable pain.
disable: @Check[medicine|dc:27] (master) to soothe the locus's pain, @Check[occultism|dc:30] or @Check[religion|dc:30] to counteract the locus's energies, @Check[thievery|dc:35] (master) to extricate the orb from the altar
reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures leave the area. After 1 hour, the haunt reactivates.
routine: (1 action; mental, nonlethal) Creatures affected by the haunt's agony lash are wracked with pain, as 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.R8bqnYiThB6MYTxD]{Phantom Pain} (@Check[will|dc:32|traits:mental,nonlethal]). If a creature falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} due to the haunt, they don't continue taking damage.

actions.name: Agony Lash
actions.description:
Trigger A creature touches the orb or attempts to disable the haunt

Effect All living creatures within 60 feet are overwhelmed by pain and must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:32] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). The haunt then rolls initiative.

zh.name: 痛苦鞭笞 Agony Lash
zh.description:
触发 一个生物触碰法球或试图解除作祟

效果 半径60 尺内的所有生物都被剧痛所淹没，必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:32] 豁免，否则 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 1} （大失败则@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心Sickened 2} ）。然后作祟进行先攻检定。

actions.name: Pain Manifest
actions.description: Casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b515AZlB0sridKSq]{Calm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.szIyEsvihc5e1w8n]{Soothe} in the orb's presence automatically destroys the locus; other spells or abilities that ease pain might also do so, at GM discretion.

zh.name: 痛苦显化 Pain Manifest
zh.description: 在法球存在的情况下施展@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b515AZlB0sridKSq]或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.szIyEsvihc5e1w8n] 会自动摧毁法器；其他能缓解痛苦的法术或能力也可能在主持人的裁决下造成同样的效果。

zh.reset: 所有生物离开该区域 1分钟后，作祟就会失效。1小时后，作祟会重新激活。
zh.routine: （1动作；心灵，非致命） 受到作祟痛苦鞭笞影响的生物会遭受剧痛，如同4环 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.R8bqnYiThB6MYTxD]（@Check[will|dc:32|traits:mental,nonlethal]），如果生物因作祟而失去意识，则不再继续受到伤害。

name: Lodestone Trap
description: The magical lodestone discharges bolts of electricity that also magnetize metal in the room.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:18] to unhook the pressure plates from the trap, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (2nd rank, counteract DC 18) to counteract the trap
publication: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
reset: At the end of a round in which there are no creatures standing on the floor or stuck to the lodestone, the trap deactivates. The vargouilles return to their alcoves, and the doors close. The trap resets automatically after 1 minute.
routine:
(1 action) On its initiative, the trap exerts a strong magnetic pull on the doors, causing the north and west doors to open if they're closed, or causing the south and east doors to close if they're open. A character can open or close a door against this pull with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:18] check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} the door. At the same time, any character in the room who wears primarily metal armor must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:18] save (characters in medium metal armor suffer a -1 circumstance penalty to this save, and characters in heavy metal armor suffer a -2 circumstance penalty).

Critical Success The PC is unaffected.

Success The PC resists the pull but treats the room as difficult terrain.

Failure The PC treats the room as difficult terrain and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. A PC who's already prone suffers a critical failure instead.

Critical Failure As failure, but the PC is also pulled 5 feet toward the lodestone. A PC who is adjacent to the lodestone instead becomes stuck to it and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} as long as the trap continues its routine ([[/act escape dc=18]]).

actions.name: Magneto-Electric Pulse
actions.description:
Trigger A single Medium or two or more Small creatures end their turn inside the room.

Effect A pulse of electricity discharges from the lodestone to strike all four doors, with smaller arcs of electricity lancing out to strike all creatures in the room. The south and east doors slam shut, while the north and west doors fly open, releasing two vargouilles into the room. All creatures in the room take @Damage[2d6[electricity]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic]). The trap then rolls initiative.

pl.name: Lodestone Trap
pl.description: The magical lodestone discharges bolts of electricity that also magnetize metal in the room.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:18] to unhook the pressure plates from the trap, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (2nd rank, counteract DC 18) to counteract the trap
pl.reset: At the end of a round in which there are no creatures standing on the floor or stuck to the lodestone, the trap deactivates. The vargouilles return to their alcoves, and the doors close. The trap resets automatically after 1 minute.
pl.routine:
(1 action) On its initiative, the trap exerts a strong magnetic pull on the doors, causing the north and west doors to open if they're closed, or causing the south and east doors to close if they're open. A character can open or close a door against this pull with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:18] check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} the door. At the same time, any character in the room who wears primarily metal armor must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:18] save (characters in medium metal armor suffer a -1 circumstance penalty to this save, and characters in heavy metal armor suffer a -2 circumstance penalty).

Critical Success The PC is unaffected.

Success The PC resists the pull but treats the room as difficult terrain.

Failure The PC treats the room as difficult terrain and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. A PC who's already prone suffers a critical failure instead.

Critical Failure As failure, but the PC is also pulled 5 feet toward the lodestone. A PC who is adjacent to the lodestone instead becomes stuck to it and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} as long as the trap continues its routine ([[/act escape dc=18]]).

name: Lonely Machine Spirit
description: Ghostly smoke rising from an alchemical engine belches forth; the screeching sound of grinding gears echoes from the engine as it shutters to life.
disable: @Check[religion|dc:22|name:Eject the animating spirit|traits:hazard,haunt,complex] (trained) or @Check[engineering|dc:20|name:Eject the animating spirit|traits:hazard,haunt,complex] Lore (trained) to eject the animating spirit from its mechanical shell. Creatures gain a +2 circumstance bonus on their check if they use the airship's name, Harpy's Kiss, as part of their skill check, or a +4 circumstance bonus if they utter the name "Phera Wyndslow." The haunt remains active until its spirit is ejected, the haunt is destroyed, or there are no living creatures within 30 feet.
publication: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg
reset: The haunt deactivates and resets after 1 hour.
routine: (2 actions) The lonely machine spirit Belches Smoke or makes two red hot gear Strikes against two creatures within 30 feet.

actions.name: Painful Whistle
actions.description:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 10 feet of the engine (marked with a "T" on the map)

Effect A loud whistle blows and all creatures within 30 feet take @Damage[2d6[sonic]] damage and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (@Check[fortitude|dc:20|basic|traits:hazard,haunt,complex]; creatures aren't stunned on a success). The lonely machine spirit then rolls initiative.

fr.name: Sifflement douloureux
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature vivante s'approche dans les 3 mètres de l'engin (marqué d'un "T" sur la carte)

Effet Un sifflement aigü s'échappe de l'engin et toutes les créatures dans un rayon de 9 mètres subissent @Damage[2d6[sonic]]{2d6 dégâts de son} et sont @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Étourdies 1} (jet @Check[fortitude|dc:20|basic|traits:hazard,haunt,complex]. Les créatures qui obtiennent un succès ne sont pas Étourdies). Puis l'esprit solitaire de la machine lance l'initiative.

zh.name: 痛苦汽笛 Painful Whistle
zh.description:
触发 一个活物接近引擎10尺范围内（在地图上以T标出）

效果 引擎发出一阵响亮的汽笛声，30尺内所有生物受到@Damage[2d6[sonic]]伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 Stunned 1}（@Check[fortitude|dc:20|basic|traits:hazard,haunt,complex]豁免，成功不受震慑）。然后孤单的机魂投掷先攻。

actions.name: Belch Smoke
actions.description:
The airship's engine issues forth a cloud of alchemical smoke in a @Template[cone|distance:30]. Creatures within the cone must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:20|traits:hazard,haunt,complex] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage and is sickened 2.

fr.name: Rejet de fumée
fr.description:
L'engin mécanique du navire volant projette un nuage de fumée alchimique dans un @Template[cone|distance:30]{cône de 9 mètres}. Les créatures dans le cône doivent tenter un jet de @Check[fortitude|dc:20|traits:hazard,haunt,complex].

Succès critique La créature n'est pas affectée.

Succès La créature subit @Damage[1d6[poison]]{1d6 dégâts de poison} et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Nauséeuse 1}.

Échec La créature subit @Damage[2d6[poison]]{1d6 dégâts de poison} et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Nauséeuse 2}.

Échec critique La créature subit @Damage[3d6[poison]]{3d6 dégâts de poison} et est Nauséeuse 2.

zh.name: 喷烟 Belch Smoke
zh.description:
飞艇引擎喷出@Template[cone|distance:30]炼金烟雾。范围内的生物必须尝试@Check[fortitude|dc:20|traits:hazard,haunt,complex]豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到@Damage[1d6[poison]]伤害和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 1}。

失败 生物受到@Damage[2d6[poison]]伤害和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 2}。

大失败 生物受到@Damage[3d6[poison]]伤害和恶心2。

fr.name: Esprit solitaire de la machine
fr.description: Une fumée fantomatique s'échappe d'un moteur alchimique. Le bruit strident des engrenages se répercute sur le moteur lorsqu'il se met en marche.
fr.disable: @Check[religion|dc:22|name:Éjecter l'esprit qui anime le mécanisme|traits:hazard,haunt,complex] (qualifié) ou test de Connaissance @Check[engineering|dc:20|name:Éjecter l'esprit qui anime le mécanisme|traits:hazard,haunt,complex] (qualifié) Éjecter l'esprit qui anime le mécanisme de son enveloppe.
fr.reset: L'appartiion se désactive et se réactive après 1 heure.
fr.routine: (2 actions) L'esprit solitaire de la machine projette de la fumée ou effectue deux Frappes de Levier de vitesse brûlant contre deux créatures dans un rayon de 9 mètres.

zh.name: 孤单的机魂 Lonely Machine Spirit
zh.description: 炼金术引擎喷出幽灵般的烟雾，发动机发出刺耳的齿轮摩擦声，仿佛活过来一般。
zh.disable: @Check[religion|dc:22|name:Eject the animating spirit|traits:hazard,haunt,complex]（受训）或@Check[engineering|dc:20|name:Eject the animating spirit|traits:hazard,haunt,complex]工程学识（受训）放逐炼金引擎中的机魂。作为技能检定的一部分，如果生物说出这艘船的名字“鹰身女妖之吻”，则有+2环境加值。或如果生物说出船长“菲拉·温德斯洛”的名字，则有+4环境加值。作祟会一直保持活动，除非机魂被放逐，或作祟被摧毁，或30尺内没有任何活物。
zh.reset: 作祟停止活动，并在1小时后重置。
zh.routine: （2动作）孤单的机魂使用喷烟能力，或对30尺内的两个生物进行红热齿轮打击。

pl.name: Lonely Machine Spirit
pl.description: Ghostly smoke rising from an alchemical engine belches forth; the screeching sound of grinding gears echoes from the engine as it shutters to life.
pl.disable: @Check[religion|dc:22|name:Eject the animating spirit|traits:hazard,haunt,complex] (trained) or @Check[engineering|dc:20|name:Eject the animating spirit|traits:hazard,haunt,complex] Lore (trained) to eject the animating spirit from its mechanical shell. Creatures gain a +2 circumstance bonus on their check if they use the airship's name, Harpy's Kiss, as part of their skill check, or a +4 circumstance bonus if they utter the name "Phera Wyndslow." The haunt remains active until its spirit is ejected, the haunt is destroyed, or there are no living creatures within 30 feet.
pl.reset: The haunt deactivates and resets after 1 hour.
pl.routine: (2 actions) The lonely machine spirit Belches Smoke or makes two red hot gear Strikes against two creatures within 30 feet.

name: Loose Slab
description: The stone slab tears free from its track with the ear-piercing sound of failing metal.
disable: @Check[crafting|dc:20] (expert) to shore up the track so that it functions as intended, or @Check[thievery|dc:18] (trained) to wedge the slab in place to immobilize it
publication: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King

actions.name: Falling Slab
actions.description:
Trigger A creature attempts to move the slab;

Effect The slab rips free from its track and falls, slamming down in one direction while it kicks up twisted metal debris in the other. All creatures adjacent to the slab take 3d6 bludgeoning and @Damage[3d6[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic]).

pl.name: Loose Slab
pl.description: The stone slab tears free from its track with the ear-piercing sound of failing metal.
pl.disable: @Check[crafting|dc:20] (expert) to shore up the track so that it functions as intended, or @Check[thievery|dc:18] (trained) to wedge the slab in place to immobilize it

name: Luminous Ward
description: A burst of radiance explodes from the door.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:40|name:|traits:action:disable-a-device] (master) to disable the wards or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (9th rank; counteract DC 38) to counteract the ward
reset: The trap resets after 1 hour.

actions.name: Radiant Explosion
actions.description:
Trigger A creature touches the door

Effect All creatures within 20 feet of the door are scorched with brilliant light, taking @Damage[20d6[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic] save). A creature that fails this save is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 hour (or permanently on a critical failure).

fr.name: Explosion rayonnante
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature touche la porte

Effet Toutes les créatures se trouvant jusqu'à une distance de 6 mètres de la porte sont brûlées par une intense lumière et subissent @Damage[20d6[fire]]{20d6 dégâts de feu} (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic]). Une créature qui obtient un échec à son jet de sauvegarde est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Aveuglée} pendant 1 heure (ou de manière permanente sur un échec critique).

zh.name: 辉煌爆破 Radiant Explosion
zh.description:
触发 有生物碰触石门；

效果 所有距离石门20尺范围内的生物会被辉煌之光所灼伤，承受@Damage[20d6[fire]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic]豁免）。在此豁免中失败的生物会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲 Blinded}1小时（大失败时为永久目盲）。

fr.name: Protection lumineuse
fr.description: Une explosion de lumière jaillit de la porte.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:40|name:|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maître) pour désamorcer la protection ou @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (contrer : Rang 9 ; DD 38) pour contrer la protection
fr.reset: Le piège se réinitialise au bout d'une heure.

zh.name: 璀璨结界 Luminous Ward
zh.description: 从门里爆发出一阵光芒。
zh.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:40|name:|traits:action:disable-a-device]（大师）以解除结界，或者@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]（9环级，反制DC38）来反制结界。
zh.reset: 陷阱会在1小时后重置。

pl.name: Luminous Ward
pl.description: A burst of radiance explodes from the door.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:40|name:|traits:action:disable-a-device] (master) to disable the wards or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (9th rank; counteract DC 38) to counteract the ward
pl.reset: The trap resets after 1 hour.

name: Lured to Ashes
description: The illusory scene of a furnished study covers the room's actual appearance. It flickers and fades, revealing a scorched and burnt chamber. A moment later, the screams of burning victims fill the room, and blazing skeletal arms reach from the ashes and charred walls to scrape and claw.
disable: @Check[intimidation|dc:26|name:Silence the Spirits|traits:action:coerce] to command the spirits haunting this room to be silent or @Check[religion|dc:23|name:Exorcise the Haunt] to exorcise the haunt
reset: 8 hours; destroying the tanglebones in area E3 destroys this haunt forever.
routine:
1 Action: If there are no targets within area B18 when the haunt takes its action, it can use its Lure reaction to try to get nearby victims back inside. The haunt manifests several burning skeletal arms that reach up from the ruined floors or out of the burnt walls to claw at every creature in area B18. These creatures must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:22|name:Lured to Ashes Fire|traits:damaging-effect,fire,necromancy,occult] save (creatures seated on a sofa take a -2 circumstance penalty to this saving throw).

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes @Damage[1d8[fire]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[2d8[fire]] damage and gains weakness 5 to fire. This weakness persists until the creature is fully healed.

Critical Failure As failure, but @Damage[4d8[fire]] damage and weakness 10 to fire.

actions.name: Lure
actions.description:
Trigger A creature moves more than 5 feet into the room

Effect All creatures in area B18 and all creatures within 10 feet of an open door or window adjacent to area B18 hear a compelling voice inviting them into the room to discuss a future move back to central Cheliax.

Each creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:22|name:Lure to Ashes] save (creatures outside of area B18 gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this save). On a failure, the creature is compelled to move into area B18 and be seated on one of the sofas.

Creatures who succeed at the save aren't compelled and see the room as the burnt ruin that it is. The haunt then rolls initiative.

fr.name: Attirer
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature se déplace de plus de 1,50 mètre dans la pièce.

Effet Toutes les créatures dans la zone B18 et toutes les créatures à 3 mètres d'une porte ouverte ou d'une fenêtre adjacente à la zone B18 entendent une voix captivante les invitant à entrer dans la pièce pour discuter d'un futur déménagement vers le centre du Chéliax.

Chaque créature dans la zone d'effet doit tenter un jet de @Check[will|dc:22|name:Attirer dans les cendres] (les créatures en dehors de la zone B18 obtiennent un bonus de circonstances de +2 à ce jet). En cas d'échec, la créature est contrainte de se déplacer dans la zone B18 et de s'asseoir dans le sofa.

Les créatures qui ont réussi leur jet de sauvegarde ne sont pas contraintes et voient la zone comme elle est réellement : une pièce en ruine. Puis la hantise lance l'initiative.

zh.name: 引诱 Lure
zh.description:
触发 一个生物进入房间超过5尺

效果 B18区的所有生物，以及与B18区域相邻的敞开的门或窗户10尺内所有生物听到一个很有吸引力的声音，邀请他们进入房间，讨论未来搬回切利亚斯中心。

每个生物都必须尝试@Check[will|dc:22|name:Lure to Ashes]豁免（B18区外的生物在此豁免中获得+2环境加值）。如果失败，该生物将被强迫进入B18区并坐在其中一个沙发上。

豁免成功的生物不会被吸引过去，而且能看到房间的被烧毁的本来面貌。然后，作祟骰先攻。

fr.name: Attiré dans les cendres
fr.description: La scène illusoire d'un bureau meublé recouvre l'apparence réelle de la pièce. Elle vacille et s'estompe, révélant une chambre brûlée et calcinée. Un instant plus tard, les cris des victimes brûlées emplissent la pièce, et des bras squelettiques enflammés sortent des cendres et des murs carbonisés pour gratter et griffer.
fr.disable: Test d'@Check[intimidation|dc:26|name:Faire taire les fantômes|traits:action:coerce] pour ordonner aux fantômes qui hantent cette chambre de se taire ou de @Check[religion|dc:23|name:Exorciser la hantise] pour exorciser la hantise
fr.reset: 8 heures ; Détruire les oschevêtrés dans la zone E3 détruit cette hantise pour toujours.
fr.routine:
1 Action : si il n'y a plus de cible dans la zone B18 lorsque la hantise prend son tour, elle ne peut utiliser sa réaction Attirer pour essayer de ramener ses victimes à proximité à l'intérieur. La hantise manifeste plusieurs bras squelettiques qui sortent du sol délabré ou du mur portant les stigmates de brulûres pour essayer de griffer les créatures dans la zone B8. Ces créatures doivent tenter un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:22|name:Attiré dans les cendres brûlantes|traits:damaging-effect,fire,necromancy,occult] (les créatures assises dans le sofa subissent une pénalité de circonstances de -2 au jet de sauvegarde).

Succès critique La créature ne subit aucun dégât.

Succès La créature subit @Damage[1d8[fire]]{1d8 dégâts de feu}.

Échec La créature subit @Damage[2d8[fire]]{2d8 dégâts de feu} et obtient une faiblesse 5 contre le feu. Cette faiblesse persiste jusqu'à ce que la créature soit totalement guérie.

Échec critique Comme en cas d'échec, mais la créature subit @Damage[4d8[fire]]{4d8 dégâts de feu} et une faiblesse 10 contre le feu.

zh.name: 诱入灰烬 Lured to Ashes
zh.description: 一个带家具的书房的虚幻场景覆盖了房间的实际外观。它闪烁着、消逝着，显示出一个被烧焦的房间。片刻之后，燃烧着的受害者的尖叫声充斥着整个房间，炽热的骷髅手臂从灰烬和烧焦的墙壁中伸出来刮擦和抓挠。
zh.disable: @Check[intimidation|dc:26|name:Silence the Spirits|traits:action:coerce]检定来命令徘徊在这个房间里的灵魂安静下来，或者@Check[religion|dc:23|name:Exorcise the Haunt]检定来驱除作祟。
zh.reset: 8小时；摧毁E3区域的缠结骨堆，将永远摧毁此作祟。
zh.routine:
1个动作；如果作祟行动时，B18区内没有目标，它可以用引诱反应动作尝试让附近的受害者进来。作祟显出几只燃烧的骷髅手臂，从废墟地板上或烧焦的墙壁中伸出来，向B18区的每个生物抓去。这些生物必须尝试@Check[reflex|dc:22|name:Lured to Ashes Fire|traits:damaging-effect,fire,necromancy,occult]反射豁免（坐在沙发上的生物在此豁免上有-2 环境减值）。

大成功 该生物没有受到伤害。

成功 该生物受到@Damage[1d8[fire]]伤害。

失败 该生物受到@Damage[2d8[fire]]伤害并获得火焰弱点5。这个弱点一直持续到该生物被完全治愈。

大失败 和失败一样，但受到@Damage[4d8[fire]]伤害并且获得10火焰弱点。

Critical Failure As failure, but @Damage[4d8[fire]] damage and weakness 10 to fire.

name: Lyzerium Bottles
description: Five tiny glass bottles, each full of volatile green liquid, are discretely positioned around the room. Each bottle explodes when its glass is broken.
disable: Interact action to pick up one of the five bottles.
publication: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg

actions.name: Explode
actions.description:
Trigger A creature steps on the bottle or the bottle becomes broken

Effect The bottle explodes, dealing @Damage[2d8[fire],2[persistent,fire],(2[splash])[fire]]{2d8 fire damage plus 2 persistent fire damage and 2 fire splash damage} to each creature sharing its square (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic|traits:hazard,mechanical,trap]).

fr.name: Explosion de lyzérium
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature marche sur la bouteille ou la bouteille se casse.

Effet La bouteille explose, infligeant @Damage[2d8[fire],2[persistent,fire],(2[splash])[fire]]{2d8 dégâts de feu, 2 dégâts de feu persistants plus 2 dégâts d'éclaboussure} à chaque créature partageant sa case (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic|traits:hazard,mechanical,trap]).

zh.name: 爆炸 Explode
zh.description:
触发 一个生物踩上玻璃瓶或玻璃瓶破损

效果 玻璃瓶破损，对所在空间内的所有生物造成@Damage[2d8[fire],2[persistent,fire],(2[splash])[fire]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic|traits:hazard,mechanical,trap]豁免）。

fr.name: Bouteilles de lyzérium
fr.description: Cinq petites bouteilles en verre, chacune remplie d'un liquide vert volatile, sont discrètement posées dans la pièce. Chaque bouteille explose lorsque le verre est cassé.
fr.disable: action Interagir pour soulever une de ces cinq bouteilles.

zh.name: 利泽元素瓶 Lyzerium Bottles
zh.description: 5个装满易挥发绿色液体的玻璃瓶，分散在散落在房间各处，每个玻璃瓶只要碎了就会爆炸。
zh.disable: 交互动作捡起五个瓶子中的一个。

pl.name: Lyzerium Bottles
pl.description: Five tiny glass bottles, each full of volatile green liquid, are discretely positioned around the room. Each bottle explodes when its glass is broken.
pl.disable: Interact action to pick up one of the five bottles.

name: Maggot Pit
description: Countless human-faced, fanged maggots wriggle and squirm in this chamber.
disable: Three @Check[religion|dc:45] checks within the room to utter prayers, which calm and quell the maggots with invocations to the gods
reset: The pit functions continuously. If it's disabled or destroyed, it resets automatically after 24 hours if the crystal stele in area M2 still functions, otherwise it doesn't reset.
routine: (2 actions; death, divine, necromancy) On its initiative, the pit uses its first action to use Damning Swarm against any creature within 5 feet of the pit floor. It then takes its second action to form a long, thrashing tendril composed of thousands of maggots to lash at a single target within area M1.
stealth: (the maggots are slow and impossible to miss)

actions.name: Damning Swarm
actions.description:
Trigger a creature appears in area M1

Effect The swarming maggots squirm into a biting frenzy, and all creatures on the ground in area M1 must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:40|traits:damaging-effect] save. The hazard then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[(1d10+5)[piercing]] damage, @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(2d10+10)[piercing]] damage, @Damage[6d6[poison]] damage, is sickened 1, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} by the maggots' bites.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[(4d10+20)[piercing]] damage, @Damage[12d6[poison]] damage, is sickened 1, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} by the maggots' bites.

pl.name: Maggot Pit
pl.description: Countless human-faced, fanged maggots wriggle and squirm in this chamber.
pl.disable: Three @Check[religion|dc:45] checks within the room to utter prayers, which calm and quell the maggots with invocations to the gods
pl.reset: The pit functions continuously. If it's disabled or destroyed, it resets automatically after 24 hours if the crystal stele in area M2 still functions, otherwise it doesn't reset.
pl.routine: (2 actions; death, divine, necromancy) On its initiative, the pit uses its first action to use Damning Swarm against any creature within 5 feet of the pit floor. It then takes its second action to form a long, thrashing tendril composed of thousands of maggots to lash at a single target within area M1.
pl.stealth: (the maggots are slow and impossible to miss)

name: Magic Starknives Trap
description: Starknife symbols on the six pillars glow and shoot across the room.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:21|traits:action:disable-a-device] (expert) or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} on any four of the six pillars disables the entire trap (the trap is a 2nd-rank spell and the DC to dispel it is 21). Destroying any four of the six pillars also disables the trap.
reset: The trap deactivates 1 round after it has no target creatures and resets each day at sundown.
routine: (3 actions) For each of its actions on its turn, a carving on a different pillar glows and makes a magical starknife Ranged Strike against a random creature within range. Creatures might have cover from this Strike, such as from one of the pillars in the room.
stealth: to spot the magical energies reverberating in the pillars

actions.name: Starknife Attack
actions.description: If a creature passes the middle pair of pillars, both doors leading out of the room slam shut and lock; while the trap is active, the doors must be battered open with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:23|name:Batter Open Door|traits:action:force-open] check or sufficient damage (Hardness 12; HP 48 [BT 24]). One of the starknife carvings glows with light, detaches from the pillar, and then flies outward, making a magical starknife Ranged Strike against a random creature within range. The trap then rolls initiative with its Stealth modifier of +12

fr.name: Attaque de lamétoile
fr.description: Si une créature passe entre les deux piliers du centre, les deux portes se ferment et se verrouillent ; tant que le piège est actif, les portes doivent être ouvertes de force grâce à un test d'@Check[athletics|dc:23|name:Défoncer la porte|traits:action:force-open] ou suffisamment de dégâts (Solidité 12, PV 48 [SR 24]). L'une des gravures de lamétoile brille, se détache du pilier puis vole en effectuant une Frappe à distance de lamétoile magique contre une créature à portée choisie aléatoirement. Le piège fait ensuite un jet d'initiative avec son modificateur de Discrétion de +12.

zh.name: 星刃攻击 Starknife Attack
zh.description: 如果生物通过中间那对石柱，房间的所有出口会猛然关闭并上锁；在陷阱启动期间，门必须由一次成功的@Check[athletics|dc:23|name:Batter Open Door|traits:action:force-open]检定来强行打开，或通过足够的伤害来破坏它（硬度 12; HP 48 [BT 24]）。柱子上的一枚星刃符号发出光芒，并从柱子射向房间中央，对射程里的一个随机生物进行一次远程打击。然后陷阱以隐秘调整值+12进行先攻检定。

fr.name: Piège de lamétoiles magiques
fr.description: Les gravures de lamétoiles sur les six piliers luisent et sont projetées à travers la pièce.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:21|traits:action:disable-a-device] (expert) ou @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dissipation de la magie} sur quatre piliers pour désamorcer le piège entier (le piège est un sort de rang 2 et le DD pour le dissiper est de 21). Détruire quatre des piliers désamorce également le piège.
fr.reset: Le piège se désactive 1 round après qu'il n'a plus de créatures à cibler et se réinitialise chaque jour au coucher du soleil.
fr.routine: (3 actions). Pour chacune de ses actions pendant son tour, une gravure d'un pilier différent brille et fait une Frappe à distance de lamétoile magique contre une créature à portée choisie aléatoirement. Les créatures peuvent bénéficier d'un abri contre cette Frappe, en se cachant derrière un pilier par exemple.
fr.stealth: Pour remarquer les énergies magiques présentes dans les piliers

zh.name: 魔法星刃陷阱 Magic Starknives Trap
zh.description: 六根柱子上的星刃符号发出光芒并向房间内发射。
zh.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:21|traits:action:disable-a-device]（专家）或对六根柱子中的任意四根施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法 Dispel Magic}（陷阱是一个2环级法术，解除DC 21）破坏六根柱子中任意四根也能使陷阱失效。
zh.reset: 如果房间里没有触发生物，则一轮后陷阱会关闭，然后在每天日落时重置。
zh.routine: （3个动作）在它回合中的每个动作中，每个不同的柱子上的符号都会发光，然后用魔法星刃对范围内的随机生物进行一次远程打击。生物在面对此打击时可能会拥有掩蔽，例如生物可以躲在其中一根柱子后面。
zh.stealth: 能发现柱子中蕴含的魔法能量

pl.name: Magiczna Pułapka z Gwiezdnymi Nożami
pl.description: Symbole gwiezdnych noży na sześciu filarach świecą i wystrzeliwują w powietrze po całym pomieszczeniu.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:21|traits:action:disable-a-device] (ekspert) lub @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Rozproszenie Magii} na dowolnych czterech z sześciu filarów wyłącza całą pułapkę (pułapka jest zaklęciem 2. rangi, a ST do jej rozproszenia wynosi 21). Zniszczenie dowolnych czterech z sześciu filarów również wyłącza pułapkę.
pl.reset: Pułapka dezaktywuje się 1 rundę po tym, jak nie ma w niej docelowych stworzeń i resetuje się każdego dnia o zachodzie słońca.
pl.routine: (3 akcje) Za każdą ze swoich akcji w swojej turze, rzeźba na innym filarze świeci się i wykonuje magiczny atak dystansowy gwiezdnym nożem przeciwko losowej istocie w zasięgu. Stworzenia mogą być osłonięte przed tym atakiem, np. przez jeden z filarów w pomieszczeniu.
pl.stealth: aby dostrzec magiczne energie rozbrzmiewające w filarach

name: Major Fireball Rune
description: An invisible rune creates an invisible, spherical magical sensor with a 20-foot radius.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:28] (expert) to erase the rune without triggering the sensor, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (5th rank; counteract DC 26) to counteract the rune
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-09: Killer in the Golden Mask

actions.name: Fireball
actions.description:
Trigger A living creature enters the sensor area

Effect The rune detonates a fireball centered on the triggering creature's square. This is a 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball} spell that deals @Damage[10d6[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic]).

fr.name: Boule de feu
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature vivante pénètre dans la zone du capteur.

Effet La rune déclenche une @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Boule de feu} de rang 5 centrée sur la case occupée par la créature qui déclenche le piège. Cette boule de feu inflige @Damage[10d6[fire]]{10d6 dégâts de feu} (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic]).

zh.name: Fireball
zh.description:
Trigger A living creature enters the sensor area

Effect The rune detonates a fireball centered on the triggering creature's square. This is a 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball} spell that deals @Damage[10d6[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic]).

fr.name: Rune de boule de feu majeure
fr.description: Une rune invisible crée un capteur magique sphérique et invisible dans un rayon de 6 mètres.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:28|name:Effacement de la rune] (expert) pour effacer la rune sans déclencher le capteur ou @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dissipation de la magie} (contrer : Rang 5 ; DD 26) pour contrer la rune

pl.name: Potężniejsza Runa Ognistej Kuli
pl.description: Niewidzialna runa tworzy niewidzialny, sferyczny czujnik magiczny o promieniu 20 stóp.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:28] (expert) to erase the rune without triggering the sensor, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (5th rank; counteract DC 26) to counteract the rune

name: Major Unstable Furniture Archway
description: This unsteady pile of furniture is piled to the top of this usually high-ceilinged room. There looks to be some space to squeeze through to the other side, but even the slightest touch causes the stack to destabilize, and there's so much that once it begins to fall, it's difficult to stop.
disable: @Check[athletics|dc:25] to knock the pile over in a safe direction or @Check[thievery|dc:23] (trained) to carefully rearrange the furniture to a more stable configuration.
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-13: All That Glitters
routine: On its initiative, the pile expands into an adjacent space, dealing creatures in that space @Damage[(2d8+5)[bludgeoning]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save, pushing them into an adjacent empty space, and making that space impassable until cleared. If no adjacent empty space is available, the pile buries the creature, suffocating it. Clearing a space or pulling a creature out requires a @Check[athletics|dc:18] check.

actions.name: Tumbling Down
actions.description:
Trigger A creature moves into a space adjacent to the furniture pile

Effect Part of the pile slides into a space the creature occupies, causing @Damage[(2d8+5)[bludgeoning]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save. The furniture pile rolls initiative.

fr.name: S'écrouler
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature se déplace dans un espace adjacent à la pile de meubles

Effet Une partie de la pile glisse dans l'espace occupé par la créature, infligeant @Damage[(2d8+5)[bludgeoning]]{2d8+5 dégâts contondants} (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic]). La pile de meubles lance son initiative.

fr.name: Arcade de meubles instable majeure
fr.description: Cet amas instable de meubles s'élève jusqu'au plafond de cette pièce normalement spacieuse. On distingue un espace permettant de se faufiler jusqu'à l'autre côté, mais le moindre contact risque de déstabiliser la pile. La quantité est telle qu'une fois la chute amorcée, il devient difficile de l'arrêter.
fr.disable: @Check[athletics|dc:25] pour renverser la pile dans une direction sûre ou @Check[thievery|dc:23] (qualifié) pour réarranger prudemment les meubles en une configuration plus stable.
fr.routine: À son initiative, la pile s'étend dans un espace adjacent, infligeant @Damage[(2d8+5)[bludgeoning]]{2d8+5 dégâts contondants} aux créatures dans cette zone (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic]), les repoussant vers un espace vide adjacent, et rendant la zone impraticable jusqu'à ce qu'elle soit dégagée. Si aucun espace adjacent n'est disponible, la pile ensevelit la créature, l'étouffant. Dégager une zone ou extraire une créature nécessite un test d'@Check[athletics|dc:18].

pl.name: Major Unstable Furniture Archway
pl.description: This unsteady pile of furniture is piled to the top of this usually high-ceilinged room. There looks to be some space to squeeze through to the other side, but even the slightest touch causes the stack to destabilize, and there's so much that once it begins to fall, it's difficult to stop.
pl.disable: @Check[athletics|dc:25] to knock the pile over in a safe direction or @Check[thievery|dc:23] (trained) to carefully rearrange the furniture to a more stable configuration.
pl.routine: On its initiative, the pile expands into an adjacent space, dealing creatures in that space @Damage[(2d8+5)[bludgeoning]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save, pushing them into an adjacent empty space, and making that space impassable until cleared. If no adjacent empty space is available, the pile buries the creature, suffocating it. Clearing a space or pulling a creature out requires a @Check[athletics|dc:18] check.

name: Malevolent Mannequins
description: A host of violent spirits possess three clockwork mannequins, and each lashes out at any creatures that dare walk near.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:37|name:Jam a mannequin's clockwork mechanisms|traits:clockwork,haunt,mechanical,hazard]{Thievery (master)} to jam a mannequin's clockwork mechanisms or a @Check[religion|dc:35|name:Exorcise a spirit from a mannequin|traits:clockwork,haunt,mechanical,hazard]{Religion (expert)} twice to exorcise a spirit from a mannequin.
reset: The haunt deactivates after it has no target creatures and resets, usually over the course of 1 round, as the mannequins move to their original positions. If a mannequin is more than 150 feet from its original position, the haunt takes longer to reset, as the mannequin moves back 150 feet each round.
routine: (9 actions) Each of the mannequins uses three of the haunt's actions on each turn, and the haunt loses three actions each turn for every disabled or destroyed mannequin. Each mannequin uses its first action to Stride up to 50 feet and its remaining two actions to make clockwork fist Strikes. Each has its own separate multiple attack penalty.

actions.name: Awaken
actions.description:
Trigger A creature comes within 30 feet of a mannequin

Effect The mannequins all lurch towards the triggering creature, Striding up to 50 feet, then roll initiative.

fr.name: Éveil
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature s'approche à moins de 9 mètres d'un mannequin

Effet Les mannequins se jettent vers la créature déclencheuse, Marchent rapidement jusqu'à 15 mètres, puis roulent leur initiative.

zh.name: 唤醒 Awaken
zh.description:
触发 一个生物接近到模特30尺范围内；

效果 所有发条模特都蹒跚着走向触发的生物，行走最多50尺远，然后作祟进行先攻检定。

fr.name: Mannequins malveillants
fr.description: Une foule d'esprits violents a pris possession de trois mannequins mécaniques et chacun d'entre eux s'en prend à toute créature qui ose s'approcher.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:37|name:Gripper le mécanisme d'un mannequin|traits:clockwork,haunt,mechanical,hazard](maître) pour gripper les mécanismes d'un mannequin ou test de @Check[religion|dc:35|name:Exorciser un esprit d'un mannequin|traits:clockwork,haunt,mechanical,hazard] (expert) deux fois pour exorciser un esprit d'un mannequin.
fr.reset: L'apparitition se désactive lorsqu'il n'y a plus de créatures cibles et se remet en position, habituellement en 1 round, le temps que les mannequins reviennent à leurs positions originelles. Si un mannequin est à plus de 45 mètres de sa position originelle, il faut plus longtemps à l'apparitition pour se réinitialiser, le temps que le mannequin recule de 45 mètres à chaque round.
fr.routine: (9 actions) Chacun des mannequins utilise trois des actions de la hantise à chaque tour et la hantise perd trois actions à chaque tour pour chaque mannequin désamorcé ou détruit. Chaque mannequin utilise sa première action pour Marcher rapidement de 15 mètres et ses actions suivantes pour faire deux Frappes de poing macaniques. Chacun d'eux possède ses propres pénalités d'attaques multiples.

zh.name: 怨毒模特 Malevolent Mannequins
zh.description: 一大群狂暴的幽灵占据了三个发条模特，每一个都会攻击任何胆敢靠近的生物。
zh.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:37|name:Jam a mannequin's clockwork mechanisms|traits:clockwork,haunt,mechanical,hazard]{贼活（大师）}阻塞其中一个模特的发条装置；或@Check[religion|dc:35|name:Exorcise a spirit from a mannequin|traits:clockwork,haunt,mechanical,hazard]{宗教（专家）}两次超度其中一个模特身上的幽灵。
zh.reset: 作祟失去目标生物后会失效，然后进行重置，这通常需要花费1轮时间，因为模特需要移动回初始地点。如果模特离初始地点超过150尺远，作祟需要更长时间来重置，因为模特每轮只能移动150尺。
zh.routine: （9个动作） 在作祟的每个回合中，每一个模特都能使用3个动作，每有一个模特被解除或摧毁，作祟在每个回合中都失去3个动作。每个模特的都会用第一个动作行走最多50尺远，然后用剩下两个动作进行发条拳打击。每个模特的多重攻击减值都单独计算。

pl.name: Złośliwe Manekiny
pl.description: Zastępy brutalnych duchów opętują trzy manekiny, każdy z nich rzuca się na wszystkie istoty, które ośmielą się podejść w ich pobliże.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:37|name:Zacięcie mechanizmów manekina|traits:clockwork,haunt,mechanical,hazard]{Złodziejstwo (mistrz)}, aby zablokować mechanizmy manekina lub @Check[religion|dc:35|name:Egzorcyzmowanie ducha z manekina|traits:clockwork,haunt,mechanical,hazard]{Religia (ekspert)} dwa razy, aby wyegzorcyzmować ducha z manekina.
pl.reset: Nawiedzenie dezaktywuje się, gdy nie ma już docelowych stworzeń i resetuje się, zwykle w ciągu 1 rundy, gdy manekiny przesuwają się do swoich pierwotnych pozycji. Jeśli manekin znajduje się w odległości większej niż 150 stóp od swojej pierwotnej pozycji, resetowanie nawiedzenia trwa dłużej, ponieważ manekin cofa się o 150 stóp co rundę.
pl.routine: (9 akcji) Każdy z manekinów wykorzystuje trzy akcje straszydła w każdej turze, a straszydło traci trzy akcje w każdej turze za każdego unieruchomionego lub zniszczonego manekina. Każdy manekin wykorzystuje swoją pierwszą akcję do Biegu na odległość do 50 stóp, a pozostałe dwie akcje do wykonania Ataku pięścią. Każdy z nich ma własną karę za wielokrotny atak.

name: Malevolent Reflections
description: Ornate full-length mirrors with fiendish filigree depict the image of Fasiel ibn Sazadin in villainous triumph over his enemies.
disable: @Check[stealth|dc:27] (trained) to approach a mirror without showing up in the reflection, followed by @Check[thievery|dc:25] to cover mirror or dispel magic (3nd level; counteract DC 25) to counteract the binding
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains

actions.name: Release Rakshasa
actions.description:
Trigger The mirror breaks

Effect The mirror releases a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.hNR4xZRsxUkGPI1v]{Dandasuka} rakshasa. The raktavarna rolls initiative and remains for 3 rounds, after which the spell ends and the rakshasa disappears. The summoned raktavarna can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.

fr.name: Relâcher le Rakshasa
fr.description:
Déclencheur Le miroir se brise.

Effet Le miroir convoque un rakshasa @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.hNR4xZRsxUkGPI1v]{Dandasuka}. Le dandasuka lance l'initiative et se bat pendant 3 rounds, après quoi le sort se termine et le rakshasa disparaît. Le dandasuka utilise 3 actions à chaque tour et peut utiliser des réactions (contrairement à la plupart des créatures convoquées)

zh.name: Release Rakshasa
zh.description:
Trigger The mirror breaks

Effect The mirror releases a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.hNR4xZRsxUkGPI1v]{Dandasuka} rakshasa. The raktavarna rolls initiative and remains for 3 rounds, after which the spell ends and the rakshasa disappears. The summoned raktavarna can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.

actions.name: Fiend's Luck
actions.description:
Trigger Fasiel is within 100 feet, this is the closest intact wicked reflections hazard, and a hostile creature's action would cause Fasiel to gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, controlled, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, petrified, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, slowed, stunned, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} condition or would deal 20+ damage to Fasiel

Effect The mirror breaks and disrupts the action.

fr.name: Chance du fiélon
fr.description:
Déclencheur Fasiel se tient à 30 mètres d'un miroir à la réflection dangereuse, et l'action d'une créature hostile lui ferait subir un des états suivants : @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Aveuglé}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confus}, Contôlé, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fasciné}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilisé}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralysé}, Pétrifié, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Entravé}, Ralenti, Étourdi, ou @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Inconscient} ; ou la créature hostile lui infligerait 20+ dégâts

Effet Le miroir se brise et interromp l'action.

zh.name: Fiend's Luck
zh.description:
Trigger Fasiel is within 100 feet, this is the closest intact wicked reflections hazard, and a hostile creature's action would cause Fasiel to gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, controlled, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, petrified, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, slowed, stunned, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} condition or would deal 20+ damage to Fasiel

Effect The mirror breaks and disrupts the action.

fr.name: Réflections malveillantes
fr.description: Des miroirs en pied ornés de filigranes diaboliques représentent Fasiel ibn Sazadin triomphant de ses ennemis.
fr.disable: p>Test de @Check[stealth|dc:27] (qualifié) pour approcher le miroir sans s'y réfléter, suivit d'un test de [type:thievery|dc:25] pour recouvrir le miroir ou Dissipation de la magie (rang 3, contre DD 25) pour contrer le lien.

zh.name: Malevolent Reflections
zh.description: Ornate full-length mirrors with fiendish filigree depict the image of Fasiel ibn Sazadin in villainous triumph over his enemies.
zh.disable: @Check[stealth|dc:27] (trained) to approach a mirror without showing up in the reflection, followed by @Check[thievery|dc:25] to cover mirror or dispel magic (3nd level; counteract DC 25) to counteract the binding

name: Malfunctioning Annihilator
description:
A gargantuan scorpion-like robot, covered in signs of damage, has been bolted into the canyon's rock walls.

Integrated Chain Gun Hardness 10, HP 50 (BT 25) per integrated chain gun

Plasma Lance Hardness 10, Plasma Lance HP 26 (BT 13)
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:26] (expert) to successfully disable the annihilator at the control box on the northwest ledge, @Check[thievery|dc:23] (trained) or @Check[engineering-lore|dc:18] to jam the mechanics of either of the two chain guns, or the "tail" mechanism where the plasma lance is mounted, preventing it from firing. Jamming the guns or tail require first getting on top of the immobilized annihilator, which counts as difficult terrain. All attempts take 2 actions.
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-24: Lightning Strikes, Stars Fall
routine: (2 actions) When the plasma lance is ready, the annihilator uses it to attack as many PCs as it can, otherwise it attacks with its two integrated chain guns while the plasma lance recharges, spending one action for each chain gun that is still functional. This trap doesn't take a multiple attack penalty. If Synthetic Khismar is destroyed, the annihilator attacks as many creatures as possible.
stealth: (trained) to notice it's still functional; noticing the annihilator is automatic

actions.name: Plasma Lance
actions.description:
The scorpion-like tail of the annihilator projects a @Template[line|distance:80] of burning plasma.

Creatures in the area take @Damage[6d6[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic]). The annihilator can't use the plasma lance again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Plasma Lance]]{1d4 rounds}.

fr.name: Lance à plasma
fr.description:
La queue en forme de scorpion de l'Exterminateur projette du plasma brûlant sur une @Template[line|distance:80]{ligne de 24 mètres}.

Les créatures dans la zone subissent @Damage[6d6[fire]]{6d6 dégâts de feu} (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic]). L'Exterminateur ne peut plus utiliser cette capacité pendant [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharger de la Lance à plasma]]{1d4 rounds}.

zh.name: Plasma Lance
zh.description:
The scorpion-like tail of the annihilator projects a @Template[line|distance:80] of burning plasma.

Creatures in the area take @Damage[6d6[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic]). The annihilator can't use the plasma lance again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Plasma Lance]]{1d4 rounds}.

fr.name: Exterminateur dysfonctionnel
fr.description:
Un robot en forme de scorpion, couvert de signes de dégâts, a été a été boulonné dans les parois rocheuses du canyon.

Canon à chaîne intégré Solidité 10, PV 50 (SR 25) par canon à chaîne intégré

Lance à plasma Solidité 10, Lance plasma PV 26 (SR 13)
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:26] (expert) pour réussir à désactiver l'Exterminateur au niveau de la boîte de contrôle sur la corniche nord-ouest, @Check[thievery|dc:23] (qualifié) ou @Check[engineering-lore|dc:18] pour bloquer les mécanismes de l'un des deux canons à chaîne, ou le mécanisme de la « queue » où la Lance à plasma est montée, l'empêchant ainsi de tirer. Pour bloquer les canons ou la queue, il faut d'abord monter sur l'Exterminateur immobilisé, ce qui est considéré comme un terrain difficile. Toutes les tentatives prennent 2 actions.
fr.routine: (2 actions) Lorsque la lance à plasma est prête, l'Exterminateur l'utilise pour attaquer autant de PJ qu'il le peut, sinon il attaque avec ses deux canons à chaîne intégrés pendant que la lance à plasma se recharge, en dépensant une action pour chaque canon à chaîne encore fonctionnel. Ce piège ne subit pas de pénalité pour attaque multiple. Si Synthetic Khismar est détruit, l'Exterminateur attaque autant de créatures que possible.
fr.stealth: Qualifié pour remarquer qu'il est toujours fonctionnel ; remarquer l'Exterminateur est automatique

name: Malfunctioning Perfumery (Eastern)
description: The magically and mechanically automated tools Sorshen used to aid in the crafting of perfume on the long, eastern workbench have interacted in unexpected ways, transforming the workshop into a dangerous peril.
disable: @Check[crafting|dc:52] (legendary) to quickly introduce neutralizing agents into the alchemical machinery, @Check[thievery|dc:55] (master) to disable the mechanized portions of the devices, or @Check[arcana|dc:55] (master) to counteract magical elements; four total successes are required to disable the hazard (destroying one of the four workbenches counts as one success)
routine:
(5 actions) On its initiative, the malfunctioning perfumery takes the following five actions, in order. For each success at disabling it, the hazard loses one action. The targets for actions 2–5 are randomly chosen from creatures in the room, with no one creature being targeted more than once before all other creatures in the room have been targeted. For example, a party of 4 PCs will each be targeted by one of these actions. If just a single PC is in the room, they will be targeted by all four.

  • 1: Crushing Notes 1 (olfactory, poison) The malfunctioning machinery exudes a blast of concentrated and overwhelming perfume notes into area B11. Creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:15|traits:olfactory,poison] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} on a critical failure).
  • 2: Nozzle Spray 1 (poison) Nozzles built into the machinery extend out to spray toxic, overwhelmingly cloying perfume in multiple directions. One randomly determined target in area B11 takes @Damage[14d6[poison]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:45|basic|traits:poison] save).
  • 3: Sillage 1 (emotion, mental) A larger, more intimidating nozzle than the one utilized in the previous action extends forward and violently sprays a staggering array of different scents at a random target in the room. The overwhelming mixture of lingering scent (the perfume's sillage) causes the creature to take @Damage[10d6[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:45|basic|traits:emotion,mental] save); on a failed save, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round by the overwhelming scents.
  • 4: Oil Spill 1 (fire) Sparks from grinding machinery ignite a patch of spilled oil somewhere in the room—a random creature in area B11 takes @Damage[10d6[fire],4d6[persistent,fire]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:45|basic|traits:fire] save).
  • 5: Boiling Beaker 1 (emotion, mental) A pressurized beaker containing boiling fluids springs a leak, and a dislodged tube sprays disorienting, psychotropic fumes at a random creature in the room, who must then succeed at a @Check[will|dc:44|traits:emotion,mental] save to avoid becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round (1 minute on a critical failure).

actions.name: Pungent Cloud
actions.description:
Trigger The door to area B11 is opened or a creature enters the area, or any open flame is brought into area B11

Effect The musky fog filling the perfume laboratory billows out into the hall, spreading 5 feet from the doorway and expanding by another 5 feet each round the door remains open. All creatures within the fog become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the fog become concealed to creatures within it. Creatures in the fog must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:45|traits:poison|options:area-effect,inflicts:sickened] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure); this is a poison effect. If the pungent cloud was triggered by open flame, chemicals in the air ignite into a flash of fire, dealing @Damage[6d6[fire],6d6[poison]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in the area (@Check[reflex|dc:45|basic|options:area-effect] save), after which the pungent cloud disperses. The hazard then rolls initiative.

zh.name: 刺鼻浓雾 Pungent Cloud
zh.description:
触发 区域 B11 的门被打开，或有生物进入该区域，或任何明火被带入区域 B11

效果 弥漫在香水实验室的麝香味雾气翻涌着涌入走廊，从门口扩散5尺，且门每多开一轮，雾气就再向外扩散5尺。雾气中的所有生物都处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽 Concealed} 状态，且雾气外的所有生物对雾气内的生物而言也处于隐蔽状态。雾气中的生物必须成功通过 @Check[fortitude|dc:45|traits:poison|options:area-effect,inflicts:sickened] 豁免，否则会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 1} （大失败则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 2} ）；这是一个毒素效果。如果刺鼻浓雾是由明火触发的，空气中的化学物质会燃烧成一片烈焰，对该区域内的所有生物造成 @Damage[6d6[fire],6d6[poison]|options:area-damage] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:45|basic|options:area-effect] 豁免），之后刺鼻浓雾消散。然后，该危害骰先攻。

zh.name: 故障香水工坊 Malfunctioning Perfumery(东侧)

  • 5: Boiling Beaker 1 (emotion, mental) A pressurized beaker containing boiling fluids springs a leak, and a dislodged tube sprays disorienting, psychotropic fumes at a random creature in the room, who must then succeed at a @Check[will|dc:44|traits:emotion,mental] save to avoid becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round (1 minute on a critical failure).

name: Malfunctioning Tidal Controls
description: Sigils carved into the turquoise sphere atop the altar illuminate. Moments later, a rush of water flows into the hallway.
disable: @Check[nature|dc:20] (trained) to neutralize the tidal magic, or @Check[survival|dc:23] to predict the changing tides, or @Check[thievery|dc:23] (trained) to scratch away the sigils; two total successes are required to disable the trap.
publication: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
routine:
(1 action) The magic controlling the tides malfunctions, causing the tides to change every few seconds. Water flows rapidly between areas B2 and B4. Each creature in area B2, area B4, or the hallway connecting them must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:20|traits:damaging-effect] save as the shifting tides buffet them, dealing @Damage[2d8[bludgeoning]] damage.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is moved 10 feet along with the water.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is moved 20 feet along with the water.

Effect The hazard rolls initiative as water rushes down the hallway. Area B4 becomes flooded with 15 feet of water.

Effet Le danger lance l'initiative alors que l'eau se précipite dans le couloir. La zone B4 se retrouve inondée avec 4,50 mètres d'eau.

Succès critique La créature ne subit aucun dégât.

name: Malicious Spirits
description: A cadre of evil spirits assails people's minds throughout the stretch of forest. The spirits first afflict their hosts with visceral images of their own deaths, then try to recreate their deaths by forcing their hosts to inflict similar wounds upon themselves. Creatures frightened by the haunt appear to have ephemeral masks with horns, tusks, and yellow eyes over their faces.
disable: Two @Check[occultism|dc:23|name:Exorcise the Haunt|traits:hazard,haunt,complex] or @Check[religion|dc:23|name:Exorcise the Haunt|traits:hazard,haunt,complex] (trained) to exorcise the spirits. A creature can either inflict 4 mental damage to the haunt or permanently lower the DC of checks to exorcise the spirits 1 by succeeding at a @Check[diplomacy|dc:20|name:Calm the Spirits|traits:hazard,haunt,complex] check to calm the spirits, a @Check[nature|dc:20|name:Ward Against the Spirits|traits:hazard,haunt,complex] check to use kami-specific warding incantations, a @Check[occultism|dc:20|name:Leverage Haunt Lore|traits:hazard,haunt,complex] check to leverage obscure haunt lore, or a @Check[religion|dc:20|name:Lesser Exorcism to Weaken the Haunt|traits:hazard,haunt,complex] check to use a lesser exorcism. Any creature currently frightened by the haunt is a potential target for inflicting damage to the haunt; mental and vitality damage only affect such a host creature if they choose to be affected, while force or similar damage harms both the haunt and the host equally.
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-06: Lost on the Spirit Road
routine:
(3 actions) On its initiative, the haunt uses its first two actions to attempt to terrify a random target in its area that is not already @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}. The target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:20|name:Resist Terror|traits:emotion,fear,mental,hazard,haunt] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune to this haunt for 24 hours.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is frightened 1. The value of the frightened condition does not automatically decrease by 1 at the end of each of the target's turns. Instead, the target can attempt a @Check[will|dc:18|name:Reduce Frightened|traits:emotion,fear,mental,hazard,haunt] save at the end of each of their turns to remove the condition.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. The value of the frightened condition does not automatically decrease by 1 at the end of each of the target's turns. Instead, the target can attempt a @Check[will|dc:18|name:Reduce Frightened|traits:emotion,fear,mental,hazard,haunt] save at the end of each of their turns to lower their frightened value by 1.

The haunt then spends an action to compels one of the creatures that it has frightened to harm itself with surrounding forest debris, its strength fueled by spirit possession. The creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:20|name:Resist Attacking Yourself|traits:emotion,fear,mental,hazard,haunt] save or attempt to Strike itself during its turn as its first action, using the haunt's statistics below. Note that frightened applies equally to the creature's attack roll and AC, and therefore does not affect the accuracy of the attack.

actions.name: Visions of Death
actions.description:
Trigger Three or more creatures enter the haunt's area

Effect Spectral faces appear, and the haunt rolls initiative.

fr.name: Visions de mort
fr.description:
Déclencheur Trois créatures ou plus pénètrent dans la zone de la hantise.

Effet Des visages fantomatiques apparaissent, puis la hantise lance l'initiative.

zh.name: 死亡幻象 Visions of Death
zh.description:
触发 三个或更多生物进入此区域；

效果 鬼面出现，精魂投掷先攻。
