name: Stinging Nettles
description: This bright green plant has long triangular leaves covered with fine hair-like stingers.
disable: @Check[survival|dc:17] to carefully navigate the plant and pull aside or cut away the nettles

actions.name: Sting
actions.description:
Trigger A creature touches the stinging nettles or moves through a square containing stinging nettles

Effect The triggering creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:17] save if they're walking through the square or a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] save if they touched the nettles.

Critical Success The creature avoids being stung by the plant's nettles.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} by the pain caused by brief contact with the nettles.

Failure The creature is sickened 1 by the pain caused by contact with the nettles and is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 8 hours from the lingering pain.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} by the pain caused by contact with the nettles and is also clumsy 1 for 24 hours from the lingering pain.

fr.name: Aiguillon
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature touche les orties piquante ou se déplace dans une case qui contient des orties

Effet La créature déclencheuse doit tenter un jet de @Check[fortitude|dc:17] si elle marche dans une case ou un jet de @Check[fortitude|dc:20] si elle a touché les orties.

Succès critique La créature réussit à.

Succès The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} by the pain caused by brief contact with the nettles.

Échec The creature is sickened 1 by the pain caused by contact with the nettles and is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 8 hours from the lingering pain.

Échec critique The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} by the pain caused by contact with the nettles and is also clumsy 1 for 24 hours from the lingering pain.

zh.name: 刺人 Sting
zh.description:
触发 有生物碰触带刺荨麻或者移动穿过生长着带刺荨麻的方格

效果 触发生物若不行穿过生长带刺荨麻的方格则必须尝试@Check[fortitude|dc:17]豁免，若直接碰触带刺荨麻则必须尝试@Check[fortitude|dc:20]豁免

大成功 生物没有被植物的刺扎伤

成功 生物由于短暂碰触荨麻导致的疼痛而陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 1}

失败 生物由于短暂碰触荨麻导致的疼痛而陷入恶心1，而且由于持续的痛感而在8小时内陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 Clumsy 1}

大失败 生物由于短暂碰触荨麻导致的疼痛而陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 2}，而且由于持续的痛感而在24小时内陷入笨拙1

fr.name: Piège des orties
fr.description: Cette plante d'un vert brillant porte des longues feuilles triangulaires est couverte de piquants aussi fin que des cheveux, semblable à des orties
fr.disable: @Check[survival|dc:17] pour naviguer précautionneusement au travers la plante et couper les orties.

zh.name: 带刺荨麻地 Stinging Nettles
zh.description: 这种亮绿色的植物生有长长的三角形叶片，上面覆盖着绒毛一般的尖刺。
zh.disable: @Check[survival|dc:17]可以小心地穿过植物，并把荨麻草压倒到一侧或者直接割断

pl.name: Kłujące Pokrzywy
pl.description: Ta jasnozielona roślina ma długie trójkątne liście pokryte drobnymi włoskami przypominającymi żądła.
pl.disable: @Check[survival|dc:17] aby ostrożnie poruszać się między roślinami i odciągać lub odcinać pokrzywy.

name: Stink-Sap Trap
description: A nozzle attached to a pressure sensor under the flagstone path sprays thick wads of smelly sap.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:15|name:Clog the nozzle|traits:hazard,mechanical,trap] (trained) to clog the nozzle or @Check[athletics|dc:14|name:Redirect the stream|traits:hazard,mechanical,trap] (trained) to redirect the stream away from the path; the Athletics check can be made at a distance with a thrown object, but a critical failure triggers the trap's Sudden Spray.
publication: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg
reset: 1 minute. The trap resets automatically twice before the supply of stink sap is exhausted.

actions.name: Sudden Spray
actions.description:
Trigger A creature or object weighing at least 50 pounds is placed on one of the flagstones north of the gate (marked "T" on the map)

Effect Pressurized sap sprays from the nozzle, coating everything in a @Template[cone|distance:15]. Creatures in the area that fail a @Check[reflex|dc:20|traits:hazard,mechanical,trap] save become affected by stink sap.

fr.name: Projection soudaine
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature ou un objet pesant au moins 23 kilos est placé sur l'une des dalles situées au nord de la porte (marquée "T" sur la carte).

Effet De la sève pressurisée est projetté d'une buse, aspergeant tout dans un @Template[cone|distance:15]{cône de 3 mètres}. Les créatures dans la zone doivent effectuer un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:20|traits:hazard,mechanical,trap]. En cas d'échec, elles sont affectées par la Sève puante.

zh.name: 突然喷射 Sudden Spray
zh.description:
触发 一个超过50磅重的生物或物体压到大门后方的石板路（在地图上以T字标出）

效果 喷嘴喷出恶臭的树液，让@Template[cone|distance:15]区域内的所有生物身上包裹一层黏液。区域内的生物如果未能通过@Check[reflex|dc:20|traits:hazard,mechanical,trap]豁免则会暴露在恶臭树液的影响下。

actions.name: Stink Sap
actions.description:
5 feet. Creatures and their equipment coated in the sap smell horrible. Creatures in the aura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:16|traits:hazard,mechanical,trap] save. On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}, and on a critical failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}. While within the aura, the creature takes a -2 circumstance penalty to saves to recover from the sickened condition. A creature that succeeds at its save is immune to stink sap for 1 minute. Creatures don't save against this effect in exploration mode and don't become temporarily immune, but creatures with stink sap on them must roll against their own aura when they roll initiative in encounter mode. The sap dissipates after 10 hours; spending 10 minutes scrubbing the sap off with soap and water reduces the duration by 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.TcgvhgpUkJFjVqBx]{Effect: Stink Sap}

fr.name: Sève puante
fr.description:
1,50 mètre.

Les créatures et leur équipement sont recouvert de ce jus qui sent horriblement mauvais. Les créatures dans l'aura doivent tenter un jet de @Check[fortitude|dc:16|traits:hazard,mechanical,trap]. En cas d'échec, la créature est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Nauséeuse 1} et sur un échec critique elle est également @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Ralentie 1}. Tant qu'elle est dans l'aura, la créature subit une pénalité de circonstances aux jets de sauvegarde pour se rétablir de son état de nauséeuse. Une créature qui réussit son jet de sauvegarde est immunisée contre la Sève puante pendant 1 minute. Les créatures n'ont pas besoin de jet sauvegarde contre cet effet en mode exploration et ne sont pas temporairement immunisées, mais les créatures qui ont de la Sève puante sur elles doivent effectuer un jet contre leur propre aura lorsqu'elles lancent un jet d'initiative en mode rencontre. La sève se dissipe au bout de 10 heures ; passer 10 minutes à frotter la sève avec de l'eau et du savon réduit la durée d'une heure.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.TcgvhgpUkJFjVqBx]{Effect: Stink Sap}

zh.name: 恶臭树液 Stink Sap
zh.description:
5尺。生物和他们的装备包裹在难闻的树液中。在此灵光范围内的生物必须尝试@Check[fortitude|dc:16|traits:hazard,mechanical,trap]豁免。如果失败，生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 1}，并且如果大失败，生物还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 Stunned 1}。只要生物待在灵光范围内，生物从恶心状态中恢复的豁免骰就有-2环境减值。通过豁免的生物对恶臭树液临时免疫1分钟。在探索模式下，生物不需要对此效果进行豁免，也不会获得临时免疫，但身上有恶臭树液的角色必须在遭遇模式开始投掷先攻时对自身的灵光进行豁免。被沾上的树液能持续存在10小时；花费10分钟用肥皂和水用力擦洗自己可以减少1小时持续时间。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.TcgvhgpUkJFjVqBx]

fr.name: Piège de sève-puante
fr.description: Une buse fixée à un capteur de pression sous le chemin de dalles pulvérise d'épaisses gouttes de sève malodorante.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:15|name:Boucher la buse|traits:hazard,mechanical,trap] (qualifié) pour boucher la buse ou test d'@Check[athletics|dc:14|name:Rediriger l'écoulement|traits:hazard,mechanical,trap] (qualifié) pour rediriger le flux loin du chemin. Le test d'Athlétisme peut être fait à distance avec un objet qui est lancé, mais un échec critique au test provoque la Projection soudaine du piège.
fr.reset: 1 minute. Le piège se réinitialise automatique deux fois avant que le réservoir de sève puante soit épuisé.

zh.name: 恶臭树液陷阱 Stink-Sap Trap
zh.description: 石板路下面的压力传感器连接着有一个喷嘴，喷出黏稠且臭气熏天的树液。
zh.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:15|name:Clog the nozzle|traits:hazard,mechanical,trap]（受训）堵上喷嘴；或@Check[athletics|dc:14|name:Redirect the stream|traits:hazard,mechanical,trap]（受训）改变喷嘴的方向，让它对着石板路旁边喷；此运动检定可以通过远程投掷一件物品的方式来实现，但如果大失败的话会触发喷嘴的突然喷射。
zh.reset: 1分钟。在储存罐里的树液用完之前，陷阱能自动重置2次。

pl.name: Stink-Sap Trap
pl.description: A nozzle attached to a pressure sensor under the flagstone path sprays thick wads of smelly sap.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:15|name:Clog the nozzle|traits:hazard,mechanical,trap] (trained) to clog the nozzle or @Check[athletics|dc:14|name:Redirect the stream|traits:hazard,mechanical,trap] (trained) to redirect the stream away from the path; the Athletics check can be made at a distance with a thrown object, but a critical failure triggers the trap's Sudden Spray.
pl.reset: 1 minute. The trap resets automatically twice before the supply of stink sap is exhausted.

name: Stinkface Surprise
description: A pile of excrement and rotten food is launched at whoever opens the trunk without first depressing a hidden button on the side of the trunk.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:26] (expert) to unhook the launch spring
publication: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
stealth: (expert; @Check[perception|dc:31] to detect the hidden bypass button)

actions.name: Stinkface Surprise
actions.description:
Trigger A creature opens the trunk or breaks open the trunk; Bypass @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} button

Effect The trap deals @Damage[(4d10+22)[poison]] damage to the triggering creature (@Check[fortitude|dc:26|basic] save). On a failure, the target is additionally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 4}. A creature can spend one Interact action to scrub the filth from their eyes, removing the blinded condition. A creature can't reduce the value of their sickened condition below 1 until they fully wash the filth off, a process which requires 5 minutes and suitable supplies.

zh.name: Stinkface Surprise
zh.description:
Trigger A creature opens the trunk or breaks open the trunk; Bypass @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} button

Effect The trap deals @Damage[(4d10+22)[poison]] damage to the triggering creature (@Check[fortitude|dc:26|basic] save). On a failure, the target is additionally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 4}. A creature can spend one Interact action to scrub the filth from their eyes, removing the blinded condition. A creature can't reduce the value of their sickened condition below 1 until they fully wash the filth off, a process which requires 5 minutes and suitable supplies.

pl.name: Stinkface Surprise
pl.description: A pile of excrement and rotten food is launched at whoever opens the trunk without first depressing a hidden button on the side of the trunk.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:26] (expert) to unhook the launch spring
pl.stealth: (expert; @Check[perception|dc:31] to detect the hidden bypass button)

name: Stonegutter Mold
description: A hardy, innocuous-looking green mold grows over surfaces, slowly absorbing minerals.
disable: @Check[survival|dc:26] (trained) to scrape away the mold without touching it
reset: 1 hour, as the mold settles back across the surface.

actions.name: Calcium Consumption
actions.description:
Trigger A creature with bones touches the mold or steps into an area covered with it

Effect The mold shudders and slithers onto the triggering creature as it attempts to absorb calcium through their skin. The creature attempts a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:25] save.

Critical Success The target shakes the mold off and is unaffected.

Success A small patch of mold clings to the target and deals @Damage[(2d10+9)[piercing]] damage.

Failure The mold clings to the target. The target takes @Damage[(4d10+18)[piercing]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Critical Failure The mold envelops the target. As failure, except the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until it's healed to its Hit Point maximum.

Note: A DC was not provided for this ability by Paizo. The DC present here is a hard DC for the hazard level according to the GM Core hazard building Tables.

zh.name: 钙质消耗 Calcium Consumption
zh.description:
触发 一个具有骨骼的生物触碰此霉菌或踏入被其覆盖的区域

效果 霉菌颤抖着滑向触发生物，试图通过其皮肤吸收钙质。该生物需进行一次 @Check[type:fortitude|dc:25] 豁免。

大成功 目标摆脱束缚且未受任何影响。

成功 一小块霉菌附着在目标身上，并造成 @Damage[(2d10+9)[piercing]] 伤害。

失败 霉菌附着于目标身上。目标受到 @Damage[(4d10+18)[piercing]] 伤害，并附加 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 Drained 1}。

大失败 霉菌包裹住目标。如同失败，但目标还会 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1} ，直至目标HP恢复至上限。

注：Paizo并未为此能力提供DC。此处显示的DC是根据《GM核心》中的危害等级构建表为该危害等级设定的困难DC。

zh.name: 溶石霉菌 Stonegutter Mold
zh.description: 一种外表无害的绿色霉菌在物体表面生长，缓慢吞噬矿物。
zh.disable: @Check[survival|dc:26] (受训) 在不碰到霉菌的情况下刮掉它。
zh.reset: 每1小时，霉菌会重新覆盖在物体表面。

pl.name: Stonegutter Mold
pl.description: A hardy, innocuous-looking green mold grows over surfaces, slowly absorbing minerals.
pl.disable: @Check[survival|dc:26] (trained) to scrape away the mold without touching it
pl.reset: 1 hour, as the mold settles back across the surface.

name: Stonescale Spirits
description: A half-dozen ghostly kobolds rise from the rubble in a howling vortex.
disable: @Check[intimidation|dc:18|name:Frighten the Spirits] (trained) to frighten the spirits with a threatening display, or @Check[religion|dc:21|name:Excorcise the Spirits] (trained) to exorcise the spirits
reset:
The haunt deactivates if there are no frightened creatures in area A7 at the start of its turn. The ghostly kobolds return to the rubble pile.

The haunt can't activate again for 1 hour.
routine: (1 action) The spirits swoop together toward one creature in area A7 who's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, instilling feelings of betrayal and confusion. The target takes @Damage[(1d10+4)[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:18|basic] save).

actions.name: Confusing Confrontation
actions.description:
Trigger A creature enters a square either fully or partially filled with rubble in the middle of the room

Effect Six ghostly kobolds surge out of the rubble with eerie yowls. Each creature in area A7 must attempt a @Check[will|dc:18] save with the following results. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected, is temporarily immune to Confusing Confrontation for 24 hours, and realizes that a display of intimidating dominance might quell the ghostly kobolds' assault.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 2 rounds and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

fr.name: Confrontation déroutante
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature entre dans une case partiellement ou complètement remplie de décombres au milieu de la pièce

Effet Six kobolds fantomatiques surgissent des décombres en poussant des hurlements inquiétants. Chaque créature dans la zone A7 doit faire un jet de @Check[will|dc:18] et appliquer les résultats suivants. La hantise fait ensuite un jet d'initiative.

Succès critique La créature n'est pas affectée, elle est temporairement immunisée contre la confrontation déroutante pendant 24 h et comprend qu'un comportement dominant et intimidant peut réprimer l'assaut des kobolds fantomatiques.

Succès La créature est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 1}.

Échec La créature est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confuse} pendant 1 round et @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 2}.

Échec critique La créature est Confuse pendant 2 rounds et @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 3}.

zh.name: 困惑交锋 Confusing Confrontation
zh.description:
触发 一个生物完全或部分地进入房间中间被碎石堆占据的方格；

效果 六只狗头人幽灵从碎石堆中升起，并发出可怕的嚎叫。A7区域内的每个生物都必须尝试通过@Check[will|dc:18]检定，否则会遭受以下效果，然后作祟进行先攻检定。

大成功 生物不受影响，并在24小时内临时免疫，并且能意识到咄咄逼人的姿态能吓退狗头人的攻势。

成功 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}。

失败 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑 Confused}，持续1轮，并且陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 2}。

大失败 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑 Confused}，持续2轮，并且陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 3}。

fr.name: Esprits des Pierrécailles
fr.description: Une demi-douzaine de kobolds fantomatiques apparaissent au-dessus des décombres sous forme de vortex hurlant.
fr.disable: @Check[intimidation|dc:18|name:Effrayer les esprits] (qualifié) pour effrayer les esprits en les menaçant ou test de @Check[religion|dc:21|name:Exorciser les esprits] (qualifié) pour les exorciser.
fr.reset: La hantise se désactive s'il n'y a aucune créature effrayée dans la zone A7 au début de son tour. Les kobolds fantomatiques retournent dans le tas de décombres. La hantise ne se réactive qu'au bout de 1 heure.
fr.routine: (1 action) Les esprits fondent ensemble sur une créature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée} dans la zone A7 en lui inspirant trahison et confusion. La cible subit @Damage[(1d10+4)[mental]]{1d10+4 dégâts mentaux} (@Check[will|dc:18|basic]).

zh.name: 石鳞之魂 Stonescale Spirits
zh.description: 半打狗头人鬼魂伴随着嚎叫从碎石堆中升起。
zh.disable: @Check[intimidation|dc:18|name:Frighten the Spirits]（受训）以具有威胁性的动作吓唬鬼魂；或@Check[religion|dc:21|name:Excorcise the Spirits]（受训）超度亡魂
zh.reset:
如果作祟的回合开始时，A7区域内没有陷入惊惧的生物，则幽灵们会退散，回到瓦砾堆中。

该作祟在1小时之内不会再次触发。
zh.routine: （1动作）幽灵一齐向A7区域内某个陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]的生物发动攻击，向他灌输背叛和困惑的感觉。目标受到@Damage[(1d10+4)[mental]]{1d10+4心灵伤害}（@Check[will|dc:18|basic]豁免）。

pl.name: Duchy Koboldów Kamiennej Łuski
pl.description: Pół tuzina upiornych koboldów unosi się z gruzów w wyjącym wirze.
pl.disable: @Check[intimidation|dc:18|name:Straszenie Duchów] (wytrenowany) aby przestraszyć duchy groźnym pokazem lub @Check[religion|dc:21|name:Egzorcyzmy Duchów] (wytrenowany) aby egzorcyzmować duchy
pl.reset:
Nawiedzenie dezaktywuje się, jeśli w okolicy nie ma żadnych przestraszonych stworzeń w obszarze A7 na początku swojej tury. Upiorne koboldy wracają na stertę gruzu.

Nawiedzenie nie może aktywować się ponownie przez 1 godzinę.
pl.routine: (1 akcja) Duchy zbliżają się do jednej istoty w obszarze A7 która jest @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Przestraszona}, wywołując uczucie zdrady i dezorientacji. Cel otrzymuje @Damage[(1d10+4)[mental]] obrażeń (rzut obronny na @Check[will|dc:18|basic]).

name: Storasta's Last Stand (3-4)
description: A ghostly host of god callers and their eidolons manifests to defend the barrow against intruders, and the strains of a battle song fill the air.
disable: @Check[deception|dc:22] to appear to be a defender of Storasta, @Check[diplomacy|dc:22] to demonstrate benign intentions, or @Check[occultism|dc:20] or @Check[religion|dc:20] to ward off the malevolent spiritual energies. Two successful checks are required to disable the haunt, and each attempt requires two actions.
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-15: A Dirge for Sarkoris
reset: The haunt dissipates 1 minute after all living creatures leave area C1. Its spiritual energies re-form after 24 hours.
routine: (1 action) (holy, illusion, mental, occult) The haunt attacks what it believes is a demonic incursion, dealing @Damage[(1d8+3)[mental],1d8[spirit]|traits:holy]{1d8+3 mental and 1d8 spirit damage} to each living creature in the area (@Check[will|dc:21|basic|name:Storasta's Last Stand|traits:holy,illusion,mental,occult] save).

actions.name: Hold The Line
actions.description:
Trigger One or more living creatures attempts to move past the entryway further into the barrow

Effect Each creature in the area feels their own form warping into that of a hideous demon and must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the onslaught of illusions.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} and believes that it is infused with demonic energy, making it susceptible to holy effects (even if it is not unholy) for as long as it remains within the haunt's area.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature also gains weakness 5 to cold iron for the next 24 hours.

fr.name: Tenir le cap
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une ou plusieurs créatures vivantes tentent de se déplacer au-delà de l'entrée pour se'enfoncer dans le tumulus

Effet Chaque créature dans zone ressent que leur forme se déforme en un démon hideux et doit tenter un jet de @Check[will|dc:21].

name: Storm Discharge
description: Ebeshra aligns its crystalline form to produce a blast of lightning that charges the surrounding area with electrical energy.
disable: @Check[nature|dc:45|name:Balance the Electrical Charges|traits:divine,electricity,environmental,evocation,kaiju,hazard] (master) to balance the electrical charges in the area or @Check[deception|dc:48|name:Divert Ebeshra's Attention|traits:divine,electricity,environmental,evocation,kaiju,hazard] (expert) to momentarily divert Ebeshra's attention
publication: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth
reset: Ebeshra waits [[/gmr 1d4 #Lightning Blast Wait]] rounds before another blast.

actions.name: Lightning Blast
actions.description:
Trigger A creature takes a hostile action against Ebeshra, produces a visible area effect, or flies within 120 feet of Ebeshra

Effect Ebeshra unleashes a @Template[line|distance:240] of electricity toward the triggering creature. Creatures in the line take @Damage[16d8[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:42|basic|options:area-effect] save). The electricity creates a static field in all squares that the line passed through and all adjacent squares. For 1 round, any creatures that enter a space in the static field take @Damage[4d8[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:38|basic|name:Static Field|options:area-effect] save).

fr.name: Décharge de foudre
fr.description:

Les créatures sur la ligne subissent @Damage[16d8[electricity]|options:area-damage]{16d8 dégâts d'électricité} (@Check[reflex|dc:42|basic|options:area-effect]). L'électricité crée une zone d'énergie statique dans toutes les cases de la ligne et les cases adjacentes. Pendant 1 round, toute créature qui entre dans cet espace de charge statique subit @Damage[4d8[electricity]|options:area-damage]{4d8 dégâts d'électricité} (@Check[reflex|dc:38|basic|name:Charge statique|options:area-effect]).

publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains
reset: The trap resets after 1 hour.

actions.name: Storm's Rage
actions.description:
Trigger A creature attempts to break or escape the chains

Effect The chains release a devastating blast of lightning that deals @Damage[(4d8+14)[electricity]] damage to all creatures in the room. Affected creatures must each attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 minute.

Failure The creature takes full damage and becomes deafened for 1 hour.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage. It also becomes deafened for 8 hours.

fr.name: Rage de l'orage
fr.description:

Succès critique La créature n'est pas affectée.

Échec La créature subit la totalité des dégâts et devient Sourde pendant 1 heure.

Effect Winds surge into the room. The hazard rolls initiative.

Effet Les vents se lèvent brusquement dans la pièce. Le danger lance l'initiative.

zh.name: Opening Melody
zh.description:

Effect Winds surge into the room. The hazard rolls initiative.

actions.name: Mesmerizing Duet
actions.description:
When a creature fails a Performance check to Disable the melody, the elemental plays along before taking over the performance. Creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save to resist becoming fascinated by the melody.

Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is then temporarily immune to Mesmerising Duet for 1 hour.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} for 1 round; this fascination does not end when the creature or its allies take damage from the hazard.

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}; this fascination does not end when the creature or its allies take damage from the hazard.

fr.name: Duo fascinant
fr.description:
Lorsqu'une créature subit un échec à son test de Représentation pour Désactiver la mélodie, l'élémentaire l'accompagne puis prend le contrôle de la Représentation. Les créatures dans la zone doivent tenter un jet de @Check[will|dc:22] pour résister à la fascination de la mélodie.

Indépendamment du résultat du jet de sauvegarde, la créature est ensuite temporairement immunisée à Duo fasciant pendant 1 heure.

Succès critique La créature n'est pas affectée.

Succès La créature est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefiée 1} pendant 1 round.

Échec La créature est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinée} pendant 1 round ; cette fascination ne s'arrête pas si la créature affectée ou un de ses alliés subit des dégâts du danger.

actions.description:
When a creature fails a Performance check to Disable the melody, the elemental plays along before taking over the performance. Creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] save to resist becoming fascinated by the melody.

Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is then temporarily immune to Mesmerising Duet for 1 hour.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} for 1 round; this fascination does not end when the creature or its allies take damage from the hazard.

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}; this fascination does not end when the creature or its allies take damage from the hazard.

fr.name: Duo fascinant

Succès critique La créature n'est pas affectée.

name: Stygian Fires
description: Freezing black fire bursts from the two quartz altars, filling the room with numbing black flames that scour away memories and emotions as swiftly as they sear flesh and bone.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:30] (master) to sever the links between the door and the lanterns, @Check[religion|dc:35] (master) to use prayer to deactivate the divine magic, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (6th rank; counteract DC 30) to counteract the trap
reset: The trap resets one minute after the doors to area E3 are closed.

actions.name: Stygian Fire
actions.description:
Trigger The doors to area E3 are opened without someone making blood offerings and lighting the lanterns.

Effect Every creature in area E2 must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:32|traits:damaging-effect] save.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes @Damage[(3d10+13)[cold]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(6d10+27)[cold]] damage and is stupefied 1.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[(6d10+27)[cold]] damage, takes @Damage[1d10[persistent,cold]] damage, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}.

fr.name: Feu stygien
fr.description:
Déclencheur Les portes vers la zone E3 sont ouverte sans offrande de sang et sans avoir allumé les lanternes.

Effet Chaque créature dans la zone E2 doit tenter un jet @Check[reflex|dc:32|traits:damaging-effect].

Succès critique La créature ne subit aucun dégât.

Succès La créature subit @Damage[(3d10+13)[cold]]{3d10+13 dégâts de froid} et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupéfiée 1} pendant 1 minute.

Échec La créature subit @Damage[(6d10+27)[cold]](6d10+27 dégâts de froid) et est Stupéfiée 1.

Échec critique La créature subit @Damage[(6d10+27)[cold]]{6d10+27 dégâts de froid}, plus @Damage[1d10[persistent,cold]]{1d10 dégâts de froid persistants} et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupéfiée 2}.

zh.name: 冥河之焰 Stygian Fire
zh.description:
触发 在有人给两盏油灯供奉血液并将其点亮之前开启区域E3的门

效果 每个位于区域E2的生物都必须尝试@Check[reflex|dc:32|traits:damaging-effect]豁免

大成功 生物不受伤害

成功 生物承受@Damage[(3d10+13)[cold]]伤害并且在1分钟内陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 1}

失败 生物承受@Damage[(6d10+27)[cold]]伤害并且陷入呆滞1

大失败 生物承受@Damage[(6d10+27)[cold]]和@Damage[1d10[persistent,cold]]伤害，并且陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 2}

fr.name: Feux stygiens
fr.description: Du feu noir et glacial explose des deux autels en quartz, emplissant la pièce avec des flammes noires qui volent les souvenirs et les émotions alors qu'au passage ils grillent la chair et les os.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:30] (maître) pour couper les liens entre la porte et les lanternes, test de @Check[religion|dc:35] (maître) utilisant la prière pour désactiver la magie divine, ou @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dissipation de la magie} (contrer : Rang 6 ; DD 30) pour contrer le piège.
fr.reset: Le piège se réactive une minute après que les portes de la zone E3 sont refermées.

zh.name: 冥河之焰 Stygian Fires
zh.description: 冰冷的黑色火焰从两座石英神龛中喷涌而出，充满整个房间的黑焰让人麻木，它在灼烧着血肉与骨骼的同时还冲刷着记忆与情感。
zh.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:30]（大师）能切断大门与油灯之间的联系，@Check[religion|dc:35]（大师）能用于通过祈祷来解除神术的力量，或者@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]（6环级；反制DC30）也能用于反制陷阱
zh.reset: 在区域E3的门关闭1分钟后重置。

pl.name: Stygińskie Ogniska
pl.description: Mrożący czarny ogień wybucha z dwóch ołtarzy kwarcowych, wypełniając pomieszczenie odrętwiającymi czarnymi płomieniami, które równie szybko wymazują wspomnienia i emocje, co wypalają ciało i kości.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:30] (mistrz) aby przerwać połączenia między drzwiami, a latarniami, @Check[religion|dc:35] (mistrz) aby za pomocą modlitwy dezaktywować boską magię, lub @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Rozproszenie Magii} (ranga 6; ST przeciwdziałania 30) aby zneutralizować pułapkę.
pl.reset: Pułapka resetuje się jedną minutę po zamknięciu drzwi do obszaru E3.

name: Subduing Gas Chamber
description: A mechanical sensor in the desk drawer releases a counterweight in the wall, which slams the door shut and opens the sleeping gas tank under the bed, allowing gas to fill the air-tight room with a hissing sound.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:26|name:Disconnect the wire|traits:hazard,complex,mechanical,trap] (Trained) to disconnect the wire to the counterweight, preventing it from falling, or @Check[crafting|dc:20|name:Create a counteragent|traits:hazard,complex,mechanical,trap,alchemical,action:craft] (Alchemical Crafting) to create a counteragent to the sleeping gas
publication: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg
reset: The gas must be manually reloaded.
routine: (1 action) Each round on its initiative count, the trap pumps more sleeping gas into the room. Any breathing creature in the room is exposed to the toxin. If a creature acts before the trap on the first round, it has the option of holding its breath to postpone breathing in the poison-holding one's breath after the trap's first action has no effect, since the air in the creature's lungs is already tainted. The trap functions for 1 minute before all the gas is expended, after which it rapidly decays over the next minute. Opening the door to an adjacent room cuts the remaining time it takes for the gas to decay in half but exposes creatures in that room as well.

actions.name: Slam Door
actions.description:
Trigger A creature opens the desk drawer without holding the release button under the desk

Effect The wooden door to the room slams shut and locks, and the trap rolls initiative.

fr.name: Claquer la porte

Déclencheur Une créature ouvre le tiroir du bureau sans tenir en même temps l'interrupteur sous le bureau.

Effet La porte en bois de la pièce se referme et se verrouille soudainement, et le piège détermine l'initiative.

zh.name: 砰然关门 Slam Door
zh.description:
触发 一个生物在没有按住桌子下面施放按钮的情况下打开了书桌抽屉

效果 房间的木门砰的一声关上并上锁，然后陷阱投掷先攻。

actions.name: Sleeping Gas
actions.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:22|traits:hazard,complex,mechanical,trap]

Maximum Duration 4 hours

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} with no Perception check to wake up (1 round)

Stage 3 unconscious with no Perception check to wake up (1 hour)

Jet de sauvegarde @Check[fortitude|dc:22|traits:hazard,complex,mechanical,trap]

Durée maximale 4 heures

Stade 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Ralenti 1} (1 round)

Stade 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Inconscient} sans Perception pour se réveiller (1 round)

Stade 3 Inconscient sans Perception pour se réveiller (1 heure)

zh.name: 催眠气体 Sleeping Gas
zh.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:22|traits:hazard,complex,mechanical,trap]

最大持续时间 4小时

阶段1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1}（1轮）

阶段2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]，且不能通过察觉检定醒来（1轮）

阶段3 失去意识，且不能通过察觉检定醒来（1小时）

fr.name: Chambre du gaz somnifère
fr.description: Un capteur mécanique situé dans le tiroir du bureau libère un contrepoids dans le mur, qui ferme la porte et ouvre le réservoir de gaz somnifère situé sous le lit, permettant au gaz de remplir la pièce hermétiquement fermée avec un sifflement.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:26|name:Déconnecter le fil|traits:hazard,complex,mechanical,trap] (Trained) pour déconnecter le fil du contrepoids, empêchant ce dernier de tomber ou test d'@Check[crafting|dc:20|name:Créer un agent pour contrer|traits:hazard,complex,mechanical,trap,alchemical,action:craft] (Artisanat alchimique) pour créer un agent qui contre les effets du gaz somnifère.
fr.reset: Le gaz doit être rechargé manuellement.
fr.routine: (1 action) A chaque round à son tour d'initiative, le piège pompe plus de gaz somnifère dans la pièce. Toute créature respirant dans la pièce est exposée à la toxine. Si une créature agit avant le piège au premier round, elle a la possibilité de retenir sa respiration pour retarder l'inhalation du poison - retenir sa respiration après la première action du piège n'a aucun effet, puisque l'air dans les poumons de la créature est déjà vicié. Le piège fonctionne pendant 1 minute avant que tout le gaz ne soit expulsé, après quoi il se décompose rapidement au cours de la minute suivante. Ouvrir la porte d'une pièce adjacente réduit de moitié le temps de décomposition du gaz, mais expose également les créatures de cette pièce.

zh.name: 毒气卧室 Subduing Gas Chamber
zh.description: 书桌抽屉里的一个机械传感器施放墙壁上的一个配重，把门砰地关上，同时打开床铺下的储罐，让气体充满这个密闭的房间，发出嘶嘶的声音。
zh.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:26|name:Disconnect the wire|traits:hazard,complex,mechanical,trap]（受训）断开连接配重的电线，防止其下落；或@Check[crafting|dc:20|name:Create a counteragent|traits:hazard,complex,mechanical,trap,alchemical,action:craft]（炼金手艺）制造一种对抗催眠气体的药剂
zh.reset: 气体必须由人工重新装填。
zh.routine: （1动作）每一轮轮到陷阱行动时，陷阱会向房间内注入更多催眠气体。房间内任何需要呼吸的生物都暴露在毒素影邵马的人造人 响下。如果一个生物在第一轮先于陷阱行动，它可以选择屏住呼吸来推迟吸入毒药——在陷阱第一轮之后屏住呼吸没有效果，因为生物肺部的空气已经被毒气污染了。陷阱在气体耗尽之前能工作一分钟，气体在接下来的1分钟内会迅速衰减。打开相邻的房门可以减少气体衰变所需的剩余时间，但也会让该房间内的生物同样暴露在毒气中。

pl.name: Subduing Gas Chamber
pl.description: A mechanical sensor in the desk drawer releases a counterweight in the wall, which slams the door shut and opens the sleeping gas tank under the bed, allowing gas to fill the air-tight room with a hissing sound.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:26|name:Disconnect the wire|traits:hazard,complex,mechanical,trap] (Trained) to disconnect the wire to the counterweight, preventing it from falling, or @Check[crafting|dc:20|name:Create a counteragent|traits:hazard,complex,mechanical,trap,alchemical,action:craft] (Alchemical Crafting) to create a counteragent to the sleeping gas
pl.reset: The gas must be manually reloaded.
pl.routine: (1 action) Each round on its initiative count, the trap pumps more sleeping gas into the room. Any breathing creature in the room is exposed to the toxin. If a creature acts before the trap on the first round, it has the option of holding its breath to postpone breathing in the poison-holding one's breath after the trap's first action has no effect, since the air in the creature's lungs is already tainted. The trap functions for 1 minute before all the gas is expended, after which it rapidly decays over the next minute. Opening the door to an adjacent room cuts the remaining time it takes for the gas to decay in half but exposes creatures in that room as well.

name: Submerged Shard
description: An immense, jagged piece of clear crystal 10 feet square and forty feet high juts up from the seafloor
disable: @Check[survival|dc:13|name:Blunt Crystal] (trained) to blunt the crystal's edges without getting cut
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-12: The Burden of Envy
reset: The hazard still damages any creature or object that enters its space, but the surface doesn't become hidden again until it settles over the course of 1 minute.

actions.name: Shard
actions.description:
Trigger A creature or object moves into the shard's space.

Effect The triggering creature takes @Damage[(2d6+5)[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save).

fr.name: Tesson de cristal
fr.description:
Déclencheur A Une créature ou un objet entre dans l'espace du tesson de cristal.

Effet La créature déclencheuse subit @Damage[(2d6+5)[piercing]]{2d6+5 dégâts perforants} (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic]).

zh.name: 碎片 Shard
zh.description:
触发 一个生物或物体移动进入碎片的位置。

效果 触发生物受到@Damage[(2d6+5)[piercing]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic]豁免）。

fr.name: Tesson submergé
fr.description: Un immense morceau de cristal clair, déchiqueté, de 3 mètres de côté et de 12 mètres de haut, émerge du plancher océanique.
fr.disable: @Check[survival|dc:13|name:Émousser le cristal] (qualifié) pour émousser les bords du cristal sans se couper
fr.reset: Le danger inflige toujours des dégâts à toute créature ou objet qui entre dans son espace, mais la surface ne redevient pas cachée tant qu'elle ne s'est pas stabilisée au cours d'une minute.

zh.name: 淹没碎片 Submerged Shard
zh.description: 一块巨大的、锯齿交错的透明水晶从海底伸出，它有10尺见方，40尺高。
zh.disable: @Check[survival|dc:13|name:Blunt Crystal]（受训）以磨钝水晶边缘从而免于受伤。
zh.reset: 碎片持续对进入的生物或物体造成伤害，但不会再次隐藏起来，直到1分钟后归于平静。

pl.name: Submerged Shard
pl.description: An immense, jagged piece of clear crystal 10 feet square and forty feet high juts up from the seafloor
pl.disable: @Check[survival|dc:13|name:Blunt Crystal] (trained) to blunt the crystal's edges without getting cut
pl.reset: The hazard still damages any creature or object that enters its space, but the surface doesn't become hidden again until it settles over the course of 1 minute.

name: Sudden Drop
description: A portion of Manaket's sewer system is under construction and has been left covered by only a few planks of wood since the Godsrain. After two weeks of wear, they're ready to collapse.
disable: If all the PCs succeed on a Perception check against the Stealth DC to spot the hazard, they're able to detour around the weakened boards without triggering it. There's not enough time for PCs who succeed on this check to warn PCs who fail.
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-03: Godsrain in a Godless Land

actions.name: Break Through
actions.description:
Trigger One or more PCs fail to spot the hazard and step onto the weakened boards

Effect The boards give way, dropping the PCs 5 feet into the open septic tank. The PCs can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge}; those who fail and fall into the tank become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} and cannot reduce this condition until after the Ambush! in Kassi's lab.

Triggering this hazard also accrues 1 AP for the party.

fr.name: Passer au travers
fr.description:
Déclencheur Un ou plusieurs PJ ne repèrent pas le piège et marchent sur les planches fragilisées

Effet Les planches cèdent, faisant chuter le PJ de 1,50 mètre dans la fosse septique ouverte. Le PJ peut tenter de @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Se raccrocher in extremis}. En cas d'échec, le PJ tombe dans la cuve devient @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Nauséeux 1} et ne peut réduire cet état qu'après l'Embuscade ! dans le laboratoire de Kassi.

Le déclenchement de ce piège accorde également 1 PA (Point d'Accusation) au groupe.

fr.name: Plongeon soudain
fr.description: Une partie du système d'égouts de Manaket est en construction et n'a été recouverte que de quelques planches de bois depuis la Pluie Divine. Après deux semaines d'usure, elles sont prêtes à s'effondrer.
fr.disable: Si tous les PJ réussissent un test de Perception contre le DD de Discrétion pour repérer le danger, ils peuvent contourner les planches affaiblies sans le déclencher. Il n'y a pas assez de temps pour que les PJ qui réussissent ce test avertissent ceux qui échouent.

pl.name: Sudden Drop
pl.description: A portion of Manaket's sewer system is under construction and has been left covered by only a few planks of wood since the Godsrain. After two weeks of wear, they're ready to collapse.
pl.disable: If all the PCs succeed on a Perception check against the Stealth DC to spot the hazard, they're able to detour around the weakened boards without triggering it. There's not enough time for PCs who succeed on this check to warn PCs who fail.

name: Sudden Geysers
description: The pooling seawater burbles and hisses.
disable: @Check[arcana|dc:32] or @Check[nature|dc:32] (master) to dissipate the fire-aligned energies in the water, or @Check[diplomacy|dc:28] or @Check[religion|dc:28] to beseech Sangeh and convince her to momentarily tamp down her mythic power; two successes are required to disable the hazard
routine: (2 actions) The hazard uses each of its actions to create a Blistering Plume centered on a space chosen by the GM. Each successful check to disable the hazard removes one action from this routine.

actions.name: Scalding Gout
actions.description:
Trigger A creature within the hazard's area rolls initiative

Effect A enormous column of superheated steam rises from the water, dealing @Damage[(4d12+26)[fire]] damage to all creatures in the area (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic] save). On a critical failure, the creature also takes @Damage[1d12[persistent,fire]] damage as the water continues to burn their skin. The hazard then rolls initiative.

actions.name: Blistering Plume
actions.description: A 30-foot-tall geyser erupts from the boiling water. Creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] of the geyser take @Damage[(2d12+13)[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save).

pl.name: Sudden Geysers
pl.description: The pooling seawater burbles and hisses.
pl.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:32] or @Check[nature|dc:32] (master) to dissipate the fire-aligned energies in the water, or @Check[diplomacy|dc:28] or @Check[religion|dc:28] to beseech Sangeh and convince her to momentarily tamp down her mythic power; two successes are required to disable the hazard
pl.routine: (2 actions) The hazard uses each of its actions to create a Blistering Plume centered on a space chosen by the GM. Each successful check to disable the hazard removes one action from this routine.

name: Suffering Xulgaths
description: The shadows of four xulgaths endlessly relive their deaths at the hands of the wendigos and their clutchmates.
disable: @Check[religion|dc:42|name:Calm a Spirit|traits:haunt] (master) or @Check[occultism|dc:42|name:Calm a Spirit|traits:haunt] (master) to calm each of the four spirits. On a character's first successful check, the character also learns that xulgath funerary rites typically involve cremation, which hints that fire is a viable way to put them to rest.
reset: The haunt is deactivated and resets 1 minute after all non-wendigo creatures leave the area.
routine: (4 actions) Each active spirit chooses a living non-wendigo creature within 120 feet and attempts to devour it, targeting different creatures if possible. Each calmed spirit reduces the hazard's actions by 1
stealth: (expert) to hear the echoed shouts of panicked xulgaths

actions.name: Wendigo Remnants
actions.description:
Trigger A living creature other than a wendigo gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition while within 100 feet of the way station

Effect The haunt rolls for initiative.

fr.name: Vestiges de wendigo
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature vivante qui n'est pas un wendigo obtient l'état @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayé} alors qu'elle se trouve à moins de 30 mètres de la station.

Effet La hantise fait un jet d'initiative.

zh.name: 温迪戈遗影 Wendigo Remnants
zh.description:
触发 一个温迪戈以外的活物在驿站的100尺以内获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]状态

效果 作祟投掷先攻。

fr.name: Xulgaths souffrants
fr.description: Les ombres de quatre xulgaths se remémorent leurs meurtres par les wendigos et leurs camarades griffus.
fr.disable: @Check[religion|dc:42|name:Calmer un esprit|traits:haunt] (maître) ou @Check[occultism|dc:42|name:Calmer un esprit|traits:haunt] (maître) pour calmer les quatre esprits. Lors du premier succès d'un personnage, celui-ci apprend que les rites funéraires xulgaths consistent généralement en une crémation, ce qui suggère que le feu est un moyen viable de leur octroyer le repos.
fr.reset: La hantise se désactive et se réinitialise 1 minute après que toutes les créatures qui ne sont pas des wendigos aient quitté la zone.
fr.routine: (4 actions) Chaque esprit actif choisit une créature vivante qui n'est pas un wendigo à moins de 36 mètres et tente de la dévorer, ciblant des créatures différentes si cela est possible. Un esprit calmé réduit les actions du danger de 1.
fr.stealth: Expert pour entendre l'écho des cris de panique des xulgaths.

zh.name: 饱受折磨的地蜥人 Suffering Xulgaths
zh.description: 四名地蜥人之影永无止境地回放他们在温迪戈以及族人的手中惨死的过去。
zh.disable: @Check[religion|dc:42|name:Calm a Spirit|traits:haunt]（大师）或@Check[occultism|dc:42|name:Calm a Spirit|traits:haunt]（大师）来抚慰四个灵魂中的一个。角色第一次成功检定时，他还会知道地蜥人的葬礼仪式通常包括火化，这意味着火焰是让他们安息的一个可行之法。
zh.reset: 当所有非温迪戈生物离开这个区域1分钟以后，该作祟就会停止激活并重置。
zh.routine: (4动作） 每个活跃的灵魂会选择一名120尺内的非温迪戈活物并试图吞食他，并尽可能选择不同的生物作为目标。每有一个灵魂被抚慰时，该危害的动作减少1。
zh.stealth: （专家）来听见惊恐地蜥人惨叫的回响。

pl.name: Suffering Xulgaths
pl.description: The shadows of four xulgaths endlessly relive their deaths at the hands of the wendigos and their clutchmates.
pl.disable: @Check[religion|dc:42|name:Calm a Spirit|traits:haunt] (master) or @Check[occultism|dc:42|name:Calm a Spirit|traits:haunt] (master) to calm each of the four spirits. On a character's first successful check, the character also learns that xulgath funerary rites typically involve cremation, which hints that fire is a viable way to put them to rest.
pl.reset: The haunt is deactivated and resets 1 minute after all non-wendigo creatures leave the area.
pl.routine: (4 actions) Each active spirit chooses a living non-wendigo creature within 120 feet and attempts to devour it, targeting different creatures if possible. Each calmed spirit reduces the hazard's actions by 1
pl.stealth: (expert) to hear the echoed shouts of panicked xulgaths

name: Summoning Rune
description: A cloud of invisible magical sensors in a 10-foot radius surrounds an invisible wall or floor rune the size of the creature to be summoned.
disable: @Check[acrobatics|dc:15|name:Approach Rune] to approach without triggering the trap followed by @Check[thievery|dc:17|name:Erase Rune|traits:action:disable-a-device] (trained) to erase the rune, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (1st rank; counteract DC 15) to counteract the rune
reset: The trap resets each day at dawn.

actions.name: Summon Monster
actions.description:
Trigger A creature enters the cloud of magical sensors

Effect This trap summons a specific 1st-level creature, determined when the trap is created. The creature rolls initiative and remains for [[/br 2d6 #rounds]]{2d6 rounds}, after which the spell ends and the creature disappears. The creature also disappears if someone disables the trap before the duration expires. The summoned creature can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.

fr.name: Convocation de monstre
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature entre dans la nuée de capteurs magiques.

Effet Ce piège convoque une créature spécifique de niveau 1, déterminée lors de la création du piège. La créature fait un jet d'initiative et agit pendant [[/gmr 2d6 #rounds]]{2d6 rounds}, après quoi le sort se termine et elle disparaît. Elle disparaît également si quelqu'un désamorce le piège avant la fin de la durée. La créature convoquée peut effectuer 3 actions chaque round, ainsi que des réactions, au contraire de la plupart des créatures convoquées.

zh.name: 召唤怪物 Summon Monster
zh.description:
触发 一个生物进入魔法传感器的范围内；

效果 此陷阱召唤一个特殊的1级生物，具体由陷阱创造时决定。该生物进行先攻检定并持续存在[[/br 2d6 #rounds]]{2d6轮}，法术效果结束之后该生物消失。如果法术效果结束前有人解除了陷阱则召唤生物也会消失。和大多数召唤的生物不同的是，此陷阱召唤的生物每轮拥有3个动作并且可以使用反应动作。

fr.name: Rune de convocation
fr.description: Une nuée de capteurs magiques invisibles dans un rayon de 3 mètres entoure une rune invisible sur le mur ou le plafond, de la même taille que la créature qu'elle peut convoquer.
fr.disable: @Check[acrobatics|dc:15|name:approcher prudemment] pour approcher sans activer le piège suivi par un test de @Check[thievery|dc:17|name:Effacer la rune|traits:action:disable-a-device] (qualifié) pour effacer la rune ou @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dissipation de la magie} (contrer : Rang 1 ; DD 15) pour contrer la rune
fr.reset: Le piège se réinitialise chaque jour à l'aube

zh.name: 召唤符文 Summoning Rune
zh.description: 在一堵隐形的墙或者地板周围半径10尺的范围内有一团无形的魔法传感器，其大小与被召唤的生物相当。
zh.disable: @Check[acrobatics|dc:15|name:Approach Rune]在不触发陷阱的情况下接近陷阱，之后通过@Check[thievery|dc:17|name:Erase Rune|traits:action:disable-a-device] （受训）来擦除符文，或通过@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法 Dispel Magic}（1环级；反制 DC15）来反制符文。
zh.reset: 此陷阱每天黎明时分重置。

pl.name: Runa Przywołująca
pl.description: Chmura niewidzialnych magicznych czujników w promieniu 10 stóp otacza niewidzialną ścianę lub runę podłogową wielkości przywoływanej istoty.
pl.disable: @Check[acrobatics|dc:15|name:Podejście do runy], aby podejść bez uruchamiania pułapki, a następnie @Check[thievery|dc:17|name:Wymazanie runy|traits:action:disable-a-device] (wytrenowanie), aby usunąć runę, lub @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Rozproszenie Magii} (1. ranga; przeciwdziałanie ST 15), aby przeciwdziałać runie.
pl.reset: Pułapka resetuje się każdego dnia o świcie.

name: Summoning Rune (Barbazu Devil)
description: A summoning circle inlaid into the room's floor detects living creatures and summons a violent devil.
disable: @Check[perception|dc:18|name:Notice the Trap's Magic|traits:action:seek] to notice the trap's magic and avoid stepping on the floor outside the circle, followed by @Check[thievery|dc:21|name:Break Summoning Circle|traits:action:disable-a-device] (trained) to break the circle or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (3rd rank; counteract DC 23) to counteract the rune
publication: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace
reset: The trap resets each day at dawn.

actions.name: Summon Devil
actions.description:
Trigger A living creature steps on any part of the floor not enclosed by the summoning circle

Effect One round after a creature touches the triggering area, the door to the room slams shut and locks (two [[/act pick-a-lock dc=20]]{Thievery} checks to pick) and a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.FIoRPHaHdYUPVKdT]{Barbazu} devil appears in the summoning circle.

The devil rolls initiative and remains for [[/br 3d6 #rounds]]{3d6 rounds}, after which the spell ends and the devil disappears. The devil also disappears if someone disables the trap before the duration expires.

The summoned devil can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.

fr.name: Convocation de diable
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature vivante marche au sol en dehors du cercle de convocation.

Effet Un round après que la créature a touché la zone déclencheur, la porte de la pièce se ferme en claquant, se verrouille (deux tests de [[/act pick-a-lock dc=20]]{Vol} pour la forcer) et un @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.FIoRPHaHdYUPVKdT]{Diable barbazu} apparaît dans le cercle.

Le diable fait un jet d'initiative et agit pendant [[/gmr 3d6 #rounds]]{3d6 rounds}, après quoi le sort se termine et il disparaît. Il disparaît également si quelqu'un désamorce le piège avant la fin de la durée.

Le diable convoqué peut effectuer 3 actions chaque round, ainsi que des réactions, contrairement à la plupart des créatures convoquées.

zh.name: 召唤魔鬼 Summon Devil
zh.description:
触发 一个活着的生物踏上地板的任何未被召唤圈包围的部分

效果 在一个生物触摸触发区域一轮后，房间的门突然关上并锁起来（两次[[/act pick-a-lock dc=20]]{贼活}检定以开锁），一只@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.FIoRPHaHdYUPVKdT]出现在召唤圈内。

魔鬼骰先攻并停留[[/br 3d6 #rounds]]{3d6轮}，之后因咒语结束而消失。如果有人在持续时间结束前解除了该陷阱，那么魔鬼也会消失。

被召唤的魔鬼与大多数被召唤的生物不同，每轮可以使用3个动作，也可以使用反应。

fr.name: Rune de convocation (Diable barbazu)
fr.description: Un cercle de convocation incrusté dans le sol de la pièce détecte les créatures vivantes et convoque un diable violent.

name: Supervolcanic Eruption
description:
Volcanic eruptions are dramatic events in which magma erupts from a planet's mantle onto its surface. They're often preceded by earthquakes and the opening of fissures in the ground that vent toxic gases. These initial signs can occur months or even years in advance, making it difficult to predict the eruption's timing. While the intensity, features, and progression of eruptions vary, this hazard represents the most dangerous variety of eruption, one that can swiftly overtake cities with rapid tides of superheated gas and rock and spew out enough ash to affect the climate for years. When these sorts of eruptions are also supervolcanos, eruptions with the highest degree of explosive force, they cause unparalleled transformation to the landscape and alter climate on a planetary scale.

If you're looking for something more supernatural, it's a relatively simple change to adjust the energy damage caused by a supervolcano's pyroclastic flow to something else—for example, a cloud of ghosts erupting from a long-lost city might inflict mental, spirit, or void damage instead of the fire or electricity damage a normal pyroclastic flow brings. Just be sure to give the new event a suitable description that matches the new type of damage!
disable: @Check[mountain-lore|dc:42] (master), @Check[survival|dc:45] (master), or @Check[nature|dc:48] (legendary) to determine evacuation paths, @Check[medicine|dc:45] (master) to safely treat and relocate people poisoned by toxic gases in the preceding days, @Check[athletics|dc:48] (master) to relocate people and essential supplies, or @Check[crafting|dc:48] (legendary) to create filtration systems and barricades capable of withstanding a pyroclastic flow
routine:
(24 hours) When the hazard begins, toxic gas vents open throughout the affected region, followed by clouds of ash. As the eruption column collapses, material rushes forth from the volcano in a pyroclastic flow, which is followed by a dense ash cloud that persists for several minutes. Ash and toxic gas persist for up to 24 hours.

Ash limits visibility like a thick fog, deals @Damage[2d6[fire]] damage per minute, and creates difficult terrain as it collects on the ground. The ash also generates bolts of ash lightning. Once per minute, one unprepared PC takes @Damage[3d12[electricity]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:46|basic] save). Pockets of dense ash are particularly dangerous. Unprepared creatures in areas of dense ash must hold their breath or begin to suffocate.

When the pyroclastic flow first hits a region, creatures in its path must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:43] save with the following results (prepared creatures increase their roll by one degree of success).

Critical Success The creature avoids most of the pyroclastic flow, but still takes @Damage[3d6[fire]] damage and treats all movement in the area as greater difficult terrain for the next 10 minutes.

Success The creature takes @Damage[3d6[bludgeoning]] damage and @Damage[3d6[fire]] damage, and is buried in ash and debris. While buried, they can't breathe and take @Damage[4d6[fire]] damage each round at the start of their turn until they succeed at a DC 40 check to Escape, in addition to the normal @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage each minute for being buried.

Failure As success, but @Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]] damage and @Damage[6d6[fire]] damage, and [[/act escape dc=42]].

Critical Failure As success, but @Damage[12d6[bludgeoning]] damage and @Damage[12d6[fire]] damage, and [[/act escape dc=46]].

zh.name: 超级火山喷发 Supervolcanic Eruption

pl.name: Supervolcanic Eruption
pl.description:
Volcanic eruptions are dramatic events in which magma erupts from a planet's mantle onto its surface. They're often preceded by earthquakes and the opening of fissures in the ground that vent toxic gases. These initial signs can occur months or even years in advance, making it difficult to predict the eruption's timing. While the intensity, features, and progression of eruptions vary, this hazard represents the most dangerous variety of eruption, one that can swiftly overtake cities with rapid tides of superheated gas and rock and spew out enough ash to affect the climate for years. When these sorts of eruptions are also supervolcanos, eruptions with the highest degree of explosive force, they cause unparalleled transformation to the landscape and alter climate on a planetary scale.

If you're looking for something more supernatural, it's a relatively simple change to adjust the energy damage caused by a supervolcano's pyroclastic flow to something else—for example, a cloud of ghosts erupting from a long-lost city might inflict mental, spirit, or void damage instead of the fire or electricity damage a normal pyroclastic flow brings. Just be sure to give the new event a suitable description that matches the new type of damage!

name: Supplicant Statues
description: Six statues rapidly slide around the room on rollers, slowing down intruders and striking at them with spring-loaded sword arms.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:34|name:Disable Statue Rollers|traits:action:disable-a-device] (master) to disable a specific statue's rollers, or @Check[thievery|dc:39|name:Disable Trap (Control Panel)|traits:action:disable-a-device] (master) on the control panel in A4 deactivates the whole trap. For each statue disabled, the trap loses 1 action from its routine and the DC for its predictive impediment ability decreases by 4. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (7th rank, counteract DC 32) doesn't harm the statues but removes the predictive impediment ability. reset: The trap deactivates and resets one minute after the room is empty.
routine: (6 actions) On the trap's initiative, each functioning statue slides up to 40 feet around the room and makes a statue shortsword Strike against an adjacent creature. The trap doesn't take a multiple attack penalty, and the statues' movements don't trigger reactions.

actions.name: Animated Statues
actions.description:

Effect The trap makes a statue shortsword Strike against the triggering creature, activates its predictive impediment ability, and then rolls initiative.

The first time on its turn that a creature attempts to move within the room, it must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:36] save or treat the entire room as difficult terrain for 1 round. Lors de son tour, la première fois qu'une créature tente de se déplacer dans la pièce, elle doit réussir un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:36] ou considérer l'entièreté de la salle comme un terrain difficile pendant 1 round. name: Swampy Quicksand
description: A 15-foot-wide patch of water and sand attempts to submerge creatures that step onto it.
disable: @Check[survival|dc:16|name:Disturb Surface|traits:environmental] (trained) to disturb the surface
publication: Pathfinder Society Intro #1: The Second Confirmation
reset: The hazard still submerges anyone who walks in, but the surface doesn't become hidden again until it settles over the course of 24 hours.
routine:
(1 action) On its initiative, the quicksand pulls down each creature within it. A creature that was submerged up to its waist becomes submerged up to its neck, and a creature that was submerged up to its neck is pulled under and has to hold its breath to avoid suffocation.

A creature in the quicksand can attempt a @Check[athletics|dc:18|name:Swim out of Quicksand|traits:action:swim,environmental] check to Swim to either raise itself by one step if it's submerged to its neck or worse, or to move 5 feet if it's submerged only up to its waist. On a critical failure, the creature is pulled down one step. A creature that Swims out of the quicksand escapes the hazard and is prone in a space adjacent to the quicksand patch. Other creatures can Aid the creature, typically by using a rope or similar aid, or attempt to pull the creature out with their own @Check[athletics|dc:18|name:Aid Another Creature in Quicksand] check, with the same results as if the creature attempted the check.
stealth: (trained), or DC 0 and no minimum proficiency if the surface is disturbed.

actions.name: Submerge
actions.description:
Trigger A Huge or smaller creature walks onto the quicksand

Effect The triggering creature sinks into the quicksand up to its waist. The quicksand rolls initiative if it hasn't already.

zh.name: 吞没 Submerge

触发 一个超大型或更小体型的生物走上流沙

效果 触发的生物腰部以下淹没到流沙中。如果流沙还未投先攻，则进行先攻检定。

zh.name: 沼泽流沙 Swampy Quicksand
zh.description: 一块15尺宽的混合着水和沙子的区域，试图将踏上它的生物吞没。
zh.disable: @Check[survival|dc:16|name:Disturb Surface|traits:environmental]（受训）来扰乱流沙表面。
zh.reset: 流沙依然能吞没任何进入其中的生物，但是表面不再隐蔽，除非它自然沉淀超过24小时。
zh.routine:
（1动作）在流沙的先攻顺位，它会将里面每个生物都往下拉。吞没到腰部的生物会被吞没到脖子，一个被吞没到脖子的生物会被拉到流沙表面以下，必须屏住呼吸来避免窒息。

在流沙中的生物可以尝试@Check[athletics|dc:18|name:Swim out of Quicksand|traits:action:swim,environmental]检定以游泳，如果它被淹没到脖子或更糟，那么检定成功可以将自己上浮一级，如果只被淹没到腰部，则检定成功可以移动5尺。如果检定大失败，则下沉一级。游泳离开流沙的生物能逃离险情范围，并在流沙的相邻方格中处于倒地状态。其他生物可以协助被困的生物，通常是使用绳子或类似的帮助，或者救援者尝试进行@Check[athletics|dc:18|name:Aid Another Creature in Quicksand]检定将被困生物拉出，其造成的结果与被困生物自己尝试运动检定的结果相同。
zh.stealth: （受训），如果流沙表面被扰乱则DC0 ，且没有最小熟练度要求。

pl.name: Swampy Quicksand
pl.description: Obszar o szerokości 15 stóp, złożony z wody i piasku, próbuje wciągnąć stworzenia, które na niego wejdą.
pl.disable: @Check[survival|dc:16|name:Bezpieczne naruszanie powierzchni] (wytrenowany) aby naruszyć powierzchnię
pl.reset: Zagrożenie nadal wciąga każdego, kto na nie wejdzie, ale powierzchnia nie staje się ponownie ukryta, dopóki nie ustabilizuje się w ciągu 24 godzin.
pl.routine:
(1 akcja) W swojej inicjatywie ruchome piaski wciągają każdą znajdującą się w nich istotę. Istota, która była zanurzona do pasa, staje się zanurzona do szyi, a istota, która była zanurzona do szyi, zostaje wciągnięta w głąb i musi wstrzymać oddech, aby uniknąć uduszenia.

Istota znajdująca się w ruchomych piaskach może podjąć próbę Pływania @Check[athletics|dc:18|traits:action:swim], aby albo wynurzyć się o jeden stopień, jeśli jest zanurzona po szyję lub głębiej, albo przemieścić się o 5 stóp, jeśli jest zanurzona tylko do pasa. W przypadku krytycznej porażki, istota zostaje wciągnięta o jeden stopień w dół. Stworzenie, które wypłynie z ruchomych piasków, uniknie zagrożenia i jest Przewrócone w przestrzeni sąsiadującej z ruchomymi piaskami. Inne istoty mogą mu pomóc, zazwyczaj używając liny lub podobnego sposobu, wykonując test @Check[athletics|dc:18|name:Wsparcie dla wciąganej istoty], z takimi samymi rezultatami jak w przypadku próby wykonania tego testu przez wciąganą istotę.

name: Swatted Like Flies
description:
Feeling the presence of creatures on its backside, the Granite Ox swishes its stone tail to swat them away.

Escaping The PCs overcome this hazard by moving out of the area that the Ox's tail can reach. A PC escapes (and is not subject to tail Strikes) by ascending the Ox's sloped back, traveling a distance based on the result of the PC's Reflex save from the Shaken Loose hazard. PCs can Climb up the Ox's back with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:24] check or—by finding and scrambling up improvised paths—a @Check[acrobatics|dc:26], @Check[perception|dc:26], or @Check[survival|dc:26] check. With a successful @Check[acrobatics|dc:20] check, a flying PC can ascend half their fly Speed (or their full Speed on a critical success). PCs can attempt to Disable the hazard whether or not they're in range of the tail.
disable: @Check[acrobatics|dc:26] to scramble out of the way, @Check[deception|dc:24] or @Check[intimidation|dc:24] (trained) to draw the Ox's attention. The DC of the flat check for this round (see Routine) is increased by 4 on a success, or by 8 on a critical success. Increasing the flat check DC to 21 or higher buys the party enough time to move up the Ox's back, disabling the hazard.
reset: Once all of the PCs moved outside the tail's striking range, the hazard is effectively disabled. The hazard reactivates if any PC returns to that area.
routine: (1 action) The Granite Ox makes a tail Strike against one creature in the area. If the attack succeeds, the GM rolls a @Check[flat|dc:9]. On a success, the hazard makes another Strike. The hazard continues making Strikes until the GM fails the flat check.

Effect The Granite Ox makes a tail Strike against the triggering creature. The hazard then rolls initiative.

name: Swatting Tail
description: Mogaru's tail sweeps forth, causing an arc of devastation in a @Template[cone|distance:60].
disable: @Check[performance|dc:45|name:Divert Mogaru's Attention] (legendary) or @Check[deception|dc:48|name:Divert Mogaru's Attention] (legendary) to momentarily divert Mogaru's attention
reset: Mogaru doesn't swat his tail again for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

actions.name: Tail Swat
actions.description:
Trigger A creature takes a hostile action against Mogaru, produces a visible area effect, or flies within 120 feet of Mogaru

Effect Creatures in the area must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:40] save or take @Damage[(6d10+28)[bludgeoning]] damage.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is pushed 20 feet away. If flying, it descends 20 feet.

Failure The creature takes full damage, is pushed 40 feet, and descends 60 feet (if flying) or is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is pushed 60 feet away, descends 120 feet (if flying) or is knocked prone, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

fr.name: Écrasement de queue
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature effectue une action hostile contre Mogaru, produit un effet de zone visible ou vole à moins de 36 mètres de Mogaru.

Effet Les créatures dans la zone doivent réussir un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:40]. En cas d'échec, elle subit @Damage[(6d10+28)[bludgeoning]] dégâts.

Succès critique La créature n'est pas affectée.

Succès La créature subit la moitié des dégâts et est repoussée de 6 mètres. Si elle vole, elle descend de 6 mètres.

Échec La créature subit la totalité des dégâts, est repoussée de 12 mètres et descend de 18 mètres (si elle vole) ou est mise @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{À terre}.

Échec critique La créature subit le double des dégâts, est repoussée de 18 mètres, descend de 36 mètres (si elle vole) ou est mise À terre, et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Étourdie 2}.

zh.name: 尾部重拍 Tail Swat

触发 个生物对魔加鲁进行敌对行为，制造可见的区域效果，或在魔加鲁120尺范围内飞行

效果 区域中的生物必须通过@Check[reflex|dc:40]豁免，否则受到@Damage[(6d10+28)[bludgeoning]]伤害。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害并被推离20尺。如果正在飞行，则下降20尺。

失败 生物受到全伤害，被推离40尺，并且下降60尺（如正在飞行）或被击@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地 Prone}。

name: Talhindir's Autumn
description: All lights in the room snap on, just as Lyari remembers the day of her death. A susurrus of accusations and a guilty verdict fill the air. Ghostly elven warriors disappear and reappear in a disorienting and implacable advance.
disable: @Check[athletics|dc:18] to stand against the force of the verdict, or @Check[arcana|dc:18], @Check[occultism|dc:18], or @Check[religion|dc:18] to ritually disrupt the haunting. Each success reduces the haunt's actions by one When the haunt has no more actions, it is disabled and the Hunted by Chains haunt triggers.

name: Tar Pit
description: A 15-foot-wide patch of tar covered with dirt and leaves attempts to capture creatures that step onto it.
disable: @Check[survival|dc:25|name:Reveal the Tar Pit|traits:environmental,hazard] (expert) to disturb the surface and reveal the tar pit
reset: Though the hazard still captures anyone who touches it, the surface doesn't become hidden again until it settles, which takes 24 hours.
routine: (1 action) On its initiative, the tar pit pulls down each creature within it, thick tar adhering to the creature's body. A creature that was submerged up to its waist becomes submerged up to its neck, and a creature that was submerged up to its neck is pulled under and must hold its breath to avoid suffocation. A creature in the tar pit can attempt a @Check[athletics|dc:33] check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb} to either raise itself by one step (if it's submerged to its neck or full submerged) or to move 5 feet if it's submerged only up to its waist. On a critical failure, the creature is pulled down one step. Other creatures can Aid the creature, typically by using a rope or similar aid or by attempting to pull the creature out with their own @Check[athletics|dc:33] check, with the same results as if the creature attempted the check. In addition to the usual results, a character adjacent to the tar pit who critically fails while Aiding moves into the tar pit. A creature that Climbs out of the tar pit escapes the hazard and lands @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} in an adjacent space.

actions.name: Capture

zh.name: 焦油坑 Tar Pit
zh.description: 一片15尺宽的焦油上面覆盖着泥土和叶子，等待着捕获踏足其上的生物。
zh.disable: @Check[survival|dc:25|name:Reveal the Tar Pit|traits:environmental,hazard]（专家）以扰动表面、露出焦油坑。
zh.reset: 尽管该危害依然会俘获任何解除它的人，但表面在平息下来（需要24小时）之前都不再处于隐藏状态。
zh.routine: （1动作）当来到焦油坑的先攻时，焦油坑将其内的每一个生物向下拉，让他们的身体粘上厚重的焦油。一个吞没到腰部的生物会被吞没到脖子，一个被吞没到脖子的生物会被吞没过头顶，必须屏住呼吸来避免窒息。焦油坑内的生物可以尝试@Check[athletics|dc:33]检定进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]，来让自己上浮一级（如果它被吞没到脖子或被吞没过头顶），或移动5尺（如果它仅被吞没到腰部）。大失败的情况下，该生物会下沉一级。其他生物可以协助该生物，通常可以采取使用绳子或类似的协助方式，或尝试进行@Check[athletics|dc:33]运动检定来把里面的生物拉出来，结果与该生物自己进行检定的结果相同。除了通常的结果以外，与焦油坑邻接而在协助检定中大失败的生物也会进入焦油坑。从焦油坑中攀爬出来的生物在邻接的空间登陆时处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]状态。

actions.description:
Trigger A creature enters the cavern

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is pushed back 5 feet.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is pushed back 15 feet.

Critical Failure As failure and the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} and knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到全额伤害，并被击退5尺。

大失败 如同失败，生物 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 Stunned 1} 并 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。
