Effect The barrel of debris tips over and showers broken glass down. The glass deals @Damage[3d8[slashing]] damage and @Damage[2[bleed]] damage(@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic|name:Dodge Falling Debris|traits:mechanical,trap] save) to all creatures within 10 feet.

fr.name: Surprise de Tok le Maître des pièges (3-4)
fr.description: Des panneaux sensibles à la pression dans le sol sont reliés à un baril de débris caché dans le plafond du couloir.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:23|name:Désamorcer les panneaux|traits:mechanical,trap] (qualifié) dans le sol avant que le baril ne se déverse.

zh.name: Trapmaster Tok's Surprise (3-4)
zh.description: Pressure sensitive panels in the floor connect to a barrel of debris hidden in the hallway's ceiling
zh.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:23|name:Disable Floor Panels|traits:mechanical,trap] (trained) on the floor panels before the barrel falls

pl.name: Trapmaster Tok's Surprise (3-4)
pl.description: Pressure sensitive panels in the floor connect to a barrel of debris hidden in the hallway's ceiling
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:23|name:Disable Floor Panels|traits:mechanical,trap] (trained) on the floor panels before the barrel falls

name: Trapped Elevator
description: An oversized cauldron rigged as an elevator suddenly drops 30 feet if it's overloaded.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:18] (trained) to lock the releasing mechanisms in place, or @Check[crafting|dc:20] to rig additional supports for the cauldron (this activity requires 10 minutes of work)
publication: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
reset: Creatures can still fall down the shaft even after the cauldron is released, but the cauldron must be reset manually.

actions.name: Release the Cauldron
actions.description:
Trigger More than one Medium or more than two Small creatures are inside the cauldron when it is activated to lower;

Effect The cauldron releases from its anchor points on the chains and drops 30 feet to area E1; any creatures within take 15 points of bludgeoning damage in the fall. A creature can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} to avoid falling by clinging to a chain.

pl.name: Trapped Elevator
pl.description: An oversized cauldron rigged as an elevator suddenly drops 30 feet if it's overloaded.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:18] (trained) to lock the releasing mechanisms in place, or @Check[crafting|dc:20] to rig additional supports for the cauldron (this activity requires 10 minutes of work)
pl.reset: Creatures can still fall down the shaft even after the cauldron is released, but the cauldron must be reset manually.

name: Trapped Gate
description: A hair trigger rings an alarm and launches a small assortment of wooden spikes to impale anyone attempting to open the gate incorrectly.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:15] (trained) to disable the thin trigger that snaps when attempting to open the gate.

actions.name: Impale Trespasser
actions.description:
Trigger A creature attempts to open the gate

Effect A loud alarm rings and set of wooden spikes swings up from below and over the gate, dealing @Damage[3d8[piercing]] damage to the triggering creature (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save). If the creature takes damage from the spikes, they also become Grabbed by the gate. The creature can attempt to [[/act escape dc=17]]. If the creature succeeded at their basic Reflex save, they gain a +1 circumstance bonus to their checks to Escape, as the spikes didn't fully impale them. If the creature critically failed their basic Reflex save, they take a –2 circumstance penalty to their checks to Escape, as the spikes are embedded particularly deep.

zh.name: Impale Trespasser
zh.description:
Trigger A creature attempts to open the gate

Effect A loud alarm rings and set of wooden spikes swings up from below and over the gate, dealing @Damage[3d8[piercing]] damage to the triggering creature (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save). If the creature takes damage from the spikes, they also become Grabbed by the gate. The creature can attempt to [[/act escape dc=17]]. If the creature succeeded at their basic Reflex save, they gain a +1 circumstance bonus to their checks to Escape, as the spikes didn't fully impale them. If the creature critically failed their basic Reflex save, they take a –2 circumstance penalty to their checks to Escape, as the spikes are embedded particularly deep.

pl.name: Trapped Gate
pl.description: A hair trigger rings an alarm and launches a small assortment of wooden spikes to impale anyone attempting to open the gate incorrectly.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:15] (trained) to disable the thin trigger that snaps when attempting to open the gate.

name: Trapped Lathe
description: The powered lathe's springs have been critically overwound so that when jostled or triggered, the lathe unwinds violently, hurling blades, gears, and sharp shards of metal around the room.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:31|name:Release the Spring Tension|traits:complex,mechanical,trap,hazard] (expert) on the lathe releases the tension on its springs without unleashing its blades and gears.
routine: (4 actions) The lathe attempts four sharpened fragment attacks against creatures in the room, selecting a target randomly from all available targets in area A1. The trap does not take multiple attack penalties for any of its attacks. The trap loses 1 action each turn as its springs wind down, and becomes disabled when it has 0 actions.
stealth: (expert); @Check[perception|dc:29|name:Notice the Line of Cord|traits:complex,mechanical,trap,hazard] to notice the line of cord running from the lathe's trigger toward the door to area A2.

actions.name: Unleash Fragments
actions.description:
Trigger The lathe is jostled or damaged, or its trigger is remotely pulled.

Effect The trap makes a sharpened fragment Strike against a random target in area A1, then rolls for initiative.

fr.name: Projection de fragments
fr.description:
Déclencheur Le tour est bousculé, endommagé, ou déclenché à distance.

Effet Le piège porte une Frappe de fragments aiguisés contre une cible aléatoire qui se trouve dans la zone A1, puis fait un jet d'initiative.

zh.name: 零件喷发 Unleash Fragments
zh.description:
触发 机床被碰撞、受到伤害或有人从远处拉扯它的触发器

效果 陷阱对区域A1内的1名随机目标进行尖锐零件打击，之后投掷先攻。

actions.name: Persistent Bleed Critical
actions.description: The sharpened fragments deal @Damage[1d8[bleed]] on a critical hit.

fr.name: Saignement sur coup critique
fr.description: Les fragments aiguisés infligent @Damage[1d8[bleed]]{1d8 dégâts de saignement} sur un coup critique.

zh.name: 重击流血 Persistent Bleed Critical
zh.description: 重击时造成@Damage[1d8[bleed]]伤害。

fr.name: Tour piégé
fr.description: Les ressorts du tour mécanique ont été tellement resserrés que, s'ils sont bousculés ou relâchés, le tour se met brusquement à tourner et projette des volées de lames, d'engrenages et d'éclats de métal dans toute la pièce.
fr.disable: Réussir un test de @Check[thievery|dc:31|name:Release the Spring Tension|traits:complex,mechanical,trap,hazard] (expert) permet de relâcher la tension des ressorts sans provoquer la rotation du tour et la projection des lames et des engrenages.
fr.routine: (4 actions). Le tour porte quatre attaques de fragments aiguisés contre les créatures qui se trouvent dans la pièce, en choisissant ses cibles aléatoirement parmi toutes les cibles qui se trouvent dans la zone A1. Le piège n'est soumis à aucune pénalité d'attaques multiples pour ses attaques. Le piège perd 1 action par tour, au fur et à mesure que ses ressorts se détendent, et il est désamorcé quand il se trouve à 0 action.
fr.stealth: Expert ; @Check[perception|dc:29|name:Remarquer la corde de la gâchette|traits:complex,mechanical,trap,hazard] pour remarquer la corde qui court de la gâchette du tour jusqu'à la porte menant à la zone A2.

zh.name: 机床陷阱 Trapped Lathe
zh.description: 这台动力机床上的弹簧绷得很紧，当它被推撞或触发时，机床会一下子松开，将刀片、齿轮和锋利的金属片一股脑向着房间各处迸射。
zh.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:31|name:Release the Spring Tension|traits:complex,mechanical,trap,hazard]（专家）能够在车床上的弹簧张力施放掉的同时却不触动上面的刀片和齿轮。
zh.routine: （4个动作） 机床尝试4次尖锐零件攻击对抗房间内的生物，从区域A1 内所有可选目标中随机选择一个目标。陷阱的任何攻击都不会承受多重攻击减值。随着弹簧的力量被释放出来变得越来越松，陷阱每个回合会失去一个动作，最终在只具有0个动作时便会被解除。
zh.stealth: （专家）; @Check[perception|dc:29|name:Notice the Line of Cord|traits:complex,mechanical,trap,hazard] 能注意到有一条线绳从机床的触发器上一直延伸至通往区域A2的门后。

pl.name: Trapped Lathe
pl.description: The powered lathe's springs have been critically overwound so that when jostled or triggered, the lathe unwinds violently, hurling blades, gears, and sharp shards of metal around the room.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:31|name:Release the Spring Tension|traits:complex,mechanical,trap,hazard] (expert) on the lathe releases the tension on its springs without unleashing its blades and gears.
pl.routine: (4 actions) The lathe attempts four sharpened fragment attacks against creatures in the room, selecting a target randomly from all available targets in area A1. The trap does not take multiple attack penalties for any of its attacks. The trap loses 1 action each turn as its springs wind down, and becomes disabled when it has 0 actions.
pl.stealth: (expert); @Check[perception|dc:29|name:Notice the Line of Cord|traits:complex,mechanical,trap,hazard] to notice the line of cord running from the lathe's trigger toward the door to area A2.

name: Trapped Portcullis
description: Two portcullises drop down to block progress through this area.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:33] (master) to disable the trigger that causes the portcullises to drop
reset: The trap can be manually reset with a 10-minute Manipulate activity performed in the hallways to the east or west of this area, as long as neither portcullis is broken or destroyed.

actions.name: Drop From Ceiling
actions.description:
Trigger A character enters a square between the two portcullises

Effect Both portcullises drop from the ceiling; attempting to lift one requires a @Check[athletics|dc:30] check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open}. When the portcullises drop, creatures in adjacent squares must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:30|traits:damaging-effect] save.

Critical Success The creature is unharmed and can take a Step as a reaction to move to an adjacent square.

Success As critical success, but the creature takes a glancing blow from the falling portcullis for @Damage[(2d12+15)[bludgeoning]] damage.

Failure The creature is struck by the falling portcullis for @Damage[(4d12+30)[bludgeoning]] damage and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} in their square.

Critical Failure The creature is struck by the falling portcullis for @Damage[(6d12+45)[bludgeoning]] damage, is knocked prone, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} by the portcullis as it pins them to the ground until they can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} or Force Open the portcullis (DC 30, Athletics).

fr.name: Tomber du plafond
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature pénètre la case qui se situe entre les deux herses.

Effet Les deux herses tombent du plafond. Pour essayer d'en relever une demande un test d'@Check[athletics|dc:30] pour l'@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Ouvrir de force}. Lorsque les herses tombent, les créatures dans les cases adjacentes doivent tenter un jet @Check[reflex|dc:30|traits:damaging-effect].

Succès critique La créature ne subit pas de dégâts et peut Faire un pas pour se déplacer sur une case adjacente.

SuccèsComme en cas de succès critique, mais la créature prend un coup de côté de la herse qui tombe, subissant @Damage[(2d12+15)[bludgeoning]]{2d12+15 dégâts contondants}.

Échec La créature est touchée par la herse qui tombe, subissant @Damage[(4d12+30)[bludgeoning]]{4d12 dégâts contondants} et est renversée @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{À terre}.

Échec critique La créature est touchée par la herse qui tombe, subissant @Damage[(6d12+45)[bludgeoning]]{6d10+45 dégâts contondants}, est renversée À terre, et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilisée} par la herse qui la cloue au sol jusqu'à ce qu'elle puisse [[/act escape dc=30]]{S'Échapper} ou [[/act force-open dc=30]]{Ouvrir de force} la herse (test d'@Check[athletics|dc:30]).

zh.name: 从房顶落下 Drop From Ceiling
zh.description:
触发 有角色进入到两道闸门之间的方格内

效果 两道闸门均会从房顶中落下；尝试抬起一道闸门需要@Check[athletics|dc:30]检定进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]。在闸门落下时，位于相邻方格内的生物必须尝试@Check[reflex|dc:30|traits:damaging-effect]豁免。

大成功 生物没有受到伤害，而且能以反应动作进行一次快步来移动至相邻的方格。

成功 同大成功，但是生物由于闸门落下的擦伤而承受@Damage[(2d12+15)[bludgeoning]]伤害。

失败 生物被落下的闸门砸中，造成@Damage[(4d12+30)[bludgeoning]]伤害，并且被@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{击倒}在自身所在的方格内。

大失败 生物被落下的闸门砸中，造成@Damage[(6d12+45)[bludgeoning]]伤害，被闸门击倒在地面上，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]，持续至这些生物[[/act escape dc=30]]或[[/act force-open dc=30]]闸门为止。

fr.name: Herse piégée
fr.description: Deux herses se referment pour bloquer le passage dans la zone.
fr.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:33] (maître) pour désactiver le piège qui fait tomber les herses.
fr.reset: Le piège peut être réactivé manuellement avec une activité de 10 minutes qui possède le trait Manipulation effectué à l'est ou à l'ouest de cette zone, pour autant qu'aucune herse n'a été cassée ou détruite.

zh.name: 闸门陷阱 Trapped Portcullis
zh.description: 两道闸门落下来，阻碍他人穿过该区域
zh.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:33]（大师）可以解除让闸门落下的触发机关
zh.reset: 陷阱可以通过10分钟的操作行动来重置，除非闸门已经损坏或被摧毁了。

pl.name: Uwięziona Brona
pl.description: Dwie opuszczane kraty blokują przejście przez obszar.
pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:33] (mistrzowski), aby wyłączyć wyzwalacz, który powoduje opuszczenie krat.
pl.reset: Pułapka może zostać ręcznie zresetowana w trakcie 10-minutowej aktywności Manipulacji, wykonywanej w korytarzach na wschód lub zachód od tego obszaru, pod warunkiem, że żadna z krat nie jest uszkodzona, ani zniszczona.

name: Treacherous Quagmire
description: A patch of treacherous bog attempts to submerge creatures that step onto it.
disable: @Check[survival|dc:18|name:Disturb Surface|traits:secret,action:sense-direction,exploration] (trained) to disturb the surface and make the quagmire plainly visible.
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-08: Revolution on the Riverside
reset: The hazard still submerges anyone who walks in, but the surface doesn't become hidden again until it settles over the course of 24 hours
routine:
(1 action) On its initiative, the quagmire pulls each creature within it 1 square toward the center of the quagmire and 1 step further submerged; a creature that is submerged up to its waist becomes submerged up to its neck, and a creature that is submerged up to its neck is pulled under and has to hold its breath to avoid suffocation.

A creature in the quagmire can attempt a @Check[athletics|dc:20|name:Swim Out of Quagmire|traits:environmental,hazard,action:swim] check to Swim to either raise itself by 1 step if its submerged to its neck or worse, or to swim out of the quagmire if its submerged up to only its waist. On a critical failure, the creature is pulled down 1 step. A creature that Swims out of the quagmire escapes the hazard and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} adjacent to the quagmire. Other creatures can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} the creature, typically by using a rope or similar tool, or attempt to pull a creature within their reach out with a @Check[athletics|dc:20|name:Pull Out of Quagmire|traits:environmental,hazard,action:aid] check, with the same results as if the creature attempted the check.

actions.name: Submerge
actions.description:
Trigger A Small or larger creature walks into a quagmire.

Effect The triggering creature sinks into the quagmire up to its waist in its current square. The quagmire rolls initiative if it hasn't already.

fr.name: Submerger
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature de taille Petite ou supérieure marche dans le bourbier.

Effet La créature déclencheuse commence à sombrer dans le bourbier jusqu'à la taille dans la case où elle se trouve. Puis le bourbier lance l'initiative si il ne l'a pas déjà fait.

zh.name: Submerge
zh.description:
Trigger A Small or larger creature walks into a quagmire.

Effect The triggering creature sinks into the quagmire up to its waist in its current square. The quagmire rolls initiative if it hasn't already.

fr.name: Bourbier perfide
fr.description: Un dangereux bourbier tente de submerger les créatures qui s'y aventurent.
fr.disable: @Check[survival|dc:18|name:Découvrir la surface|traits:secret,action:sense-direction,exploration] (qualifé) pour déranger et découvrir la surface pour que le bourbier soit totalement visible.
fr.reset: Le danger submerge toujours les personnes qui s'y aventurent, mais la surface ne redevient cachée que lorsqu'elle s'est stabilisée au cours des 24 heures suivantes
fr.routine:
(Une action) A son initiative, le bourbier tire vers le bas chaque créature qui s'y trouve. Une créature qui était immergée jusqu'à la taille le devient jusqu'au cou, et une créature qui était immergée jusqu'au cou est tirée vers dans l'eau boueuse et doit retenir sa respiration pour éviter de suffoquer.

Une créature immergée partiellement dans le bourbier doit tenter un test d'@Check[athletics|dc:20|name:Nager dans le bourbier|traits:environmental,hazard,action:swim] pour soit Nager, soit tenter de se relever d'un cran (si elle est sous l'eau boueuse pour se retrouver immergée jusqu'au cou ou si immergé jusqu'au cou se retrouver immergée jusqu'à la taille, ou s'échapper du bourbier si seulement submergée jusqu'à la taille). Le DD du test augmente à @Check[athletics|dc:25|traits:action:swim] pour les créatures immergée jusqu'au cou ou en-dessous. En cas d'échec critique, la créature est tirée d'un cran vers le bas. Les autres créatures peuvent utiliser l'action @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aider}, en utilisant une corde ou assistance similaire (à condition d'obtenir un succès automatique), ou tenter de faire sortir une seule créature avec son propre test d'Athlétisme, avec les mêmes résultats que si la créature aidante avait fait le test elle-même.

name: Treacherous Scree
description: The footing on this sloped ground appears to be stable at first glance, but the tiny rocks that cover it are loosely packed and prone to slipping.
disable: @Check[survival|dc:20|name:Navigate Safe Path] (trained) to navigate a safe path

actions.name: Rockslide
actions.description:
Trigger A creature steps on the unstable ground.

Effect Rocks tumble and slip beneath its feet. The triggering creature must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:21|traits:damaging-effect] save as they tumble against the rocks, which deal @Damage[(2d10+13)[bludgeoning]] damage.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage and falls prone in its space.

Failure The creature takes full damage, falls prone in its space, and tumbles down to the bottom of the slope.

Critical Failure As failure, but double damage.

fr.name: Passage dans la terre
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature marche sur le sol instable.

Effet Les pierres se dérobent sous ses pieds. La créature ayant déclenché le danger doit tenter un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:21|traits:damaging-effect] lorsqu'elle doit éviter d'être entraînée par les rochers ce qui lui inflige @Damage[(2d10+13)[bludgeoning]]{2d10+13 dégâts contondants}.

Succès critique La créature ne subit pas de dégât.

Succès La créature subit la moitié des dégâts et tombe à terre dans son espace.

Échec La créature subit la totalité des dégâts, tombe à terre dans son espace et dévale jusqu'en bas de la pente.

Échec critique Comme en cas d'échec mais les dégâts sont doublés.

zh.name: 岩崩 Rockslide
zh.description:
触发 一个生物走上不稳定的地表；

效果 岩石崩落导致触发的生物跌倒，并造成@Damage[(2d10+13)[bludgeoning]]{2d10+13钝击伤害}，该生物必须尝试一次@Check[reflex|dc:21|traits:damaging-effect]豁免。

大成功 该生物不受伤害。

成功 该生物受到一半的伤害，并且在它占据的空间内倒地。

失败 生物受到全伤害，在它占据的空间内倒地，并且滚落至斜坡下方。

zh.disable: @Check[survival|dc:20|name:Navigate Safe Path] （受训）找到一条安全路径

pl.name: Zdradzieckie Osypisko
pl.description: Podłoże na tym pochyłym terenie na pierwszy rzut oka wydaje się stabilne, ale drobne skały, które je pokrywają, są luźno upakowane i podatne na poślizgnięcia.

name: Treacherous Scree
description: The footing on this sloped ground appears to be stable at first glance, but the tiny rocks that cover it are loosely packed and prone to slipping.
disable: @Check[survival|dc:20] (trained) to navigate a safe path
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-16: The Heart of the City

actions.name: Rockslide
actions.description:
Trigger A creature steps on the unstable ground

Effect Rocks tumble and slip beneath its feet. The triggering creature must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:21] save as they tumble against the rocks, which deal @Damage[(2d10+13)[bludgeoning]] damage.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage and falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} in its space.

Failure The creature takes full damage, falls prone in its space, and tumbles down to the bottom of the slope.

Critical Failure As failure, but double damage.

fr.name: Passage dans la terre
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature marche sur le sol instable.

Effet Les pierres se dérobent sous ses pieds. La créature ayant déclenché le danger doit tenter un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:21|traits:damaging-effect] lorsqu'elle doit éviter d'être entraînée par les rochers ce qui lui inflige @Damage[(2d10+13)[bludgeoning]]{2d10+13 dégâts contondants}.

Succès critique La créature ne subit pas de dégât.

Succès La créature subit la moitié des dégâts et tombe à terre dans son espace.

Échec La créature subit la totalité des dégâts, tombe à terre dans son espace et dévale jusqu'en bas de la pente.

Échec critique Comme en cas d'échec mais les dégâts sont doublés.

name: Treasure Avalanche
description: A large pile of treasure trembles precariously, threatening to collapse down into a crashing wave of coins and fine objects.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:16] (trained) to remove the right pieces from the treasure pile and induce a controlled collapse.

actions.name: Flood
actions.description:
Trigger A creature moves within 5 feet of the treasure pile

Effect Treasure slides down the side of the triggering creature in a large wave. All creatures within 15 feet of the falling treasure must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:16] save as an onslaught of treasures bears down on them, dealing @Damage[(2d6+5)[bludgeoning]] damage.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is trapped in treasure, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} until they @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} the collapsed treasure (DC 16).

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is buried in treasure, requiring another creature to dig them out of the treasure before they can Escape.

fr.name: Effondrement
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature se déplace à 1,50 mètre du trésor.

Effet Le tas de trésor glisse vers la créature déclencheuse dans une grande vague. Toutes les créatures dans les 4,50 mètres du trésor qui s'effondre doivent tenter un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:16] alors qu'un fracas de trésors leur tombe dessus, infligeant @Damage[(2d6+5)[bludgeoning]]{2d6+5 dégâts contondants}.

Succès critique La créature ne subit aucun dégât.

Succès La créature subit la moitié des dégâts.

Échec La créature subit la totalité des dégâts et est enterrée dans le trésor, ce qui la rend @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilisée} jusqu'à ce qu'elle @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{S'Échappe} du tas de trésors effondré (DD 16).

Échec critique La créature subit la totalité des dégâts et est enterrée dans le trésor effondré et nécessite l'aide d'une autre créature pour la déterrer avant qu'elle ne puisse S'échapper.

fr.name: Avalanche de trésors
fr.description: Un grand tas de trésors précairement empilés, vacille et menace de s'effonder dans une vague de pièces et d'objets d'art.

name: Tree of Dreadful Dreams
description: The statue of the willow tree animates, its branches lashing out to try to grab anyone in area B2.
disable: @Check[athletics|dc:25|name:Force Open a Branch|traits:complex,magical,trap,hazard,action:force-open] or @Check[thievery|dc:25|name:Lever Open a Branch|traits:complex,magical,trap,hazard] (trained) to force or lever open a single branch, disabling that branch and freeing any creature trapped within. @Check[thievery|dc:29|name:Disrupt the Tree's Magical Animation|traits:complex,magical,trap,hazard] (expert) to disrupt the tree's magical animation, shut it down, and free all trapped creatures. Placing a dreamstone in the tree's trunk takes 2 Interact actions and causes the trap to shut down, freeing all trapped creatures. Placing the cursed dreamstone from area B4 in the trunk instead increases the tree's actions per turn to 4 and gives it a +2 item bonus to all saving throws and attack rolls.
reset: The trap deactivates and resets if it has no creatures @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} and no creatures in the room to attack. If an uncursed dreamstone is placed in its trunk, the statue doesn't reactivate.
routine: (3 actions) The statue uses each action to attempt a branch Strike against a random creature in the room that it hasn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}. If there are no creatures for it to attack and it has at least one creature grabbed, it instead Constricts. The trap can have up to six creatures grabbed.

actions.name: Terrifying Visions
actions.description: A creature that begins its turn grabbed by the trap experiences vivid, warped visions of true events and must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:31|traits:damaging-effect] save or take @Damage[4d8[mental]] damage. On a critical failure, the creature also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 24 hours.

fr.name: Visions terrifiantes
fr.description: Une créature qui débute son tour en étant agrippée par l'arbre est soumise à des visions vivaces et déformées d'événements réels et elle doit réussir un jet de @Check[will|dc:31|traits:damaging-effect] pour éviter de subir @Damage[4d8[mental]]{4d8 dégâts mentaux}. En cas d'échec critique, la créature se trouve également dans l'état @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Condamnée 1}. Une créature qui réussit son jet de sauvegarde est temporairement immunisée pendant 24 heures.

zh.name: Terrifying Visions 恐怖幻象
zh.description: 若生物的回合开始时受擒于陷阱的话，会体验生动的真实事件的扭曲幻象，必须成功通过@Check[will|dc:31|traits:damaging-effect]豁免，失败则会承受@Damage[4d8[mental]]伤害。大失败时，该生物还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭 Doomed 1}。成功通过豁免的生物会获得持续 24 小时的临时免疫。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.AttackOfOpportunity]

actions.name: Independent Limbs
actions.description: Any creature struck by the tree's Branch strike are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}. Additionally the tree's Branch strikes do not suffer from multiple attack penalties.

fr.name: Membres indépendants
fr.description: Toute créature touchée par les branches de l'arbre est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agrippée}. De plus les branches ne souffrent pas de pénalité d'attaques multiples.

zh.name: 单独枝抽 Independent Limbs
zh.description: 任何被树枝打击命中的生物会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]。此外树枝打击不承受多重攻击减值。

fr.name: Arbre des rêves effroyables
fr.description: La statue du saule s'anime et ses branches fouettent l'air en tentant d'agripper les créatures qui se trouvent dans la zone B2.
fr.disable: Un test d'@Check[athletics|dc:25|name:Force Open a Branch|traits:complex,magical,trap,hazard,action:force-open] ou de @Check[thievery|dc:25|name:Lever Open a Branch|traits:complex,magical,trap,hazard] (qualifié) pour desserrer l'étreinte d'une branche ou la soulever et libérer la créature emprisonnée. Un test de @Check[thievery|dc:29|name:Disrupt the Tree's Magical Animation|traits:complex,magical,trap,hazard] (expert) afin d'interrompre l'animation magique de l'arbre, le désactiver et libérer toutes les créatures emprisonnées. Placer une pierre onirique dans le tronc de l'arbre grâce à 2 actions d'Interaction permet de le désactiver et de libérer toutes les créatures emprisonnées. Placer la pierre onirique maudite récupérée dans la zone B4 dans le tronc permet par contre à l'arbre de bénéficier de 4 actions par tour et d'un bonus d'objet de +2 à tous ses jets de sauvegarde et d'attaque.
fr.reset: Le piège se désactive et se réinitialise si aucune créature ne se trouve dans la pièce et que l'arbre n'a aucune créature agrippée entre ses branches. La statue ne se réactive pas si une pierre onirique non maudite est placée dans son tronc.
fr.routine: (3 actions). La statue utilise chacune de ses actions pour porter une Frappe de branche contre une créature déterminée aléatoirement, qui se trouve dans la pièce et qu'il n'a pas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agrippée}. S'il n'a aucune créature à attaquer et qu'il agrippe au moins une créature, il utilise alors Constriction. Le piège peut agripper jusqu'à six créatures à la fois.

zh.name: 恐怖梦境之树 Tree of Dreadful Dreams
zh.description: 柳树雕塑活化起来，它的枝条试图抓住区域B2内的任何人。
zh.disable: @Check[athletics|dc:25|name:Force Open a Branch|traits:complex,magical,trap,hazard,action:force-open]或@Check[thievery|dc:25|name:Lever Open a Branch|traits:complex,magical,trap,hazard]（受训）能够用蛮力或用杠杆的方式撬开单根树枝，解除这根树枝并解放被困于其中的任何生物。@Check[thievery|dc:29|name:Disrupt the Tree's Magical Animation|traits:complex,magical,trap,hazard]（专家）能够扰乱柳树的魔法流通，关闭它，并释放所有被困的生物。将梦境石安置在树干上需要两个交互动作，而这会使陷阱关闭，释放所有被困的生物。若将区域B4内的被诅咒的梦境石放置到树干上反而会将柳树每个回合的动作增加到4个，并使它在所有豁免检定以及攻击检定中获得+2物品加值。
zh.reset: 当没有生物被陷阱@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]，房间内也没有生物可供攻击时，则陷阱关闭并重置。若未被诅咒的梦境石被安置在树干上，该雕像就不会被再次激活。
zh.routine: (3个动作） 雕像会使用每个动作来尝试树枝打击对抗一名房间内还未被@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]的随机生物。若没有生物可供攻击，但至少有一名生物被擒抱的话，它会使用紧勒取代树枝打击动作。该陷阱至多擒抱6名生物。

name: Trial of the Gods
description: What appears to be an eye opens within the glowing orb near the ceiling.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:43] (master) to deactivate the glowing orb and prevent it from observing the room, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (9th rank; counteract DC 36) to counteract the trial, @Check[religion|dc:45] (master) to perform a complex 5-round candle-lighting ritual, or placing General Ordulf's religious symbol on an empty hook on any wall as an Interact action
reset: Once the room is empty of creatures, the trial deactivates and then resets after 1 minute has passed.
routine: (1 action; death, emotion, fear, mental) The red eye glances at a randomly determined creature in area B3 that it can see and is not engaged in a candle-lighting ritual, then casts a 9th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Jmxru8zMdYMRuO5n]{Vision of Death} on that target, causing them to experience the sight of Achaekek rising up from the ground to smite the transgressor for failing to honor the gods.

actions.name: Wrath of the Gods
actions.description:
Trigger A creature attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock} on the eastern door, or ends a turn in this room while not performing the candle-lighting ritual

Effect A glowing red eye manifests in the ceiling mounted orb to stare angrily at the triggering creature, who must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:46] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure). The Trial of the Gods then rolls initiative.

zh.name: 诸神之怒 Wrath of the Gods
zh.description:
触发 一个生物尝试对东门进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]，或在未执行烛光仪式的前提下在房间内结束其回合

效果 天花板上的宝珠中出现一只发光的红眼，愤怒地死死盯着触发生物，该生物必须成功通过@Check[will|dc:46]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}（大失败陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 2}）。之后诸神试炼骰先攻。

name: Trial of Tolerance
description: A convincing illusion of a bustling market scene fills the empty room, confronting the viewers with potentially frightening diversity and unexpected encounters.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:43] (master) to scratch out well-hidden key runes etched into the room's floor, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (9th rank; counteract DC 36) to counteract the trial
reset: Once the room is empty of creatures, the trial deactivates and then resets after 1 minute has passed.

If the target has a type of fear or hatred toward a specific kind of creature, this unexpected figure epitomizes those fears and hatreds. The target must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:46|traits:emotion,fear,illusion,mental] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure). If any creature in the room takes any hostile action against the intimidating figure, the Trial of Tolerance uses its Reflective Violence reaction. Once three rounds pass without the Trial of Tolerance using Reflective Violence, the hazard deactivates.

actions.name: Unveil the Bazaar
actions.description:
Trigger A creature begins its turn in area B2

Effect A convincing illusion of an Ilizmagorti city bazaar appears, complete with a cloudless blue sky above. The surrounding crowd is dense, and the smells and sights and sounds are quite realistic even as no one in the crowd actually bumps against the PCs as they mill about. The Trial of Tolerance then rolls initiative.

zh.name: 集市亮相 Unveil the Bazaar
zh.description:
触发 一个生物在B2区域开始其回合

效果 伊利兹马格罗提城中的集市出现了，栩栩如生，天空万里无云。周遭人流密集，气味、景象和声音都无比真实，但没有人在PC周围走动时撞到他们。之后忍耐试炼骰先攻。

actions.name: Reflective Violence
actions.description:
Trigger A creature uses a hostile action against an illusory figure created by the Trial of Tolerance or fails at an attempt to disable the trap

Effect The illusory figure effortlessly avoids the triggering action, then appears to attack the triggering creature using its most harrowing and violent option. Regardless of what this attack appears as, the triggering creature takes @Damage[(3d12+19)[mental]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:38|basic] save).

zh.name: 暴力映射 Reflective Violence
zh.description:
触发 一个生物对忍耐试炼生成的幻觉形象采取敌对行动，或在解除陷阱的尝试中失败

效果 幻觉形象毫不费力地避开触发动作，之后用它最能造成痛苦的暴力手段攻击触发生物。不管这次攻击的表象如何，触发生物承受@Damage[(3d12+19)[mental]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:38|basic]豁免）。

zh.name: 忍耐试炼 Trial of Tolerance

pl.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:43] (master) to scratch out well-hidden key runes etched into the room's floor, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (9th rank; counteract DC 36) to counteract the trial
pl.reset: Once the room is empty of creatures, the trial deactivates and then resets after 1 minute has passed.

name: Trinity Star
description: A blazing comet with three tails—one red, one black, and one with rainbow hues—careens throughout the area.
disable: @Check[athletics|dc:48] (legendary) to grab one of the comet's tails and rip it free; @Check[occultism|dc:45] or @Check[religion|dc:45] (master) to exorcise the divine energy of the red tail (which is infused with Gorum's legacy) or the black tail (infused with the nihilism of Abaddon's Eclipse); @Check[arcana|dc:45] (master) to unweave the magic of the rainbow tail (Xanderghul's mythic power); or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (9th rank; counteract DC 36) to counteract one of the tails. Each tail must be disabled separately to disable the hazard.
reset:
(1 action) The Trinity Star flies at a speed of 60 feet, moving through the spaces of as many creatures as possible. Each creature the Trinity Star moves through must make a @Check[reflex|dc:42] save with the following results.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[6d6[force]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[11d6[force]] damage and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[22d6[force]] damage, is knocked prone, and if the creature is mythic, they lose 1 Mythic Point. If the Trinity Star has lost any of its tails, it regrows one of them (chosen at random if it's lost two tails).

actions.name: Starform
actions.description:
Trigger Dream Aethusa has been dead for 10 minutes

Effect Dream Aethusa's body is consumed with mythic energy, transforming into a comet with three blazing tails. All creatures within 120 feet must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:40] save to resist becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} permanently on a critical failure). The hazard then rolls initiative.

zh.name: 星体形态 Starform
zh.description:
触发 梦境阿图萨已死亡10分钟

效果 梦境阿图萨的身体被神话能量吞噬，变成一颗带有三条燃烧尾巴的彗星。120尺内的所有生物必须进行DC 40的@Check[fortitude|dc:40]，失败则@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]1分钟（大失败则永久@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]）。然后危害骰先攻。

name: Trip Wire
description: Barbed wire stretches across the passageway at the perfect height to tear into ankles.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:17] (trained) to detach the wire
publication: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril

actions.description:
Trigger A creature walks into the trip wire

Effect The trip wire snaps free and coils around limbs. The triggering creature must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:20] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 hour.

fr.name: Enchevêtrement
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature se prend le fil d'acier

Effet Le fil d'acier se détache et s'enroule autour des membres. La créature déclencheuse doit tenter un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:20]. Si la créature obtient un échec, elle est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Maladroite 1} pendant 1 heure.

fr.description: Le fil de fer barbelé est tendu à travers le passage à la hauteur idéale pour lacérer les chevilles.

name: Trump of the Oliphaunt
description: An overwhelming trumpeting sound vibrates and suffuses the area, causing everything to slow.
disable: @Check[arcana|dc:38|name:Shore Up the Area] (expert), @Check[maelstrom-lore|dc:38|name:Shore Up the Area] (expert), @Check[occultism|dc:38|name:Shore Up the Area] (master), @Check[religion|dc:38|name:Shore Up the Area] (master) to recognize and shore up the area against the localized planar instability causing a connection to the Oliphaunt of Jandelay. Four successes are needed to strengthen the area enough against the instability to end the hazard.
reset: The area becomes unstable again after 24 hours.
routine:
(1 action) Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:36] save. A creature with the slowed condition from this hazard takes a –2 circumstance penalty on further saves against this effect.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[(2d6+6)[sonic]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(4d6+13)[sonic]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 2 rounds.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[(8d6+26)[sonic]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 2 rounds.
stealth: (master) to notice the tension of a low vibration forming in the area from the imminent release of the Oliphaunt's trumpet

actions.description:
Trigger Three or more characters enter the area of planar instability

Effect Pent-up magical energy from another world begins to release in waves of overwhelming sound. The hazard rolls initiative.

name: Turbulent Koi Egg
description: A raging storm covers the mountain lake as spring water levitates from the lake to fall back down in a driving spiral of steaming rain. In the depths of the storm, barely visible, is a tiny koi egg surrounded by three bands of water.
disable: @Check[arcana|dc:27], @Check[religion|dc:27], @Check[nature|dc:27], or @Check[occultism|dc:27] to purify the magic corrupting the ascension ritual, or @Check[diplomacy|dc:30] or @Check[performance|dc:30] to soothe the spirit within the koi egg and give it the strength to fight off the corruption itself; four total successes are required to purify the ritual, each of the first three successes purifying one ring of water and the final one halting the ritual itself. If the cursed comb has not been removed from the ritual site, then succeeding on this final check merely halts the ritual; if the cursed comb has been removed from the ritual site, then succeeding on this final check completes the ascension ritual.
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-11: The Godsrain and the Dragon
reset: The turbulent koi egg can attempt to hatch again, restarting the ascension ritual, after 1000 years of Xalreonshin's care.
routine: (1 action) Torrential water descends from the sky, taking the shape of a dragon that smashes into one creature within 60 feet of the egg. The dragon always targets the creature that is closest to the egg, dealing @Damage[2d10[bludgeoning],2d10[fire]]{2d10 bludgeoning damage and 2d10 fire} damage in a spray of boiling water (@Check[fortitude|dc:26] save). Creatures that fail the save are pushed 10 feet away. Creatures that have the earth trait, are carrying an item with the earth trait, or are otherwise strongly tied to elemental earth (such as an earth elemental sorcerer or kineticist) get the result one degree of success better than the outcome of their save, as the power of elemental earth overcomes water.

actions.name: Immune to All Damage (Until Final Ring is Purified)

fr.name: Immunité contre tous les dégâts (jusqu'à ce que le dernier anneau soit purifié)

actions.name: Raise the Storm
actions.description:
Trigger Xalreonshin rolls initiative, three rounds pass after the PCs begin speaking with Xalreonshin, or a creature other than Xalreonshin comes within 40 feet of the egg

Effect The turbulent koi egg churns the lake surface, ejecting water into the sky. A 1-mile-radius area centered on the egg becomes filled with heavy rain and strong wind imposing a -2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks and requiring flying creatures to [[/act maneuver-in-flight dc=22]].

fr.name: Provoquer la tempête
fr.description:
Déclencheur Xalreonshin lance l'initiative, trois rounds s'écoulent après que les PJ ont commencé à parler avec Xalreonshin, ou une créature autre que Xalreonshin s'approche à moins de 12 mètres de l'œuf

Effet L'œuf de koï turbulent agite la surface du lac, projetant de l'eau vers le ciel. Une zone de 1,6 km de rayon centrée sur l'œuf est recouverte d'une pluie torrentielle et de vents violents, infligeant une pénalité de circonstances de -2 aux tests de Perception et obligeant les créatures volantes à [[/act maneuver-in-flight dc=22]].

fr.name: Oeuf de koï turbulent
fr.description: Une tempête déchaînée recouvre le lac montagneux tandis que des eaux printanières s'élèvent du lac pour retomber en une spirale tourbillonnante de pluie fumante. Dans les profondeurs de la tempête, à peine visible, se trouve un minuscule œuf de koï entouré de trois anneaux d'eau.
fr.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:27], @Check[religion|dc:27], @Check[nature|dc:27] ou @Check[occultism|dc:27] pour purifier la magie corrompant le rituel d'ascension, ou @Check[diplomacy|dc:30] ou @Check[performance|dc:30] pour apaiser l'esprit à l'intérieur de l'œuf de koï et lui donner la force de lutter contre la corruption elle-même ; quatre succès au total sont nécessaires pour purifier le rituel, chacun des trois premiers succès purifiant un anneau d'eau et le dernier arrêtant le rituel lui-même. Si le peigne maudit n'a pas été retiré du site du rituel, alors réussir ce dernier test ne fait que stopper le rituel ; si le peigne maudit a été retiré du site du rituel, alors réussir ce dernier test achève le rituel d'ascension.
fr.reset: L'œuf de koï turbulent peut tenter d'éclore à nouveau, redémarrant le rituel d'ascension, après 1000 ans de soins de Xalreonshin.
fr.routine: (1 action) De l'eau torrentielle descend du ciel, prenant la forme d'un dragon qui s'écrase sur une créature dans un rayon de 60 pieds de l'œuf. Le dragon cible toujours la créature la plus proche de l'œuf, infligeant @Damage[2d10[bludgeoning],2d10[fire]]{2d10 dégâts contondants et 2d10 de feu} dans un jet d'eau bouillante (@Check[fortitude|dc:26]). Les créatures qui échouent à la sauvegarde sont repoussées de 10 pieds. Les créatures ayant le trait terre, portant un objet avec le trait terre, ou étant fortement liées à la terre élémentaire (comme un sorcier ou kineticiste de la terre) obtiennent un résultat d'un cran supérieur à leur jet, car le pouvoir de la terre élémentaire surpasse celui de l'eau.

name: Tusk Mountains Avalanche
description: Snow and ice gathered at the peaks of the mountain come crashing down in an explosive wave.
disable: Three @Check[crafting|dc:34] or @Check[engineering-lore|dc:34] (expert) to create cover for a 10-foot square area and shelter from the avalanche; a flying creature can attempt a @Check[acrobatics|dc:29] check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Qf1ylAbdVi1rkc8M]{Maneuver in Flight} to avoid the avalanche

actions.name: Cascade
actions.description:
Trigger The zombie mammoth horde moves beneath the peaks

Effect An avalanche of snow and ice cascades down the mountainside at astonishing speed. All creatures on the ground within a 200-foot radius must attempt @Check[reflex|dc:30] saves.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] damage and @Damage[4d6[cold]] damage.

Failure The creature is swept away, moving 200 feet down the mountainside, and takes @Damage[8d6[bludgeoning]] damage and @Damage[8d6[cold]] damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is also buried, taking an additional @Damage[2d6[bludgeoning]] damage and then @Damage[1d6[cold]] damage per minute of burial. Locating a buried creature requires a @Check[perception|dc:28] or @Check[survival|dc:28] check; once located, a buried creature can be extricated with a @Check[athletics|dc:28] check in one round or dug out with a @Check[athletics|dc:23] check with 4 minutes of work.

zh.name: 瀑流 Cascade
zh.description:
触发 丧尸猛犸象群在山峰之下移动

效果 一场惊人的雪崩从山坡上以惊人的速度倾泻而下。半径200 尺范围内的所有地面生物必须进行 @Check[reflex|dc:30] 豁免。

大成功 该生物不受伤害。

成功该生物受到 @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] 伤害和 @Damage[4d6[cold]] 伤害。

失败该生物被卷走，沿着山坡向下移动200 尺，并受到 @Damage[8d6[bludgeoning]] 伤害和 @Damage[8d6[cold]] 伤害。

大失败 如同失败，但生物还被掩埋，每轮额外承受 @Damage[2d6[bludgeoning]] 伤害，且每被掩埋一分钟再承受 @Damage[1d6[cold]] 伤害。找到被掩埋的生物需要进行一次 @Check[perception|dc:28] 或 @Check[survival|dc:28] 检定；一旦找到，可以通过一次@Check[athletics|dc:28] 检定在一轮内将其救出，或者通过一次@Check[athletics|dc:23] 检定在四分钟内将其挖出。

zh.name: 獠牙山脉雪崩 Tusk Mountains Avalanche
zh.description: 积聚在山顶的冰雪如爆发的巨浪倾泻而下。

name: Twist of Fate
description: Seldeg's ritual nears its conclusion, causing magical energy to arc erratically between the ritual circles.
disable: @Check[arazni-lore|dc:44] or @Check[iomedae-lore|dc:44] to recount a tale from history that grounds that deity in the current reality, @Check[crafting|dc:50] (legendary) to create a device to siphon energy from the ritual circle, or @Check[religion|dc:46] (legendary) to discharge the escalating divine energy; six successes (three successes per circle) are required to disarm the hazard.
reset: While atop the floating platform, Seldeg Bhedlis can use a 3-action activity with the auditory trait to reenergize the ritual. Doing so removes one success to disable the hazard and immediately triggers the hazard's Reorder Reality reaction.
routine:
(1 action; divine) The divine energy gathered by the ritual spikes. One of the eleven stained-glass windows (each depicting one of her Eleven Acts) transforms to feature Arazni instead. Any creature that can see the window change must attempt a @Check[will|dc:50] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is immune to this effect for 10 minutes.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(3d12+20)[mental]] damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[(6d12+40)[mental]] damage. If the creatures' next d20 roll is a critical success, they earn a critical failure instead. This is a misfortune effect. If all 11 windows transform, Seldeg's ritual finishes ahead of schedule. The stained-glass windows shatter, dealing @Damage[(8d10+52)[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:50] save) to each creature in the room. The hazard then becomes inactive.
stealth: (master) to notice the buildup of divine energy and anticipate its discharge.

actions.name: Reorder Reality
actions.description:
Trigger A creature other than Seldeg enters the area contained by the ritual circles

Effect Arcs of divine energy travel between the two circles. Each creature within the circles takes @Damage[(4d10+26)[spirit]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:45|basic] save). If one of the ritual circles has been disabled, the hazard instead affects all creature in the room, but each creature gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their save. The hazard rolls initiative.

pl.name: Twist of Fate
pl.description: Seldeg's ritual nears its conclusion, causing magical energy to arc erratically between the ritual circles.
pl.disable: @Check[arazni-lore|dc:44] or @Check[iomedae-lore|dc:44] to recount a tale from history that grounds that deity in the current reality, @Check[crafting|dc:50] (legendary) to create a device to siphon energy from the ritual circle, or @Check[religion|dc:46] (legendary) to discharge the escalating divine energy; six successes (three successes per circle) are required to disarm the hazard.
pl.reset: While atop the floating platform, Seldeg Bhedlis can use a 3-action activity with the auditory trait to reenergize the ritual. Doing so removes one success to disable the hazard and immediately triggers the hazard's Reorder Reality reaction.
pl.routine:
(1 action; divine) The divine energy gathered by the ritual spikes. One of the eleven stained-glass windows (each depicting one of her Eleven Acts) transforms to feature Arazni instead. Any creature that can see the window change must attempt a @Check[will|dc:50] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is immune to this effect for 10 minutes.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(3d12+20)[mental]] damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[(6d12+40)[mental]] damage. If the creatures' next d20 roll is a critical success, they earn a critical failure instead. This is a misfortune effect. If all 11 windows transform, Seldeg's ritual finishes ahead of schedule. The stained-glass windows shatter, dealing @Damage[(8d10+52)[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:50] save) to each creature in the room. The hazard then becomes inactive.
pl.stealth: (master) to notice the buildup of divine energy and anticipate its discharge.

name: Twisted King's Court
description: Countless fey with grisly visages and misshapen bodies cavort throughout the room, kicking up caustic debris and pulling other creatures into their dangerous dance.
disable: @Check[nature|dc:32] or @Check[occultism|dc:32] (expert) to perform a ritual to ward the area against fey intrusion, @Check[performance|dc:34] (master) to meet the Twisted King's demands with a disturbing dance, or @Check[athletics|dc:32] or @Check[intimidation|dc:32] (expert) to fend off or frighten the fey dancers. Three total successes are required to disable the haunt, and each check takes 2 actions.
reset: The haunt deactivates after 1 minute. It re-forms every new moon. If all of the glyphs in area B6 are restored—a process requiring 10 days of downtime and 10 successful @Check[nature|dc:36] or @Check[occultism|dc:36] checks—the haunt becomes permanently disabled and doesn't re-form.
routine: (1 action) Spectral fey cavort about the room. All creatures in the room are raked by ghostly claws and splashed with toxic water, taking @Damage[(1d10+14)[force],2d10[acid]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic] save). Creatures that critically fail their Reflex saves are pulled 10 feet toward the standing stones.

actions.name: Welcome to the Feywrithe
actions.description:
Trigger 1 round passes since both isqulugs in area B6 are slain, or 10 rounds pass since they rolled initiative

Effect The isqulugs die horribly (if they're still alive), rent by clawed fey hands. Spectral fey pull at the other creatures in the caves, all of which must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:36] save. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is pulled 10 feet toward the standing stones.

Failure The creature is pulled 15 feet toward the standing stones.

Critical Failure The creature is pulled 15 feet toward the standing stones, knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, and takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage (in addition to any damage from the toxic water).

Creatures that critically fail their Reflex saves are pulled 10 feet toward the standing stones.

name: Tylegmut's Last Meal
description: The former bank manager's ghostly presence tempts creatures to partake in a dubious meal.
disable: @Check[religion|dc:18|name:Recite a Prayer to Urgathoa] (trained) to say a prayer to Urgathoa and put the haunt temporarily to rest until it resets, @Check[occultism|dc:22|name:Commune with the Manager's Spirit] (trained) to commune with the bank manager's spirit and convince her to permanently pass on, disabling the haunt
reset: The haunt re-forms after 1 hour. The haunt becomes disabled and doesn't re-form if a creature eats a full meal at the desk-this can be any food, not just the "food" at hand.
routine: (1 action) The haunt sends a cloud of dust and bone shards hurtling about the room. The dust and bones batter all creatures in the room, dealing @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic]). Creatures who fail the save are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round (or 1 minute on a critical failure).

actions.name: Foul Temptation
actions.description:
Trigger A creature looks over the contents of the desk

Effect The haunt tempts nearby creatures to eat from the plates and bowls arrayed on the desk by concealing it in an illusion of food the viewer finds delicious. Each creature in area D5 must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature sees through the illusion entirely and is temporarily immune to the haunt's routine for 1 minute.

Success The creature is not tempted by the food.

Failure The creature believes the food is appetizing and becomes driven to consume it. The creature takes @Damage[(4d4+4)[slashing]] damage as it chews the jagged bones and husks.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round as the haunt continues to tempt it.

fr.name: Vile tentation
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature examine le contenu du bureau

Effet La hantise incite les créatures proches pour qu'elle mange dans les assiettes et les bols disposés sur le bureau en les dissimulant dans une illusion de nourriture que l'observateur trouve délicieuse. Chaque créature dans la zone D5 doit tenter un jet de @Check[will|dc:21]. Puis la hantise lance l'initiative.

Succès critique La créature perce parfaitement l'illusion et est temporairement immunisée à la routine de la hantise pendant 1 minute.

Succès La créature n'est pas tentée par la nourriture.

Échec La créature considère que la nourriture est appétissante et a envie de la manger. Elle subit @Damage[(4d4+4)[slashing]]{4d4 dégâts tranchants} alors qu'elle mâche des morceaux d'os.

Échec critique Comme en cas d'échec mais la créature est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralysée} pendant 1 round alors que la hantise continue à la tenter.

zh.name: 恶浊诱惑 Foul Temptation
zh.description:
触发 一个生物看了眼桌上的东西

效果 作祟将摆在桌上的盘碗中的食物隐藏于一个令观察者认为它们很美味的幻象中，引诱周围的生物吃下它们。身处D5区的所有生物必须进行一次@Check[will|dc:21]豁免检定。接着，作祟骰先攻。

大成功 该生物完全识破了幻象，并在1分钟内临时免疫作祟的流程。

成功 该生物未被食物引诱。

失败 该生物认为食物十分诱人，并被驱使着去食用它们。该生物会因咀嚼锯齿状的骨骼和虫壳而受到@Damage[(4d4+4)[slashing]]伤害。

大失败 如同失败，但该生物受到双倍伤害并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]1轮，因为作祟正不断地引诱他。

fr.name: Le dernier repas de Tylegmut
fr.description: La forme fantomatique de l'ancien gérant de la banque invite les créatures à partager un repas des plus suspects.
fr.disable: @Check[religion|dc:18|name:Réciter une prière à Urgathoa] (qualifié) pour prier Urgathoa afin de donner un peu de paix temporaire à la hantise jusqu'à qu'elle se réactive ou @Check[occultism|dc:22|name:Communication avec l'esprit du gérant] (qualifié) pour parler au fantôme du gérant de la banque et le convaincre de partir vers son repos éternel, désactivant la hantise.
fr.reset: La hantise se réactive après 1 heure. La hantise ne se réactivera pas et ne se reformera pas si une créature mange un repas complet à son bureau. Cela peut être n'importe quelle nourriture, pas uniquement la "nourriture" qui se trouve sous la main.
fr.routine: (1 action) La hantise projette un nuage de poussière et d'échardes d'os dans la pièce. La poussière et les os frappent toutes les créatures dans la pièce, infligeant @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]]{4d6 dégâts contondants} (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic]). Les créatures qui obtiennent un échec à leur jet de sauvegarde sont @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Aveuglées} pendant 1 round (ou 1 minute sur un échec critique).

zh.name: 泰拉格穆特的最后一餐 Tylegmut's Last Meal

Creatures who fail the save are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round (or 1 minute on a critical failure).

name: Typhoon Koi Egg
description: A raging storm covers the mountain lake as spring water levitates from the lake to fall back down in a driving spiral of steaming rain. In the depths of the storm, barely visible, is a tiny koi egg surrounded by three bands of water.
disable: @Check[arcana|dc:30], @Check[religion|dc:30], @Check[nature|dc:30], or @Check[occultism|dc:30] to purify the magic corrupting the ascension ritual, or @Check[diplomacy|dc:33] or @Check[performance|dc:33] to soothe the spirit within the koi egg and give it the strength to fight off the corruption itself; four total successes are required to purify the ritual, each of the first three successes purifying one ring of water and the final one halting the ritual itself. If the cursed comb has not been removed from the ritual site, then succeeding on this final check merely halts the ritual; if the cursed comb has been removed from the ritual site, then succeeding on this final check completes the ascension ritual.
publication: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-11: The Godsrain and the Dragon
reset: The turbulent koi egg can attempt to hatch again, restarting the ascension ritual, after 1000 years of Xalreonshin's care.
routine: (1 action) Torrential water descends from the sky, taking the shape of a dragon that smashes into one creature within 60 feet of the egg. The dragon always targets the creature that is closest to the egg, dealing @Damage[(2d12+2)[bludgeoning],2d12[fire]]{2d12+2 bludgeoning damage and 2d12 fire} damage in a spray of boiling water (@Check[fortitude|dc:28] save). Creatures that fail the save are pushed 10 feet away. Creatures that have the earth trait, are carrying an item with the earth trait, or are otherwise strongly tied to elemental earth (such as an earth elemental sorcerer or kineticist) get the result one degree of success better than the outcome of their save, as the power of elemental earth overcomes water.

actions.name: Immune to All Damage (Until Final Ring is Purified)

fr.name: Immunité contre tous les dégâts (jusqu'à ce que le dernier anneau soit purifié)

actions.name: Raise the Storm
actions.description:
Trigger Xalreonshin rolls initiative, three rounds pass after the PCs begin speaking with Xalreonshin, or a creature other than Xalreonshin comes within 40 feet of the egg

Effect The turbulent koi egg churns the lake surface, ejecting water into the sky. A 1-mile-radius area centered on the egg becomes filled with heavy rain and strong wind imposing a -2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks and requiring flying creatures to [[/act maneuver-in-flight dc=24]].

fr.name: Provoquer la tempête
fr.description:
Déclencheur Xalreonshin lance l'initiative, trois rounds s'écoulent après que les PJ ont commencé à parler avec Xalreonshin, ou une créature autre que Xalreonshin s'approche à moins de 12 mètres de l'œuf

Effet L'œuf de koï tempête agite la surface du lac, projetant de l'eau vers le ciel. Une zone de 1,6 km de rayon centrée sur l'œuf est recouverte d'une pluie torrentielle et de vents violents, infligeant une pénalité de circonstances de -2 aux tests de Perception et obligeant les créatures volantes à [[/act maneuver-in-flight dc=24]].

fr.name: Oeuf de koï typhon
fr.description: Une tempête déchaînée recouvre le lac montagneux tandis que des eaux printanières s'élèvent du lac pour retomber en une spirale tourbillonnante de pluie fumante. Dans les profondeurs de la tempête, à peine visible, se trouve un minuscule œuf de koï entouré de trois anneaux d'eau.
fr.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:30], @Check[religion|dc:30], @Check[nature|dc:30] ou @Check[occultism|dc:30] pour purifier la magie corrompant le rituel d'ascension, ou @Check[diplomacy|dc:33] ou @Check[performance|dc:33] pour apaiser l'esprit à l'intérieur de l'œuf de koï et lui donner la force de lutter contre la corruption elle-même ; quatre succès au total sont nécessaires pour purifier le rituel, chacun des trois premiers succès purifiant un anneau d'eau et le dernier arrêtant le rituel lui-même. Si le peigne maudit n'a pas été retiré du site du rituel, alors réussir ce dernier test ne fait que stopper le rituel ; si le peigne maudit a été retiré du site du rituel, alors réussir ce dernier test achève le rituel d'ascension.
fr.reset: L'œuf de koï turbulent peut tenter d'éclore à nouveau, redémarrant le rituel d'ascension, après 1000 ans de soins de Xalreonshin.
fr.routine: (1 action) Un torrent d'eau s'abat du ciel, prenant la forme d'un dragon qui s'écrase sur une créature dans un rayon de 18 mètres de l'œuf. Le dragon cible toujours la créature la plus proche de l'œuf, infligeant @Damage[(2d12+2)[bludgeoning],2d12[fire]]{2d12+2 dégâts contondants et 2d12 dégâts de feu} dans un jaillissement d'eau bouillante (@Check[fortitude|dc:28]). Les créatures qui obtiennent un échec à leur jet de sauvegarde sont repoussées de 3 mètres. Les créatures possédant le trait terre, portant un objet avec le trait terre, ou étant fortement liées à la terre élémentaire (comme un sorcier ou kineticiste de la terre) obtiennent un résultat d'un cran supérieur à leur jet, car le pouvoir de la terre élémentaire surpasse celui de l'eau.

name: Tyrant's Orders
description: Yagrekash appears to berate weak soldiers for not doing their part.
disable: @Check[deception|dc:28] (expert) or @Check[performance|dc:28] (expert) to feign joining the fray, or @Check[religion|dc:30] (master) to ward Yagrekash away; three total successes in any combination are required to disable the haunt
reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area of Fort Whiteskull but resets immediately. Tyrant's orders resets 1 day after being disabled if the ancestor storm isn't put to rest.

actions.name: Command of the Legion
actions.description:
Trigger A PC critically fails a skill check to navigate the ancestor storm

Effect Yagrekash barks orders at the PCs to join the battle. All PCs must attempt a @Check[will|dc:27] save; orc and dromaar PCs take a –1 penalty.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} for 1 minute.

Failure The creature is compelled to join the Umbra Legion in battle, taking @Damage[(2d12+13)[mental]] damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but the damage is doubled.

zh.name: 军团之令 Command of the Legion
zh.description:
触发玩家角色在穿越祖灵风暴的技能检定中大失败

效果 亚格雷卡什向玩家角色们下达命令，让他们加入战斗。所有玩家角色必须进行一次 @Check[will|dc:27] 豁免；兽人和半兽人玩家角色-1减值 。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}，持续1分钟。

失败 该生物被迫加入暗影军团作战，承受 @Damage[(2d12+13)[mental]] 伤害。

大失败 如同失败，但伤害加倍。

zh.name: 暴君的命令 Tyrant's Orders
zh.description: 亚格雷卡什似乎在斥责那些不思进取的士兵，指责他们没有尽到自己的职责。
zh.disable: @Check[deception|dc:28] （专家）或@Check[performance|dc:28] （专家） 来装作加入了战斗，或 @Check[religion|dc:30] （大师） 驱离亚格雷卡什；成功通过三次任意组合的技能才能解除作祟。
zh.reset: 当所有生物离开白骨堡垒的区域1分钟后，作祟就会失效，但会立即重置。如果祖灵风暴未被平息，暴君的命令在被禁用1天后会重置。

name: Umbra's Rage
description: The anger of the fallen Umbra Legion seeps into any creature entering combat.
disable: @Check[religion|dc:26] (expert) to exorcise the closest spirits or @Check[diplomacy|dc:30] (expert) to calm them down

actions.name: Curse of Eternal Battle
actions.description:
Trigger A creature enters combat while in Umbra's Last Stand

Effect The creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:26] save as the rage of the surrounding orcs threatens to overwhelm them.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is confused for 1 minute.

zh.name: 永恒战斗诅咒 Curse of Eternal Battle
zh.description:
触发一个生物在暗影之末中进入战斗

效果 生物因周围兽人的狂暴威胁要将其淹没，须进行一次 @Check[will|dc:26] 豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 1}，持续1轮。

失败 该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ] ，持续1轮。

大失败 如同失败，但是困惑状态持续1分钟。

zh.name: 暗影之怒 Umbra's Rage
zh.description: 堕落的暗影军团的怒火会侵染任何进入战斗的生物。
zh.disable: @Check[religion|dc:26] (专家) 来驱逐最近的精魂或 @Check[diplomacy|dc:30] (专家)来安抚它们。

pl.name: Umbra's Rage

pl.disable: @Check[religion|dc:26] (expert) to exorcise the closest spirits or @Check[diplomacy|dc:30] (expert) to calm them down

name: Unbreakable Sorrow
description: The PCs hear the sound of sobbing and feel an overwhelming sense of sorrow, as if they'd lost something more precious to them than their own life.
disable: @Check[deception|dc:32] or @Check[performance|dc:32] (master) to laugh away the sadness, @Check[occultism|dc:31] (expert) to banish the psychic imprint, @Check[thievery|dc:33] (master) to disperse the emotional energy
reset: The trap resets automatically after 24 hours.

actions.name: Mourn
actions.description:
Trigger A living creature approaches the statue

Effect The trap deals @Damage[(4d10+14)[mental]] damage to all creatures in the room (@Check[will|dc:28|basic] save). On a failed save, a creature additionally falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and begins to weep, taking @Damage[1d10[persistent,mental]] damage.

fr.name: Faire le deuil
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature vivante approche de la statue

Effet Le piège inflige @Damage[(4d10+14)[mental]]{4d10+14 dégâts mentaux} à toutes les créatures dans la pièce (@Check[will|dc:28|basic]). En cas d'échec, une créature se met également @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{À terre} et commence à pleurer, subissant @Damage[1d10[persistent,mental]]{1d10 dégâts mentaux persistants}.

zh.name: Mourn
zh.description:
Trigger A living creature approaches the statue

Effect The trap deals @Damage[(4d10+14)[mental]] damage to all creatures in the room (@Check[will|dc:28|basic] save). On a failed save, a creature additionally falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and begins to weep, taking @Damage[1d10[persistent,mental]] damage.

fr.name: Chagrin insurmontable
fr.description: Les PJ entendent des bruits de sanglots et ressentent un sentiment de chagrin irrépréssible comme s'ils avaient perdu quelque chose de plus précis que leur propre vie.
fr.disable: @Check[deception|dc:32|name:évacuer la tristesse] ou @Check[performance|dc:32|name:évacuer la tristesse] (maître) pour évacuer la tristesse, @Check[occultism|dc:31|name:bannir l'empreinte psychique] (expert) pour bannir l'empreinte psychique, @Check[thievery|dc:33|name:disperser l'énergie émotionnelle] (maître) pour disperser l'énergie émotionnelle

pl.name: Unbreakable Sorrow
pl.description: The PCs hear the sound of sobbing and feel an overwhelming sense of sorrow, as if they'd lost something more precious to them than their own life.

description: Magical energy contained within the room surges in flashes of dark lightning.

actions.name: Necromantic Discharge
actions.description:
Trigger A creature steps into the room.

Effect The necromantic energy pulsing throughout the room branches out like lightning, inundating any creatures in the room or the three squares of hallway outside it. Each creature in those areas must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:18|traits:damaging-effect] save as they are suffused with dark energy, which deals @Damage[2d8[void]] damage, or @Damage[2d8[vitality]] damage to any creature with void healing.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 hour.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is enfeebled 1 for 1 hour.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is enfeebled 1 for 1 day.

fr.name: Décharge nécromantique
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature pénètre dans la pièce.

Effet L'énergie nécromantique qui palpite dans la pièce se ramifie comme un éclair, inondant toutes les créatures qui se trouvent dans la pièce ou dans les trois carrés de couloir à l'extérieur de celle-ci. Chaque créature qui se tient dans cette zone doivent effectuer un jet de @Check[fortitude|dc:18|traits:damaging-effect] alors qu'elles sont empreint de cette sombre énergie, qui inflige @Damage[2d8[void]]{2d8 dégâts de vide}, ou @Damage[2d8[vitality]]{2d8 dégâts de vitalité} à toutes les créatures qui possèdent la guérison du vide.

Succès critique La créature n'est pas affectée.

Succès La créature subit la moitié des dégâts et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Affaiblie 1} pendant 1 heure.

Échec La créature subit tout les dégâts et est Affaiblie 1 pendant 1 heure.

Échec critique La créature subit le double des dégâts et est Affaiblie pendant 1 journée.

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 Enfeebled 1}，持续1小时。

失败 生物受到完整伤害，陷入力竭1，持续1小时。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害，陷入力竭1，持续1天。

name: Unfinished Portalrender
description: A sphere of concentrated agony harvested from a qlippoth begins pulsing with violet light as it blasts the room with otherworldly agony.
disable: @Check[thievery|dc:37] (master) to dismantle the housing and refocus the agony inward so it consumes itself harmlessly, @Check[arcana|dc:33] or @Check[occultism|dc:33] (master) to vent the agony in a controlled way that causes the portalrender to become inert after 1 minute (during which it can still be triggered normally), or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (7th rank; counteract DC 31)
routine: The unfinished portalrender continues to flood area B4 with agony, and everyone in the room must attempt a @Check[will|dc:33] save against its Agonizing Pulse. At the end of its turn, the unfinished portalrender attempts a @Check[flat|dc:6]. On a failure, its stores of agony deplete and it deactivates, causing the central orb of agony to fade away permanently.

actions.name: Agonizing Pulse
actions.description:
Trigger The unfinished portalrender takes any damage or is moved (the portalrender is Bulk 5)

Effect The central sphere of concentrated agony flashes bright violet, filling the mind's of the room's inhabitants with overwhelming mental sensations of pain and hallucinations that the world around them is being torn away and replaced by a demon-haunted apocalypse. All creatures in area B4 must attempt a @Check[will|dc:33] save, then the trap rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[4d6[mental]] damage from the pain.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[8d6[mental]] damage from the pain and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} until the end of their next turn.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[16d6[mental]] damage from the pain, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}, and is confused for 1 minute.

fr.name: Pulsation agonisante
fr.description:
Déclencheur Le sourceportail subit des dégâts ou est déplacé (Encombrement 5)

Effet La sphère centrale d'agonie concentrée s'illumine en un lumière violette brillante, emplissant les pensées des occupants de la zone avec des sensations subjugante mentales de douleurs et d'hallucinations que le monde autour d'eux est en train d'être déchiqueté en une apocalypse hantée par des démons. Toutes les créatures dans la zone B4 doivent tenter un jet de @Check[will|dc:33], puis le piège détermine l'initiative.

Succès critique La créature n'est pas affectée.

Succès La créature subit @Damage[4d6[mental]]{4d6 dégâts mentaux} provoqués par la douleur.

Échec La créature subit @Damage[8d6[mental]]{8d6 dégâts mentaux} provoqués par la douleur et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Étourdie} jusqu'à la fin de son prochain tour.

Échec critique La créature subit @Damage[16d6[mental]]{16d6 dégâts mentaux} provoqués par la douleur, est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupéfiée 1} et Étourdie pendant 1 minute.

name: Unfulfilling Banquet
description: This banquet table is covered with a wide range of delicious-looking snacks and a mix of chilled and piping hot beverages.
disable: @Check[religion|dc:48] to offer prayers to neutralize the sour reputation of the food and render it safe to eat
reset: The unfulfilling banquet resets instantly.

actions.name: Disappoint Feaster
actions.description:
Trigger A creature tastes any of the food or beverages on the banquet table

Effect The flavor blooming in the triggering creature's mouth simultaneously delights and frustrates the triggering creature, who must attempt a @Check[will|dc:47] save.

Critical Success The triggering creature is unsatisfied by the taste, but is otherwise temporarily immune to the Unfulfilling Banquet for 24 hours.

Success The triggering creature is momentarily distracted by their unsatisfying taste, and until the start of their next turn takes a –2 status penalty to Perception checks.

Failure The triggering creature becomes obsessed with dissatisfaction and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (or increases their existing stupefied condition value from this hazard by 1, to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}) for an unlimited duration.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is compelled to taste something else from the table on their next turn and won't willingly move away from the table until they do so. They take a –2 status penalty on their Will save to resist the hazard's effects on their next taste.

name: Unruly Crowd
description: Concerned citizens shout slogans about the dangers of dealing with Cheliax and throw bricks at Chelaxian sympathizers.
disable: Succeed at two of the following checks in any combination: @Check[athletics|dc:20] (trained) to confiscate dangerous debris, @Check[diplomacy|dc:20] (trained) to calm the crowd, @Check[intimidation|dc:18] (untrained) to scare the crowd away, @Check[will|dc:22] (trained) to maintain a brave and confident demeanor; an effect such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b515AZlB0sridKSq]{Calm} that can target an area counts as one automatic success.
routine: (three actions) The unruly crowd uses an action to chant a Catchy Slogan if it is not already benefiting from the effect It uses Shake Confidence once per turn and uses its remaining actions for cobblestone Strikes.
stealth: (trained) Characters automatically detect this hazard when they open the door to the Grand Hall.

actions.name: There They Are!
actions.description:
Trigger A creature opens the door to the Grand Hall

Effect The unruly crowd rolls Initiative.

fr.name: Ils sont là !
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature ouvre la porte de la Grande Salle.

Effet La foule incontrôlée détermine l'initiative.

actions.name: Catchy Slogan
actions.description:
All the hazards in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.wFpKEx9KSjoVg9xq]{Effect: Catchy Slogan}

fr.description:
Tous les pièges dans une @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]{émanation de 9 mètres} obtiennent un bonus de statut de +1 aux jets d'attaque et aux jets de dégâts pendant 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.wFpKEx9KSjoVg9xq]{Effet : Slogan Entraînant}

actions.name: Shake Confidence
actions.description:
The unruly crowd targets a creature within 30 feet The creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:20] save

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and immune to Shake Confidence for 24 hours

Success The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}

Critical Failure The creature becomes frightened 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}.

fr.name: Ébranler la confiance
fr.description:
La foule incontrôlée cible une créature dans un rayon de 9 mètres. La créature doit tenter un jet de @Check[will|dc:20].

Succès critique La créature n'est pas affectée et est immunisée contre Ébranler la confiance pendant 24 heures.

Succès La créature devient @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 1}.

Échec La créature devient @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 2}.
