name: Xarwin Portraits
description: The paintings suddenly start to bleed-Ioseff Xarwin from the left wrist and the other three Xarwins in a line cutting across their brows-as the viewers receive glimpses of the traumas the family endured.
disable: @Check[religion|dc:25|name:Exorcise Painting] to exorcise one of the paintings (a critical success exorcises all of the paintings at once) or @Check[thievery|dc:21|name:Cover a Painting|traits:action:disable-a-device] to quickly cover a painting with a cloak or remove it and turn it to face the wall
reset: 1 hour; putting Xarwin's ghost to rest destroys this haunt forever.
routine:
(4 actions) The haunt uses up to 4 actions to afflict bleeding wounds on different creatures in area B22. These bloody wounds manifest where the target would have felt pain from Inflict Agony, regardless of whether they succeeded in resisting that effect or not. A creature can't be targeted more than once by this routine. Each creature affected must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:24|traits:emotion,fear,mental,necromancy,occult] save.

The haunt loses 1 action for each painting that's disabled or destroyed.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[(1d8+3)[slashing]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} by the conviction that these wounds were caused by a loved one.

Failure As success, but @Damage[(2d8+6)[slashing]] damage, @Damage[1d6[bleed]], and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure As failure, but @Damage[(4d8+12)[slashing]] damage, @Damage[2d6[bleed]], and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}. Increase the value of the character's malevolence condition by 1.

actions.name: Inflict Agony
actions.description:
Trigger At least four characters are in area B22, or someone touches or attempts to damage a painting

Effect All characters in area B22 must attempt a @Check[will|dc:27] save to resist sudden, agonizing pain (the PC with the highest Intelligence feels this pain in the left wrist, while the others feel it in their heads). On a failure, a PC becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} from the agony (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). The haunt then rolls initiative.

fr.name: Infliger l'agonie
fr.description:
Déclencheur Au moins quatre personnages se tiennent dans la zone B22 ou quelqu'un touche ou essaye d'endommager la peinture

Effet Tous les personnages dans la zone B22 doivent tenter un jet de @Check[will|dc:27] pour résister à une soudaine forte douleur (le PJ qui a le plus haut modificateur d'intelligence le ressent dans son poignet gauche, alors que d'autres le ressentent sur le front). En cas d'échec, un PJ devient @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Nauséeuse 1} à cause de la douleur intense (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Nauséeuse 2} sur un échec critique). Puis la hantise lance l'initiative.

zh.name: 施加痛苦 Inflict Agony
zh.description:
触发 至少有四个角色在B22区域，或者有人触碰或试图破坏一幅画

效果 B22 区域的所有角色必须尝试@Check[will|dc:27]豁免来抵抗突如其来的痛苦（智力最高的人在左手腕感到这种疼痛，而其他人则在头部感到这种痛苦）。如果失败，PC就会因痛苦而获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 1}（大失败则@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 2}）。然后作祟骰先攻。

fr.name: Les portraits de Xarwin
fr.description: Les peintures commencent soudainement à saigner - Ioseff Xarwin au poignet gauche et les trois autres Xarwin sur une ligne qui coupe leur front alors que les spectateurs perçoivent des flashs de ce que la famille a enduré.
fr.disable: Test de @Check[religion|dc:25|name:Exorciser la peinture] pour exorciser une des peintures (un succès critique exorcise toutes les peintures en une fois) ou test de @Check[thievery|dc:21|name:Recouvrir la peinture|traits:action:disable-a-device] pour couvrir la peinture rapidement avec une cape ou la prendre et la retourner face contre le mur
fr.reset: 1 heure ; donner le repos éternel au fantôme de Xarwin détruit L'apparition.
fr.routine:
(4 actions) La hantise utilise jusqu'à 4 actions pour infliger des blessures de saignement au hasard sur différentes créatures qui se tiennent dans la zone B22. Ces blessures sanguinolentes se manifestent là où les cibles auraient ressentis la douleur de Infliger l'agonie, indépendamment du fait qu'ils aient résisté à l'effet ou pas. Une créature ne peut être ciblée plus d'une fois durant cette routine. Chaque créature affectée doit réussir un jet de @Check[fortitude|dc:24|traits:emotion,fear,mental,necromancy,occult].

La hantise perd une action pour chaque peinture qui a été désactivée ou détruite.

Succès critique La créature n'est pas affectée.

Succès La créature subit @Damage[(1d8+3)[slashing]]{1d8+3 dégâts tranchants} et devient @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 1} par la conviction que ces blessures ont été infligées par quelqu'un qu'elle aime.

Échec Comme en cas de succès, mais la créature subit @Damage[(2d8+6)[slashing]]{2d8+6 dégâts tranchants}, @Damage[1d6[bleed]]{1d6 dégâts de saignement} et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 2}.

Échec critique Comme en cas d'échec, mais la créature subit @Damage[(4d8+12)[slashing]]{4d8 dégâts tranchants}, @Damage[2d6[bleed]]{2d6 dégâts de saignement} et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 3}. Augmentez la valeur de malévolence du personnage de 1.

zh.name: 夏尔文画像 Xarwin Portraits
zh.description: 画作突然开始流血，位置在约瑟夫夏尔文的左手腕处，其他三位夏尔文则是穿过眉毛的一条线，同时观看者会感受到家族承受的精神创伤。
zh.disable: @Check[religion|dc:25|name:Exorcise Painting]检定可以驱除其中一幅画（大成功可以同时驱除所有的画），或者@Check[thievery|dc:21|name:Cover a Painting|traits:action:disable-a-device]迅速用斗篷盖住一幅画，或者把它取下并转过去面对墙。
zh.reset: 1小时；让夏尔文的鬼魂安息会永远摧毁这个作祟。
zh.routine:
（4 个动作）作祟最多使用4个动作，在B22区域的不同生物身上施加流血的伤口。这些流血伤口显现在目标会从“施加痛苦”中感受到疼痛的地方，不管他们是否成功地抵抗了该效果。一个生物不能被这个流程作为目标超过一次。每个受影响生物都必须尝试@Check[fortitude|dc:24|traits:emotion,fear,mental,necromancy,occult]豁免。

每一幅画被解除或毁掉，作祟就会失去一个动作。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到@Damage[(1d8+3)[slashing]]伤害，并因确信这些伤口是由所爱之人造成而获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}。

失败 和成功一样，但受到@Damage[(2d8+6)[slashing]]伤害，@Damage[1d6[bleed]]伤害，并获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 2}。

大失败 与失败相同，但受到@Damage[(4d8+12)[slashing]]伤害，@Damage[2d6[bleed]]伤害，并获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 3}。将角色的咒怨状态值增加1。

pl.name: Xarwin Portraits
pl.description: The paintings suddenly start to bleed-Ioseff Xarwin from the left wrist and the other three Xarwins in a line cutting across their brows-as the viewers receive glimpses of the traumas the family endured.
pl.disable: @Check[religion|dc:25|name:Exorcise Painting] to exorcise one of the paintings (a critical success exorcises all of the paintings at once) or @Check[thievery|dc:21|name:Cover a Painting|traits:action:disable-a-device] to quickly cover a painting with a cloak or remove it and turn it to face the wall
pl.reset: 1 hour; putting Xarwin's ghost to rest destroys this haunt forever.
pl.routine:
(4 actions) The haunt uses up to 4 actions to afflict bleeding wounds on different creatures in area B22. These bloody wounds manifest where the target would have felt pain from Inflict Agony, regardless of whether they succeeded in resisting that effect or not. A creature can't be targeted more than once by this routine. Each creature affected must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:24|traits:emotion,fear,mental,necromancy,occult] save.

The haunt loses 1 action for each painting that's disabled or destroyed.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[(1d8+3)[slashing]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} by the conviction that these wounds were caused by a loved one.

Failure As success, but @Damage[(2d8+6)[slashing]] damage, @Damage[1d6[bleed]], and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure As failure, but @Damage[(4d8+12)[slashing]] damage, @Damage[2d6[bleed]], and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}. Increase the value of the character's malevolence condition by 1.

name: Yellow Mold
description: Poisonous mold spores assault nearby creatures.
disable: @Check[survival|dc:26|name:Remove the Mold] (expert) to remove the mold without triggering the spores

actions.name: Spore Explosion
actions.description:
Trigger A creature moves into the mold's space or damages the mold. The mold can't use this reaction if it's in direct sunlight or if the damage was fire damage.

Effect The triggering creature and all creatures within @Template[emanation|distance:10]{10 feet} are exposed to yellow mold spores.

fr.name: Explosion de spores
fr.description:
Déclencheur Une créature endommage la moisissure ou entre dans l'espace qu'elle occupe. La moisissure ne peut pas effectuer cette réaction si elle est directement exposée à la lumière du soleil ou si les dégâts qu'elle a subis sont des dégâts de feu.

Effet La créature à l'origine du déclenchement et toutes celles à @Template[emanation|distance:10]{3 mètres} ou moins sont exposées aux spores de la moisissure jaune.

zh.name: 孢子爆发 Spore Explosion
zh.description:
触发 一个生物移动到霉菌占据的空间或对霉菌造成伤害。如果霉菌被阳光直射，或伤害类型为火焰伤害，则该反应动作不可用；

效果 目标生物和@Template[emanation|distance:10]{10尺}范围内的所有生物都暴露在黄霉菌孢子中。

actions.name: Yellow Mold Spores
actions.description:
Any drained condition from the spores persists after the poison's duration ends.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:26]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d8[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[2d8[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[3d8[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3} (1 round)

fr.name: Spores de moisissure jaune
fr.description:
Tout état Drainé infligé par les spores persiste après la fin de la durée du poison.

Jet de sauvegarde @Check[fortitude|dc:26]

Durée maximale 6 rounds

Stade 1 @Damage[1d8[poison]]{1d8 dégâts de poison} et @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drainé 1} (1 round)

Stade 2 @Damage[2d8[poison]]{2d8 dégâts de poison} et @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drainé 2} (1 round)

Stade 3 @Damage[3d8[poison]]{3d8 dégâts de poison} et @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drainé 3} (1 round)

zh.name: 黄霉菌孢子 Yellow Mold Spores
zh.description:
孢子造成的任何流失状态都持续到毒素的持续时间结束之后；

豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:26]

最大持续时间 6轮

阶段1 @Damage[1d8[poison]]伤害和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 Drained 1}（1轮）

阶段2 @Damage[2d8[poison]]伤害和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 Drained 2}（1轮）

阶段3 @Damage[3d8[poison]]伤害和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 Drained 3}（1轮）

fr.name: Moisissure jaune
fr.description: Les spores de la moisissure empoisonnent les créatures à proximité.
fr.disable: @Check[survival|dc:26|name:Retirer la moisissure] (expert) pour enlever la moisissure sans déclencher le nuage de spores.

zh.name: 黄霉菌 Yellow Mold
zh.description: 有毒的霉菌孢子攻击附近的生物。
zh.disable: @Check[survival|dc:26|name:Remove the Mold] （专家）可以移除霉菌而不触发孢子。

pl.name: Żółta Pleśń
pl.description: Trujące zarodniki pleśni atakują pobliskie stworzenia.
pl.disable: @Check[survival|dc:26|name:Usuwanie pleśni] (ekspert) aby usunąć pleśń bez wyzwalania zarodników

name: Zogototaru
description: Narseigus's worm-calling enchantments have attained imperfect control over Zogototaru, compelling her to aid him. She follows his directions loosely and with little finesse.
disable: Disable @Check[arcana|dc:28] or @Check[occultism|dc:28] (trained) to identify a loophole in mind-controlling magic, @Check[diplomacy|dc:30] to reason with Zogototaru, or @Check[deception|dc:31] or @Check[performance|dc:31] to speak as if the PC were Taargick
routine: (1 action) Zogototaru acts on Narseigus's most recent command, either Rescuing, Roaring, or Thrashing.

actions.name: Rescue
actions.description: Zogototaru lunges near Narseigus, flips him atop her head, and recoils. This moves Narseigus up to 30 feet horizontally and positions him atop Zogototaru, treating her head as a 10-by-10-foot space that's 20 feet above the magma's surface. This movement triggers reactions based on the move trait, targeting Narseigus. Zogototaru continues supporting Narseigus until ordered to perform a different action, after which she deposits him in a safe location within 30 feet as a free action. A PC can Climb (@Check[athletics|dc:25]) Zogototaru's coarse hide to reach him.

fr.name: Sauver
fr.description: Zogototaru se jette sur Narseigus, le projette au-dessus de sa tête, puis se recule. Cela déplace Narséigus jusqu'à 9 mètres horizontalement et le positionne au dessus de Zogototaru, considérant sa tête comme un espace de 3 mètres sur 3 qui se trouve à 6 mètres au-dessus de la surface de magma. Ce déplacement déclenche les réactions basées sur le trait déplacement, en ciblant Narséigus. Zogototaru continue à soutenir Narséigus jusqueà ce qu'elle se voir ordonner d'accomplir une action différente, après quoi elle le dépose en lieu sûr dans les 9 mètres par une action gratuite. Un PJ peut Escalader (@Check[athletics|dc:25]) la peau rugueuse du Zogototaru pour l'atteindre.

zh.name: Rescue
zh.description: Zogototaru lunges near Narseigus, flips him atop her head, and recoils. This moves Narseigus up to 30 feet horizontally and positions him atop Zogototaru, treating her head as a 10-by-10-foot space that's 20 feet above the magma's surface. This movement triggers reactions based on the move trait, targeting Narseigus. Zogototaru continues supporting Narseigus until ordered to perform a different action, after which she deposits him in a safe location within 30 feet as a free action. A PC can Climb (@Check[athletics|dc:25]) Zogototaru's coarse hide to reach him.

actions.name: Roar
actions.description:
Zogototaru looms and screeches ferociously. Creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:60] take @Damage[6d6[sonic]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:29|basic] save) and must attempt a @Check[will|dc:29] save.

Critical Success No effect.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

fr.name: Rugir
fr.description:
Zogototaru se dresse, menaçante, et pousse des cris perçants. Les créatures dans un @Template[cone|distance:60]{cône de 18 mètres} subissent @Damage[6d6[sonic]]{6d6 dégâts de son} (@Check[fortitude|dc:29|basic]) et doivent tenter un jet de @Check[will|dc:29].

Succès critique Aucun effet.

Succès La créature est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 1}.

Échec La créature est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 2}.

Échec critique La créature est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Sourde} pendant [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 3}.

zh.name: Roar
zh.description:
Zogototaru looms and screeches ferociously. Creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:60] take @Damage[6d6[sonic]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:29|basic] save) and must attempt a @Check[will|dc:29] save.

Critical Success No effect.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

actions.name: Thrash
actions.description:
Zogototaru lashes her body, rattling the ground and splashing magma in a @Template[cone|distance:30]. Creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:29] save.

Critical Success No effect.

Success The creature takes @Damage[4d6[fire]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[4d6[fire]] damage and @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] damage, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[6d6[fire]] damage and @Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]] damage, and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Special The first time she Thrashes, Zogototaru destroys the pillars in area F2a. Anyone there can leap free as part of their Reflex saving throw, landing on the closest surface. For the remainder of combat, the rear half of the crimson worm's body floats in the magma there, creating an improvised bridge 10 feet wide and 30 feet long. Creatures on Zogototaru take a –2 circumstance penalty to their Reflex saves against her Thrashing.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.QzJv3TybABeCjwQc]{Effect: Riding Zogototaru}

fr.name: Rosser
fr.description:
Zogototaru se met à fouetter l'air, faisant trembler le sol et projetant du magma dans un cône de @Template[cone|distance:30]. Les créatures dans la zone doivent tenter un jet de @Check[reflex|dc:29].

Succès critique Aucun effet.

Succès La créature subit @Damage[4d6[fire]]{4d6 dégâts de feu}.

Échec La créature subit @Damage[4d6[fire]]{4d6 dégâts de feu} et @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]]{4d6 dégâts contondants} et est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Maladroite 1} pendant 1 round.

Échec critique La créature subit @Damage[6d6[fire]]{6d6 dégâts de feu} et @Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]]{6d6 dégâts contondants} et est mise @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{À terre}.

Spécial La première fois qu'elle rosse, Zogototaru détruit les piliers de la zone F2a. Quiconquese trouve ici peut se libérer en effectuant son jet de Réflexes, atterrissant sur la surface la plus proche. Pendant lerste du combat, la moitié arrière du corps du ver pourpre flotte dans le magma à cet endroit, créant unpont improvisé de 3 mètres de large et 9 mètres de long. Les créatures sur Zogototaru subissent une pénalité de circonstances de -2 à leurs jets de Réflexes lorsqu'elle Rosse.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.QzJv3TybABeCjwQc]{Effect: Riding Zogototaru}

Success The creature takes @Damage[4d6[fire]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[4d6[fire]] damage and @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] damage, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[6d6[fire]] damage and @Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]] damage, and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Creatures on Zogototaru take a –2 circumstance penalty to their Reflex saves against her Thrashing.

fr.name: Zogototaru
fr.description: Les enchantements d'invocateur de ver de Narséigus ont permis de lui donner un contrôle imparfait sur Zogototaru, l'obligeant à l'aider. Elle suit ses directives sans grande rigueur et avec peu de finesse.
fr.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:28] ou @Check[occultism|dc:28] (qualifié) pour identifier une faille dans la magie de contrôle mental, @Check[diplomacy|dc:30] pour raisonner Zogototaru ou @Check[deception|dc:31] ou @Check[performance|dc:31] pour parler comme si le PJ était Taargick
fr.routine: (1 action) Zogototaru exécute le dernier ordre donné par Narséigus : Sauver, Rugir ou Rosser.

pl.name: Zogototaru
pl.description: Narseigus's worm-calling enchantments have attained imperfect control over Zogototaru, compelling her to aid him. She follows his directions loosely and with little finesse.
pl.disable: Disable @Check[arcana|dc:28] or @Check[occultism|dc:28] (trained) to identify a loophole in mind-controlling magic, @Check[diplomacy|dc:30] to reason with Zogototaru, or @Check[deception|dc:31] or @Check[performance|dc:31] to speak as if the PC were Taargick
pl.routine: (1 action) Zogototaru acts on Narseigus's most recent command, either Rescuing, Roaring, or Thrashing.

name: Zutha's Legacy
description: The scowling visage of Runelord Zutha appears above the altar. Meanwhile, mask-like versions of Zutha's face manifest on nearby rubble and vomit swarms of maggots. Once the masks are destroyed, the air fills with spectral duplicates of Zutha's life-draining bone scythe.
disable: @Check[occultism|dc:45] (legendary) or Religion (legendary) to exorcise Zutha's spirit, or @Check[intimidation|dc:48] (master) or @Check[performance|dc:48] (master) to recite the details of Zutha's defeat; six total successes are required to disable the haunt.
reset: The haunt deactivates once no living creatures remain nearby. The haunt resets 1 hour later.
routine: (4 actions) The haunt uses Vomit Maggot three times, then Poisonous Belch once. For each success at Disabling the haunt, the haunt loses one Vomit Maggot action. Destroying a mask also removes one of the haunt's Vomit Maggot actions. Once the haunt can no longer use Vomit Maggot, it immediately regains three actions and replaces Vomit Maggot with Spectral Scythe. Destroying a scythe also removes one of the haunt's Spectral Scythe actions. Once the haunt loses all three of its Spectral Scythe actions, the haunt is destroyed.
stealth: (expert) to sense Zutha's hungry spirit before it manifests

actions.name: Howl of Rage
actions.description:
Trigger A living creature attempts to descend the stairwell at area A1 a into the islet's interior

Effect A ghostly version of Zutha's face appears above the island. Meanwhile, the rubble on the islet warps into smaller versions of Zutha's face. The faces howl in rage as one. All creatures on the islet must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:42] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} on a critical failure). The haunt then rolls initiative.

zh.name: 愤怒咆哮 Howl of Rage
zh.description:
触发 一名活物试图从区域A1a的楼梯井下到小岛内部

效果 祖萨作祟般的脸孔浮现在岛屿上方，同时小岛上的碎石扭曲成较小的祖萨脸孔的样子。这些脸孔一同发出愤怒的咆哮。岛上的所有生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[will|dc:42] 意志豁免，否则将陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}（若大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 3}）。随后，作祟骰先攻。

actions.name: Vomit Maggot
actions.description: One of Zutha's rubble-masks vomits a swarm of maggots. (The masks appear everywhere on the islet, and destroyed masks reform moments later, making nowhere on the islet safe.) The maggots burrow into the flesh of a creature of the GM's choice. The creature takes @Damage[2d12[persistent,piercing]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:42|basic] save) and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for as long as they continue taking this damage. When the persistent damage ends, the maggots dissolve into foul-smelling oil.

zh.name: 喷吐蛆虫 Vomit Maggot
zh.description: 祖萨的碎石面具之一喷吐出一群蛆虫。（面具出现在小岛各处，被摧毁的面具很快又会重新形成，使得小岛上没有安全之处。）蛆虫会钻入由GM选择的生物体内。该生物受到 @Damage[2d12[persistent,piercing]] 伤害（ @Check[fortitude|dc:42|basic] 豁免），并在持续受到此伤害期间陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1}。当持续伤害结束时，蛆虫会溶解成一股恶臭的油。

actions.name: Spectral Scythe
actions.description:
One of Zutha's scythes swipes at a creature of the GM's choice. The creature must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:42] save with the following results.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[(3d10+10)[void]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(6d10+10)[void]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[(12d10+10)[void]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}.

zh.name: 幽魂骨镰 Spectral Scythe
zh.description:
祖萨的一把骨镰挥向由GM选择的生物。该生物必须尝试 @Check[reflex|dc:42] 豁免，结果如下：

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到 @Damage[(3d10+10)[void]] 伤害。

失败 生物受到 @Damage[(6d10+10)[void]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 Drained 1}。

大失败 生物受到 @Damage[(12d10+10)[void]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 Drained 2}。

actions.name: Poisonous Belch
actions.description:
The ghostly image of Zutha's face belches a toxic cloud that reeks of decaying flesh. The cloud fills a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] centered anywhere on the island and lasts until the haunt's next turn. Any creature that enters the area or that starts its turn in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:44] save with the following results.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[5d8[poison]|options:area-damage] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[10d8[poison]|options:area-damage] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[20d8[poison]|options:area-damage] damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for as long as it remains sickened.

zh.name: 毒气喷吐 Poisonous Belch
zh.description:
祖萨面孔的灵魂影像喷吐出一股散发着腐烂肉味的毒云。毒云充满以小岛上任意一处为中心的 @Template[type:burst|distance:10] 范围，并持续到作祟的下一回合。任何进入该区域或在该区域内开始回合的生物必须尝试 @Check[fortitude|dc:44] 豁免，结果如下：

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到 @Damage[5d8[poison]|options:area-damage] 伤害。

失败 生物受到 @Damage[10d8[poison]|options:area-damage] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 1}。

大失败 生物受到 @Damage[20d8[poison]|options:area-damage] 伤害，陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 Sickened 2}，并在恶心状态持续期间陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1}。

pl.name: Zutha's Legacy
pl.description: The scowling visage of Runelord Zutha appears above the altar. Meanwhile, mask-like versions of Zutha's face manifest on nearby rubble and vomit swarms of maggots. Once the masks are destroyed, the air fills with spectral duplicates of Zutha's life-draining bone scythe.
pl.disable: @Check[occultism|dc:45] (legendary) or Religion (legendary) to exorcise Zutha's spirit, or @Check[intimidation|dc:48] (master) or @Check[performance|dc:48] (master) to recite the details of Zutha's defeat; six total successes are required to disable the haunt.
pl.reset: The haunt deactivates once no living creatures remain nearby. The haunt resets 1 hour later.
pl.routine: (4 actions) The haunt uses Vomit Maggot three times, then Poisonous Belch once. For each success at Disabling the haunt, the haunt loses one Vomit Maggot action. Destroying a mask also removes one of the haunt's Vomit Maggot actions. Once the haunt can no longer use Vomit Maggot, it immediately regains three actions and replaces Vomit Maggot with Spectral Scythe. Destroying a scythe also removes one of the haunt's Spectral Scythe actions. Once the haunt loses all three of its Spectral Scythe actions, the haunt is destroyed.
pl.stealth: (expert) to sense Zutha's hungry spirit before it manifests
